[h1]Cyberpunk 2077 & Phantom Liberty – Fast 1000 Stunden in Night City[/h1]

[b]Mein Fazit vorweg: Eines der besten Rollenspiele aller Zeiten.[/b]

[h2]Meine Spielzeit in Zahlen[/h2]
Ich habe Cyberpunk 2077 nicht einmal, sondern zweimal gekauft – und bereue keinen Cent. Über 500 Stunden habe ich zunächst in der GOG-Version verbracht, seit dem Release-Tag im Dezember 2020. Danach habe ich mir die [b]Ultimate Edition auf Steam[/b] noch einmal zugelegt und dort weitere [b]443 Stunden[/b] in Night City gelebt. Zusammengerechnet bin ich bei knapp 1000 Stunden – eine Zahl, die ich sonst bei keinem anderen Singleplayer-RPG auch nur annähernd erreicht habe.

[h2]Der Release: Für mich kein Desaster[/h2]
Viel wurde über den katastrophalen Start des Spiels geschrieben, besonders auf den Last-Gen-Konsolen. Meine Erfahrung war eine andere: Mein damaliger PC war offenbar leistungsstark genug, sodass ich bereits zum Release eine weitgehend problemfreie Erfahrung hatte. Die Atmosphäre von Night City, die Charaktere und die Geschichte haben mich von der ersten Stunde an gepackt – lange bevor Patch 2.0 und Phantom Liberty das Spiel endgültig rehabilitierten.

[h2]Der zweite Durchgang: Pathtracing, Mods und ein neuer PC[/h2]
Mit einem neuen Rechner habe ich das Spiel auf Steam quasi neu erlebt. Mit [b]Pathtracing[/b] und Grafikeinstellungen auf höchstem Niveau ist Cyberpunk 2077 auch heute noch ein technisches Schaufenster: die Neonreflexionen auf regennassem Asphalt, die Sonnenuntergänge über den Badlands, die Lichtstimmung in den engen Gassen von Dogtown – das erreicht kaum ein anderes Spiel. Ergänzt habe ich das Ganze mit [b]Mods von Nexus Mods über Vortex[/b], was dem Spiel in meinem zweiten Durchgang noch einmal frischen Wind verliehen hat. Die Mod-Community ist aktiv, vielfältig und hält das Spiel für Veteranen wie mich lebendig.

[h2]Phantom Liberty: Ein Agententhriller auf Höchstniveau[/h2]
Die Erweiterung setzt mitten in der Haupthandlung an und führt V in den abgeriegelten Stadtteil Dogtown. Der Auftrag: die abgestürzte Präsidentin der NUSA retten – an der Seite der Netrunnerin Songbird und des FIA-Agenten Solomon Reed, gesprochen von Idris Elba. Was folgt, ist ein dichter Spionagethriller mit gebrochenen Loyalitäten, moralischen Grauzonen und einigen der stärksten Missionen, die CD Projekt Red je entworfen hat. Zusammen mit dem kostenlosen Update 2.0 – das Perk-System, Cyberware, Polizei und Fahrzeugkämpfe komplett überarbeitet hat – fühlt sich Cyberpunk 2077 seitdem wie das Spiel an, das es immer sein wollte.

[h2]Mein einziger Wermutstropfen: Kein Happy End für V[/h2]
Hier muss ich ehrlich sein, und es ist ein rein subjektiver Punkt: Ich bin jemand, der Happy Ends braucht. Thriller und Dramen meide ich im Kino eher. Cyberpunk 2077 bietet – weder im Hauptspiel noch mit dem zusätzlichen Ende aus Phantom Liberty – einen wirklich positiven Ausgang für V. Jedes Ende ist bittersüß, manche sind schlichtweg tragisch. Die Geschichte hat mich deshalb mehr als einmal nah ans Wasser geführt, und ja, die eine oder andere Träne musste ich mir verdrücken. Dass ein Spiel das überhaupt schafft, spricht allerdings für seine erzählerische Qualität. Es ist eben Cyberpunk – das Genre handelt vom Preis, den Menschen in einer entmenschlichten Welt zahlen. Ich wünschte mir trotzdem, CDPR hätte V wenigstens eine Tür offen gelassen.

[h2]Was das Internet sagt[/h2]
Meine positive Stimmung steht nicht allein. Ein Blick auf die Rezensionslandschaft:

[list]
[*][b]Metacritic:[/b] Phantom Liberty erreicht auf dem PC einen [b]Metascore von 89[/b], auf PS5 87 und auf Xbox Series X/S 89. Von 54 gewerteten Kritiker-Reviews für die PC-Version sind 98 % positiv, nur eine einzige fällt negativ aus. Der User-Score liegt bei 8.9 (89 % positiv).
[*][b]GameSpot[/b] vergab ein seltenes [b]10/10[/b] und nannte Phantom Liberty [i]„Cyberpunk 2077 at its best“[/i] – „grausam, ernüchternd und bittersüß“, eine Geschichte, die lange nach dem Abspann hängen bleibt. (Womit die Kritiker im Übrigen meinen Punkt zum Ende bestätigen.)
[*][b]PC Gamer[/b] beschrieb die Erweiterung als „spannenden Spionagethriller“ und „krönenden Abschluss von Cyberpunk 2077s dreijährigem Erlösungsbogen“.
[*][b]Pure Xbox[/b] schrieb: Mit 2.0 und Phantom Liberty fühle sich das Spiel „wie neu geboren“ an und könne „neben The Witcher 3 als eines der ganz Großen“ stehen.
[*][b]Steam:[/b] Das Hauptspiel steht bei Hunderttausenden Nutzerrezensionen auf [b]„Sehr positiv“[/b]; die jüngsten Reviews liegen sogar bei 94–95 % positiv – Anfang 2025 erreichte das Spiel kurzzeitig den Status „Äußerst positiv“. Cyberpunk 2077 wurde zudem bei den Steam Awards als [b]„Outstanding Story-Rich Game“[/b] ausgezeichnet.
[*][b]Awards:[/b] Phantom Liberty gewann bei den [b]Game Awards 2023[/b] „Best Ongoing Game“ und war für „Best Narrative“ nominiert, holte den BAFTA für „Evolving Game“ und den Golden Joystick als „Best Game Expansion“. Bei den New York Game Awards war es sogar für Game of the Year nominiert – als Erweiterung.
[*][b]Verkaufszahlen:[/b] Das Hauptspiel hat laut CD Projekt die Marke von [b]40 Millionen[/b] verkauften Exemplaren überschritten, Phantom Liberty steht bei über [b]15 Millionen[/b] – rechnerisch hat sich also fast jeder dritte Spieler die Erweiterung gekauft. Für einen 30-Euro-DLC ist das außergewöhnlich.
[/list]

Fairerweise sei erwähnt: Nicht jede Stimme ist euphorisch. Einige Spieler kritisieren, dass Phantom Liberty etwas abrupt in die Haupthandlung einbricht und das Pacing stört, dass die Gegner-KI schwach bleibt und das Fahrverhalten Geschmackssache ist. Vereinzelt stolpert man auch heute noch über kleinere Bugs. Für mich fallen diese Punkte angesichts des Gesamtpakets nicht ins Gewicht.

[h2]Fazit[/h2]
Cyberpunk 2077 hat eine der bemerkenswertesten Wiederauferstehungen der Spielegeschichte hingelegt – vom gescholtenen Release zum gefeierten Meisterwerk. Für mich war es schon zum Start ein großartiges Spiel, mit Update 2.0 und Phantom Liberty ist es ein überragendes geworden. Night City ist die dichteste, glaubwürdigste und schönste offene Spielwelt, die ich kenne; die Charaktere – Johnny, Panam, Judy, Jackie, Takemura, Reed, Songbird – gehören zu den besten des Mediums. Dass mir das Spiel kein Happy End gönnt, nehme ich ihm ein bisschen übel. Aber dass es mich fast 1000 Stunden lang gefesselt und zum Weinen gebracht hat, sagt alles.

[b]Wertung: 10/10 – Eines der besten RPGs aller Zeiten.[/b]

Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty - Beautiful, Brutal, and Unforgettable

Night City is beautiful in a way few games manage to achieve. The neon-soaked streets, the rain reflecting off the pavement, the distant skyline, the quiet moments in a city that never really sleeps. Sometimes I found myself stopping simply to take it all in.

But the real achievement isn't the world itself. It's the people living in it.

The story is emotionally exhausting in the best possible way. Beneath all the chrome, violence, and technological excess lies a story about humanity, desperation, loyalty, and the terrible things people are willing to do when they're running out of options.

And Phantom Liberty takes that foundation and pushes it even further.

Dogtown feels oppressive, the stakes feel personal, and the characters are far more than disposable quest-givers. Everyone has something to hide, something to lose, and a reason to believe they're the one making the right choice.

What I appreciate most is that the game doesn't need to tell you who's good and who's evil. It lets you sit with uncomfortable decisions and live with the possibility that there simply isn't a clean solution. Sometimes doing the right thing means hurting someone. Sometimes doing what feels right for one person comes at the expense of another.

And that hurts precisely because the characters feel human.

The performances, the writing, the music, the atmosphere — everything comes together to create moments that stay with you long after you've put the controller down.

Cyberpunk 2077 isn't just a game about a dystopian future. It's a game about people desperately trying to find something worth holding on to in a world that treats them as disposable.

Night City may be beautiful, but it isn't kind.

And that's what makes its most emotional moments hit so hard.

Phantom Liberty doesn't just give you more Cyberpunk 2077. It gives you another reason to care about it.

A beautiful world. A devastating story. An experience I'll remember long after the credits roll.

What a ride. Didn't expect to be left questioning loyalty, survival, and how often “I’m trying to help you” means someones about to ruin your life.

After playing every ending, including Phantom Liberty, I changed my mind about some characters quite a few times. It went from understanding someone, to hating it, back to sympathize with them. The world and story excells in showing raw actions and consequences, while not judging directly anyone.

Major spoilers below. Seriously, play the game.

[spoiler]I won't go into the base game, as it allready aged and all loved and hated Johny, but he remained authentic.

Songbird was a tough one. I followed her path first, betrayed Reed, then spent half the journey wondering whether I backed the wrong person. She lied to everyone, to V, used his desperation to save herself. Meanwhile, Reed increasingly seemed like a man who genuinely wanted to get everyone out alive.

Fuck Myers btw. All that talk about duty and saving lives, while people become disposable the second they threaten her political interests. I wished I could have shot her the moment I met her.

I sent So Mi to the Moon first. Killing Reed didnt feel good. He believed in what he was doing, and I really hoped it would work out somehow. So I went back and handed her over. Reed alive, Alex alive, Songbird alive, yet back in FIA hands, but maybe Reed would help her. Seemed like a decent compromise.

Then I took the cure...
After spending the entire game looking for a way for V to survive, I finally got one. Two years in a coma, Johnny gone, Panam gone, almost nobody left. The life V fought so hard to keep had moved on without him. That fucking hurt and all of sudden those 6 uncertain months with people I cared about looked a lot more valuable than they had before.

The Arasaka ending had already left a rotten taste. I felt sorry for Goro, much like Reed: capable, loyal men who believe they’re doing the right thing, serving institutions that are perfectly happy to use them up. Even the rooftop suicide felt like it might spare everyone else until those calls showed what V would leave behind.

So I went back again. Betrayed Songbird in Firestarter. Watched everything fall apart. Alex died, So Mi lost control, and I started thinking she really was the root of the whole disaster.

Cynosure: that Cerberus sequence was fun and scary and I loved it. First time in a while that my V didnt feel like the overpowered killing machine.
Songbirds memories hit: before all this, she was basically a kid who wanted to become a great netrunner. Took a dangerous shot at a bigger life. Sound familiar?
But she didn't have V's luck to remain free for much longer, netwatch would have gotten her soon enough, so Reed thought recruiting her would save her.
Myers turned her into a weapon and kept pushing her into the Blackwall until she was losing herself. By the time she reaches V, Songbird doesn't trusted anyone, and tries anything for survival.
I know it doesn’t erase what she did, but I finally could see her perspective.

I played both outcomes in that bunker. After seeing everything, I came back to the Moon.

Save So Mi. Shoot Reed. Walk away from the FIA cure.

I still feel bad for Reed. Especially after seeing that he could begin questioning his loyalty for the F*ingIA in the other ending. I wished he could have reached that point before.
Also gave that medal to a begger, just like Songbird did.[/spoiler]

All in all it was a emotional roller coaster, absolutely fucking worth it.

So I will end with a quote from Johny:
"Swap meat for chrome, live a BD fantasy, whatever, but at the end of it all, it's the code you live by that defines who you are."

Alright, here's a hot take on this game.

I understand the whole premise that CD Projekt Red is this glorified company that genuinely cares about its community, and that whatever they release is automatically going to be the best new shit on the market. But man, Cyberpunk is fucking boring.

The graphics are amazing, the futuristic setting is done incredibly well, and the characters are engaging... but holy shit, they are so boring.

You start the game, and you're basically thrown into an interactive movie where nothing, and I do mean nothing, engaging happens. You get introduced to a few characters, some dude named Jack asks you to grab a bite to eat approximately six times within 15 minutes, and you're told you have a dark history and that you're some kind of vigilante. But what do you actually do? You sit there, waiting for a conversation consisting of 16 paragraphs to finish, only to move on to the next section, where you're treated to another 18 paragraphs of dialogue.

I get it. They're trying to establish the setting, introduce the characters, and get you invested in the story. But bruh, I just want some actual gameplay.

I don't need 15 minutes of preparation before killing a dude, followed by 10 minutes of shooting, followed by another 15-minute postmortem about how we're killers and how great a job we did, followed by yet another 15-minute guided tour where I wait for the next part of the quest to begin.

And then there's the gameplay itself. It's clunky. Driving feels completely off, melee combat is weird as hell, and shooting is... okay-ish.

Even six years after release, the game still has bugs and jittery animations, NPCs walking through terrain, and stuff like that. I accidentally hit some dude once, and suddenly World War III breaks out around me. Meanwhile, Jack is casually strolling through a literal firefight, completing his questline as if the people shooting near him are carrying water pistols, continuing the conversation, while I'm dodging bullets like Neo. Then we go inside, and I have to talk to some doctor while the war rages on outside. I finish a solid 10 minutes of dialogue, walk back out, and the fucking war is still going on.

The skill tree, or perks, or whatever the hell they're called is another issue. I understand that the game was built to last dozens of hours, and you need some way to differentiate the early, mid, and late game. Fair enough. But I wasn't expecting "insert boss music" Path of Exile 2 levels of skill trees, modifiers, perks, and build variety. Maybe it's just me being so bored out of my mind that I can't be bothered to read through everything, but by the time the game finally introduces the system, all I want to do is actually play the damn game. Instead, I'm staring at yet another list of things I can unlock, modify, upgrade, or combine.

And then there's the dialogue. Sure, the conversations might feel realistic if you completely ignore how many times you should realistically have been killed by now.

You call up some higher-up, meet them in an alley, and they bring along a possible witness who's been beaten to shit. They threaten you, you lie to them "I tried that at least" and somehow, 17 dialogue options later, everything is fine. They trust you enough to hand over their credit card. Like, imagine you're walking down the street with a friend, someone tries to steal your wallet, you catch them red-handed, and a few minutes later you're handing them your credit card. Sure... Realistic.... Happened to me a few weeks back. My friend and I still laugh about it hehe.

I get it. You're the protagonist. You can't exactly get killed at the beginning of your own story. But holy shit, that entire conversation felt so unnatural. Why would this noble give you a card when they were prepared to gun you just a second ago. Sure, storytelling, V can get something they need. But to give V their ultra premium platinum Raiffeisen? A squirrel befriending SpongeBob at the bottom of the sea makes more sense to me. 

You have so many things to do, so many options, so many NPCs, and so many... who the fuck cares. You can interact with an NPC to fight a robot in a boxing match. You can pick up a guitar pick. You can scan things. You can use vending machines. You can even customize the length of your character's dick.

Cool. Can I actually shoot something and play the fucking game?

BUT BRO, YOU CAN CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER'S PUBIC HAIR.

Oh, and by the way, V's animations are some of the slowest things I've ever seen in a video game. God forbid you press "F" to sit down on a chair. If Stephen Hawking needed to get up, I imagine it would be approximately the same time as V. And it's not just sitting down. Staring at a mirror. Getting into a car. I haven't played long enough, but I assume there's a "interactive breathing" down the line.

One last thing that really got me. The "Is this game relevant to you?" section lists Skyrim and Dark Souls III. The walk to Gundyr was more engaging than this entire three-hour experience. I wanted to take an arrow to the knee after three hours of dialogue occasionally interrupted with gameplay. 

I spent three hours "playing" Cyberpunk, and I feel like I've watched the first few episodes of some hyper-unrealistic Netflix series about a wannabe drug lord trying to climb the criminal underworld's corporate ladder. I can't even refund it at this point.

Edit:
Beautiful Support Team at Steam processed the refund. Will leave my rant in case someone finds it useful though.

Great game been really enjoying it. If you have specs similar to mine and can't figure out how to run it with good picture with minimum stutters use this setup for 1080p. 

Open Nvidia control panel global settings in Manage 3D Settings, DSR=On 2.25x DL Sharpness=33/default, Low Latency=Ultra, Threaded Optimization=On 
Next go to add program section with the control panel right next to global settings add the exe file for Cyberpunk2077 set MaxFrameRate=60 and enable Vsync=Fast also have Textures=Quality
Finally launch the game turn off Vsync and MaxFrameRate in game, turn on DLSS to Quality with sharpness=40
Set crowd population to low everything else medium to high. ray tracing off.
Hope these settings help you enjoy it like i have been! Final note make sure your framerate within windows setting is set to max mine is 180hz but i use control panel as a limiter because of my cpu bottleneck.

缺点也很明显。四轮车的驾驶手感很差，车子像踩在冰面上，稍微打方向就容易漂移打滑，日常赶路开车算是一种折磨，摩托会好不少。游戏是第一人称，用手柄游玩时需要频繁推摇杆调整视角，长时间玩不太舒服。射击方面，哪怕把辅助瞄准拉到最高，也很难明显感受到辅助瞄准的效果，远距离跟枪会比较吃力。另外开放世界底层交互一般，路人 AI 比较模板化，除了任务之外可以深度互动的内容不多。

[b]"В Найт-Сити нет хороших концов, в Найт-Сити ты откидываешь концы"[/b].

Или что-то там тра-ля-ля. Я не ебусь в философию, но после прохождения игры (почти) полностью на 100%, прохождения всех концовок, выполнения всех ачивок, прохождения DLC также (почти) полностью и на все концовки, а также просмотра аниме (боже упаси), я наконец решил сделать этот обзор.

В начале своего запуска эта игра, мягко говоря, обосралась в технической части уж точно, но [b]время всё лечит[/b], и игра стала более-менее играбельной, хотя у меня она постоянно вылетала (особенно во время концовок, что меня пиздец как бесило), потому что мой ПК еле-еле дотягивал до минимально требуемых характеристик. Но даже так я смог наиграться.

Но есть в игре то, что было с самого начала, - это сюжет. И когда собираешь команду сценаристов, то они либо высерают невнятную тупую хуету, либо создают очень хорошо прописанный и внятный сюжет. К счастью, для этой игры произошёл второй сценарий: в начале это история о желании стать легендой Найт-Сити, но потом это история о выживании и смирении с демонами прошлого в своей голове (в прямом и переносном смысле). Сюжет чувствуется взрослым и хорошо продуманным, а в конце сюжета нет одного правильного решения, ведь за каждое решение ты что-то получаешь, но взамен также что-то теряешь. Короче, выбор между большим и меньшим злом - это если не вдаваться в детали и ничего не спойлерить.

Персонажи тоже хорошо прописаны, за ними интересно наблюдать и с ними интересно взаимодействовать, особенно с Джонни Сильверхендом. Не знаю, каким был Джонни в первоисточнике - «Киберпанке» от Майка Пондсмита, - но у этой версии Джонни выслушивать его бубнёж под нос, цитаты, слушать его комментарии почти ко всей хуйне, которая происходит вокруг, а также взаимодействовать с ним - одно удовольствие. Русская озвучка тоже сыграла в этом свою роль ([b]"Всё, что мы можем получить здесь, так это пизды, причём в плохом смысле"[/b]). Остальные персонажи тоже в стороне не остались, и выполнять их сюжетные арки было приятно: помочь Панам воссоединиться и помириться с её кланом «Альдекальдо» [spoiler]а потом трахнуть[/spoiler], а также пообщаться с Митчем из клана по душам; пройти сюжетную линию Джуди; выполнить просьбу Джонни и провести время с Бестией; помочь Керри выйти из кризиса среднего возраста; а также помочь Риверу найти его похищенного племянника. Короче, шик. Ах да, ещё не забыть вернуть Виктору долг.

Геймплейно игра очень разнообразная и даёт тебе кучу вариантов для игры: начиная от обычного стиля с пострелушками и заканчивая сеттингом ниндзя-самурая и смертоносного нетраннера, ведь дерево прокачки очень большое и предлагает игроку много вариаций скиллов под каждый стиль игры, который ему подходит. Но в нём очень легко запутаться, и придётся хорошенько разобраться, что для казуального игрока - минус.

DLC, пускай и замечательное, имеет такие же плюсы, как и выше перечисленное, но также и дополняет их, особенно в части дерева прокачки (что, как по мне, тоже минус, ведь без DLC у тебя не будет доступа к годным и полезным скиллам). Оно также даёт доступ к новой локации и новым сюжетным линиям, но, как по мне, ощущается как попытка впихнуть в полную чашу ещё больше песка. И, по моему мнению, оно бы лучше подошло в формате отдельного продукта от основной игры.

[b]"Две бомбы было недостаточно или они были лишними?"[/b]

Таким философским вопросом я задаюсь, когда думаю об аниме. Не поймите меня неправильно: мне нравится аниме как стиль искусства, но его подача - это ебаный, блядь, стыд. Когда какая-то школота собирается, получает какие-то неуебические силы и идёт давать всем пизды, и всё это под рвотный пафос, кучу монологов и крики... Это пиздец (и, оказывается, у этого есть обозначение - «сёнэн»). Не то чтобы само аниме по «Киберпанку» было таким, но оно из этого разряда по подаче сюжета. Скажу сразу: не всё аниме такое. Есть куча аниме-произведений с другой подачей, не такой, как та, которую я описал. И вот вроде бы для такой вселенной, как «Киберпанк», такая подача сюжета не подойдёт, но нет - они смогли это просунуть. Скажу мнение о парочке персов и выскажу свою оценку самого аниме. Будет немного спойлеров

Дэвид, пускай в начале и был интересным персом, но чем дальше за ним наблюдаешь, тем меньше ему сочувствуешь. [spoiler]Это как следить за стероидозависимым качком: вроде вот ответ перед тобой - остановись нахуй, - но нет. В принципе, его кончина в кои-то веки логична.[/spoiler]

Из всех персов мне больше всего понравился Фалько, но и Ребекка тоже прикольная из-за своего взрывного характера, ей хоть как-то можно простить брезгливость. Короче, моя оценка - 5/10, а по Папичометру - 0/10.

В общем, как-то так. Это моё мнение об игре, DLC и аниме по ней. Я буду скучать по игре, её миру, персонажам и её боёвке. Это замечательная игра, жаль, что она расцвела очень поздно.

[b]От лица персонала мотеля «Свободная Калифорния» желаю вам, блять, приятных сновидений.[/b]

Honestly, Cyberpunk 2077 just isn't that good of a game for me.

The Graphics Are Unmatched

Visually, it is easily the best-looking game out there right now. On my PC, running everything maxed out at 1440p, I get around 100 FPS, and the graphical fidelity is mind-blowing. The ray tracing, lighting, neon lights, and reflections look incredible and push hardware to its absolute limits.

The Story & Setting Miss the Mark

Where the game really falls flat is its world and storyline:

Overly Futuristic Aesthetic: The world design feels a bit too futuristic—so much so that it breaks immersion and loses its charm.

Disappointing Narrative: You can clearly tell how much effort the developers put into building the lore, setting up the story, and creating emotional character build-ups. But despite all that obvious effort, the execution fails to land and ends up being a disappointment.

Cyberpunk 2077 is probably one of the best games I’ve played.

There are a lot of great things to say about this game.

First of all the gameplay mechanics are fun and interesting. There’s a real skill curve and a real difference between being a noob and having hundreds of hours in the game. For me, this is the one of the hallmarks of a good RPG. When you first start out, the game systems can feel overwhelming, but ultimately the game game gets you TONS of options, you just have to learn how to utilize them.

The 5 attributes and associated perk trees provide a near-endless amount of build choices, many of which have very very different play styles, but which can all accomplish your goals in different ways. The perk trees have exciting progression with things like sandevistan (slows down time i.e. giving you super human reactions), netrunning (hacking into cameras, vehicles, robots, and enemy cyberware), character movement upgrades (dashing, double jumping, leap attacks), and a plethora of different cyberware with various upgrades to your character’s ability, plus all kinds of different guns, melee weapons, and explosives. It’s really a very flexible system with lots of fun options to explore across multiple playthroughs. You can also re-spec within an individual attribute tree’s perks without starting a new character, if you want to switch things up on the same character.

Most encounters and missions are designed to give you multiple ways to approach them too. There are usually multiple entrances or paths through an area, multiple ways to interact with the environment (explosives, cameras, computers, turrets and robots that can be hacked, air vents or hidden tunnels for stealth runs, etc.). There are almost always many ways to approach and deal with hostile situations, which makes the play style of different builds feel very different, and that’s a huge win for the game.

The dialogue and choices are also pretty amazing. There’s so many cases where you can vastly alter the outcome of a quest just by choosing a different dialogue option, and many branches to the main storyline and even some of the side quests.

This is a game where your actions actually make a difference in the outcome.

Not only that, but the characters and voice actors portraying them memorable and interesting.

Additionally, many parts of the game touch on philosophically heavy topics from the fields of philosophy of mind, identity, and moral philosophy, and how all three fields intersect in a world where brain-computer interfaces are normal. The game intimately explores classical philosophical-leaning cyberpunk concepts like “brain in a vat” / fully immersive cyberspace, “mind uploading”, and more, and the implications of these technologies on society.

And then it probably goes without saying, but the world building and aesthetic / visual presentation is fantastic. There are so many cinematic environments and moments that feel quintessentially cyberpunk as a genre. It’s “high tech / low life” through and through, with towering corporate mega-skyscrapers, neon signs everywhere, wild outfits, and grunge-y trash and degeneracy ridden alleyways all smashed into the densely packed Night City. There’s clear inspiration drawn from real-world cities like Tokyo and LA, as well as classic cyberpunk titles like Blade Runner. The world building does not disappoint in the slightest!

There are some weaknesses worth mentioning: Despite this being an open-world game, the open world can start to feel a little empty after many hours into the game. Once you realize the most efficient gameplay loop is to hunt down iconic weapons and then break down other items to upgrade your iconic weapons, visiting vendors becomes nearly useless except for cyberware upgrades. The loot and upgrade system is so streamlined that at times it just doesn’t feel very interesting. But in other ways, this is a good thing - it gives you more time to focus on the actual stories without over-concerning yourself with piles upon piles of loot. However, the world is also a little lacking in unique named characters aside from specific journal missions. Most named unique characters you meet are either part of the main quest, or side quests that are given to you by Fixers, who are basically the middlemen connecting mercenaries (you) to citizens who need something done. Fixers simply text you on the game’s phone system… you rarely have to go meet them in person. There are very few instances where you can truly stumble across a side quest that you didn’t know was there just through exploring, the way you might in a game like Fallout or Elder Scrolls for example.  Another major weakness is that there are driveable vehicles in the game, but the handling really sucks. Like don’t even get me started, it’s truly awful. You’ll definitely want to go find some mods to improve that.

But all in all, it’s a game with both excellent gameplay mechanics, excellent storytelling, and excellent world building ALL simultaneously. A true gem.

Ahora bien, entre lo bueno, y después de casi 50 horas de juego, radica en lo que me enfoqué una vez entendí que el mundo abierto está roto: la historia principal y sus personajes. Cyberpunk aborda consigo una historia de acción, drama y nostalgia genial. Con escenas simplemente impresionantes y que te dan una bofetada con sus coreografías, visuales y personajes. Me encantaron los personajes de la campaña, conocer la melancolía y dificultad en vivir de Judy, el esfuerzo y necesidad de grandeza de mi amigo Jackie, al traidor de Dex, la dulce y amable Misty, el buena onda y que me salvó más de una vez… el bonachon Virktor, y sobre todo la hermosa y querida Panam, con quien decidí seguir la mecánica de parejas, y con quien he decidido llegar al final de la historia, y por lo que debo decir que estoy más que feliz… ese final me ha parecido un broche de oro, un final melodramático, con muchas perdida pero una recompensa invaluable que V siempre estuvo persiguiendo, el ser libre, el sentirse pertenecer a un lugar, el ser amado… y en ese momento Night City deja de ser su hogar, y Panam pasa a serlo.

Entre mi aventura en Cyberpunk me sentí en una película de Blade Runner, y eso para mí, ya refleja una experiencia genial. Recomiendo este juego sin duda, aunque claro, solo si quieres vivir una buena historia.

0. Ressenti global:
Globalement un bon jeu car un bon gameplay et une DA sympa.
Mais il y a plein de choses scénaristiques baclées, disons. Jouez à Cyberpunk pour le gameplay, pas pour l'histoire; histoire qui sera un peu plus rattrapée par la relation développée avec Johnny et le DLC.

1. Un scénario et l'invocation d'un lore qui vous ennuie:
Concernant le scénario, il est pas ouf. Je ne peux pas vous citer un moment qui était trop bien car je n'en ai rien retenu. Ce qu'on retient le mieux, c'est la première plus grosse mission avant de perdre Jackie. On s'attache vite à lui et on nous l'arrache très vite. L'univers est impitoyable et le scénario aussi. Concernant le lore, je suis assez vite las de ce dernier. Ils invoquent des concepts de psychologie: myélinisation, plasiticité cérébrale mais rien n'est une réelle découverte. J'ai fini par arrêter de lire les éclats de lore car plus rien ne me passionnait. J'ai dû arrêter au bout de 10h de jeu. Je dois imputer ma lassitude à mes études de psychologie mais je n'ai pas sû me repaître d'un goût qui dit: Voilà, ici, c'est de la science-fiction, eu la biopuce mais ils ont abandonné le projet. 

2. Une solitude marquée:
Et c'est bien dommage car même s'il y a des love interest et que la psychologie des personnages est relativement bien construite, on sent que ça manque d'un véritable compagnon. On s'attache à certains personnages mais avec un sentiment d'insatisfaction relationnelle amère. Là où Jackie aurait joué un réel rôle de compensation de cette solitude. Pour ce qui est des personnages, plus vous entrez dans leur monde, plus ils vous proposent des nuances de réactions faisant partie des archétypes sur lesquels ils ont été construit. J'ai bien conscience que l'univers de Cyberpunk joue de l'isolement exacerbé par la technologie mais la légèreté et les principes de Jackie aurait rendu le jeu tellement plus riche. Pour ce qui est des partenaires, on en a vite plus rien à faire car une fois que vous les avez invité 3-4x chez vous, il n'y a plus d'interêt à le faire car vous n'apprenez plus rien d'eux. 

3. Un gameplay qui m'a personnellement enfermé dans un style de combat:
On reprocherait presque souvent aux mondes ouverts avec une diversité apparente de gameplay et de stratégies de nous amener à n'utiliser que la stratégie la plus efficace. La mienne est le révolver, aucune tête ne m'échappe longtemps. Dans le mille. Et c'est ça qui est dommage, les apprioris d'abre de compétences pour les autres nous invite à nous dire: Est-ce si ouf que ça de jouer au katana ? Et on se rend compte que non. C'est le souci, qu'avec une telle diversité de fight-tactics, on se retrouve à s'enfermer dans un gameplay plus proche de notre facilité plutôt que de nous charmer et nous amener à un embarras du choix.

4. Gameplay globalement amusant et parfois jouissif:
- Une approche technologique et informatique:
Il est possible d'amener avec assez de mémoire vivre à faire faire aux ennemis des dingueries: leur déclencher une cyberpsychose qui attaque les autres, leur pousser à se neutraliser (mort) ou de les neutraliser sans traçabilité.
- Une approche sadique:
A travers certains dispositifs des armes, il est possible de créer un incendie avec des balles, de les démembrer avec une lame ou un pombe.

One of the best and most fun story games ever. Don't listen to people complaining about the launch, yes it was really bad then but that was 6 years ago. This game is now a masterpiece, especially with the DLC.

CYBERPUNK 2077 REVIEW

I've been waiting a long time to play Cyberpunk 2077. For couple of years, my PC was too weak to run it with acceptable graphics, and now I finally could play it.

During the first 20 to 30 hours, I was pretty disappointed with the game. It felt like a real drag at first. What I really liked from the start, though, was the immersive world and the graphics.
After around 30 hours, the game finally started getting really interesting. The story is good, the storytelling is nice too, and the missions are fun, at least most of them.

I can't speak from personal experience about how buggy the game was at launch, since I didn't play it myself back then. But I think pretty much everyone has heard about just how insanely buggy it was.
During my playthrough, I fell through the map twice, which caused me to fail the mission. And there are still quite many visual bugs in the game, like floating NPCs, people T-posing during conversations, and cars glitching out and flying through the air.
But these are mostly just visual bugs and don't really break the game. Still, they definitely take you out of the immersive world.

Driving felt awful at first, but I have to say that once I got used to it, I actually started having a lot of fun with it. It's more challenging than driving in most other games, even if it feels pretty weird at first. Honestly, I'd take that over the way-too-easy driving in GTA 5 any day.

The gunplay isn't perfect either. Some weapons could definitely feel a bit more powerful, but overall, it's pretty good and not too easy. And once I got the Malorian Arms 3516, I had the time of my life :)

Character creation was another thing I really liked. If you put enough time into it, you can create some really cool-looking characters.

I bought the game for €17.99, and I have to say it was definitely worth it for that price. On a scale of 1 to 10, I'd give it a 7.5.

All in all I definitely recommend it, but I wouldn't call it a masterpiece.

Tatsächlich fahre ich Fahrzeuge mit den Controller, und mache alles andere wie das kämpfen mit Maus und Tastatur. 🎮 Cyberpunk 2077 — Welcome to Night City

Imagine a world where everyone has an implant in their arm, money is worth more than a heartbeat, and problems are solved with either cash or a bullet. Welcome to Cyberpunk 2077 — a city of the future where dreams are for sale and human life is worth next to nothing.

You play as V, a mercenary who wanted to hit the big score but ended up with someone else’s personality stuck in their head and a one-way ticket to hell. And along for the ride is Johnny Silverhand, who somehow still manages to get on your nerves even after death. 😎

🔥 What’s the game all about?

A massive city, sick cars, guns, cybernetic implants, gangs, and corporations that couldn’t care less about anyone. Want to complete missions quietly? Go for it. Want to turn the whole district into a war zone? Your call. And if everything goes sideways — well, that’s just Night City doing its thing.

🎵 The atmosphere is something else. Neon lights, rain-soaked streets, music, late-night drives, and the feeling that you’re living inside a cyberpunk action movie.

❤️ But the real highlight is the story. Behind all the flashy visuals lie betrayal, friendship, tough choices, and one big question: what does it mean to remain human when half of you can be replaced with metal?

The downsides? Some missions can get repetitive, and you’ll need a powerful PC to enjoy the game at its best visually. But once you’re cruising through Night City at night with your favorite track playing, you quickly forget about all that.

🏆 Final Verdict

Cyberpunk 2077 isn’t just a game about the future. It’s a story about trying not to lose yourself in a world where everything has a price.

Night City doesn’t ask if you’re ready. It just turns on the neon and starts the show.

You either become a legend or just another name in a police report.

My rating: 9/10. And yeah, after playing this game, an ordinary city at night will never look quite the same again. 🔥

사이버펑크 2077은 레벨과 장비를 육성하는 것보다 대사와 퀘스트를 따라가며 스토리의 과정과 결말을 즐기는 데 초점을 맞춘 게임이다. 히든 엔딩을 위해 시너지 호감도 수치를 40%이상으로 유지하고 조니는 어디에 퀘스트에서 선택지를 잘골라야합니다, 메인 퀘스트의 다음 편지를 기다리며 NCPD 임무 등을 수행하는 것도 그 과정의 일부다.

레벨과 스탯, 무기 강화는 스토리 진행을 위한 부수적인 요소에 가깝다. 하지만 스토리를 모두 완료하면 성장의 목적과 즐길 콘텐츠도 대부분 사라진다.

엔딩 이후에도 육성한 캐릭터를 활용할 콘텐츠를 제공하고, 이전 진행 시점으로 자유롭게 돌아갈 수 있도록 개선했으면 한다.

사이버펑크 2077 플레이 후기 및 개선 요구사항

1. 엔딩 이후 할 콘텐츠가 없다

퀘스트를 전부 클리어하면 더 이상 할 게 없다.

DLC 포함 레벨 60 만렙을 달성하면 경험치를 얻거나 캐릭터를 성장시킬 방법도 사실상 사라진다. 스킬과 스탯을 더 올릴 수 없고, 보조 레벨을 올릴 이유도 적다. 몬스터를 사냥하며 파밍할 만한 장소도 마땅치 않다.

결국 이 게임은 퀘스트와 임무가 주된 콘텐츠인데, 이를 모두 소진하고 나면 추가로 보상을 얻을 방법이 거의 없다. 그나마 차량 회수 퀘스트가 대안이지만, 난이도까지 있어 오히려 짜증만 유발한다.

DLC를 클리어한 뒤에는 이전 진행 시점으로 돌아갈 수도 없다. 메인 스토리를 끝내면 특정 분기점으로 돌아가는 방식인데, 결국 게임을 끝내기 전의 시점으로 되돌려 놓고 다시 플레이하라는 이야기다.

게임을 끝내고 나면 시민 살해 범죄 외에는 할 만한 콘텐츠가 없다. 그렇다고 적과 싸우자니 너무 강해서 버티기 어렵고, 결국 죽게 된다. 적을 처치해도 드롭 아이템이 없으니 사냥할 의미도 없다. 마지막 저장 시점으로 돌아가는 것 외에는 할 수 있는 게 없다. 끝이다. 네.

밤의 도시에서 영원한 시한부 인생을 살아가며 눈뽕이나 감상하는 것 말고는 할 게 없다.

2. 게임의 전반적인 평가

돈을 주고 구매할 만한 게임인지 의심스럽다. 황야 위에 날림으로 공사를 해 놓은 듯한 느낌이며, 플레이하는 내내 시스템과 편의성 전반에서 불편함을 느꼈다.

스토리와 성우 연기가 그렇게 뛰어나다고 평가할 만한 게임인지도 의문이다. 서브 퀘스트는 많지만, 그만큼 성장의 재미나 보상이 보장되는 것도 아니다. 결국 이 많은 퀘스트를 내가 왜 하고 있는지 의문이 든다.

다시 캐릭터를 키우고 싶을 정도로 애정이나 매력이 있는 게임이라고 생각하지 않는다. 콘텐츠의 양만 늘릴 게 아니라 게임의 기본 구조와 편의성부터 개선해야 한다.

3. 전투 시스템과 무기 밸런스

3-1. 무기 성능과 전투 효율

쌍수 무기는 성능이 좋지 않다. 스마트 링크 무기도 기대에 미치지 못한다. 자동 사격 방식이지만 빗나가는 탄환이 많고, 굳이 사용할 만한 뚜렷한 장점도 없다.

업그레이드 비용에 비해 데미지 상승률도 만족스럽지 않다. 결국 무기는 발사 형태에 맞춰 데미지가 높은 것을 선택하는 편이 더 편하고 효율적이다.

총을 장전하고 발사하는 과정에서 스태미나까지 소모되는 것도 불편하다. 그나마 영원히 걸어 다니지 않도록 달리기는 가능하게 해 놓았다.

3-2. 탄약 수급과 장탄수 확인

탄약은 플레이 체감 사용량에 비해 부족하고, 총알을 구할 곳도 마땅치 않다. 장탄수를 확인하는 것마저 불편하다.

전투가 중요한 게임에서 탄약 수급과 장탄수 확인이 불편하다는 건 상당한 문제다. 단순히 적이 강해서 어려운 게 아니라, 기본적인 전투 편의성부터 부족하다.

3-3. 적 처치에 따른 보상 부족

GTA처럼 범죄를 저지르면 수배 별이 생기는 시스템은 있지만, 시민이나 경찰, 군인을 많이 죽인다고 해서 RPG 특유의 성장으로 이어지는 것은 아니다.

시민을 제외한 노란색·파란색·빨간색으로 표시되는 대상도 현상금이 없거나 평판이 이미 최대치라면 처치해도 별다른 의미가 없다.

적을 죽여도 경험치나 드롭 아이템 등 실질적인 보상이 부족하다. 전투를 반복할 이유가 없고, 범죄를 저지르더라도 성장으로 이어지지 않는다.

이 게임에서는 RPG적인 성장을 기대하지 않는 편이 좋다.

4. 성장 시스템과 난이도

특성과 특전 포인트가 각각 존재하며, 퀘스트 진행에 필요한 능력치가 부족하면 특정 구간에서 막힐 수 있다. 최소한의 조건으로 플레이할 수는 있지만, 능력치가 요구되는 상황에서는 진행에 제약이 생긴다.

어려움 난이도를 선택하더라도 그에 따른 경험치 배율이나 추가적인 성장 기회가 충분히 제공되지 않는다. 난이도에 따른 보상이나 성장 차이가 크지 않다면 굳이 높은 난이도를 선택할 이유가 없다.

편하게 진행하고 싶다면 쉬움 난이도로 플레이하는 것이 낫다. 높은 난이도에 도전하더라도 그에 걸맞은 성장이나 보상이 보장되지 않기 때문이다.

5. 아이템 강화와 DLC 무기 부품

DLC 콘텐츠를 포함하면 무기 등급의 최고 단계는 5티어++다. 하지만 무기를 강화하는 데 필요한 부품을 모으기가 상당히 어렵다.

마지막 강화 단계에 5티어 부품 200개가 필요한 수준인데, 이를 모으는 과정이 쉽지 않다. 사냥 한 판당 얻는 부품은 대략 2~3개 수준이며, 1티어나 3티어 부품을 몇 개 얻는 데 그치는 경우도 있다.

단계별 필요 수량과 강화 효율을 고려하면 성장 과정이 지나치게 번거롭다. 체감 데미지 차이도 크지 않으니 많은 시간과 자원을 투자할 가치가 있는지 의문이다.

강화 비용과 수고에 비해 성능 향상이 충분하지 않다. 무기를 강화하는 재미를 느끼게 하려면 필요한 부품의 수량과 획득률, 강화에 따른 성능 차이를 개선해야 한다.

6. 퀘스트와 스토리 진행

서브 퀘스트는 많지만, 이를 수행한다고 해서 성장이나 보상이 보장되는 것은 아니다. 퀘스트를 계속 진행하다 보면 내가 왜 이 일을 반복하고 있는지 의문이 든다.

짧은 시한부 인생이라는 설정을 중심으로 스토리가 진행되지만, 이를 충분히 매력적으로 살렸는지도 의문이다. 스토리와 성우 연기가 특별히 뛰어나다고 느껴지지도 않는다.

대사에 시간제한이 표시되더라도 크게 신경 쓸 필요는 없다. 실제로는 성우의 대사가 재생되는 시간 정도로 느껴질 뿐, 선택에 큰 영향을 미치지 않는 경우가 있다.

키보드가 없으면 대화를 넘길 수 없는 점도 불편하다. 퀘스트의 양을 늘리는 것보다 선택의 의미와 보상, 진행 편의성을 개선하는 것이 우선이다.

7. 이동 수단과 내비게이션

7-1. 빠른 이동과 장거리 주행

빠른 이동 기능이 있으니 적극적으로 이용하는 편이 낫다. 누가 주행만으로 몇 킬로미터씩 기어 다니고 싶겠는가?

이동 수단을 이용한 주행 자체가 불편한 상황에서 빠른 이동은 사실상 필수적이다.

7-2. 차량 및 도로 AI

도로와 차량 AI가 엉망이다. 정차해 있을 때도 다른 차량이 와서 부딪히는 경우가 있고, 차량이 저절로 굴러가기도 한다. 보닛이 부서지면 시야를 가리는 문제까지 발생한다.

기어는 자동 기어인데 계기판 표기까지 해 놓았다. 이런 세부적인 표현보다 기본적인 주행 시스템과 AI부터 제대로 개선하는 것이 우선이다.

7-3. 자동 주행과 내비게이션

자동 주행을 이용하면 목표 지점으로 제대로 이동하지 못하는 경우가 있다. 목적지가 다리 밑인데도 제대로 주행하지 못하거나, 내비게이션을 따라갔다가 옥상에서 떨어져 죽는 상황까지 발생한다.

안내 경로를 믿고 따라갔는데 오히려 사망하게 된다면 시스템을 신뢰하기 어렵다. 자동 주행과 경로 안내가 목적지와 지형에 맞게 정상적으로 작동하도록 개선해야 한다.

7-4. 시야와 조작

시야가 360도로 자유롭게 회전하지 않는다는 느낌이 든다. 목줄에 묶인 것처럼 한 바퀴를 돌려고 해도 제대로 회전하지 못하는 듯하다.

이러한 시야 제한과 조작의 불편함은 주변을 확인하고 상황에 대응하는 데 방해가 된다.

8. 기본 조작과 인터페이스

무기를 집어넣고 꺼내는 조작이 기존 게임과 차별화를 시도하려는 것인지는 모르겠지만, 지나치게 불편하다.

ALT 키와 마우스를 사용해 돌림판 형태로 무기를 선택하도록 구성해 놓았는데, 실제로 편리한지는 의문이다.

V 키로 차량을 호출하면 차량이 자동으로 플레이어에게 오는 것이 아니라, 플레이어가 직접 뛰어가서 탑승해야 한다. 차량 호출 기능을 제공하면서도 실제 탑승 과정은 번거롭다.

엘리베이터를 이용할 때도 내리려면 문 앞에 서 있어야 한다. 문 앞에서 멍하니 서 있었던 경험도 있다. 기본적인 이동 과정조차 직관적이지 않은 부분이 많다.

9. 시민 및 NPC 반응

시민과 어깨가 부딪히면 총을 쏘는 경우가 있다. 물론 시민을 때리면 범죄 별이 뜬다.

사소한 충돌에도 과도한 반응이 발생할 수 있어 불편하다. NPC의 행동과 범죄 판정이 자연스럽게 이어지는지 의문이다.

그리고 살인은 되도록 하지 않는 것이 좋다. 적을 마무리하지 않고 살려 두면 돈을 더 많이 받을 수 있기 때문이다. 굳이 살해할 이유가 없다면 살려 두는 편이 보상 측면에서 유리하다.

10. 밤의 도시와 그래픽 설정

밤의 도시는 영원한 시한부 인생처럼 느껴진다. 화면이 지나치게 밝거나 눈부신 문제가 있으며, 감마를 조절해도 해결되지 않는다.

감마 설정만으로 해결되지 않는 눈부심과 시각적 피로 문제는 별도의 조정 기능을 통해 개선할 필요가 있다. 화면 밝기와 조명 효과를 보다 세밀하게 조절할 수 있어야 한다.

최신 그래픽 드라이버를 설치하라는 안내도 문제다. NVIDIA 앱을 다운로드하고 3분이나 기다렸는데도 지원하지 않는다는 메시지가 나온다. 최신 드라이버를 설치하라는 안내와 실제 지원 상황이 일치하지 않는다.

11. 게임 실행 및 지도 편의성

게임을 시작하는 과정부터 번거롭다. 게임 유통사가 환불을 어렵게 만들려는 것인지, 실행 과정이 이중으로 구성된 듯한 느낌을 받았다.

게임을 구매한 뒤 2시간 안에 환불하지 못하도록 하려는 것처럼 느껴질 정도다. 실제 의도가 무엇이든, 본격적으로 플레이하기까지 불필요한 과정이 많다면 사용자 경험에 악영향을 줄 수밖에 없다.

게임 내 지도와 전체 경로 표시도 불편하다. 길을 확인하고 이동 경로를 파악하는 과정이 번거롭다. 맵과 경로를 직관적으로 확인할 수 있도록 개선할 필요가 있다.

12. 캐릭터 관련 불만

팬앰 팔머 좀 치워라.

특정 인물의 등장이나 관련 콘텐츠가 마음에 들지 않는다. 캐릭터와 스토리 구성은 취향에 따라 호불호가 갈릴 수 있지만, 플레이하는 동안 불편하게 느껴지는 인물이나 연출도 있다.

13. 가격과 환불에 대한 불만

게임 가격과 결제 및 환불 과정에도 불만이 있다.

원화로 가격을 표시해 놓았는데도 게임 가격이 3만 7천 원이라면 실제로는 3만 8천 원을 가져가는 것처럼 느껴진다. 표시 가격과 실제 결제 금액 사이에 차이가 있다면 소비자 입장에서 불쾌할 수밖에 없다.

돈은 바로바로 빠져나가면서 당일 환불은 해 주지 않는 유통 방식도 불만스럽다. 게임을 구매한 뒤 충분히 확인하고 환불할 수 있어야 하는데, 환불 조건이나 절차가 소비자에게 불리하게 느껴진다.

구매 전에는 가격뿐 아니라 실제 플레이 경험과 환불 조건까지 확인하는 것이 좋다.

14. 개선 요구사항

이 게임은 다음과 같은 부분에서 개선이 필요하다.

엔딩 이후 콘텐츠 추가: 메인 스토리와 DLC를 클리어한 뒤에도 플레이를 지속할 이유와 보상을 제공해야 한다.

전투 보상 개선: 적을 처치했을 때 경험치와 드롭 아이템 등 실질적인 보상을 제공해야 한다.

성장 시스템 개선: 난이도에 따른 경험치 배율과 성장 기회를 제공해 도전할 만한 이유를 만들어야 한다.

무기 밸런스 조정: 쌍수 무기와 스마트 링크 무기의 효율을 개선하고, 강화 비용에 걸맞은 성능 향상을 제공해야 한다.

탄약 수급 개선: 탄약을 구하기 쉽게 하고 장탄수를 명확하게 확인할 수 있도록 해야 한다.

이동 및 차량 AI 개선: 정차 중 충돌, 차량의 비정상적인 움직임, 손상된 보닛으로 인한 시야 가림 등을 해결해야 한다.

내비게이션 개선: 자동 주행과 경로 안내가 목적지와 지형에 맞게 정상적으로 작동해야 한다.

조작과 인터페이스 개선: 무기 교체, 대화 넘기기, 차량 호출, 엘리베이터 이용 등의 기본 조작을 직관적으로 만들어야 한다.

그래픽 설정 개선: 감마 조절만으로 해결되지 않는 눈부심과 시각적 피로 문제를 개선해야 한다.

퀘스트와 NPC 개선: 퀘스트 보상과 성장을 연계하고, 시민과 NPC의 반응 및 범죄 판정을 자연스럽게 조정해야 한다.

결제 및 환불 안내 개선: 표시 가격과 실제 결제 금액을 명확하게 안내하고 환불 조건을 쉽게 확인할 수 있도록 해야 한다.

이러한 문제를 고객센터나 스팀 판매·유통 담당자에게 문의해 게임이 개선되었으면 한다. 다만 실제로 개선될지는 회의적이다.

15. 최종 결론

병신 같은 게임이다. 다 뜯어고치고 싶을 정도다.

서브 퀘스트는 많지만 성장의 재미가 보장되지 않고, 적을 처치해도 보상이 부족하다. 난이도를 높여도 그에 따른 성장 기회가 충분하지 않으며, 엔딩 이후에는 할 만한 콘텐츠도 거의 없다.

차량과 도로 AI는 엉망이고, 내비게이션은 위험한 경로를 안내하기도 한다. 무기 조작과 이동 시스템은 불편하며, 탄약 수급과 아이템 강화 역시 지나치게 번거롭다. 그래픽 설정과 게임 실행 과정, 가격 및 환불 문제까지 여러 부분에서 불만이 쌓인다.

이 게임을 RPG로 생각하고 성장과 보상을 기대한다면 실망할 가능성이 크다. 많은 시간을 투자해 서브 퀘스트를 수행하더라도 그만한 성취감을 얻지 못할 수 있다.

구매할 가치가 있는 게임인지 충분히 의심해 보자. 스토리와 콘텐츠의 양만 볼 것이 아니라 실제 전투와 성장 시스템, 편의성, 엔딩 이후의 플레이 가능성까지 고려해야 한다.

패치와 개선을 해 주었으면 한다. 지금 상태로는 불편한 점이 너무 많다.

정말이지, 병신 같은 게임이다. 다 뜯어버리고 싶다.

I've just finished my first playthrough of this game, trying a couple different endings and completing pretty much every side mission and task I could find. I've had an absolute blast with it. The gameplay is a lot of fun and highly varied, and I never grew bored of it despite how long the game can be if you're playing it to near-completion like I did. There's a lot here. Here's my breakdown of how I personally found various aspects and mechanics of the game:

- Gunplay: Satisfying, fun, and with a lot of variability in weapon types and combat styles.

- Stealth: Not as much my thing and I occasionally had difficulty with enemies seeming to spot me when it didn't feel like they should be able to, but in a lot of cases I found myself deliberately trying it for as long as I could despite going in guns blazing usually being more my style. The stealth mechanics and the options for it created by landscape layouts often provide enough options that it encourages you to try it.

- Driving: Overall a lot of fun, and I love the styling of all the different cars. I really enjoyed building up a large garage and trying different cars to see how I liked them, both for style and for driving feel. One small but persistent complaint I had here is that pretty much every car feels quite hard to handle - prone to oversteer and difficult to corner smoothly without a lot of caution and practice. On the cars that are clearly meant to be powerful rear-drive muscle cars this makes sense, but when even the cars that come across as very 'normal' cars that your grandmother would drive to the grocery store and back feel like all the tyres are bald and only Ken Block would have a hope of controlling the thing, it feels a bit silly. This was a very minor issue and probably largely up to my personal preference, but it annoyed me frequently enough that it feels worth mentioning.

- Clothing and style: Maybe a silly thing to mention, but big open-world RPGs like this that give you such control over how you present yourself and approach things and appear in game should be all about wish fulfilment. If I'm going to play a game that lets me be a big shot mercenary in a cyberpunk world, I want to be able to dress up in a way that feels suitably badass and satisfying to me, have weapons that fit my play style and make me feel awesome, drive cars that I would dream of driving... all of that. Let me drop into a game like this and live out a fantasy. On this front, the game absolutely delivers. I became very vain about taking photos of my character wearing different cool outfits, posing by various cars, and generally looking and feeling stylish and badass. For me, this sort of thing is a big part of a big open game like this, especially one based in a cyberpunk genre. The world may be a dystopian hellscape but at least I get to look amazing.

- Story and lore: As good as the basic gameplay mechanics are, the powerful storytelling, rich characters, great voice acting, and immersive world is what kept pulling me back to wanting to play more and more of the game night after night. I think I'd have to put this game in my top ten, maybe top five, for best story, and the power with which the story (and all the various sub- and side-stories) propels the entire gaming experience.

- Unexpected grumbles: For all that the game usually lets you approach problems on your own terms, every now and then it does unexpectedly force a certain playstyle on you. Sometimes it's optional - stealth is encouraged with extra pay, but if you just want to go in guns blazing you can, you just won't get as big a payout from your fixer, and they might give you some cranky words over it, but there's no further penalty. Other times however, especially in the main story missions, your preferred and specced approach to solving problems is not considered and you are forced into stealth sections with varying degrees of difficulty, and there is no other option in how you can progress. I will freely admit that my struggles with this in places are down to personal preference, or what some could fairly label a 'skill issue' as the kids are saying these days, but there is one section of the game where, depending on the story choices you make, this can become particularly, I would say game-breakingly, bad. Enforced stealth and hiding and if you are discovered it is instant game over. It felt jarringly out of place and out of keeping with the entire style of the rest of the game, and not something that people buying this game would expect. It quickly grew frustrating and difficult enough that I felt my only option was to reload an older save and make a different choice in the story that led me down a different path to avoid that section of the game entirely - otherwise I don't believe I could have progressed further in the game at all.

So I have a few small grumbles, the largest of which by far is the one I've just described as it shut me out of a branch of the story entirely, but honestly - this is a fantastic game and I've had an absolute blast playing it. It's one that I can see aging very well and enduring the test of time the way Skyrim has, and similarly one that I will likely come back to and play again sometime in the future, like revisiting a long but really good book.

eu amo cyberpunk 2077, de verdade. esse jogo tá fazendo parte de uma época muito importante da minha vida, minha adolescência, e acho que isso é uma das coisas que mais fazem ele ser especial pra mim. não é só um jogo que eu abro quando tô entediado, é um jogo que eu realmente gosto de passar horas jogando, explorando e vivendo tudo que ele tem pra oferecer. night city é simplesmente absurda, sério. os gráficos, as luzes, os prédios, as ruas, os carros e toda aquela atmosfera fazem o mundo parecer vivo de um jeito que poucos jogos conseguem. às vezes eu nem quero fazer missão nenhuma, só fico andando pela cidade, vendo os npcs bandidos, e isso já é o suficiente pra me divertir, é muito bom quando um jogo consegue fazer você gostar até de não fazer absolutamente nada nele
a história também é uma das minhas partes favoritas. os personagens são muito bem escritos e é muito fácil acabar se apegando a eles. o(a) V, o Johnny, a Judy, a Panam e vários outros fazem você se importar com o que acontece, e algumas missões realmente ficam na sua cabeça depois que você termina de jogar. gosto muito de como o jogo consegue misturar ação com momentos mais tranquilos e histórias que fazem você pensar. e as escolhas também ajudam bastante, criando um aspecto diferente em cada run
a gameplay é muito divertida também, principalmente pela quantidade de possibilidades que existem. dá pra testar várias builds, usar diferentes armas, melhorar seus implantes e jogar do jeito que você preferir. cada vez que descubro alguma coisa nova, parece que ainda tem mais pra explorar. sem contar a trilha sonora, que combina demais com o jogo e deixa tudo ainda melhor pprt

Cyberpunk 2077 est tout simplement l'un des plus grands jeux auxquels j'ai joué en plus de 25 ans de gaming. Sur plus de 300 jeux terminés, il entre sans la moindre hésitation dans mon Top 3.

Ce qui rend ce jeu exceptionnel, ce n'est pas uniquement son univers visuellement hallucinant ou son gameplay, mais surtout la qualité de son écriture. L'histoire de V et de Johnny Silverhand est portée par des personnages mémorables, des choix souvent difficiles et des thèmes profonds comme l'identité, la liberté, la mort ou encore la place de l'humain dans un monde dominé par les mégacorporations.
 
Le scénario principal est captivant, mais ce qui impressionne encore davantage, c'est la qualité des quêtes secondaires, dont certaines surpassent le scénario principal de nombreux RPG concurrents.

Pendant longtemps, Cyberpunk 2077 a traîné la réputation de son lancement catastrophique. Mais juger le jeu aujourd'hui sur sa sortie de 2020 n'a plus aucun sens. Après des années de mises à jour, CD Projekt RED a totalement transformé l'expérience. 
La mise à jour 2.0 a profondément revu les systèmes de progression, l'intelligence artificielle, la police, les compétences, les combats en véhicule et de très nombreux aspects du gameplay, tout en apportant une quantité massive de corrections et d'améliorations.

Aujourd'hui, Night City est l'une des villes les plus crédibles, immersives et fascinantes jamais créées dans un jeu vidéo. Chaque quartier possède sa propre identité, ses histoires, son ambiance et ses secrets. On ne se contente pas d'y jouer : on y vit.

Et c'est peut-être là la plus grande qualité de Cyberpunk 2077. Quand on termine réellement le jeu, qu'on a exploré Night City sous toutes ses coutures et qu'on arrive au générique de fin, le seul véritable regret que l'on peut ressentir, c'est que l'aventure s'arrête. 

Parce qu'au fond, on sait pertinemment qu'il sera extrêmement difficile de retrouver un jour une expérience aussi marquante. Dans l'état actuel de l'industrie du jeu vidéo, les œuvres capables de réunir une telle richesse scénaristique, une telle immersion et un tel attachement aux personnages sont devenues rares.

Cyberpunk 2077 n'est plus seulement une rédemption spectaculaire. C'est désormais une référence du RPG moderne. Un jeu qui marque durablement la mémoire du joueur et qui rappelle pourquoi nous sommes tombés amoureux du jeu vidéo.

画面切换到几十年前的荒坂塔。强尼·银手的脸在火光旁边停留了三秒，随后被大卫的照片替换。主播提醒大家，敌人从未放弃破坏我们来之不易的生活。

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 没有见过银手，但从入职培训起就认识那张照片。

新闻下面滚动着修复倡议：建议员工自愿减薪 15%，与公司共渡难关。报名截止时间为当日 18:30。

收到倡议时，受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 正在查看义体分期账单，待还款 32,400 欧元。减薪以后，每个月就只剩 100 多欧元可以吃饭。

胸口的循环辅助器发出两声提示。维护预约已经推迟了三次。这次，受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 把提醒改到了下个月。

晨会上，主管重申了特殊时期的工作安排：[b]每周 7 天，每天 12 小时，原有加班补贴暂停发放。[/b]
“康陶正在挤压我们的生存空间。每一笔资源都必须用在最需要的地方。这一切，最终都是为了员工，为了大家更美好的未来。”

主管说，自愿减薪完全尊重个人意愿。部门的参与进度被投到墙上。每个名字后面都有一个方框。

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 的方框是空的。

午餐时，食堂正在播放 Relic 宣传片。一位老人隔着屏幕，重新听到了亡妻的声音。字幕说：“荒坂正在守护人类最珍贵的财富。”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 B 已经自愿减薪 20%。
“有些东西是底线。”受到尊敬的优秀员工 B 指着屏幕说，“这些数字人格当然属于荒坂。没有荒坂，哪还有这些灵魂？谁否认这个，就是在践踏人类的尊严。”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 看了一会儿价目表。存一次灵魂，比剩下的全部义体贷款还贵。

“减薪要持续多久？”受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 问。
“等打赢了康陶，自然就好了。”
“可是分期每个月都要还。”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 B 放下筷子。
“都是公司给了你机会，是公司在养你。”
“明明是我自己的工作在养自己。”
“白眼狼！不懂感恩！”

邻桌的人转过头来。受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 咽下嘴里的饭。
“没有不感恩。只是想问问。”
“嫌荒坂不好，就滚去康陶。享受着荒坂的保护，又不肯为荒坂出力，康陶到底给了你多少欧元？”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 从没见过康陶的人，也不知道该去哪里找康陶。这话说出来，又像是在打听。

食堂屏幕上的老人微笑着，亡妻正在祝老人生日快乐。

饭后，受到尊敬的优秀员工 B 追上来，放轻声音。
“赶紧签了吧。大家不会一直等你。刚才那些话，出了这个部门，可就没人替你解释了。”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 点头，感谢提醒。

下午，受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 向人事咨询能否暂缓减薪。人事发来一张转办单：义体贷款由合作金融机构发放，延期事宜需联系贷款方。贷款方很快回复：工资调整属于雇主内部事务，不影响还款安排。

两张单据都显示问题已解决。

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 又向主管解释，自己没有拿康陶的欧元。主管说，部门从来没有认定任何人是间谍，完全不必紧张。特殊时期，大家只是希望确认彼此仍然站在一起。
“减薪自愿。相信你会作出自己的选择。”

17:59，部门参与进度已经达到 27/28。

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 算过少吃一顿饭能省多少，也算过卖掉一只义眼能还多少。受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 点开宿舍和医疗额度页面，[b]申请条件是：在职员工。[/b]

18:12，受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 勾选了自愿减薪 15%，并确认决定不受任何胁迫。主管发来一个握手的表情。受到尊敬的优秀员工 B 在群里说：“早就知道是一家人。”

胸口的提示又响起来。受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 关闭声音，终于松了一口气。

非常满意。

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 差一点因为个人困难，辜负了大家的信任。公司没有放弃受到尊敬的优秀员工 A，同事们也没有放弃受到尊敬的优秀员工 A。

12 小时的工作结束前，部门录制了一段团结倡议视频。屏幕上出现荒坂的标志。
“携手共创光明未来。”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 站直身体，跟着大家喊了第一遍。第二遍，受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 主动提高了声音。

“我爱荒坂！碾压康陶！”

受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 死了。

一栋海景豪宅里，一名肥胖的荒坂高层搂着两个格外“坦诚”的女人。电视里的员工关怀简报正在重播受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 的表态视频。

“劳动者最光荣。”高层对着屏幕举起酒杯。两个女人也举起酒杯。

碰杯后，高层带着两个女人走进卧室。门合上了，电视没有关。

播音员继续念道：
“受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 连续奋战，主动减薪，在生命的最后时刻仍心系公司，倒在了光荣的工作岗位上。公司对受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 的奉献给予高度评价，并向受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 的亲友表示亲切慰问。”

屏幕右侧出现了一个收款码。

“经核实，受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 尚欠合作金融机构 57,000 欧元。公司已为受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 的亲友开通爱心代偿通道，诚邀大家自愿接续这份责任，让受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 放心离去。”

播音员停顿了几秒。

“请于 24 小时内完成登记。逾期未登记者，公司将依据受到尊敬的优秀员工 A 的紧急联系人及社交记录，主动寻找相关亲友，提供上门协助。”

“感谢理解与配合。”

I'm someone who absolutely loves long open-world games with massive maps, immersive environments, exploration, and, most importantly, a great story. And Cyberpunk 2077 delivers on all of these.

After spending more than 87 hours in Night City, I'm still not bored. In fact, I still find myself wanting to explore more, complete side quests, discover new places, and just enjoy the atmosphere of this incredible world.

The world itself is one of the biggest reasons I love this game. Night City feels alive, detailed, and full of personality. Every district has its own atmosphere, and sometimes just driving around the city, especially at night, is an experience in itself.

The storytelling is another highlight. The main story is engaging, the characters are memorable, and many of the side quests feel just as meaningful as the main missions. The choices, relationships, and emotional moments make the experience even better.

The combat, character customization, soundtrack, visuals, and overall atmosphere make it incredibly easy to lose track of time.

Sure, the game isn't perfect, but the overall experience is something special.

For me, a good open-world game isn't just about having a huge map. It's about having a world that makes you WANT to spend hundreds of hours in it. Cyberpunk 2077 absolutely succeeds at that.

If you love massive open worlds, strong storytelling, memorable characters, and games that you can get completely lost in for hours, I highly recommend Cyberpunk 2077.

[h1]CYBERPUNK 2077 - Пример прекрасной работы и творческого упорства.[/h1]

Я слежу за данным проектом ещё со времён релиза и за всё это время успел увидеть, какой непростой путь прошла игра. На старте проект столкнулся с множеством проблем, и результат оказался далеко не таким, каким его задумывали разработчики. Однако вместо того, чтобы оставить всё как есть, CD PROJEKT RED продолжила работу над игрой, постепенно исправляя ошибки, улучшая механики и развивая игровой мир. И за проделанную работу хочется выразить команде отдельную благодарность.

На сегодняшний день Cyberpunk 2077 не просто "красивый фантик" а весьма хорошо поставленный сюжет и глубина погружения, может и не все действия нашего персонажа отражают влияние на сюжет, но даже учитывая этот факт, игра всё равно остаётся тем местом, куда хочется иной раз вернуться что-бы "просто исследовать/осматривать весь Найт-Сити".

Отдельно хочется отметить визуальную составляющую. Освещение, архитектура, отражения, дождливые улицы и неоновые огни сочившиеся отовсюду создают красочную и приятную глазу атмосферу.

[b]"Город мечты"[/b] - это место, в которое хочется возвращаться даже после завершения основных историй. Ради атмосферы, ради новых открытий и ради тех самых моментов, когда можно просто остановиться и посмотреть на город.

Если вы всё ещё не сделали этого - возможно, ваше путешествие только начинается.

[b]Добро пожаловать в Найт-Сити ![/b]

                                                   [b]-Небольшое послесловие-[/b]

Если у вас есть желание и подходящее оборудование, а визуальная составляющая игры представляет для вас ( как и для меня ) особый интерес и элемент ещё более атмосферного погружения, рекомендую обратить внимание на DreamPunk и дополнительные графические улучшения.

Даже при использовании базовых настроек можно добиться впечатляющей картинки, а в подходящих сценах - получить кадры, которые выглядят почти фотореалистично.

I ended up quite enjoying Cyberpunk 2077. This was my first time playing a game with guns in it, which took a bit of getting used to, but the game actually makes using guns pretty easy. There is an aim button to lock onto targets, which helps a ton, but it doesn’t work in every situation, which is nice. Since the targeting seems to go for the center of the body, it doesn’t work if the enemy is behind cover, meaning you have to aim to hit the parts sticking out from the cover. Also, headshots do a lot more damage, but they also require you to manually aim. Going for headshots was really fun, and it was nice getting slowly better at them throughout the game. Lastly, the aiming doesn’t stay on target if you are rapidly firing a gun, meaning to use those effectively requires a fair bit of skill. My favorite weapon to use was a sniper rifle I found whose shots exploded on impact; it was rather fun lining up headshots and one-tapping each enemy. Eventually, the damage of it fell behind my other weapons, so I switched over to mainly using a shotgun, which was also fun in its own way, just walking up to enemies and blasting them in the face. Using the guns was pretty fun for around 3/4s of the game, but once I neared the end and felt confident in my ability, most encounters were pretty easy to beat, and there weren’t any unique combat challenges to overcome. Upping the difficulty might’ve helped, but I had a tanky build, so it probably would’ve just required me to play a bit more cautiously. Ultimately, while I did have fun learning to use guns, when I actually think about the combat encounters, they were all incredibly similar to each other, largely because pretty much every enemy in the game fights the same. Unlike in fantasy RPGs where they can have various monsters and beasts that all fight differently and can offer novel experiences with each combat, Cyberpunk 2077 is in a fairly grounded world, meaning basically all of your enemies are just people with guns. Basically, if you're someone who enjoys gunplay, you’d probably find the gameplay consistently fun, but for people who don’t love gunplay, the combat can grow a bit repetitive. The other main form of gameplay in this is stealthing. I really liked sneaking past guards and taking down all the guards one by one without getting caught. Honestly, don’t really have any complaints apart from the fact that retrying a stealth section was quite difficult, as you either had to run fully out of the area to get out of combat and try again, or reload your save, which took a while on my computer. But honestly, that’s a minor gripe, I still rather enjoyed those sections. Next up, I’ll discuss the quests and story in this game. The game is divided into three acts, which is a fairly odd structure since you’ll spend the vast majority of your time in Act 2, but that’s beside the point. Act 1 is probably my favorite in terms of the story. I’m no story writing expert, so I can’t explain exactly why, but the characters, situations, and story beats feel a lot more gripping and better written than the main quests in Act 2. It also helps that you’re basically locked into the main quests during the first act, making the intro to the game a few hours straight of well-written story. Once Act 1 one ends, the world opens up and the main story begins. However, the main quests in this section don’t really hit the same highs as Act 1; I just found the story and content of these quests to be less engaging. My major problem with this act is how short the main quests are compared to side content. There’s maybe around a dozen hours worth of main content compared to upwards of a hundred hours of side content. Now don’t get me wrong, I love side content, but the ratio of main quests to side quests feels far too high to me. As well, it’s very easy to accidentally complete too much main quest content at once, leaving you with an even worse ratio of main content to side content left to do. This is fine in games where the side content is well integrated into the main quests, but most of the side stuff you do in this feels very tangential to the main plot of the game. It especially feels strange to be spending so much time on side quests when V is on a time crunch since they’re dying soon. In The Witcher, it makes sense that Geralt is stopping to slay beasts and help people since he is a witcher, but in this game, it feels weird for V to be wasting all this time on helping various people when he’s supposedly going to die any day now. Anyways, despite the side quests not being well integrated into the main story, I still rather enjoyed them. Most of the side quests are quest chains that each have you helping a different character with various problems they’re facing. These side quests are great from a character perspective, as each one lets us spend a lot of time getting to know a character, seeing them develop over the course of the quests, and lets V slowly get closer to them. Pretty much all of my favorite characters in the game come from these quests: Panam, River, Judy, Claire, and, in a sense, Delamain and Brendan. As well, the events you go through and the story of these side quests are a lot more interesting than Act 2’s main quests in my opinion, as well as more variety in the stuff you’re doing, including things like racing, investigating a conspiracy, and spending a day with a reformed murderer. Outside of the side quests, there’s a ton of minor quests (AKA minor jobs), gigs, and NCPD Scanners. These quests are far less interesting, as they basically boil down to you either killing a bunch of people or sneaking into a place. If you absolutely love the gameplay, these quests can be fun, but despite how much I liked the gameplay, they quickly got repetitive for me. It also doesn’t help that there’s very little incentive to do them, and it’s pretty easy to accidentally skip them while playing through the main game given the sheer number of fast travel points dotted around the map. I just feel like if the developers wanted more players to do these, as the achievements imply, there should’ve been far fewer fast travel points on the map. And as for Act 3 of the game, it basically just consists of the ending path you choose, only taking one to two hours. Each pathway is a good bit different from the others, offering varying gameplay challenges and very unique endings to V’s story. As we become hyper-focused on the story again, it gets a lot more engaging, similar to Act 1 levels. The stories in all of the endings I experienced were all quite interesting. Each one feels like it could be the canon ending to V’s story, either through perfectly resolving V’s arc or being an incredibly fitting end for a cyberpunk story. While I think I enjoyed Act 1 more, many people absolutely love the endings in this game, which I think is completely fair. Lastly, as many are aware, this game initially launched in a very buggy and almost unplayable state for some, but in my playthrough I only noticed the occasional visual bug or issue with the NPC pathfinding. I’d say it’s roughly the amount of slight bugs one would expect in a AAA game, so nothing out of the ordinary. 

To summarize, I quite enjoyed the gunplay and stealthing, however, the combats themselves were fairly similar to each other and started to feel a bit boring near the end. The main story was quite good in the first act, was pretty good in the last act, but wasn’t all that interesting in the second act. The sidequests were all quite good from a character-writing perspective, as well as providing very novel and interesting experiences in the game. The minor quests though are all fairly repetitive and only really enjoyable for those who are in love with the combat. Overall, while it has its occasional lows, Cyberpunk 2077 is a consistently pretty fun ride throughout, with fun gameplay, great characters, and plenty of gripping story moments. A solid 8/10.

Киберпанк стал самым неожиданным открытием среди игр за последнее время. Все прошлые игры, которые теперь хранятся в моём списке самых любимых, всегда изначально считались мной хорошими. Завышенные ожидания, которые оправдались. Но эта игра не об этом. Слыша кучу скандалов, я не рассчитывала вообще ни на что. Хоть и восторги друга от этой игры внушали некоторые сомнения в мою предвзятость. Но начав, передо мной открылась такая история, которую я не ожидала и даже не могла мечтать.

Геймлей понятен, легок в использовании. Я пошла по пути хладнокровия и силы, в основном кидая ножи или катаны. Всё очень плавно, было приятно ходить на перестрелки. В кибер-имплантах тоже нетрудно разобраться, везде помечено, к какому он классу, пассивные навыки. Потому голова не начинает болеть, когда ты пытаешься собрать для себя идеальную сборку.

Настолько комфортно играть в открытый мир мне было только в Ведьмаке. Просто ощущение, что ты как рыба в воде. Всё интуитивно понятно, что для меня (как человека, игнорирующего текст в обучении) главное в играх. Персонажи максимально неоднозначны и глубоко прописаны, что заставляет тебя и рыдать, и ненавидеть их одновременно. Эмоций куча, осадок огромный. И дикое ощущение недосказанности. Мне так будто не хватило этой истории. Так будто этого было мало (я в игре провела +100 часов). И как же обидно знать, что второго ДЛС не будет.

Тут выбор НЕ ИЛЛЮЗИЯ. Ты не делаешь пустые решения. Ты правда влияешь на мир вокруг себя, и это тебе потом аукается. Хоть и не в глобальном плане, но радует, что персонажи не забывают о твоих словах.

Доп. квесты не скучные, а даже имеют свою историю. Почти на каждом заказе есть чипы, в которых рассказывается история отдельных НПС. Что только сильнее тебя погружает в мир и осознание, насколько же плохо в этом городе «мечты». И тем не менее, они недолгие. Редко льют воду, а дают тебе лишь факты, с которыми ты должен разбираться сам. Убить или оставить в живых, украсть или помочь. Нет ощущения, что ты проходишь их через силу.

Длс вообще не расстроило, а подарило точно такую же бурю эмоций. Драма, стресс, обман. Тебя кидают в новую историю, где каждый ищет выгоду для себя. Вариативность концовок радует, хоть и сами концовки вызвали личный негатив к развитию событий.

Я безумно прониклась главным героем. И так давно не ощущала единство с ГГ, потому что зачастую он выступает глупым, надоедливым или наоборот слишком умным. Мне очень понравилась главная героиня (голос женской версии Ви мой любимый). Я правда ощущала себя там, что это мои выборы, что её манера общения близка со мной. Персонаж получился и вправду живым, который просто хочет выжить в этом мире, где всё как будто против него.

Концовки — это особый сок. Я сразу вышла на “Легенду”, которую я считаю для себя самой самой приятной, каноничной и идеальной. Концовка с Арасакой немного расстроила. Очень хотелось, чтобы тревожность и депрессию героя дожали, вылив это в какой-нибудь психологический хоррор. Но меня в целом и это устраивает.

Ну и стоит добавить, что игра реально играбельна и пробивает тебя на эмоции только спустя кучу патчей и 5-ти лет после выпуска. Играющие на релизе, вероятней всего, потеряли все эти ощущения и не смогли увидеть весь тот потенциал, что скрывался под багами. Что определённо очень обидно.

¡Un juegazo que ojalá hubiera descubierto antes!

He jugado a Cyberpunk 2077 este verano, en 2026, y me da rabia no haberlo comprado antes. Es de los mejores juegos que he jugado últimamente. Le he dedicado unas 180 horas y, aunque siento que he explorado muchísimo y he visto prácticamente todos los finales, todavía me queda un montón por completar: solo he conseguido alrededor de la mitad de los logros.

Lo que más me atrapó no fue tanto la historia principal como el vínculo que acabas desarrollando con tu propio personaje y con su forma de desenvolverse en el mundo. Le cogí muchísimo cariño. Algunos momentos del lore hacen que conectes con él, te plantees qué decisiones tomar y, a veces, elijas una opción más moral. Esa conexión hizo que mi partida se sintiera muy personal.

Night City es inmensa y espectacular. El mundo se siente abierto y recorrerlo resulta muy fluido; en mi ordenador, las cargas fueron rapidísimas y no tuve problemas técnicos. Y los gráficos… maravillosos.
También me encantó cómo las decisiones cambian la experiencia. Incluso algunas misiones secundarias pequeñas tienen historias con profundidad, y la forma de abordarlas puede cambiar lo que ocurre: puedes negociar, enfrentarte a alguien o decidir si lo matas. Las misiones secundarias son interesantes por sí mismas y algunas te dejan pensando. Además, los tres trasfondos iniciales influyen en ciertos diálogos y ayudan a definir quién es tu personaje.

El ritmo me pareció muy bueno: hay carreras, misiones intensas y otras más tranquilas, con más espacio para el lore. Puedes avanzar en la historia principal cuando se desbloquea la opción de ir hacia el final, o seguir explorando y completando misiones para conocer mejor el mundo y descubrir otros desenlaces. También puedes adaptar el combate a tu estilo, aunque al principio hay tantas mecánicas y opciones para desarrollar al personaje que puede costar un poco orientarse. A mí me llevó unas horas entenderlas bien; después, todo encajó.

Los personajes y los diálogos son increíbles. Me reí muchísimo y también hubo momentos que me emocionaron. Tiene algunas escenas subidas de tono, así que no lo recomendaría para menores.
No he jugado todavía a Phantom Liberty, pero la tengo muy pendiente. Recomiendo Cyberpunk 2077 a cualquiera que disfrute de este tipo de juegos. Para mí, ha sido una experiencia brutal.

CYBERPUNK 2077
Cyberpunk 2077 คือเกมแนวแอ็กชัน Open-world ที่มีเสน่ห์เฉพาะตัวอย่างน่าประหลาด การรังสรรค์โลก Night City ทำออกมาได้ละเมียดละไม มีปกรณัมและปมหลัง (Lore) ที่เข้มข้นจนทำให้เมืองนี้มีชีวิตจริงๆ จุดเด่นสำคัญคือเนื้อเรื่องที่ชะตากรรมทุกอย่างขึ้นอยู่กับการตัดสินใจของเราเอง การปฏิสัมพันธ์กับตัวละครเต็มไปด้วยความลึกซึ้ง มีการวางรากฐานและเส้นทางชีวิตของแต่ละตัวละครไว้เป็นอย่างดี ไม่เว้นแม้กระทั่ง "เควสรอง" ที่เขียนบทมาได้อย่างกินใจ จนทำให้ทุกครั้งที่ต้องเลือกคำตอบหรือทางเดิน เราต้องหยุดคิดและหนักใจอยู่เสมอ

ในแง่ของงานสร้าง ฉากแอ็กชันทำออกมาได้จัดเต็ม สะใจ และดุเดือด ผสานเข้ากับเพลงประกอบ (Soundtrack) ที่เข้าถึงอารมณ์และเสียงพากย์คุณภาพสูงที่ช่วยถ่ายทอดอารมณ์ออกมาได้อย่างครบรส แม้ว่าเส้นทางในตอนจบจะมีหลากหลายรูปแบบ แต่เราก็สามารถเลือกได้ด้วยตัวเองว่าฉากจบแบบไหนคือจุดสิ้นสุดที่ดีที่สุดสำหรับเรา — นี่คือเกมแอ็กชันที่เลือกเส้นทางที่ดีที่สุดตลอดกาล

PHANTOM LIBERTY (DLC)
เรื่องราวในภาคเสริมเริ่มต้นขึ้นเมื่อมีบุคคลปริศนาติดต่อเข้ามา เป็นการเปิดม่านสู่พื้นที่ใหม่อย่าง Dogtown อันเป็นจุดเริ่มต้นของบทบาทใหม่เต็มไปด้วยอันตราย การเข้ามาของตัวละครหลักอย่าง ท่านประธานาธิบดีโรซาลินด์ ไมเออร์ส (Rosalind Myers), โซโลมอน รีด (Solomon Reed), อเล็กซ์ (Alex) และตัวแปรสำคัญอย่าง ซองเบิร์ด หรือ ซองโซมี (Songbird / Song So-mi) ทุกชะตากรรมมาบรรจบกันในดินแดนแห่งนี้

เนื้อหาในภาคนี้มีความเข้มข้นและตึงเครียดสูงขึ้นมาก เสน่ห์ของตัวละครแต่ละตัวเปล่งประกายอย่างเด่นชัด ยิ่งเล่นไปเรายิ่งรู้สึกผูกพันและสัมผัสได้ว่า ทุกคนต่างก็มีอุดมการณ์ เป้าหมาย และเหตุผลในการดิ้นรนเป็นของตัวเอง แม้สุดท้ายแล้วทุกอย่างจะไม่เป็นไปตามแผน และเนื้อเรื่องจะบีบบังคับให้เราต้องเลือกในสถานการณ์ที่ไร้ซึ่ง "จุดจบที่สมบูรณ์แบบ" แต่มันก็คือสิ่งที่เราต้องตัดสินใจเพื่อเลือกทางที่ดีที่สุดเท่าที่จะทำได้

ท่ามกลางคำโกหกและการทรยศหักหลังใน Dogtown คนเดียวที่อาจไว้ใจได้จริง ๆ กลับมีเพียง จอนนี่ ซิลเวอร์แฮนด์ (Johnny Silverhand) เท่านั้น นี่คือ DLC ที่ทำออกมาได้ทรงคุณค่า คุ้มค่าสมราคา และเนื้อเรื่องกินใจขั้นสุด 10/10

9/10，現今賽博龐克題材遊戲中，沉浸感最強的作品之一
這款遊戲已經推出六年了，但如今真正破完一輪，我依然覺得它完全沒有過時。戰鬥、音樂、畫面與整體美術表現都相當出色，但真正讓《Cyberpunk 2077》鶴立雞群的，還是它對劇情與角色的刻畫。你以 V 的視角穿梭在夜城，與各方勢力打交道，也在旅途中認識一個又一個夥伴。遊戲並不會一直用旁白告訴你「夜城有多危險」，而是透過這些角色的經歷、選擇與結局，讓你一點一點拼湊出這座城市的樣貌。

而真正讓我驚訝的，是很多支線劇情甚至不輸主線。像約書亞的任務線，就讓我花了不少時間去思考宗教、罪、救贖與善惡。我很佩服CDPR願意在一款商業遊戲裡放進這麼具有爭議、又不急著給玩家標準答案的劇情。它甚至讓我在任務結束之後，還會繼續想「如果是我，我會怎麼看待這件事？」而主線則是我認為《2077》最頂尖的部分。從與強尼相遇開始，一路尋找救命的方法，同時結識不同的夥伴、捲入各方勢力，直到最後站在人生最後一次重大抉擇的門前，你會突然意識到：這些人、這些經歷，真的要在這裡畫下句點了。那種重量感，是我認為《Cyberpunk 2077》最出色的地方。而且遊戲提供的不同結局，也不是單純換一段CG而已。不同的選擇會重新詮釋V、強尼，以及一路上遇到的那些人的故事。即使知道結局可能不會改變某些事情，走到最後依然會有一種「我真的做出了這個選擇」的感覺。

可惜，這也是我沒辦法給滿分的原因。因為我是首發預購玩家。當年我滿懷期待買下這款遊戲，卻因為首發版本糟糕的優化與技術問題，最後幾乎沒有真正體驗它。對我來說，這不只是「當年的遊戲有Bug」這麼簡單，而是我與這款遊戲第一次相遇的體驗，就已經被破壞了。六年後，在經歷無數次更新、修正與重製版級別的改造之後，我終於真正坐下來把它玩完。而最有意思的是，我現在反而更加確定，當年大家期待的那款遊戲，其實真的存在。它只是晚了很多年才真正完成。如果不是首發版本留下的那段經歷，我現在很可能會直接給它滿分。但沒有如果，所以我最後給9/10。

即便如此，我依然認為《Cyberpunk 2077》是近年少數真正能讓我在破關之後，還會一直回想劇情與角色的 RPG。希望CD PROJEKT RED能把這次一路跌跌撞撞累積下來的經驗帶進下一部作品。如果《Cyberpunk 2》能延續這種角色塑造、世界觀與敘事能力，我很期待有一天能看到他們真正把這個系列做到自己當初想像中的樣子。

夜城，再見。下一次見面，希望不用再等六年。
