[h1]🌆 Обзор на Cyberpunk 2077: или как я в 2020 писал руководство, а в 2026 наконец-то могу просто наслаждаться 🎮[/h1]
🕰️ Часть 1. Исповедь человека, который писал то самое руководство
Когда-то, в далёком 2020 году, я написал руководство по Cyberpunk 2077. Это был не гайд. Это был крик души, записанный в текстовом редакторе. 😱

Я учил людей, как убрать это унылое мыло. Как закинуть файлы в bin/x64. Как запустить программу решений, выбрать Киберпанка, нажать на два checkbox, потом на Update, потом выбрать только первые два пункта и самый последний 👇. Как открыть EditReShade, нажать на троеточие, выбрать CP2077_photorealistic_1.0.ini, нажать OK и закрыть программу. Как зайти в игру, нажать Home и начать экспериментировать с ползунками. Как скачать репак для процессора AMD, чтобы игра не отжирала ФПС, а наоборот — добавляла 10–15 кадров. 🛠️
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2334573763
Тогда я писал: «Она не должна была выйти так рано, ей как минимум года 2 ещё». И знаете что? Я был прав. Но это было тогда. Сейчас 2026 год. Вода утекла, высохла, снова налилась, а Cyberpunk 2077… стал хорошим. Нет, не просто хорошим. Он стал тем, чем обещали. 🌃🔥

Моё старое руководство теперь можно вставить в рамку и повесить на стену как исторический экспонат. Экспонат эпохи, когда игроки были одновременно тестировщиками, мододелами, психологами и немножко шаманами. 📜😂

🌊 Часть 2. Что мы имели тогда
Давайте честно. В 2020 году Cyberpunk 2077 был сырым, как тесто, которое забыли в холодильнике на три года. 🧀

Баги лезли из всех щелей. NPC исчезали, стоило отвернуться. Машины летали. Полиция телепортировалась. Текстуры не грузились. Оптимизация была такой, что мой ПК плакал в углу и просил пощады. 💻😭
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2341804481
Я помню, как сидел с бубном, ставил ReShade, крутил ползунки, нагружал процессор AMD, чтобы получить хотя бы стабильные 40 кадров. Это была не игра. Это была работа. Вторая смена. Без зарплаты. Но с надеждой, что однажды CD Projekt Red всё исправят. 🤞

И они исправили. Не сразу. Не быстро. Но исправили. 🚀

✅ Часть 3. Что мы имеем сейчас
После обновления 2.0, дополнения Phantom Liberty и кучи патчей CD Projekt Red сделали невозможное: они не просто починили игру — они её пересобрали. Переработали перки, полицию, киберware, вождение, ИИ, баланс, добавили метро. Мыло? Разработчики сами добавили DLSS, FSR, XeSS, sharpening и path tracing. Моё старое руководство теперь можно вставить в рамку и повесить на стену как исторический экспонат 📜😂.

Тогда я учил людей, как убрать мыло. Теперь игра сама всё убрала. Прогресс! 😭🚀

🐛 Баги? Остались, но теперь это смешные баги, а не «игра сломалась, верните деньги».

📉 Оптимизация? Стало лучше. Мой старый ПК всё ещё плачет, но уже от счастья. 💻😭

🧼 Мыло? Убрали. Можно даже вернуть, если вы ностальгируете по 2020-му.

📖 Сюжет? Он всегда был топ. Теперь и геймплей топ. 🔥

🕶️ Phantom Liberty? Идрис Эльба и Кибер-Джонни. Что ещё нужно для счастья?

🚇 Метро? Добавили. Можно просто кататься и смотреть на Найт-Сити. 🚊

🌟 Часть 4. Хорошие моменты, которые я теперь могу вспоминать без боли
1. Первый вход в Найт-Сити. 🏙️
Когда ты выходишь из квартиры, садишься в машину и едешь по ночным улицам. Неон, дождь, реклама, радио, люди. Это не графика. Это настроение. Тогда это было круто, но с багами. Сейчас это круто и работает.

2. Джонни Сильверхенд. 🎸
Киану Ривз в роли цифрового призрака в твоей голове. Он ворчит, философствует, подбивает на плохие поступки и иногда говорит то, что ты сам боишься признать. Он не просто попутчик. Он второе я. Или первое. Смотря кого слушать.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2332475536
3. Джекки. 🍻
Джекки Уэллс — это друг, которого хочется иметь в реальной жизни. Простой, тёплый, с золотым сердцем и большими мечтами. Его история — одна из самых душевных в игре. И да, я до сих пор не могу спокойно смотреть на его мотоцикл. 💔

4. Панам, Джуди, Ривер, Керри. ❤️
Романтические линии в Cyberpunk — это не просто «нажми правильную реплику». Это живые люди со своими проблемами, травмами, мечтами. Панам — огонь. Джуди — нежность. Ривер — справедливость. Керри — рок-н-ролл. Каждый из них делает Найт-Сити теплее, даже когда вокруг холодный бетон и корпорации.

5. Phantom Liberty. 🕶️
Дополнение, которое переворачивает всё.

6. Метро. 🚇
Добавили в 2.1. И это гениально. Можно просто сесть в вагон, смотреть в окно, слушать музыку и смотреть на Найт-Сити. Никаких перестрелок, никаких заданий. Просто жизнь. Это один из лучших способов расслабиться после тяжёлого дня.

7. Фоторежим. 📸
В 2.2 его прокачали. Теперь можно менять позы, время суток, освещение, добавлять NPC. Я сделал больше скриншотов, чем прошёл заданий. Найт-Сити — это фотомодель, которая никогда не бывает некрасивой.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2325218762
8. Вождение. 🏎️
Раньше машины ездили как пьяные табуретки. Теперь — как машины. Появилась стрельба из машины, полицейские погони, нормальный ИИ. Можно просто кататься по городу и чувствовать себя королём дорог. Или пешеходом, который чудом выжил.

9. Киберware и билды. ⚡
Сандевистан, мантисы, гориллы, моноуайр, нетраннерство. Ты можешь быть кем угодно. Хочешь замедлять время и резать всех? Пожалуйста. Хочешь взламывать мозги и смотреть, как враги стреляют друг в друга? Легко. Хочешь просто быть терминатором? Не вопрос. С 2.0 система перков стала глубже, интереснее и разнообразнее.

10. Полиция. 🚓
Раньше она телепортировалась. Теперь она приезжает. Сначала патрульные, потом SWAT, потом MaxTac. И это весело. Ограбил магазин? Беги. Сбил пешехода? Беги быстрее. Убил копа? Беги очень быстро. Найт-Сити не прощает.

🔍 Часть 5. Прекрасные наблюдения
Найт-Сити — это не карта. Это состояние души. 🌃
Он живой. Он дышит. Он пахнет дождём, бензином и неоном. Он красив и уродлив одновременно. В нём есть районы для богатых и трущобы для бедных. В нём есть корпорации, которые выше закона, и люди, которые ниже земли. Это не просто декорация. Это персонаж.

Музыка — это отдельный вид искусства. 🎵
Радиостанции, боевая музыка, ambient. Когда ты едешь по городу и играет «Resist and Disorder» или «Never Fade Away», ты чувствуешь себя в клипе. Когда ты идёшь по Догтауну и играет тревожный эмбиент, ты чувствуешь себя в шпионском фильме. Саундтрек — это половина атмосферы.

Побочные задания — это не «принеси-подай». 📜
Здесь каждая история — это маленький фильм. Про женщину, которая потеряла мужа. Про парня, который мечтал стать рокером. Про ИИ, который влюбился. Про клона, который не знает, кто он. CDPR умеют рассказывать истории. И в Cyberpunk они рассказывают их лучше, чем когда-либо.

Город меняется в зависимости от времени суток и погоды. 🌧️☀️
Утром он серый и деловой. Днём — шумный и суетливый. Вечером — неоновый и опасный. Ночью — тёмный и загадочный. В дождь он становится ещё красивее. В туман — ещё таинственнее. Это не просто смена дня и ночи. Это смена настроения.

Джонни не всегда прав. Но он всегда честен. 🎸
Он может бесить. Он может быть эгоистичным. Он может предлагать ужасные вещи. Но он не врёт. Он говорит то, что думает. И иногда это именно то, что тебе нужно услышать.

Смерть в игре имеет вес. 💀
Здесь нельзя просто «перезагрузиться и забыть». Каждое решение имеет последствия. Кого-то можно спасти, кого-то — нет. И ты будешь помнить об этом. Даже после титров.P.S. Кому не сложно, наградите обзор. Теперь я коплю не на аксессуары, а на нейроимплант, чтобы не забыть, как я страдал в 2020. 🧠⚡

P.P.S. Удачи, странник! Найт-Сити ждёт. 🌃✨

P.P.P.S. Если вы дочитали до конца — вы либо очень любите Киберпанк, либо очень любите читать. В обоих случаях — респект! 😄🎉

También me encanta la libertad de explorar, conducir y descubrir cosas por mi cuenta. Siempre hay algo que hacer, alguien a quien ayudar o alguna historia escondida esperando a que la encuentres.

Cyberpunk 2077 no es solamente un juego sobre el futuro; también habla de la humanidad, la soledad, la libertad y las decisiones que definen quiénes somos.

Cyberpunk 2077 is nothing short of a monumental achievement in modern gaming. Its meticulously crafted open world, breathtaking visual fidelity, and extraordinarily immersive atmosphere set a benchmark that few titles can even aspire to reach. Night City is not merely a backdrop for the narrative; it is a living, breathing metropolis, teeming with moral ambiguity, social stratification, technological obsession, and the haunting consequences of unchecked corporate power.

What truly distinguishes the game, however, is its narrative sophistication. Beneath its dazzling neon lights and futuristic spectacle lies a profoundly human story about identity, mortality, freedom, and the desperate pursuit of meaning in an increasingly dehumanised world. Its characters are remarkably nuanced, its dialogue often incisive, and its most emotionally resonant moments linger long after the credits roll.

Visually, Cyberpunk 2077 is nothing less than extraordinary. The interplay of neon illumination, atmospheric fog, intricate environmental detail, and sophisticated lighting techniques creates an aesthetic that is simultaneously mesmerising and unsettling. Night City feels as though it has been ripped from the darkest, most compelling visions of the future and brought to life with astonishing technical precision.

Ultimately, Cyberpunk 2077 transcends the boundaries of conventional entertainment. It is an ambitious, thought-provoking, and occasionally heartbreaking exploration of what it means to remain human in a world that increasingly treats humanity as a commodity. Few games manage to combine such artistic ambition, narrative depth, and technological brilliance so convincingly. Cyberpunk 2077 is not merely a game worth experiencing; it is an experience that exemplifies the extraordinary artistic potential of the medium itself.

Je ne peux rien dire d'autre que "bravo" à CD Projekt Red.

C'est à mon sens un chef d'oeuvre narratif. On est immergés dans une ambiance dépaysante et à la fois familière, répertoriant des problèmes de sociétés actuels et nous avertissant sur ce que pourrait devenir le futur. Si vous cherchez du storytelling qui vous fera réfléchir autant que ça vous portera, ce jeu est réellement fait pour vous. 

On peut s'endormir un peu au début, le tutoriel et l'acte 1 ne nous permettant pas d'exploiter réellement les propriétés d'un monde ouvert RPG. Cependant, dès le début de l'acte 2 (et après s'être mis en jambe dans l'univers de Night City), c'est un éventail de possibilités qui se présente à nous. La customisation et la liberté de faire ce que l'on veut est incroyable; sans parler des builds d'équipements cybernétiques qui font en sorte que chaque expérience est réellement différente dans le gameplay.

Le seul bémol dans tout ça, et comme dans beaucoup de jeux récents, ce sont les performances. N'ayant pas une config très poussée, mon PC soufflait h24 comme si il était à l'agonie. En contrepartie, c'est un des plus beaux jeux auxquels j'ai pu jouer graphiquement.

J'ai joué à partir de la version 2.3, ce qui signifie que je n'ai pas eu affaire à énormément de bugs excepté un où je perdais de la vie en continu et quelques bugs sur les NPC. Comparativement à ce qui est apparu à la sortie, le jeu a fait du chemin et est aujourd'hui un des meilleurs en son genre.

La DA est top, le gameplay est top, le storytelling est top. C'est innovant, immersif, tout ce qu'on peut souhaiter d'un studio triple A. Les autres devraient s'en inspirer.

Jouez y au moins jusqu'à la quête du basilisk de Panam, croyez moi sur parole.

I think that if you go into this game with the right expectations, Cyberpunk 2077 delivers everything you could ask for. A very well-written story that is presented beautifully, and a combat system that works well and offers different playstyles.

I don’t think I need to say much about the graphics. Depending on your budget and what kind of high-end PC you have at home, everything is possible, from a polygon paradise to razor-sharp photorealism.

After over 600 hours in this game, I can safely say, this game is really overrated. Nothing you choose or do in the game matters. Murder a bunch of Valentinos? They treat you just the same, and Padre wouldn't even bat an eye. Have 5 star police wanted levels? No problem, enter a save zone, in and out and the all the police simultaneously suffers from collective amnesia. The dialogue choice barely matters either, why give me the choice if it doesn't matter? All you're doing is wasting my time making a choice that does nothing. 

And it's not just the lackluster RPG mechanics. The writing in this game is also aggressively mid. The game want us to treat Jackie like an old friend, and want us to feel sad when he dies, but barely give us much time to get to know him personally, how am I supposed to feel for a character that I barely know? Your character V also doesn't have much agencies within the narrative, and by extension a character arc. Not even 1 hour in Johnny immediately hijacks the story and the rest of the story is basically V being taken along for the ride in Johnny's story, hell one of the endings are literally just johnny taking over at the end and V not even being aware of what's going on. V themself also is a very selfish and shallow character, what else does V wanted out of their life other than becoming a legend, get rich, or survive; I really can't find anything else that V values even towards the end. The game does not give me a reason to root for V, and there is also no sense of urgency to V's condition beyond the cutscenes, I just doesn't care about V at all as a character, let alone engage with their story. 

The world building is also extremely generic. Hell it's name literally is just it's genre + 2077, you could not find a game that is more of a parody of cyberpunk than this game. "Oh no! AI will take over!" Yeah like I haven't seen this story already in Terminator, 2001 a Space Odyssey, The Matrix, I Have No Mouth and I Must Scream, Dune, exc... all of them have a deeper exploration into the topic than this game does. And the concept of Rogue AI is also so dumb, like the writer don't understand how technology works, they think AI programs can just "exist" in the magical realm that is the net, without requiring a hardware to run on, like human's can't just locate the server that contains the rogue AI and cut it's power source. And don't even get me started on "Capitalism Bad" and how even more generic and milked to death that topic is. Night City also don't give my any desire to explore it, when basically 95% of the building is just a shell with no interiors, filled with pedestrians that are dumber than a squirrel. Fallout 4 gives me better motivation to explore it's world than this game, and it's literally just a wasteland. There just isn't anything interesting in night city to explore and discover, most of the lore are basically shards with text messages for me to read telling the same generic miserable story about, you guess it, "Capitalism Bad". There is also very little philosophical exploration on the nature of identity, in a game where the story is literally about one person's identity overriding the other, which is just another massive waste of potential in a mountain of wasted potential that is this game. Like imagine V contemplating what it means to be yourself, and questioning rather or not merging with another person's identity is really that bad, like what if instead of Johnny taking over, their identity merges and becomes a whole new person that is neither Johnny or V, imagine the potential of the premise of transferable consciousness and identity, but NO, this game doesn't explore ANY of those possibilities! Ghost in the Shell explore a lot of these topics, so I don't know why they didn't even study one of the most popular cyberpunk franchise out there and learn from it, like I'm not even asking you to have original ideas, at least match the depth of other stories in the same genre! 

I can use two words to summarize this game: Wasted Potential. Choices don't matter, characters don't develop, generic world building, shallow narrative, and I haven't even mention all the unfulfilled promises that they still haven't remotely fulfilled. This game is just too overrated for me to recommend it.

Головна сила гри — історія Ві та персонажі поруч із ним. Джонні дратує, змушує сперечатися, а згодом його думка починає мати значення. Панам поступово стає людиною, до якої хочеться повертатися. Бойова система дає простір для експериментів: можна покладатися на зброю, клинки, злам або приховане проходження. Імпланти й розвиток персонажа дозволяють відчутно змінювати стиль гри, а побічні завдання нерідко захоплюють не менше за основний сюжет.

Cyberpunk 2077 é uma experiência que transcende o espetáculo de sua ambientação futurista. Por trás dos implantes, da violência e da obsessão pelo poder, existe uma história sobre mortalidade, identidade e o que realmente merece ser preservado quando tudo parece estar perdido.

Escolher V como nômade tornou essa jornada particularmente significativa. Em uma cidade que transforma tudo em mercadoria, encontrei nos Aldecaldos e em Panam algo que Night City jamais poderia oferecer: pertencimento, lealdade e a possibilidade de um futuro que não fosse definido pela ambição alheia.

A relação com Johnny também merece destaque, evoluindo de uma convivência hostil para uma reflexão sobre arrependimento, legado e a possibilidade de encontrar compreensão mesmo nas circunstâncias mais improváveis.

Ao escolher partir com Panam, V não conquistou Night City. Fez algo talvez mais importante: recusou-se a permitir que ela determinasse o fim de sua história. O futuro permaneceu incerto, mas, pela primeira vez, havia algo além da sobrevivência pelo qual valia a pena lutar.

No fim, talvez a maior vitória não seja vencer o sistema, mas encontrar pessoas com quem valha a pena enfrentá-lo.

Fiquei hypado em 2019, mas, com o lançamento, deixei pra lá. Depois de anos e de ter visto o anime, o hype voltou, e comprei o jogo porque estava em promoção. Pensei que seria um RPG de roleplay mesmo, porque tinha tudo para ser superimersivo. Mas é um jogo raso, com personagens bobos, um protagonista infinitamente desinteressante e uma cidade absurdamente linda, mas vazia.

Eu não sei quem é o meu personagem. Ele não tem passado, e a suposta história que o jogo apresenta não dá profundidade nenhuma a ele. Também não tem uma motivação clara. Quando o jogo apresenta o plot, ainda na primeira parte da campanha, não fui convencido de que deveria fazer alguma coisa pelo personagem. Não vi motivo para sentir empatia por ele. Todos os diálogos são bem limitados e praticamente lineares. Não existe roleplay.

Night City é vazia. A dirigibilidade dos carros e das motos é bastante satisfatória, e o cenário é deslumbrante, mas nada acontece. Você anda pela cidade, encontra uma troca de tiros e, no mais, é basicamente isso. Não existe aquela exploração em que, por acaso, você esbarra em algum NPC e acaba se envolvendo em uma trama secundária sem querer. Isso simplesmente não acontece. Se o jogo não fosse mundo aberto, se ele fosse linear, a experiencia seria a mesma.

Todas as sidequests seguem basicamente a mesma lógica, sendo varias e varias pessoas, inclusive pessoas que você nunca nem viu no jogo, te ligando e mandando mensagens para você ir encontra elas ou pedindo serviços. É frio, vazio e desinteressante. Não existe vínculo com nenhum NPC. E por que voce iria atender esses pedidos? Por que você se importa com aquele NPC? Não. Por que está interessado na sidequest? Aqui, tenho que ser justo, algumas me surpreenderam positivamente, mas várias são bem simples. Motivação por dinheiro? Definitivamente não. O dinheiro quase não tem utilidade no jogo. Usei os mesmos upgrades cibernéticos do começo ao fim do jogo. Todas as armas foram dadas ao longo da campanha ou encontradas em loot. Não há motivo para comprar um carro, a moto do Jackie já resolve absolutamente tudo. Também não há motivo para comprar um apartamento. Ele só serve para trocar de roupa, e você ainda pode fazer isso em qualquer loja de roupas. Você não precisa dormir, comer, se curar no apartamento. Não existe uma motivação convincente para fazer nada no jogo. Tudo se desenvolve muito rápido e com muita facilidade, deixando a sensação de que esse mundo é falso.

Falando em roupas, as opções são limitadíssimas e, sobretudo, horrorosas. Ainda estou incrédulo com o nível de customização. Pensei: "Pelo menos nas cutscenes e nos diálogos eu apareço, como acontece em outros jogos em primeira pessoa. Deve ser por isso que existe tanta customização". Não. Nem isso. O único momento em que você se vê em terceira pessoa é em cima da moto, e só.

A perspectiva em primeira pessoa, como um FPS funciona perfeitamente. Foi uma das coisas que me manteve jogando até o final, porque a gameplay é satisfatória. Agora, quanto ao combate físico, nem me arrisquei. Acho que já passou da hora de a indústria abandonar o combate melee em primeira pessoa. Isso foi uma questão de limitação técnica nas últimas décadas; hoje, não há motivo para manter esse padrão. Sei que tem gente que gosta, mas eu não gosto. Como nem joguei, não vou dizer se o combate melee é bom ou ruim. Acho que ele já nasce errado, com exceção de Kingdom Come: Deliverance, que, até hoje, foi o único jogo que experimentei capaz de fazer isso de forma coesa e funcional.

Ao longo da campanha, não consegui deixar de comparar o jogo com KCD. O quanto de carisma o Henry possui, como os personagens são cativantes, a maioria deles, eu diria. E aqui, em Cyberpunk, todos são toscos. Me senti dentro de um anime shonen, todo mundo é badass demais, o tempo todo. Todas as conversas sobre como eles são fodões chegam a ser meio cringe. Todos os relacionamentos se desenvolvem muito rápido. Bastam duas missões com alguns coadjuvantes para vocês já serem irmãos de consideração. O Goro foi o único, com exceção do Jackie, com quem senti que houve algum desenvolvimento real na relação.

Pouquíssimos foram os momentos em que houve um aprofundamento filosófico sobre o que é o ser, o que é a mente/consciência ou a alma. Onde os engramas e as cópias se encaixam nisso tudo? SOMA, de 2015, explorou esses temas de um jeito simples e de forma bem profunda, mas em Cyberpunk o tema foi completamente desperdiçado.

O tema anticapitalista ou anarquista também foi desperdiçado, aparecendo apenas em algumas citações bastante tímidas. Não existe ninguém politizado nesse mundo, mas, considerando a situação dos EUA na vida real, até que faz sentido.

O jogo não faz jus a quem diz que ele é uma obra-prima. Quem diz isso ou tem menos de 15 anos ou jogou apenas três jogos na vida. Se sua referência para jogos é GTA, então eu entendo por que você considera Cyberpunk incrível. Não funciona muito bem como RPG, zero imersão, nem como jogo de campanha, historia fraquissima. É um FPS bem ok e divertido. Finalizei sem saber exatamente o que joguei. Fiquei apertando o botão de interação e matando muita gente até a história acabar, sem receber nenhum desfecho interessante ou qualquer surpresa.

Enfim, um jogo bem medíocre e sem sal. Diria uns 6, no máximo 7. Não vale as 30 horas de campanha.

Joguei em um nitro 5, GTX 1650, 16 de ram. Rodou no hdmi suficientemente bem e bonito, acho que joguei nas configurações medias e não deixou a desejar, na media de uns 30fps ou um pouco mais. Não vi nenhum bug em 40 horas de jogo.

I think it's both easy and difficult to describe just how good of a game Cyberpunk 2077 turned out to be from the way I experienced it. In one sentence, Cyberpunk 2077 is probably one of the most well-made, wholeheartedly complete games that exists out there. The entire world of Cyberpunk basically lived by its code of making a name for yourself that it itself spawned a majorly successful anime, collaborations, comics and books, a whole new fandom out of it. Just the CD Projekt effect maybe. 

Else, Cyberpunk 2077 certainly has some flaws that to others may have been the arrow to the knee for them, but I'm going to be describing how I felt. And in spite of the minor flaws it had, as a whole, I felt very, VERY content with it all. 

I spent the past year and a bit playing this game, on and off, taking breaks that were months long before picking it up again, and every time I did, I got right back into the groove of completely absorbing myself into the world of Night City like I never left. Some games when I've played after a certain time away from it, I end up struggling to reconnect. But with Cyberpunk, it never felt like that at all. 

Every character actually had depth. I sympathised with more than one character and wanted to learn of their back stories more than ever. Learning characters back stories? Who would've thought. The side gigs - sure, some of them got repetitive - but they at least were different in that each gig occasionally had motives. They had clues, evidence of something else going on, and at some point Cyberpunk 2077 the action RPG turned into a mystery thriller game. The combat is extremely versatile. I mostly played a Netrunner build for my V with quickhacks and non-confrontational attacks, but when I restarted and decided to go for a mostly Mercenary frontal assault V, it was just as smooth of a transition to be a ruthless killer slicing enemies with katanas and shooting everybody down with the spray of your machine gun. 

I finished the whole game, completed all gigs, got all tarots, played the DLC with all endings through and through, and I can say without a doubt that I'll be remembering Cyberpunk 2077 for a long time. In fact, I know that once I finish this review to go to uninstall this game, I'm actually going to miss it. I intend to keep it as one of my most favourite games of all time for the kind of impact it has on my experience as a gamer towards video games, and if anything, I hope that when people pick this game up or wonder if this game was the right choice to start playing, they haven't seen anything yet.

Bon, que dire de Cyberpunk 2077 après 477 heures au compteur, dont 131 sur ma dernière partie, et les 57 succès débloqués ? Eh bien… une chose est sûre : le jeu en valait largement la chandelle !

Pour être honnête, tout n'est pas parfait. La conduite manque parfois de précision, certaines mécaniques de gameplay peuvent se montrer un peu lourdes et quelques bugs subsistent, sans oublier les crashs occasionnels. Rien qui ait véritablement gâché mon expérience, mais ce sont des défauts qui méritent d'être soulignés.

Le rythme n'est pas toujours irréprochable non plus. J'ai trouvé certains passages un peu longs, notamment au début, où l'histoire prend son temps pour réellement démarrer. Mais au fil des heures, on se laisse progressivement emporter par l'univers du jeu.

Et c'est justement là que Cyberpunk 2077 révèle toute sa force : son histoire, ses personnages et cette atmosphère si particulière qui donne vie à Night City. Suivre le périple de V, s'attacher aux personnages et découvrir les conséquences de nos choix rend l'aventure véritablement prenante. Malgré quelques longueurs, je n'ai pas vu passer ces 131 heures.

Et que dire de Phantom Liberty ? Tout simplement incroyable ! Je n'avais pas ressenti une telle claque avec une extension depuis celle d'Elden Ring. Les développeurs ont réalisé un travail remarquable, aussi bien dans l'écriture que dans la mise en scène et l'ambiance générale. Une extension qui vient magnifiquement compléter l'expérience.

Au final, malgré ses imperfections, Cyberpunk 2077 restera pour moi une aventure mémorable. Un jeu qui m'aura marqué bien au-delà de ses qualités techniques, et dont je ne regrette absolument pas d'avoir parcouru l'histoire.

Je ne vais pas m'étendre davantage. Si vous hésitez encore, je n'ai qu'une chose à vous dire :

Foncez, Night City vous attend !

This game is one of the most fun games I ever played. First person shooters can be pretty hit or miss for me, but this game starts off incredibly fun and it only gets better as you level up. There are a LOT of ways to customize your character, from weapons, to skills, to clothes, and to cyberware, and you can really create some interesting combinations. Plus, there is so much leveling! Normal leveling, plus skill progression, plus street cred! By the end of the game, I'm a powerhouse with armor, health, weapon damage, and resistances, mowing my way through whatever crosses my path.

The main issue is the story SUCKSSSSSSSS. There are fun and interesting parts of the story, but a lot of it is slow and unskippable. I've done the main story all the way through twice, and there are so many dead moments. There is also a lot of slow walking behind someone, sometimes while they explain something you can't skip. There are a lot of times where you have to [spoiler]fight as Johnny, removing any and all upgrades/cyberware/weapons you've gotten but keeping the level difficulty. You get thrown into a completely new playstyle at a high level with no way to manual save! It's the only part of the game I really die in.[/spoiler]

Plus, [spoiler]I love Keanu Reeves, but Johnny is ANNOYING. I liked him the first playthrough, but he actually lies to you/misleads you/misrepresents things a LOT and he shames you for things you have no control over. Plus he bothers you all the time. And your relationship is applied inconsistently. Why am I being forced to say I hate him when I spent the entire game building rapport? Why am I forced to say I like him around when we have no relationship to speak of? There are times where he tells you to do something, and if you don't do it, you're treated like an idiot by the game, and there are times where you are treated like an idiot if you DO listen to him. It's all very confusing and jarring. [/spoiler]

Speaking of characters, Judy and Panam are fine, but the male romance options are TERRIBLE. You have a [spoiler]corrupt cop who tries to play puppy after dragging you through corrupt cop shit[/spoiler] and then you have [spoiler]the 80 year old rockstar who is still in love with the man in your head who tries to destroy three girls careers because he's a bitter washed up asshole.[/spoiler] Plus, both male romance options are side quest locked, so completely missable, while Judy and Panam are met through the main plot.

Heck, even Judy has her problems. Judy [spoiler]is left sad in all endings except one that has nothing to do with her. Why am I becoming distant and shitty to her in the mansion ending? My V wouldn't do that?[/spoiler] I haven't finished the Panam romance yet, but it's... weird so far too.

Also, the gigs. There are so many gigs with secret requirements that aren't communicated in anyway. Sometimes it will say "Don't be seen (optional)" but a LOT of times, the game expects you to be stealthy or not kill people or whatever and you only find out at the end of the mission when the fixer is disappointed in you. It happened with EVERY fixer, to the point that I dropped a save before EVERY gig so I could go back and do it again in case of secret expectations.

The biggest sin of the story has got to be the extreme cynicism. By the time I was getting to the end of the game, I knew that if I was going out of my way to save someone, there was a pretty high chance they would [spoiler]kill themselves.[/spoiler] It literally just kept happening. There are so many times where you try so hard to do good things, and it almost feels like the game is laughing at you for trying. I actually really like grimdark, gritty, and cynical media, but this was almost unpalatable in some cases because instead of "everything is literally as bad as possible, but you can do something" it very much has the feeling of "everything is bad and you're stupid for thinking you could make ANYTHING better." There are a couple places where you can do something, but it's mostly punished in my experience.

All this to say, the story is frustrating and mean and painful. There isn't a single ending [spoiler]where you don't die,[/spoiler] which has some foreshadowing, but it really feels like the last f u to [spoiler]give you hope and then show you that it's hopeless.[/spoiler]

The reason I have 184 hours (and why I will almost certainly have more) is that the gameplay is genuinely so fun. I feel like I can recommend this game, despite all the huge issues, because you can literally just not play the story. I have a character right now that I started with phantom liberty, but instead of doing the DLC, I just ran around and did all the NCPD side quests and killed enemies wherever they showed up. That it the real fun of the game. Running around the map with your cool abilities and awesome guns and mindlessly killing stuff to level up. I could, and have, done it for hours, and it's something I've even used to relax.

I would say get this game on sale and be prepared for the slog to get to the good stuff, if you are willing. If you aren't willing to wade through everything above for a fun, brainless, in game murder spree, I don't recommend this game.

[h1]Cyberpunk 2077: O preço da sobrevivência[/h1]

[h2]Jogo base[/h2]

[h3]O começo de uma jornada[/h3]

Minha história com [i]Cyberpunk 2077[/i] começou no lançamento, quando joguei pela primeira vez no PC. Os bugs e a falta de tempo fizeram com que terminasse a campanha sem compreender tudo o que a história tinha a oferecer.

Anos depois, voltei disposto a explorar Night City e descobrir o que havia deixado passar.

[h3]Valerie: quando a personagem se torna parte de você[/h3]

Comecei usando Sandevistan e armas pesadas, mas acabei adotando a furtividade, com facas e pistolas.

Na primeira jogatina, escolhi o V masculino, mas não consegui estabelecer uma conexão verdadeira com ele. Dessa vez, escolhi Valerie, e tudo mudou. A conexão foi quase instantânea, como se ela fosse a verdadeira V desde o começo.

O desespero diante do prazo e a vontade de continuar lutando passaram a parecer meus também. Eu não estava apenas controlando Valerie; estava vivendo sua história.

Ela não queria ser uma lenda por vaidade. Queria continuar viva e escolher o próprio futuro. Foi essa luta pela sobrevivência que tornou nossa conexão tão especial.

[h3]Night City: a verdadeira vilã[/h3]

Para mim, o principal antagonista não é Adam Smasher, Johnny Silverhand ou a Arasaka. É Night City.

Uma cidade onde parece não existir meio-termo: ou você tem dinheiro, poder e influência, ou não é ninguém. Luzes neon e promessas de futuro convivem com pobreza, violência e pessoas esquecidas.

Mesmo respeitada, Valerie continuava insignificante diante da cidade. Dinheiro, reputação e poder não garantem vitória. Night City permanece indiferente, e isso basta para torná-la ameaçadora.

[h3]Johnny Silverhand: amor, ódio e compreensão[/h3]

Minha relação com Johnny foi de amor e ódio. Seu espírito revolucionário entra em conflito com Valerie, que deseja sobreviver, enquanto ele parece disposto a sacrificar tudo por suas convicções.

Muitas de suas atitudes me irritavam, mas percebi que ambos carregavam dores e arrependimentos. Aprenderam a se compreender sem precisar pensar da mesma maneira.

[h3]Missões que levarei comigo[/h3]

[h3]Canção da Pirâmide[/h3]

Essa missão tem um lugar especial no meu coração. A conexão entre Judy e Valerie foi tão forte que parecia que eu também vivia aqueles momentos.

A descida até Laguna Bend me marcou pela melancolia. Judy revela sua dor e solidão, e ali compreendi o quanto Valerie significava para ela. Aquela noite foi uma pausa no sofrimento, uma oportunidade de experimentar a felicidade em um mundo que raramente a permite.

[h3]Com uma pequena ajuda dos meus amigos[/h3]

Os Aldecaldos representam uma família. Talvez essa missão tenha me atingido tanto porque meu relacionamento com meus familiares não é dos melhores.

Estar com aquelas pessoas me proporcionou uma sensação de pertencimento que eu não esperava encontrar em um jogo. Em Night City, encontrar pessoas dispostas a lutar umas pelas outras é extraordinário.

Para Valerie, os Aldecaldos eram mais do que uma maneira de sobreviver: eram pessoas pelas quais valia a pena lutar.

[h1]Phantom Liberty: sobreviver a qualquer custo[/h1]

[i]Phantom Liberty[/i] trouxe uma narrativa sombria, repleta de espionagem, investigação e desconfiança. A expansão aprofundou a reflexão sobre o preço da sobrevivência.

Dogtown provoca medo e desespero. Parece existir à margem de qualquer esperança, como se até as regras cruéis de Night City tivessem sido abandonadas ali.

[h3]Song So Mi, a Songbird[/h3]

Para mim, Song So Mi é a personagem mais marcante de [i]Cyberpunk 2077[/i]. Sua história me deixou angustiado e triste. Seu corpo se deteriorava, enquanto a Blackwall ameaçava consumir sua mente. A cada passo, parecia perder mais um pedaço de si mesma. E, ainda assim, continuava lutando.

Songbird mente, manipula e toma decisões que afetam outras pessoas. Sua busca pela liberdade não apaga as consequências de seus atos, mas suas contradições a tornam humana. Ela é alguém desesperada, encurralada por forças maiores, tentando escapar antes que seja tarde demais.

Quanto mais descobria sobre sua história, mais queria que ela escapasse. Até onde alguém pode ir quando sobreviver se torna sua única prioridade?

Para mim, [i]Phantom Liberty[/i] atinge seu ponto mais alto nessa história. É uma narrativa brutal sobre algo maior do que continuar respirando: tentar continuar sendo você mesmo quando o mundo parece determinado a tirar isso de você.

[h3]Minhas escolhas e suas consequências[/h3]

Valerie escolheu sobreviver, mas isso nunca significou sair ilesa.

Escolhi a ajuda dos Aldecaldos para invadir a Mikoshi. Eles já não eram apenas aliados, mas a família que Valerie havia encontrado. Também fiquei feliz ao ver Judy partir com ela para longe de Night City. O futuro das duas talvez não fosse perfeito, mas existia a possibilidade de recomeçar.

Em [i]Phantom Liberty[/i], escolhi enviar Songbird para a Lua com a matriz neural. Depois de conhecer sua história, não consegui fazer outra escolha. Queria que ela escapasse daquilo que destruía seu corpo e sua mente. Isso não significa ignorar suas mentiras, mas acreditar que ela ainda merecia uma chance.

Gosto de imaginar que Songbird encontrará a liberdade pela qual lutou. Minhas escolhas dizem tanto sobre mim quanto sobre as personagens.

[h3]Considerações finais: não existem finais felizes em Night City[/h3]

Ao olhar para tudo o que vivi, fica um gosto amargo: cada decisão cobra seu preço, e cada tentativa de escapar traz novas perdas. Não existe solução capaz de apagar o passado ou garantir um futuro melhor.

As corporações continuam no poder, a violência permanece nas ruas e as pessoas continuam tentando sobreviver. Para Night City, Valerie é apenas mais alguém tentando encontrar seu lugar em um mundo que não parece ter espaço para ela.

Você pode lutar com todas as suas forças e ainda assim não controlar o resultado. Mas isso não significa que a luta tenha sido em vão.

[h3]Uma reflexão sobre escolhas[/h3]

[i]Cyberpunk 2077[/i] me fez pensar nas escolhas que fazemos e nas consequências que carregamos. Algumas só aparecem muito tempo depois, quando já não podemos voltar atrás. Outras nos acompanham por anos, lembrando decisões que tomamos acreditando fazer o melhor possível.

Também preciso lidar com minhas próprias escolhas. Não posso apagá-las; preciso enfrentar suas consequências e tentar construir algo melhor.

Valerie tentou sobreviver mesmo quando as probabilidades estavam contra ela. Nem sempre fez as escolhas certas ou salvou quem gostaria, mas continuou lutando.

Essa é a lição que levo: não existe promessa de um final feliz, mas podemos decidir o que faremos a partir do passado.

Não sei quando chegarei onde desejo, mas continuo lutando com tudo o que tenho.

[h3]Adeus, Night City[/h3]

Night City - 2077

Neon. Chrom. Konzerne. Eine Stadt, in der jeder jemand werden will und die meisten als Niemand enden.
Cyberpunk 2077 ist eines dieser Spiele, bei denen ich manchmal einfach nur durch die Straßen fahre, das Radio laufen lasse und vergesse, dass ich eigentlich irgendeinen Auftrag erledigen wollte.
Die Atmosphäre ist unglaublich. Wolkenkratzer, überfüllte Straßen, heruntergekommene Apartments, die Badlands. Visuell teilweise absurd schön, besonders nachts im Regen. Dazu ein Soundtrack, der irgendwo zwischen aggressiver elektronischer Musik, melancholischen Momenten und Never Fade Away alles richtig macht.

WELCOME TO NIGHT CITY.

Das Gameplay bietet mittlerweile verdammt viel Freiheit. Sandevistan, Netrunning, Mantis-Klingen, Katana oder einfach mit gezogener Waffe durch die Vordertür. Die überarbeiteten Perks und Cyberware-Systeme machen unterschiedliche Builds tatsächlich interessant. Und trotzdem macht es manchmal mehr Spaß, einfach nur durch Night City zu laufen und sich in irgendwelchen Nebenquests zu verlieren.

Die Story? Was zunächst wie eine typische Geschichte über Konzerne und Macht wirkt, wird ziemlich schnell zu etwas Persönlicherem. 
Identität, Sterblichkeit und die Frage, was am Ende eigentlich von einem Menschen übrig bleibt.

NO FUTURE.

Besonders die Charaktere bleiben hängen. Jackie, Judy, Panam, Johnny. Gespräche, die sich nicht immer wie Dialogoptionen anfühlen, und Nebenquests, die teilweise mehr Eindruck hinterlassen als die eigentliche Hauptgeschichte.

DOGTOWN. TRUST NO ONE.

Und dann ist da noch Phantom Liberty.
Dreckiger, bedrückender und stellenweise sogar besser geschrieben als das Hauptspiel. Reed, Songbird und Entscheidungen, bei denen ich teilweise minutenlang vor dem Bildschirm saß, weil sich keine davon wirklich richtig angefühlt hat. Dazu eine Spionagegeschichte, die perfekt in diese Welt passt.
Natürlich ist nicht alles perfekt. Die KI hat ihre Momente, manche Bereiche wirken lebendiger, als sie tatsächlich sind, und gelegentlich erinnert einen das Spiel daran, woher es ursprünglich kommt. Aber verglichen mit dem Release ist Cyberpunk 2077 heute kaum wiederzuerkennen.

Was für mich bleibt, ist weniger die offene Welt an sich, sondern dieses Gesamtgefühl. Die Musik, die Charaktere, die kleinen Geschichten am Straßenrand und eine Stadt, die gleichzeitig wunderschön und vollkommen kaputt ist.

Ich habe Night City inzwischen mehrfach verlassen.
Und komme trotzdem immer wieder zurück.

Vielleicht wegen der Atmosphäre. Vielleicht wegen der Musik. Vielleicht, weil sich kaum eine andere Spielwelt so sehr nach einem Ort anfühlt, an dem ich tatsächlich Zeit verbracht habe.

NEVER FADE AWAY.

When I first heard about this game, it didn’t have the best reputation, to be honest… and I’m sure most people reading this know exactly why. But as someone who gave it a chance despite the bugs and its bad reputation, I’m really happy to see how it has turned into such a solid, almost legendary game over the years!

If you’re wondering whether it’s still as buggy as it was when it first came out, I can happily confirm that the devs did an awesome job cleaning up the mess from launch. Now you can play without wanting to do your enemies a favor and shoot yourself in the face! Jokes aside, this game is a solid 9–9.5/10 for me.
The story is fantastic and keeps you on the edge of your seat, wanting to learn more about the characters and the world the game builds. Night City feels alive at every hour and everywhere you go. There are tons of missions and side quests to keep you busy for a long, long time. The customization is also huuuuuge so you won’t feel like NPC #7847, you can create a unique and cool character with the cyberpunk aesthetic we all love.

The gameplay is also fantastic and fast-paced. Almost every mission has multiple ways to complete it, so you can have fun finding the most efficient, funniest, or most chaotic way to get the job done ;)
There are also tons of builds and abilities to fit your favorite playstyle. Want to be a hacker who lurks in the shadows? Go for it. Want to be a berserk brawler who fights on the front lines? You can do that too. The possibilities are almost endless!

Unfortunately, even though it’s a great game, it has a few flaws. Some missions can feel repetitive the more you play, since many follow similar patterns. If you don’t enjoy this kind of game or really dislike repetitive missions in open-world games, it might not be for you. Also, even though the devs have fixed most of the problems, there are still a few minor bugs that can be annoying, but they’re much rarer now.
With all that said, Cyberpunk 2077 is an excellent game that has redeemed itself in a way few games can claim. If you decide to give it a try, you might discover one of the coolest and most interesting worlds and stories in gaming. The DLC is awesome too, so if you get the chance to pick up both, do it without hesitation!

Recommended, but there's a lot of wasted potential.

First off, Cyberpunk 2077 is a genuinely enjoyable game. The atmosphere, visuals, combat, and overall design of Night City are impressive. However, the longer I play, the more I notice just how many opportunities were missed.

On the technical side, I've experienced some rendering issues that may or may not be related to my PC. I've lowered my graphics settings considerably, but the problems persist. I've also encountered a handful of bugs that required me to save, completely close the game, and restart it. Annoying, but nothing that has ruined the experience.

My biggest complaint, however, is Night City itself.

For a city that looks so alive, it feels surprisingly dead.

There's an incredible amount of detail throughout the world, but very little of it actually responds to your existence. You can spend hours completing side activities, fighting gangs, and building your street cred, but it rarely feels like any of it carries meaningful weight in the world around you.

Take the gangs, for example. If I spend my time hunting down members of a particular gang, eventually they should recognize me as an enemy and attack me on sight. On the other hand, if I've consistently avoided conflict with another gang, maybe their members should acknowledge that. Even something as simple as different dialogue, attitudes, or reactions based on your history with a faction would make the world feel significantly more immersive.

Street cred could have been so much more than a number. Imagine having separate reputations with different gangs, where your actions determine whether you're respected, feared, tolerated, or hated. That alone would give side activities a much greater sense of purpose.

Cyberware customization is another missed opportunity. For a game centered around a society obsessed with body modification, installing cyberware has surprisingly little impact on your physical appearance. Being able to customize the color, style, or design of your implants would have added another layer of immersion and personal expression.

But all of that ties into my biggest issue with the game:

You never really feel like you're part of Night City.

At times, it almost feels like The Truman Show, except nobody is actually watching you. Nobody seems to care who you are, what you've accomplished, or what you've done to the people around them. You can be an absolute menace to a particular gang, and the next group you encounter acts like they've never heard of you.

The city is beautiful, flashy, detailed, and full of people, yet somehow manages to feel strangely lifeless. It's almost like exploring an incredibly elaborate movie set rather than living in a functioning world.

And that's what frustrates me the most. The foundation for something truly incredible is already there.

Despite all of this, I still recommend Cyberpunk 2077. I've had a lot of fun with it, and there's plenty the developers got right. I just can't shake the feeling that Night City could have been so much more.

It's a great game set in an incredible world that doesn't always seem to realize you exist.

What a game! I wanted to finish it in one sitting, but somehow, it took me over 200 hours to reach 100% completion. And honestly I enjoyed every second of it.
I immediately fell in love with Night City. The futuristic design, technological advancements, cyberware, and the whole question of what it means to be human. Everything comes together beautifully. The Asian inspired aesthetics give certain parts of the city an almost Japanese atmosphere, making Night City feel unique and unforgettable.
And the story... absolutely incredible. I genuinely grew attached to the main and side characters, especially those with their own relationship storylines. Even the NPCs make the city feel alive, as if everyone has their own life beyond your own. CD Projekt Red did an outstanding job creating a world that feels like it actually exists.
And those endings... damn. Some of them genuinely made me emotional, and a few even made me cry. Not many games can make you feel that connected to their characters and their stories.
I also have to mention Phantom Liberty. This DLC could easily stand on its own as a separate game set in the Cyberpunk universe. The story, the characters, the quests, the atmosphere... it's an intense experience from beginning to end. Calling it just a DLC almost feels unfair.
I've also heard rumors about an upcoming Cyberpunk movie, and I'm curious to see how it turns out. Though, honestly, the game has set the bar incredibly high. It's going to be difficult to capture the same depth, atmosphere, and emotional impact in a movie.
CD Projekt Red, you didn't just create a game. You created a world I wasn't ready to leave.

Fantastic game, 9.5/10. Thanks to it's basis on a long-running pen and paper RPG there is a huge amount of backstory and lore to make the world feel real and interesting. Combine that with well written, realistic and fallable characters and excellent voice acting (maybe Johnny aside, depending on your opinion of Keanu's acting) and it's hard not to get sucked into this game. I've just completed it after 2 months and nearly 140 hours and I still don't feel ready to leave the world yet.

The only negative thing I can say is that the Romantic Hangouts aren't great. I understand why they added them, but I would honestly have preferred not to have them in the game. Sure, it sucks when the questline ends and you no longer get to interact with the character you've built a relationship with, but having them turn into a flat robot that only gives stock responses somehow makes it even worse. [spoiler]It's especially bad if you choose The Star ending after romancing Panam, they actually recycled lines from this ending in the Romantic Hangouts with her. This broke the immersion a bit for me when V and Panam spend their last evening together on the clifftop overlooking the camp.[/spoiler]

That said, definitely worth playing and for me it trumps The Witcher 3 in character design. Some moments will really hit you in the feels.

I will almost certainly play through this again as female V at some point.

[h1]无名小卒还是名扬天下[/h1]
《赛博朋克2077》是一款开放世界动作冒险游戏，在游戏中，我们将扮演大名鼎鼎的V，因为接下了一个废物中间人的任务，结果意外撞穿了夜之城最大公司荒坂的丑恶，还被误认成了凶手，在逃跑的路上。还失去了挚友，自己也差点死去，却巧合般的跟曾经毁灭荒坂塔的强尼相遇，而在撑过去之后，最终踏上向公司复仇道路的故事。

游戏的玩法和内容很简单，就是接委托做任务来推进剧情，玩起来有点像GTA和大镖客，不过是赛博朋克风格的，这种走到哪打到哪的战斗方面不算很出色，但也能玩出花来，比如斯安维斯坦的时停太刀流，黑客小刀流，除了近战也可以打枪，游戏能玩的战斗内容还是挺丰富的，我玩的就是黑客小刀流，直接瞪着敌人让他自行了断。

[h1]剧情的丰富和细节[/h1]
赛博朋克最出名的便是他的剧情，这种剧情体现在方方面面，委托任务，拳击比赛，处理赛博精神病都能让我们看到人生百态，我们会遇见装了大钢炮把自己那里炸掉的倒霉蛋，甚至可能会因不谨慎被人暗算，差点被割肾，有很多赛博精神病都是被人给逼疯的，而在面对挚友杰克的亲人时候，又让人感到心酸。

游戏有个细节的部分，就是我们的出身和加点，会影响开头剧情，与人对话时还会有特殊对话，比如当我们是荒坂员工的时候，说话就会和公司狗一样趾高气扬，可以在门卫门前爆出荒坂高官的名字，对话特别狂。力量高的时候，我们甚至可以通过威胁来避免一些战斗，拳头才是力量，有时候还可以徒手掰开一扇铁门之类的，而还有些剧情还特定需要技巧或是别的属性高才能触发。

[h1]结语[/h1]
这款游戏里有很多我喜欢的角色，老维是最棒的义体医生，为了他，我打赢了那场比赛，没有让他失望，罗格、帕南，她们都是好样的，我不想让她们死，所以我决定和强尼一起以我残躯化烈火，在复仇完成后，我决定把身体给强尼，让他带着我的那一份活下去，通关之后也没去玩DLC，只是觉得结束了。所以我还是很推荐没玩过的朋友来试试的。

Tive a sorte de jogar Cyberpunk 2077 vários anos depois de seu lançamento, o que me permitiu aproveitar uma versão muito mais completa, polida e próxima daquilo que o jogo sempre se propôs a ser. E posso dizer, sem medo, que foi uma das experiências que mais me surpreenderam nos últimos tempos.

A história principal é simplesmente incrível, com personagens marcantes, diálogos muito bem construídos e momentos que realmente conseguem envolver o jogador. As missões secundárias também merecem destaque, pois não estão ali apenas para aumentar o tempo de jogo. Muitas delas apresentam histórias tão interessantes quanto a campanha principal, aprofundando ainda mais o universo e fazendo com que cada escolha e interação tenha seu próprio peso.

E o que dizer de Night City? A cidade é um espetáculo à parte. Sua ambientação, arquitetura, iluminação e riqueza de detalhes criam um mundo extremamente imersivo. Explorar cada rua, descobrir novos lugares e simplesmente andar pela cidade é uma experiência por si só. É impressionante como o cenário consegue transmitir a sensação de estar em uma metrópole viva, caótica e cheia de personalidade.

Outro ponto que me conquistou foi a liberdade na gameplay. As possibilidades de construir seu personagem, experimentar diferentes armas, habilidades e implantes cibernéticos tornam o combate extremamente divertido. É possível abordar as situações de várias maneiras, e essa variedade faz com que o jogo esteja constantemente oferecendo novas formas de se divertir.

Ainda não tive a oportunidade de jogar a expansão Phantom Liberty, mas pretendo fazer isso em breve. Se o conteúdo adicional mantiver o nível de qualidade que encontrei no jogo base, tenho certeza de que ainda há muita coisa boa pela frente.

No fim das contas, fico feliz por ter dado uma chance a Cyberpunk 2077 nesse momento. Apesar de todo o histórico conturbado de seu lançamento, o que encontrei foi um RPG extremamente envolvente, ambicioso e cheio de personalidade. Uma experiência que, sem dúvidas, vai ficar marcada na minha memória por muito tempo.

历经了许久，终于把整个游戏通关了，后续也许会刷一个全成就，作为整个游戏真正的终结。有很多想评论的地方，就按顺序一点点说吧：
首先是V，绝对的主角，本作里我最喜欢的角色，从对话中都能体现出魅力。尽管很多时候V体现的是我的选择，但从其他对话中依然能窥见她的可爱之处，着实有魅力。
其次是剧情，个人觉得往日之影的剧情完胜主线，主线到处都充满着阉割味道，无论是突然从公司离开然后和杰克在夜之城打拼，还是后来river突兀的感情线，有时都让人摸不着头脑，怎么一下子就跳到这里了？支线剧情有时也是非黑即白，感觉根本没有连续性，而往日之影则很不同，塑造的人物真的特别立体。李德、亚历克斯和百灵鸟我都很喜欢，在剧情里面可以了解他们的过去，知道他们的价值观，即使有我不认可的地方，但不可否认他们的人物立体性。所以在打往日之影的时候比主线痛苦很多，因为怎么选都没有百分百完美的结局，无论选择哪条路都像走进了死路，但如果要比较的话，我还是更喜欢百灵鸟上月球的剧情，尤其是在先玩的李德线的情况下，更加了解百灵鸟后会更心疼她，有种她代替V去寻找新生活的感觉，小鸟就是得自由自在的飞向外太空啊。
最后评价一下结局吧，在我这里最讨厌的是恶魔结局，给到的评价是拉完了，竹村和华子对V的态度不如李德一根，尤其和高塔结局对比后，恶魔结局真的恶心透了。剩下的结局更有优劣，在我这里太阳>星星>克制，比起当无名小卒，还是希望V能成为大人物，即使生命有限，但成为大人物的V说不定有新的活下去的机会呢？
不知道赛博朋克2077还会不会出续作，如果出，请把欠玩家的各种主线、支线和任务都还回来好吗？

Cyberpunk 2077 - пожалуй, лучшая игра, в которую я когда-либо играл. Судить, конечно же, буду субъективно из-за первого предложения (хотите объективного – спросите ИИ). К самой стилистике киберпанка я не то чтобы испытывал какие-либо запредельные эмоции, но эта игра заставила меня её полюбить. Долгое предисловие расписывать не хочу, поэтому пройдёмся по волнующим (вряд-ли) многих пунктам.
Сюжет
Шедевр. То, что такая, с виду, короткая игра содержит в себе так много сюжета, поражает. Найт-Сити за яркими билбордами и нарядами пропитан гнилью и безысходностью живущих в нём. Яркий контраст богатства, похоти, нищеты, безумия и отчаяния даёт тебе понять, что неинтересной эту игру уже назвать грех. У каждого происшествия, которое ты встречаешь на улице (а их бесчисленное множество), есть свой сюжет, который постоянно напоминает, где ты живёшь. Про основной сюжет я толковать особо не хочу, ибо это спойлеры, но скажу лишь то, что это первая игра, на концовке которой я заплакал от того, насколько это было хорошо.
Геймплей и боёвка
В геймплей я мог бы напихать кучу минусов, связанных с отсутствием какой-либо визуальной кастомизации, поломанным балансом и прочей лабудой, НО из того, что меня тревожило, в патче с Фантом Либерти пофиксили ВСЁ. Возможно, те, кто хотел от этой игры ГТА, очень злятся, что нельзя поставить себе хромовый шноркель на спорткар, но киберпанку такая кастомизация не нужна. Вождение машин странное, но к нему быстро привыкаешь. Приятный интерфейс у компьютеров. Правда, можно посчитать за минус не особо удобный инвентарь, но всё же от этого у игры для меня баллов не убавится.
Боёвка - это просто нечто. Такое количество путей, которыми ты можешь убить человека, - это просто ВАУ. Взрывай, отравляй, разрезай, пристреливай, сжигай мозги, заставляй застрелиться. Боже, да ради одного только средства убийства с помощью Киносуры можно купить игру. Для садистов - самое то. Стрельба интуитивная, а для тех, кто плохо стреляет, есть умное оружие. Для тех, кому не нравятся пушки, - вшейте себе ножи в руки и кромсайте. Для тех, кто не любит соприкасаться с врагом, - захватите камеры и переубивайте всех, взломав им мозги. В плане боёвки игра – шедевр, опять же. В общем геймплейном плане - не шедевр, но и неплохо, одним словом - хорошо.
Графика и визуальные составляющие
Эта игра заставила меня полюбить киберпанк. Про графику особо распинаться не хочу, ибо с таким компом, как у меня, на ультрах не поиграешь. Но визуальный стиль вывозит. Он смотрится лаконично. Описывает мир таким, какой он есть: с красивой обёрткой и убогим внутри. Контраст между бедными и богатыми регионами, красивые улочки и бомжи, ЛЮДИ, которые выглядят пёстро до того, что это становится обыденностью, – всё это даёт незабываемую атмосферу. Дизайн главных и второстепенных героев подходит как под их роли, так и под мир. Общая структура соответствует. За визуальный стиль и графику игра тоже получает оценку "шедевр".
Музыкальная и звуковая составляющая
Музыка повсеместная, типа радио или отдельных звуков, подходит под настроение мира киберпанка. Музыка в боёвках, в серьёзных сценах - до дрожи. Она прекрасно подходит под ситуации, в которых ты находишься, и, повторюсь, в целом под стиль игры. С озвучкой в основной части игры и локализации проблем нет. В Фантом Либерти, напротив, отсутствует озвучка, но тем, кто немного знает английский и умеет читать субтитры, это дискомфорта не должно принести. Очень хорошо.
Оптимизация и баги
Очень не хочу распинаться про баги, ибо это был большущий косяк на выходе. Но поскольку все баги оперативно фиксили, распинаться не придётся. Насчёт оптимизации. Раньше, когда я играл на 16 гб оперативки, в целом не лагало вовсе, на низких-средних 50-60 фпсов, чего для соло-игры хватало. Сейчас же 8 гб оперативки, да и остальные составляющие тянут туго, очень туго, но играть можно. Может, без рейтрейсинга с ультрами я что-то потерял. Но эта потеря меня не особо ранит, ибо и без того мне понравилось.
А на итог: если вы ожидали чего-то другого, то в самом начале я предупреждал, что оценка субъективная, и я не могу себе позволить оценить меньше 10/10. Эта игра для меня идеальна.

It had a rough beginning, no doubt about it. However, since then, this game has become an absolute masterpiece. There is no game on this Earth that has ever made me feel what this game has. It is a masterclass example of what exceptional story writing should be. There are no happy endings in Night City, and no game has ever made me, as the main character, feel so powerless. 

When Phantom Liberty was released, I was expecting a simple DLC that added a few extra hours of gameplay, but man was I wrong and I couldn't be happier about that. This DLC alone is better than 99% of the full-fledged games I have played throughout my entire life.

Aside from the story and the writing, the characters are exceptional by themselves, especially Johnny, the other main story characters, the romance options, and honestly, all the character of Phantom Liberty. No matter what you do in this game, whether it be focusing on the main story, doing side quests or gigs, or simply exploring, you will find gems hidden away at every corner of this map.

The combat is phenomenal. It is highly responsive, bloody, and gritty. There are dozens upon dozens of builds you can do, focusing on melee, snipers, blades, netrunning, drugs, spray and pray, stealth, and on and on. There are various types of weapons such as the basic ballistic firearms, but also power firearms that pack a greater punch and can be increased via certain builds, smart weapons whose ammunition locks onto targets and can be more effective with a netrunning build, explosives, burning, poison, blades, dildos (yes, I'm serious, you can beat people to death with dildos), hammers, etc. You can also forgo weapons altogether and focus purely on netrunning hacks which permit you to do various things such as spread viruses, knock enemies out, force them to commit suicide, and so on and so forth.

You could replay this game a dozen times and have a different build each time. How many games offer that much freedom?

Vehicles in this game are also quite beautiful and fun to use. Some of them are a little too slippery on the road for my liking, but those are the minority. There are at least 40 types of cars from my count that you can either buy or find throughout the world and use, a good chunk of them being original/unique vehicles such as Johnny's Porsche 911 that you can find through a quest.

And lastly, the music? I have to say, without a doubt, the Official Soundtrack of Cyberpunk 2077 is the BEST soundtrack of any game out there, hands down. Samurai? Phantom Liberty (the song)? And atmospheric music like Killing Moon? Absolutely out of this world. Its very rare that I listen to music in videos games outside of said video games, but I see myself coming back to the OST very often.

There is nothing more I can say. Get this game, it is a masterpiece, the greatest game of the last three decades, and I have no doubt it'll remain on that pedestal for me for many years to come.

10/10, without a doubt in my mind. Masterpiece.

Игра берёт очень высокую планку качества и проработки мира, его хочется исследовать и вникать в тонкости.🎨
Здесь просто приятно находиться, за всю игру воспользовался быстрым перемещением 2 раза, а это о многом говорит.🏄
У меня были очень высокие ожидания, и они оправдались с лихвой.📊
Персонажи выглядят очень живо, проработка характеров и настроений в зависимости от твоего общения и действий приводит к абсолютно нестандартным ситуациям.🫂
По поводу сюжета скажу, что он очень хорош; проходил всю игру почти не отрываясь.🗿
Я рекомендую проходить игру так, как чувствуешь, и не чекать гайды, как выйти на ту или иную концовку. У меня своими силами получилось выйти на хорошую концовку.🧮
Night City останется для меня таким же культовым местом, как и Grove Street, и я явно сюда вернусь ещё не раз.📼
Прокачка сделана следующим образом: вы можете вживить себе огромное количество имплантов и создавать свои сборки, из этого выходит очень вариативный геймплей под каждого геймера.🕹
Отыгрывать стелс или выбивать двери ногой, держа в руке пулемёт, — выбор всегда за тобой, и игра тебя не ограничивает.🤸
Оружие ближнего и дальнего боя сделано просто изумительно, каждое оружие ощущается по-своему, даже если оно из одного семейства.🧩
Можно даже отыграть кибер самурая с катаной.😁
Эту игру явно добавлю в свой храм величайших игр, и я очень рад, что решил её пройти именно сейчас, когда устранили все проблемы и баги (что, в свою очередь, могло бы испортить впечатление об игре).🏯
Добавлю ещё пару слов о графике: я сделал больше сотни скриншотов за своё прохождение.🌅
Здесь футуристические небоскребы соседствуют с трущобами окраин, а сразу за ними открывается безмолвное величие пустошей.🏙

Cyberpunk 2077, c’est tout simplement une claque monumentale. Un jeu qui réussit à s’adresser à tous les profils de joueurs, et c’est là que réside toute sa force.

Tu veux te laisser porter par l’histoire, découvrir Night City, suivre les quêtes et profiter de l’aventure sans te prendre la tête avec des mécaniques complexes ? C’est possible. Tu préfères creuser les possibilités, façonner ton personnage, peaufiner ton build, expérimenter les compétences, les implants et les améliorations pour créer un style de jeu qui te ressemble ? C’est possible aussi.

La liberté est immense, et chacun peut vivre son aventure à sa manière.

Mais réduire Cyberpunk 2077 à ses mécaniques de jeu serait passer à côté de l’essentiel. Son univers est incroyable, son ambiance est hallucinante, ses personnages sont marquants et son histoire sait te happer comme peu de jeux en sont capables. Night City n’est pas simplement un décor : c’est un monde vivant, brutal, fascinant, où chaque rue semble raconter quelque chose.

Et non, ce n’est pas un GTA futuriste. Ce n’est pas non plus un The Witcher transposé dans un univers de science-fiction. Cyberpunk 2077 possède sa propre identité, sa propre âme et une atmosphère absolument unique.

C’est un jeu qui peut te faire passer des heures à explorer, à combattre, à expérimenter ou simplement à te perdre dans son univers. Un jeu qui te laisse libre, tout en te proposant une aventure qui peut véritablement te marquer.

Bref, une expérience exceptionnelle, généreuse et immersive, qui prouve qu’un jeu vidéo peut être bien plus qu’un simple divertissement.

Pour moi, c’est une masterclass. Un univers de dingue, une histoire de dingue, une liberté incroyable. Et surtout, un jeu qui a quelque chose que beaucoup d’autres n’ont pas : une véritable identité. 🤘🔥

2.天上没有免费的馅饼o(￣ヘ￣o#)（最后我还是把她送上火箭）不过《往日之影》确实让《赛博朋克2077》焕发了第二春，也是玩家在首发灾难后收到的一份满意的答复。通关游戏后我觉得有两个结局值得聊一下，分别是“以我残躯化烈火”和“自杀结局”，以我残躯化烈火是V和强尼一起单枪匹马杀进荒坂塔不让任何伙伴替V送命，强尼让V领悟的成为传奇的秘诀，很难想象一个还有半年寿命的街头佣兵和一个死了五十多年的狂热恐怖分子一起杀进荒坂塔，V死了亚当·重锤替强尼报仇，而强尼一路陪伴着V直到进入神舆…我认为以我残躯化烈火是V和强尼双向成长的最好答复V像强尼，强尼像V从“城市之王”中的V不惧任何风险完成委托到“节制”中的强尼变得“碌碌无为”感叹夜之城的美好（放以前强尼会说“夜之城就是他妈的一座化粪池而且每时每刻还有不少2B往里面跳”o(￣ヘ￣o#)）我想这个结局是非常值得体验的结局。如果说“以我残躯化烈火”是《赛博朋克2077》的巅峰之作而“自杀结局”是考验CDPR心细和功底的最好展现，想想看目前很少厂商和作者能像《2077》那样敢把主角自杀直白的展现出来，主角自杀这个话题向来是极其敏感，如果弱化自杀就没多大含义，如果把自杀写的很醒人耳目容易会背上宣传自杀的意图。我第一次我这个结局为什么会有这个结局总感觉这个结局是来凑数的，并未有什么感受只觉得疑惑，但在结尾V的朋友们打来的电话有人自责，有人悲伤，有人愤怒，有人不解。整个结尾让人看着不想再体验第二遍，直到有人解释这个结局只是给一少部分人看的，因为从V选择自杀那一刻，强尼先会劝一下V到朋友们对V的各种感受这其中包含着强烈的反自杀倾向，自杀后你的家人和朋友只会感到悲伤，只会显得自己很不负责不把自己亲近之人当回事，我认为CDPR在这方面下了很足的功夫也侧面展现他们的功底和用心。这两个结局是我认为CDPR的用心之作。最后还是催促一下CDPR抓紧开发《赛博朋克2》期待下一步巨作。(•‿•)

For me, Cyberpunk 2077 is an interesting and enjoyable game because of its futuristic setting, exciting missions, and engaging storyline. What I like most about the game is how it presents a world where advanced technology plays a big role in people's lives. The city is full of bright lights, tall buildings, cybernetic enhancements, and different characters that make the game more realistic and immersive.

I also like that the game gives players the freedom to explore the city, customize their characters, and choose different ways to complete missions. The story makes the game more interesting because the decisions you make can affect certain events and relationships throughout the game.

However, I think the game can sometimes feel overwhelming because of its large open world and numerous missions. Some activities can also become repetitive after playing for a long time. Despite these weaknesses, I still think the game offers a memorable experience.

Overall, I would recommend Cyberpunk 2077 to players who enjoy open-world games, action, and science fiction. For me, its graphics, storyline, and freedom of exploration make it a worthwhile game to experience.

Сюжет Cyberpunk 2077: чому це не «шедевр», якщо увімкнути мізки
Усі хвалять сюжет за емоції, Кіану Рівза та гарну музику. Але якщо розібрати сценарій тверезо, через логіку та оригінальний лор всесвіту — гра тріщить по швах:
1. Сценарний абсурд у готелі «Компякі Плаза»
Сабуро Арасака — 158-річний імператор найбагатшої мегакорпорації світу. У нього своя армія, супутники і параноя галактичного масштабу. І тут його син Йорінобу просто душить діда голими руками в номері! Де персональний біомонітор діда з викликом Trauma Team за тривожним кодом? Де автономні приховані камери в номері імператора? Чому охорона не вибила двері через пів секунди після зупинки серця? Сцена написана на рівні дешевого серіалу, просто щоб у Ві з Джекі випадково опинився чіп.
2. Людо-наративний дисонанс (Брехня про терміновість)
Лікар Віктор у першому акті ставить діагноз: «Чіп роз'їдає твій мозок, ти кашляєш кров'ю, тобі лишилося лічені дні, рахунок на години!». І яка реакція людини, яка помирає? Ві спокійно купує 20 спорткарів, зачищає 100 притонів для фіксерів, малює карти Таро на стінах, бере участь у боксерських боях і катається на побачення. Уся драма про «швидку смерть» помножена на нуль самою структурою гри.
3. Правда про Джонні Сільвергенда: не бунтар, а гарматне м'ясо
Гра нав'язує Джонні як великого рокера-анархіста, який кинув виклик системі. Але за каноном оригінальної настілки (Cyberpunk 2020: Firestorm): штурм вежі Арасаки у 2023 році був офіційною брудною операцією корпорації Militech! Ядерну валізу Джонні дали самі корпоранти. Керував штурмом найкращий соло Морган Блекхенд, а Джонні був звичайним відволікаючим маневром, якого Адам Смешер за дві секунди розпиляв навпіл із дробовика. Уся його «велич» на чіпі — марення самозакоханого нарциса з пошкодженою пам'яттю.
4. Бар «Потойбіччя» і культ дешевих самогубців
Культ «помри молодим у перестрілці, щоб на твою честь назвали коктейль» — це найцинічніший корпоративний розводняк. Корпораціям і фіксерам вигідно романтизувати смерть, щоб наївні малолітки за власні гроші купували імпланти та пачками вмирали в чужих розборках за копійки. Гра ж подає це на серйозних щах як «велику мету найманця».
5. Ві — не RPG-герой, а безвільна ганчірка
У грі немає реального вибору. Ти не можеш відмовити Дексу і сказати: «Ні, це суїцид». Тебе використовують абсолютно всі: Декс, Евелін, Такемура, Ханако, президентка Маєрс, а Сойка в доповненні бреше в очі від початку до кінця. Найіронічніше, що єдині персонажі, які не порушили своє слово — це аристократка Ханако і Такемура: вони пообіцяли відправити Ві в орбітальну клініку в обмін на скинення Йорінобу — і виконали це.
6. Медичний цирк фіналу: чому Ві «не змогли» вилікувати у 2077 році?
Головний сценарний провал: лікарі кажуть, що чіп видалили, але тіло вважає мозок чужорідним і вбиває його за 6 місяців. У світі 2077 року?!
Повна заміна тіла (Full Body Conversion): Адам Смешер живе десятиліттями у вигляді мозку в броньованій капсулі (Biopod). Пересадіть мозок Ві в кібер-каркас — там взагалі немає біологічного імунітету, відторгатися нема чому.
Клонування: Biotechnica масово вирощує чисті тіла в чанах. Сам Сабуро в цьому ж фіналі переселяє свій розум у тіло сина! Виростіть клон Ві і запишіть його туди.
Наніти: Чіп створила сама Арасака, їхні вчені знають код цих нанороботів уздовж і впоперек.
Але розробники спеціально заборонили очевидні рішення, щоб видавити штучну сльозу під сумну музику на титрах.
Підсумок:
Як візуальна технологічна виставка з чудовим містом, звуком і брутальною стріляниною — моє шанування. Але як глибока RPG із логічним сюжетом — це лінійна казка, шита білими нитками.

At the time of this review, I still haven't finished the story because I've been taking it slow. Contrary to the fast-paced world of Cyberpunk, I'd say Night City and the Badlands are best experienced without rushing it. I've been taking the train, walking, not using the minimap or the on-screen quest marker for immersion's sake. This helped me familiarize myself with the world and appreciate the beautiful, near photo realistic world that the people at CD Projekt put together. It is a truly a beautiful game like no other.

The gameplay is varied, if you let it be. You can of course just be a jack of all trades, but then you're missing out on some the role playing aspect of the game. Faire une review objective après 200h de jeu c'est mission impossible, mais laissez moi vous donner les raisons qui font que je trouve ce jeu aussi bon.
Si vous connaissez Cyberpunk 2077 de nom, il y a de grandes chances que ce soit par sa sortie catastrophiquement buggée en 2020. Et bien le jeu de 2026 n'a plus rien à voir et mérite amplement sa place parmi les plus grands RPG de l'histoire. Il n'est pas exempt de bugs, mais ils sont devenus tellement anecdotiques et n'entachent en rien la qualité du jeu.

Pour commencer, le monde est immersif et incroyablement bien construit. La ville déjà : selon moi la qualité d'un open-world se mesure à "à quel point on est tenté d'utiliser la navigation rapide ?". Dans Cyberpunk 2077, la complexité, la variété et la beauté de la ville rend tout trajet largement préférable à une téléportation. Pourquoi devrais-je me rendre instantanément à l'autre bout de la ville lorsque je peux en profiter pour passer une quinzième fois dans ce quartier magnifique et riche en détails ? Le monde ensuite : le récit d'anticipation est splendide, réaliste et très immersif. L'existence d'une réalité alternative où l'Amérique de 2077 ressemble au jeu m'est parfaitement envisageable.

La qualité d'écriture de l'histoire et des personnages également. Jamais un dialogue ne m'a paru forcé, jamais un personnage ne m'a paru plat ou caricatural, jamais un moment de l'histoire ne m'a déçu. Souvent tragique, toujours incroyable à découvrir, le récit du jeu est honnêtement proche de la perfection. On reconnait bien la grande force de CD Projekt Red, déjà bien remarquable dans leur autre chef d'œuvre qu'est The Witcher 3. Idem pour le DLC Phantom Liberty : décidément ce studio aime faire des extensions à l'histoire encore plus incroyable que celle de leur jeu (déjà folle). Johnny, Panam, Judy, So Mi, Jackie : je ne vous oublierais jamais.

Dernier point et après promis j'arrête : la qualité folle de la personnalisation du gameplay. L'arbre de compétences offre tellement de façons de jouer c'est fou. Vous êtes fan du rentre-dedans et adorez charcuter les ennemis au corps à corps ? Vous avez une bonne dizaine d'options qui s'offrent à vous. Vous préférez l'infiltration précise et méticuleuse ? Une dizaine d'autres façons d'approcher chaque mission est possible. Ajoutez à cela la modification du corps, des vêtements, des véhicules et bien sûr les choix de dialogues et vous obtenez un niveau de personnalisation difficile à dépasser.

Mention honorable à la musique que j'écoute avec plaisir aussi bien en jeu qu'en dehors.

Bref (ce ne fut pas bref), jouez et rejouez à Cyberpunk 2077. J'y reviendrai définitivement un jour.

DISCLAIMER:
The game is definitely worth buying if you can get it at a massive discount, as in: single-digit price, being that one cannot deny that it is not a complete miss after the massive overhaul and fixes which polished what they could from the infamous initial version.

PROS:
The game obviously had a AAA budget and a fairly long story.
Someone poured their love for the Cyberpunk lore into the concepts and the pre-release marketing promised to deliver it.
If you want to end up with a mindless time-skip in the form of a semi-idle walk-and-click in your Library, this is a good choice. But again: only and only at a massive discount.

CONS:
1. Before anything else, the first thing that destroys the fun in this are the *unskippable* segments.
[spoiler] After Chapter 1 , you are thrown into an unskippable walking simulator with horrendous overeasy gameplay, that suffocates you with hopes of ending every time there is a fade-to-black, but no! At several points you have to literaly press the forward button several times to (!)crawl forward [/spoiler].
And the dialogue skip option is intentionally taken away at instances where you just sit and look at a character the developers deemed to be so important that you cannot skip.
Do you have choices? None that affect the gameplay.

And this can eat up to 15+ minutes of your life at several instances.

2. The gameplay is a an enormous tease and a letdown. You grow powerful incredibly fast and are given such a vast array of ways to combat that I had stopped upgrading my character a tad bit into chapter 2 because I couldn't find a reason to. The enemy AI is atrociously bad and unchallenging, the weapon classes are a gimmick (one even removes the need to aim at all, scoring instant headshots at a click of a mouse) and at first I thought the driving physics were some sort of an in-game joke.

3. The "cyberpunk" starts and ends with cosmetics in an illogical world that is simply any GTA-like space of copy-paste design, but you get to have a universal remote in your eyes.
The characters are unbelievable and the dialogues are cringe-inducing, with propaganda and forced perspectives infused with varying subtlety.

4. The game-breaking bugs that made it infamous are largely removed, but still present. At certain points the loading screen will shut down the game, there are untested spaces where you can get trapped and have to reload, the physics quirks are still present although rare, etc.

I really wanted to like the game and read online review promising the gameplay to get better as time progresses, but even this much time invested in it later, I cannot say that it is a win.
Unless, I repeat, you are to get it at a *large* discount.

Story and Atmosphere ★★★★★
The narrative hits like a truck, especially after watching the Edgerunners anime, which gives Night City an entirely new level of emotional depth. The bond between V and Johnny is unforgettable, and the Phantom Liberty expansion takes the writing even further with a gripping spy-thriller plot full of gut-wrenching choices. It is a bleak, unforgiving world that you simply cannot tear yourself away from.

Gameplay and Combat ★★★★★
Ever since the 2.0 overhaul, the combat and progression systems have been completely revitalized. Running a Sandevistan Katana build to slice through enemies like in the anime feels lightning-fast and immensely satisfying, while Netrunner builds offer lethal tactical power. Vehicle combat and gunplay feel punchy and responsive, with the DLC boss encounters offering some of the best challenges in the entire game. Easily worth buying again.

Visuals and Sound ★★★★★
Night City and Dogtown represent the gold standard of cyberpunk aesthetics. The neon-drenched streets, architectural verticality, and environmental details look breathtaking, with old launch bugs finally pushed aside. The radio stations and original soundtrack set the perfect gritty mood for cruising through the city at night. An absolute comeback story that turned a rough start into a definitive masterpiece.
