Your choices do not matter. Cyberpunk 2077 has a story that it wants to tell, and you are not a part of it. 

I came to Cyberpunk 2077 after years. I suppose I expected something between Skyrim and GTA. And that is there. Let's compare it to Skyrim for now. In Skyrim, faction quests matter, alter your character, and affect the world around you. In Cyberpunk 2077, they really do not. From the beginning of Cyberpunk, I was asked to choose a background: Nomad, Streetkid, Corpo (corporate). I had never heard this before the game as I came in spoiler free. I chose Corpo and at first, I was delighted. A cool story of intrigue and corporate espionage....for about the first 10 minutes of the game. It then blends it all together, throws it all out, and rolls every character into the same "merc starting from the bottom" story line.  

These backstories could have been cool factions like in the old MMO "The Secret World." Nomads could tell stories of honor and tradition in the Cyberpunk 2077 world. Streetkids could get invited to underground street races and be involved in gang wars. Corpos could navigate power in the corporate world. But it was not to be. These backstories were probably intended as factions like the faction quests in Skyrim, but were probably cut. All you get is dialogue options based on your backstory and that is it. The game oozes cut content everywhere. It oozes this because of one Johnny Silverhand.

Yes, I had heard of Johnny Silverhand played by Keanu Reaves before I played this game, and frankly I believe his implementation in the main quest is what holds this game back. Keanu does great work, honestly, with tons of voice lines. He is a character in this world and he put in a lot of work. He clearly respects this game as a story telling medium. However, I cannot help but think the inclusion of his celebrity is what derailed the development of this game from what it could have been.

Is Cyberpunk 2077 a good game? Sure. I give it a solid B-. In the end, the combat is fun. I relax and play the game at my own pace, but my choices do not matter. Oh sure. The character and combat customization of a Skyrm/GTA mix in a cyberpunk world is there, and that is fun. But the way your character plays is just a part of the experience. Your agency in a game like this has to effect the world around you. Night City feels living and immersive. I often see game critics try and defend the degree to which the story in this game is ultimately static. "V cannot save Night City" is a common defense I hear of this game. So let's fix that. "V does not have any effect on Night City." There we go. Fixed it. Because your choices in Cyberpunk 2077 do not matter.

Finalmente fechei Cyberpunk 2077 depois de literalmente 3 anos e meio enrolando.

E o mais bizarro é que não foi porque eu não gostava do jogo. Muito pelo contrário. Acho que justamente por gostar tanto da atmosfera dele, eu acabava entrando só pra “viver” Night City. Já tinha começado umas 2 ou 3 runs antes, jogava algumas horas, fazia missão secundária, dava rolê de moto ouvindo rádio, ficava admirando a cidade, explorando os becos, os prédios gigantescos, a chuva batendo no neon… e simplesmente parava.

Cyberpunk virou quase um lugar pra mim antes de virar um jogo que eu queria zerar.

Só que dessa vez eu realmente fui até o fim.

E sinceramente? Me arrependo demais de não ter feito isso antes.

Porque quando você finalmente entra de cabeça na narrativa, percebe que Cyberpunk 2077 é MUITO mais do que aquele “jogo futurista bonito” que ficou marcado pelos problemas do lançamento. O negócio é absurdo em vários níveis.

A trilha sonora é surreal. Tipo surreal mesmo. Tem jogo que usa música pra acompanhar cena. Cyberpunk usa música pra construir sentimento. Tem momentos em que você simplesmente para em algum ponto alto de Night City, olha aquela cidade gigantesca brilhando enquanto toca alguma faixa absurda ao fundo e fica meio anestesiado pela atmosfera. Parece exagero falando assim, mas jogando você entende.

Night City talvez seja um dos cenários mais imersivos que já vi em videogame.

E o mais louco é que, apesar de toda estética cyberpunk, implante, corporação, chrome, IA, tecnologia e caos futurista… esse universo fala MUITO sobre a gente hoje. Sobre sociedade, consumo, ego, solidão, exploração, gente tentando ser alguém num sistema que transforma todo mundo em produto descartável.

No fundo, Cyberpunk 2077 não é sobre futuro. É sobre humanidade. E acho que foi isso que me pegou tão forte.

Os personagens são absurdos. Não só os principais, mas praticamente todo mundo importante na história deixa marca de algum jeito. O Johnny Silverhand é facilmente um dos personagens mais carismáticos e complexos que já vi num jogo. Você passa boa parte da campanha dividido entre “esse cara é um filho da puta” e “caralho… talvez ele esteja certo”. E conforme a relação entre ele e o V evolui, o jogo começa a ficar quase melancólico sem você perceber.

E uma coisa que eu gosto MUITO é como o jogo consegue fazer você sentir que algumas pessoas realmente se importam com o V. Não parece só NPC te dando missão ou personagem criado pra mover roteiro. Você sente conexão de verdade.

A Judy Alvarez, o Viktor Vektor, o próprio Johnny… cada um tem seus problemas, suas cicatrizes, suas visões de mundo e suas próprias lutas acontecendo paralelamente. E mesmo assim, eles tão ali. Tentando ajudar do jeito deles.

O Vik principalmente passa uma sensação muito genuína de alguém que realmente se preocupa com o V além de interesse ou conveniência. Em Night City, onde praticamente tudo gira em torno de dinheiro, poder ou sobrevivência, essas relações acabam tendo um peso absurdo.

Os romances também funcionam muito mais porque parecem humanos do que porque o jogo quer te entregar “fanservice”. Tem silêncio, tem vulnerabilidade, tem trauma, tem aquele sentimento constante de que ninguém ali tá realmente inteiro.

E acho que o mais pesado de tudo em Cyberpunk é justamente isso: não existe final feliz em Night City.

Só existe final menos pior.

O jogo deixa isso muito claro o tempo inteiro. Não importa quanto você lute, sempre parece existir um gosto amargo no fundo. Uma sensação de que o sistema sempre cobra a conta depois. E sinceramente? Faz MUITO sentido dentro da proposta do universo.

Inclusive, depois de assistir Cyberpunk: Edgerunners recentemente, acho que tudo ficou ainda mais forte pra mim. O anime consegue capturar exatamente essa alma do universo cyberpunk: pessoas tentando sobreviver, sonhar, amar ou deixar algum legado num mundo completamente quebrado.

E talvez seja por isso que eu tenha criado tanto apego por esse universo. Porque mesmo sendo extremamente estilizado e futurista, ele parece assustadoramente humano.

Claro que o jogo não é perfeito. Ainda tem sistema meio cru, algumas coisas que poderiam ser muito mais profundas, conteúdo que parece que ficou no meio do caminho e marcas óbvias daquele lançamento caótico. Mas honestamente? Nada disso apaga o que o jogo conseguiu construir.

Pra mim, virou facilmente um dos melhores jogos que já joguei.

E acho que um dos maiores elogios que posso fazer é que poucos jogos deixam aquele vazio depois dos créditos igual Cyberpunk deixa. Você termina e fica pensando nos personagens, nos diálogos, nos lugares, nas músicas, nos finais… fica aquela sensação estranha de saudade de um lugar que nem existe.

E no fundo eu ainda torço MUITO pra continuação seguir a história do V de alguma forma.

Quero acreditar que existe um pós-ending possível. Seja o V sobrevivendo com os Aldecaldos e encontrando alguma cura perdida no meio do deserto, seja escapando da Arasaka depois de perceber que virou só mais uma peça descartável da corporação. Qualquer coisa menos aceitar virar um fantoche vazio igual o Adam Smasher.

Porque no fim, acho que essa é a alma inteira de Cyberpunk:

continuar lutando pra não perder sua humanidade, mesmo num mundo que faz de tudo pra arrancar ela de você.

Porra… que jogo do caralho.

Cyberpunk 2077 is an impressive game even years after its initial release. It sounds like an oxymoron, but Night City is brutally, savagely beautiful.

-------------
What I liked:
-------------

Gameplay Variety:
The game gives you a lot of freedom in how you want to play. You can go full cyborg Yakuza/Samurai with a katana or Mantis Blades, feel like a Terminator smashing people with Gorilla Arms after running out of ammo on your heavy machine gun, or take a stealthier approach with optical camo if you’re the kind of masochist who enjoys going for “Suit Only, Silent Assassin” in Hitman.

These are all valid options, and while I’m personally not big on stealth, I can only appreciate the amount of choice the game gives you.

The Characters:
Oh my god.

Without spoiling the story, the final boss of the main story has serious charisma. Sure, he’s evil. Sure, his lore is absolutely terrifying. But a good indicator of strong character design is when you totally detest a villain, yet still find them epic. It’s like Sauron: absolutely awesome and powerful, and you’d hate it if he ever crossed your path, but damn, you can appreciate how powerful he is.

There are also characters like Panam… The others don’t matter.

Except Jackie. Love and miss you, brother.

-------------------
What I didn’t like:
-------------------

I dislike when a game presents itself as a full RPG without fully immersing the player in that role. Cyberpunk 2077 feels more like an FPS with a rich story and RPG elements than a true RPG. You wouldn’t call GTA an RPG just because you make decisions in some missions, so I’m not sure why this gets placed in the same category as something like Fallout: New Vegas.

Is the story great? Absolutely. But while you initially choose a background for your character, the game ultimately pushes you away from it pretty quickly. For example, you can pick a corporate background and then get kicked out of the corporation within five minutes. What, no Arasaka counter-intel missions for V? It felt wasted, if not pointless.

That said, the unique dialogue options are definitely cool, and I do recommend the Corpo beginning. It makes the Devil ending make a lot more sense.

Also... it saddens me to say this, because I love this developer studio, but CD Projekt Red really needs to show its modding community some TLC. Every update breaks core mods, and I’m not going to lie: they should be hiring some of the people making those mods. They’re holding up a whole community, and yet CDPR doesn’t seem to give them the time of day. It feels like a step backwards and somehow makes Bethesda look like saints, which is saying something.

--------------
Performance:
--------------

Please don’t look at my current specs and assume I’m going to glaze my own setup. I first played Cyberpunk 2077 on a PC with a Ryzen 5 2600, a GTX 1070, and 16GB of RAM, and it still looked and performed great with standard rasterisation.

Ray tracing and path tracing are genuinely nice upgrades, but if you’re sitting there with specs similar to what I originally had, or slightly better, don’t worry. You do not need a 5090 to enjoy this game. It runs well on a variety of hardware and also plays nicely on a gaming laptop.

That said, I won’t lie: I do not recommend it on the Steam Deck. It needs work out of the box, and even then, it just doesn’t feel properly optimised.

----------------
Final thoughts:
----------------

Overall, Cyberpunk 2077 is absolutely something you want in your Steam library. Even if you only want to drive around Night City listening to the radio, this game is a perfect example of immersion. You really do feel like you’re in a lived-in world. Thanks to CDPR for the BREATHTAKING experience, but I expect nothing less from the people who brought us The Witcher 3.

Overall a decent RPG. It is very linear in the sense that most of your decisions (whether dialogue or how to complete a quest) don't have any impact either immediately or in the greater narrative. You're also often forced to complete quests in certain ways, with little choice besides how exactly you're going to waste some gonks. It's no BG3 from that standpoint. There's a lot of different types of weapons although if you're min-maxxing, you're pretty limited in terms of what the "best" weapon is for a given playstyle. I wouldn't say it's overly difficult - even at higher difficulty levels, the enemies aren't smarter or playing with different abilities, they just hit harder and have more health. I really do wish they would let you respec your attributes more than once - there's even a tip about "exploring different playstyles" by choosing different perks but the perks are directly linked to your attributes (and you can't max all attributes out), so you're limited within one playthrough as to how much you can move the perks around.

去年大概这个时候，我购入了这个游戏，此后的两个月，甚至更长的时间，都投入到这个游戏里。通关了所有结局，尝试了不同的出生选择，每个小任务也都试了起码两次或者多次，最后打了全成就，完善了全流程任务图。在游玩的过程中，我也经常向周围的朋友讲我有多爱它，它有多好，朋友也戏谑我为赛博妹，我喜欢这个称呼，我也喜欢夜之城和V的一切。

首先是无与伦比的城市设计。现实中我非常讨厌大城市，在某一线城市求学的十几年里，高楼除了遮蔽天空以外没有任何意义，我只能在低矮的出租房里仰望它们，借助地铁从高楼的地基，在家与学校间压抑的往返。但在夜之城，V是最自由的存在，市政中心的高科技与繁华，小唐人街的风情与浓郁的日本味，海伍德应该算是拉美风，恶土的荒漠，还有最令人惊叹的狗镇，可探索性大大提升，等等等等，借助V的双腿和摄影模式，整个城市在我面前展开。在那个网红高架路口拍了很多照片，确实很美，巨大的灯组配上赛博樱花，还有川流不息的车群，确实应该成为网红打卡点。

然后是电台音乐和过场音乐，每一首都很精良有点太过头了，但起码有80%的很好听，洗脑的悲怆的压抑的迷幻的纸醉金迷的，现在网易云播放时偶尔跳到其中的一些歌曲，也能瞬间把我拉回到夜之城，骑着杰克的摩托车驰骋，前往下一个任务目的地。我最喜欢的是和亚历克斯跳舞的hardest to be，任务前的紧张，对未来的不确定，和Alex简短的推心置腹后插入这么一段，就像溺水的人踹了口气，最重要的，当时没看攻略，算是一个十足的惊喜。还有night city和afterlife,非常符合城市的调性和剧情。

剧情，本来想放第二位的，但这个故事结局太难受了，除了 恶魔 自杀 节制 结局外其它都有点算是开放式结局，神舆里奥特吟诵的“那么我们走吧，你我两个人……要把你引向一个重大的问题……”很适合抉择的诗句，充满神性。never fade away播放时配上结局的过场动画，劲太大，那两天失魂落魄，如果非要比喻，就是看完巨人大结局时的那种感觉吧，好像灵魂里有什么被剥离出去。第一人称带来的极度沉浸，和杰克（我第一个玩的3A和战斗就是2077，开头打了很多遍，所以很喜欢杰克）在绀碧大厦前一秒还热情的喊我chica，傻傻的讲笑话，后一秒就死在车里。还有绕不开的强尼银手，扯嘴皮子中不断感情深入，Panama，百灵鸟，李德，简单的故事配合顶尖的演出，仿佛真的经历过这一切，2077的故事，给了我一段新的，另一个世界的人生。

还有其它种种优点，穿搭，拍照，丰富的浪漫线，帅帅的华丽的武器，多种流派，不同战斗方式。当然缺点也很多，比如稀碎的赛车手感，不过后来练成了也就还好了，网上也有很多缺点帖子，我举双手赞成这些言论，太可惜了，本来应该是一个更好的游戏。

最后说一些有的没的，最喜欢的是女V，一开始我是把自己代入主角的，但到后面就代入不了了，我和这个主角是完全不一样的人。英配女V磁性沙哑的声音，非常火热的感觉（有机会一定要试试英配）诱导着我去想如果真的是她会怎么做，然后做出选择。黑皮雇佣兵，温柔强大，在一些场面又霸气十足，谁不爱美强惨呢。还有故事中强尼频繁提到的燃烧，反抗，玩到最后，确实能感到，我心里有一团火，我就是要燃烧，加上现在现实中的种种，前几个月深圳不也被称为是现实中的夜之城吗，这可是坏事，因为在这，我们不是V。还有活下去，V强大的求生意志，结局却进攻荒坂塔，真的是活和死都轰轰烈烈，夜之城真正的传奇。

总而言之，我爱赛博朋克2077，写这么一段絮絮叨叨的纪念一下，静候第二部>ᴗoಣ

I think the idea a lot of people still hold about Cyberpunk date back to its disastrous first release with its game breaking bugs. I would not have considered picking this game up if it weren't for a friend of mine vouching for it! 

As someone that has now played through most of the base game on the steam deck, I have still run across a couple bugs ranging from falling out of the map, floating weapons and npcs, to issues with CDPR's launch system, but none that impede my engagement aside from an immersion break. It is a far cry from the game breaking bugs first reported, and from other recent reviews, people either have a bug free experience (like my friend) or are unlucky like myself.

This is all to say, these bugs do not at all overshadow the sheer world building and wanderlust of the game itself. On the steam deck, it runs better than a couple other AAA games I've put through the system. With optimisation you can get an easy 50 fps in dense crowds. 

Overall, I think the crowning achievement of Cyberpunk is its diverse combat system. I would say it isn't a very difficult game in terms of combat at all, but it has a high plasticity in terms of builds and seamless combat systems. This is alongside the stat/perk tree, which they have integrated very successfully in function. Nothing feels as though it is to waste. 

I would also say that the story is quite engaging, especially in its various discussions on the interaction between humanity and technological advancements, the parameters of what it means to be sentient, and the limit to which we are still able to maintain a sense of self while uprooting biological parts for metal and code. As with any game however, I find there are some minor short comings in other aspects of storytelling (pertaining to cliches, predictability, and secondary character focus), but there are many quests that have very in depth nuance akin to Witcher 3. (Though I believe out of these two very strong instalments from CDPR, Witcher 3 is a stronger contender story wise.)

Elaboración de la receta de Crepes caseros
En primer lugar, funde la mantequilla introduciéndola en el microondas durante 30 0 40 segundos.

A continuación, pon en un vaso de batidora los ingredientes líquidos: la leche, la mantequilla fundida y los huevos. Añade la harina, el azúcar y la sal. Tritura todos los ingredientes hasta conseguir una crema y pasa la mezcla por un colador para eliminar cualquier grumo que pueda tener. También puedes mezclarlos a mano con las varillas.

Masa de crepes

Unta una sartén antiadherente con una cucharadita de mantequilla con la ayuda de un pincel o brocha. Pon a calentar la sartén a fuego medio.

Vierte un poco de masa en el centro y espárcela bien por toda la sartén. Cuando empiece a cuajarse, dale la vuelta y cocina el crepe brevemente por el otro lado.

Repite la operación hasta terminar toda la masa.

[h1]Симулятор шизофрении в неоновом гетто[/h1]
Добро пожаловать в Найт-Сити — город будущего, где у каждого второго стоит хромированный тостер вместо почки, а уличные банды выглядят так, будто ограбили склад магазина секс-игрушек. Это история о том, как простой наемник пытается выселить из своей головы мёртвого рокера-террориста.
## [h2]ПЛЮСЫ ЭТОГО ЦИФРОВОГО ДУРДОМА:[/h2]
[b]• Друг, которого ты не просил[/b]
Всю игру в вашей черепной коробке будет сидеть Киану Ривз. Он будет курить вам прямо в мозг, материть ваши жизненные выборы и постоянно предлагать взорвать какую-нибудь корпорацию. Лучший бесплатный психотерапевт.
[b]• Хром на любой вкус[/b]
Вы можете вставить себе импланты, которые замедляют время, позволяют прыгать выше крыш или шинковать врагов лазерными лесками прямо из рук. Правда, лицо вам все равно разобьет первый встречный бомж с легендарной бейсбольной битой.
[b]• Дорога ярости[/b]
Местный автопарк прекрасен: от ржавых ведер с гайками до футуристичных гиперкаров. Управляются они все как утюги на льду, но сбивать ими бандитов на тротуарах — сплошное удовольствие. Физика вышла из чата, но веселье осталось.
[b]• Романтика в подворотнях[/b]
Игра дает возможность закрутить роман с местными маргиналами. Выбор богатый: от суровой кочевницы, которая любит чинить танки, до депрессивного копа и синеволосой девушки-монтажера. Главное — не перепутать кнопки в диалогах, а то придется дружить.
 [h2]МИНУСЫ (ДЛЯ СЛАБАКОВ):[/h2]
[b]• Нано-полиция[/b]
Стоит вам случайно задеть пешехода мизинцем, как местный ОМОН материализуется прямо у вас за спиной. Из воздуха. В пустой комнате. Физика будущего, не иначе.
[b]• Синдром Плюшкина[/b]
Вы будете пылесосить тонны мусора: завернутые в газету пушки, старые трусы, чипсы и пепельницы. Зачем? Чтобы разобрать это всё на гайки и сделать свой пистолет на 2% смертоноснее. Космос, который мы заслужили.

Огромный, красивый и дико циничный симулятор на 80+ часов, где вы будете грабить корпоратов, ловить цифровой трип и пытаться понять, почему в мире будущего самая дефицитная вещь — это нормальные, не багующие штаны.

Ein absolutes Meisterwerk – Das ultimative Next-Gen-Erlebnis (10/10)

Review:

Nach unzähligen Stunden in Night City kann ich nur sagen: Cyberpunk 2077 ist ein absolutes Meisterwerk. Wer ein Spiel sucht, in das man verdammt tief eintauchen kann, ist hier genau richtig. Die Immersion ist einfach Next-Level.

Grafik & Spielwelt
Die Stadt lebt. Die Liebe zum Detail, die CD Projekt Red in jede Straßenecke, jede Neonreklame und jede Gasse gesteckt hat, ist der Wahnsinn. Der Vibe dieser Welt ist einfach insane. Grafisch kommen vor allem die Charaktere extrem lebendig rüber – Mimik, Gestik, Details, das wirkt teilweise schon unheimlich real.
Pro-Tipp: Gerade auf dem PC kann man mit Mods noch mal so viel mehr rausholen und das Spiel perfekt an den eigenen Geschmack anpassen.

Gameplay, Skill-Tree & Wiederspielwert
Besonders gut gelungen ist das Leveln des Charakters. Anhand des extrem vielseitigen Skill-Trees gibt es unzählige Varianten und Möglichkeiten, wie man seinen Charakter spielen möchte. Ob man sich als Netrunner durchhackt, sich wie ein Ninja mit dem Katana durchschlägt oder klassisch mit schweren Waffen reingeht – es gibt unendlich viele Wege, das Gameplay anzugehen, und keine einzige Variante fühlt sich schlecht oder falsch an.

Dazu kommt noch, dass du anhand der vielen Entscheidungen im Spiel einen komplett anderen Weg einschlagen kannst. Das sorgt, zusammen mit den verschiedenen Builds, für extrem viel Variation und einen riesigen Wiederspielwert.

Story & Charaktere
Die Story hat mich von der ersten Minute an extrem gepackt. Und man muss es einfach sagen: Keanu Reeves als Johnny Silverhand ist ein absolutes Highlight. Er bringt seine Rolle verdammt gut rüber. Die Dynamik zwischen ihm und V fühlt sich nicht wie ein stumpfes Videospiel an – es fühlt sich an wie ein verdammt guter Hollywood-Film, in dem man selbst die Hauptrolle spielt.

Fazit
CD Projekt Red hat hier ein Epos abgeliefert, das seinesgleichen sucht. Gameplay, Story, Welt und Freiheit stimmen hier einfach an jeder Ecke. Für mich eine glatte 10 von 10. Wer ein intensives, emotionales und visuell atemberaubendes RPG sucht, kommt an Night City nicht vorbei. Absolute Kaufempfehlung!

This is first time i write a serious review, so yeah... 👀
The game run on average 30-45 FPS on a potato laptop with Medium to High settings (Low Crowd Density), i'll say it's good performance wise if you are gaming on the budget like me. 

as for the game itself, i think i will give it 8/10,
PROS:
- It's fun to run around as Netrunner in Night City, but after several hours i kinda feel that the game is kinda too easy, maybe my decision making a Netrunner V is have a big role on it too.

- The world itself feels big and lively (even at low crowd settings),
 
- The story is good enough to keep me playing, especially Phantom Liberty DLC part, i think the Relic mechanic it introduce is really fun, and Tower Ending (without Spoiler) might be the best ending of all time in my opinion. I would say though, after you watch some in-game news on tv, you probably will be like me and think "wow, the world building in this game is kinda fun and chaotic".

- CDPR also have make mod support for the games, making it kinda easy to add mods, especially for stuff like tiny immersion fixes, you know, the unnecessary detail like making all in game ads fully animated or pettable cat (yes you can adopt cat and iguana in this game, weirdly enough, you can only pat the iguana, still, they are both cute though).

- also, the music are awesome, if you have watched Edgerunner on Netflix, you might already have taste a little bit of those juicy bangers. but let me tell you, most of the songs in this games are really good. Recently, i even start to make a habbit of listening to some of the songs while doing chores, especially Chippin In, Pon Pon Sh*t (Jhonny Silverhand version, it's easter egg, not in Radio) and Never Fade Away, they really make me forgot how exhausting doing daily laundry was. (FYI, most of the songs from anime are in Body Heat Radio btw, including that song).

- Easter eggs, lots of easter eggs, really fun. I kinda don't want to talk too much about this because it was really fun if you notice something you don't know, but just you know, there are a lot of eater egg in this game. (just so you know, Murkman is the best detective)

CONS:
-Even though most of annoying bug from first released was already been patched and fixed, there are still some minor bug or glitches in the game, Some like driving drift, texture pop-in (not as bad as first released) and that one time Jackie walk through lockers during the first mission are might tied to FPS and you machine, but stuff like auto drive feature driver recklesly or showing negative million numbers (it was without mod btw) and monowire doesn't glow at all sometimes are still small stuff that need fixes in my opinion. (also, i know Fream gen is bad since it will give you low latency, but so far, i can't use frame gen at all. It will crash on me when i open map, even when using the settings for RTX 30s and 20s, so i don't know what kind of stuff that will happened if you able to use it on RTX 20s or 30s).

- lack of consequences might be one factor that make the story can feel a bit monotone and less exciting for me. Like, don't get me wrong, some dialogue choice does lock you out from good reward, like when i miss my chance to get Jackie guns for free, but like what i just said, "for free", mean you don't really missing out much when you make a wrong choices, if you own the DLC you can just buy your best friend's gun from the vendor in Dogtown. pretty neat since it was your best friend's gun, you know something that supposed to be sentimental for his family and people close by :). And not only that, if you fail to save someone who will give you car if you save them, you can also just,,, buy the car. Yeah, no sh*t i actually kinda lost excitement when i find out i can just buy stuff i missed out, like, i might get that some stuff like buying car from someone being killed in street race kinda make sense, but buying your own best friend's gun? I don't think Mama Wells or Misty will appreciate me to buy item that so sentimental for them (it kinda make me feels like paying people to make myself a grave robber). And it's just about rewards, you can try to just never talk when the timer is on during dialogue, there are some exception that instant kill you, but most of them at least from my experience, you don't really need to do anything to resolve the situation. I know that CDPR doesn't advertise this game as RPG anymore since the only RPG you get from this game is only a character building game like most J-RPG, but i mean, even as action game, it kinda lost to GTA, i still remember how hard it was to make decision in GTA 4. Still, i appreciate that the game locked you out from the side mission if you fail to do it (even if you can just save scum it.

- on last thing that less  of annoying and more of nitpicking for me is that you can't save car you stole. I know we don't play as literal criminal and mor of a merc in need of help in this game, but that doesn't mean you can't be criminal in the game. I mean, since 2.0 update, they add wanted system, it was fun even though you can kinda cheese it with going to safe zone. Why not try making a mechanic where you can hack a system of the car and it to your collection? Like limited amount of stolen cars that can be save  to your cloud so you can call it whenever until it was blown up and make it so that stolen car can't be repaint using the crystalcoat because unlike El Capitan, when you break the system of the car you can restore the neat content inside it. Idk, having permanent different colors of the same cars kinda sound interesting and stealing car outside the quests feel kinda useless for me right now.

THINGS THAT I WANT IN THE FUTURE:
- more updates, even sometimes update can break the mods, some stuff does need to be fix imo
- more DLC, we will get Witche 3 DLC in 2026-2027 (probably), i don't think one DLC is enough for this game, Phantom Liberty was fun, but i hope it get more story contents, and i do think it deserve more, maybe stuff that connected to Project orion?
- This one is for Project Orion i think, in the next game i hope the mission will be much more harder, the choices have much more weight on it and at the start of the mission, you can get a choice to either hire a merc to help you or call you online friends to help you if they really do want to make add the online function, just for immersion, because doing the mission alone against crowded enemy that have so many chrome kinda feels weird, well, this one doesn't feel weird because of the plot, but i don't think the same plot can work twice (well, even if i given choice to go with people, i might go alone though since it's video game, lol)

Un scénario incroyable tout en étant plongé au plein coeur de night city, l'immersion est incroyable je trouve avec beaucoup de choix de possibilités ouvertes en terme de personnage, de builds, de choix de dialogue, on s'attache très vite au personnages. Encore quelques bugs présents en 2026 mais rien de très bloquant, on reste plongé dans l'univers que nous offre ce jeu juste incroyable!!

Au moment où j'écris ces lignes, j'ai a mon actif 4 runs réparties sur 520h réparties sur 4 ans, à chaque fois avec une manière de jouer différente : netrunner expert au katana, puis Mantis + Sandevistan, puis impitoyable runner spé grillade par Mur Noir, puis tank indestructible qui fait des lancers à 3 points avec des membres de la MaxTac pour son sport du matin. Bon au vu de mes builds si j'avais un truc à redire, c'est que l'équilibrage du jeu fait que à partir d'un certain stade d'implants on délaisse les armes à feu (qui sont pourtant tout aussi belles, bien animées et bruitées les unes que les autres) car c'est NOUS, l'arme, et qu'on roule sur tout le monde même en difficulté max (mais qu'est ce que c'est jouissiiiiif).

Eh bien je n'ai jamais cessé d'être émerveillé par cet immense personnage qu'est Night City toute entière, impliqué dans tout ce que je faisais (du simple petit contrat à la méga mission d'espionnage) et dans les histoires proposées, et leurs personnages tous plus réussis et humains les uns que les autres, malgré leur chrome (sans pour autant être attaché émotionnellement comme pas mal de joueurs, je garde à l'esprit que c'est des persos fictifs dans un jv, mais j'apprécie énormément leur écriture). A chaque fois j'ai pris plaisir à incarner ce V, et au fil de la run devenir progressivement l'habitant le plus redoutable de cette ville.

Cyberpunk 2077 est un jeu que vous n'oublierez jamais, qui ne vous lâchera jamais. Il n'y a pas un jour sans que je pense à un truc en rapport avec ce jeu, que ça soit une musique (là aussi, les musiques, magistrales, ça représente au moins un quart de ma playlist perso), une réplique d'un personnage... jamais un jeu m'aura autant marqué. 

Alors, on se retrouvera, à l'Afterlife !

흥미로운 세계관을 제외하면 오픈월드 게임이 공통적으로 공유하는 단점과 장점을 모두 갖고 있음. 여러 번 유지보수를 거쳤다고는 하나, 일반적인 관점에서 플레이해도 거슬리는 버그가 다수 있다.

1. 브레인 댄스, 카메라 제어 등 특정 씬에서 조작 시 더미 데이터 툴팁 UI가 클릭 시마다 출력되었다 사라짐. 사소하지만 실제로 게임을 해 보면, 놓친 단서였나 싶어서 특정 지점 위에서 계속 조작을 바꿔 보는데 여기서 오는 피로감과 시간 낭비가 심함.

2. 특정 지점으로 이동하는 미션일 때, 강제 조작이 아니어서 해당 지점보다 캐릭터를 앞서 위치시키거나 이벤트가 일어나는 곳에 캐릭터를 위치시키면 십중팔구 미션이 꼬여서 터진다.
예수 브레인 댄스를 찍는 사이드 미션의 경우, 도로를 막은 트럭 앞에 차를 바짝 주차시키면 퀘스트 필수 NPC가 강제 이동되면서 자동으로 적대형 NPC가 됨. 문제는 해당 적대형 NPC가 엄청나게 튼튼한 경찰이라 샷건을 30대는 먹여줘야 죽고, 그러는 와중에도 경찰이 무한 지원을 와서 종국에는 경찰차 20대 사이에서 난전을 벌이게 됨. 체크 포인트로 돌아가도 주차시킨 차의 위치는 변하지 않아서 똑같은 이슈가 반복된다.

비단 이 미션만 그런 건 아니고, 어느 정도 플레이어를 유도하는 미션에서 위치나 행동이 조금만 어긋나도 예외처리가 안 되어 있는 바람에 다 터지고 만다. 문제는 그 유도라는 게 두루뭉술해서 미션이 터지고 재시작해도 이게 왜 이러는지 유저 입장에서는 도통 알 수가 없다.

3. 최적화............................ 내 컴퓨터가 GTX5070인데 재팬타운 저격수 제거 미션 들어갔더니 캐릭터 한 걸음마다 프레임이 끊긴다. 이외에도 자동차 타고 조금 빨리 달려서 다른 지역 NPC한테 바짝 다가가면 얼굴이 하프라이프 급으로 찰흙이 되어 있음. 이해 못하는 영역은 아닌데, 보통 유저 경험 상 이런 그래픽 자체를 거의 볼 일이 없도록 하는 게 착한 최적화 아닌가? 호그와트 레거시는 문에 1분을 비비게 만들더니 얘네는 찰흙이랑 뽀뽀를 시킨다.

4. 자잘하게는 이동수단 호출 시 내 머리 위 고가 도로에 바이크가 도착한다거나, 적 캐릭터가 슈의 얼려먹는 초코처럼 천장이나 바닥에 처박힘. 뽀뽀하듯이 가까이 다가가서 칼질을 해도 안 맞는다. 또는 게임 포인터에 나사가 빠져 있어서, 앉았다 일어섰다 카메라를 돌렸다 점프했다 다가갔다 멀어졌다 온갖 염병을 해도 오브젝트에 상호작용 UI가 안 뜬다든가.

- 버그 외적인 면에서는 시나리오 진행 방식이 경험적으로 너무 불쾌하고 나쁜 편임. 특정 스탯을 찍어야 시나리오의 선택지를 고를 수 있게 되어 있는데, 캐릭터 스킬과 연동되어 있어서 성능인지, 유저 경험인지 무조건 택일을 하게 만든다. 심지어 선택지를 고를 수 있는 스탯은 미션마다 뒤죽박죽이라, 한두 개 스탯에 집중해서 육성하지 않으면 모든 선택지의 요구 스탯이 1씩 모자라서 고르지 못하는 한심한 나를 볼 수 있다. 델라메인 미션에서 지능이 살짝 부족해서 특수 선택지를 고르지 못하고 일반 선택지를 골랐다가 조니한테 욕 뒤지게 처먹었을 때 정말 억울했다. 미션마다 권장 스탯 수치를 기재하거나, 해금되는 지역마다 스탯의 요구치를 조정하는 식으로 유저 성장, 메인 진행도에 따라 조정했어도 이 정도로 불쾌하진 않았을 듯함. 하다 못해 일정 스탯을 찍지 않으면 아예 선택지를 안 보이게 하든가. 그림의 떡도 아니고 뭐하자는 건지.

我打开这款游戏的时候，没指望它能理解我。

但它在某些方面确实理解了。比如那种站在雨里不知道该去哪的感觉。比如你脑子里住着一个比你更有趣的人——他叫强尼·银手，基努·里维斯演的，而你的身体正在一点一点被他吃掉。这听起来像是个隐喻，但它同时也是你的主线任务。

我演过银翼杀手。我知道那种在霓虹灯下站着、什么都不说的滋味。你知道的——就是站在那里，眨着眼睛，不知道为什么就有一种很悲伤的感觉。夜之城就是那种悲伤的具象化。它不是那种哭出来的悲伤，而是你点了一碗拉面，面摊老板的植入体在咔咔作响，你吃着面，外面下着酸雨，广告飞艇在你头顶兜售永生——而你连下一针抑制剂都买不起的那种悲伤。

这款游戏刚发售的时候是个灾难。Let's be real——它基本上是半成品，bug多到你的车会在天上飞，NPC会在墙里出生，你的角色会突然变成一根会走路的面条。但就像我演过的某些角色，它花了几年时间，终于弄明白了自己是谁。2.0更新加上《往日之影》资料片，把它从"你在开玩笑吧"变成了"okay, now we're talking"。

**夜之城本身**就是主角。这座城市，不夸张地说，是电子游戏历史上最漂亮的反乌托邦之一——每一道霓虹都像是有人精心放置的，就为了让你在凌晨三点骑着摩托车经过时觉得"damn, that hits different"。在高端显卡上，光线追踪让雨后的街道反射出整个世界，真实到你会忘记这只是一堆多边形。没有光追的情况下它依然好看——但如果你有光追，你会花很多时间只是站在那里看水坑。我就是在看水坑。看了大概四十分钟。No regrets。

**剧情方面**——主线的紧迫感和你实际上可以做的事情之间存在某种存在主义级别的脱节。你脑子里有颗芯片在倒计时杀死你，但你依然有时间帮街头混混偷车、给AI出租车公司解决劳资纠纷、或者花六个小时换衣服拍照。这就像医生告诉你还剩两周可活，你却说"cool，我先去考个潜水执照"。这种节奏上的奇怪感某种程度上反而成全了它——夜之城就是这样，哪怕你快要死了，生活还得继续，账单还得付，义体还得升级，某个中间人又给你打电话了，你嘴上说"我没空"，身体已经在接委托了。

《往日之影》DLC解决了不少这个问题。它更像一部紧凑的谍战惊悚片，每个角色都写得很扎实——李德、百灵鸟，这些人让你真的在乎他们会发生什么。这不是那种"加几个支线就收钱"的敷衍DLC，这差不多算半个续作塞进了资料片里，强度比本体高出一截。

**角色方面**——V（也就是你）其实有点像《亡命驾驶》里那个无名司机。你不多话，你接活，你执行，你在必要的时候用螳螂刀把整个房间的人切成碎片。然后你回到公寓，淋浴，保存游戏，盯着窗外霓虹灯闪烁的城市发呆。这基本上就是整个游戏循环。而你居然会上瘾。

强尼·银手是你的脑子里室友，他话很多，意见很多，基本每条评论都是负面Yelp评价，但逐渐地你会发现他在你身上留下的印迹比你愿意承认的多。基努的表演让这个角色不至于变成单纯的"愤怒摇滚幽灵"——他在某些安静的时刻，会让你觉得这个人和你一样困惑。

**战斗和义体系统**在2.0之后终于像样了。你可以走黑客流躲在暗处把所有人烧脑，也可以装上猩猩臂冲进去把墙壁和敌人都锤烂。技能树被重新做过，装备系统也不再是混乱的Excel表。驾驶手感还是偏轻，摩托车比汽车好用得多，不过当你骑着一辆阿波罗在夜晚的高架桥上穿行，电台放着Pacific Dreams——我可以诚实地告诉你，那种体验是接近完美的。

**那这款游戏到底值不值得？**

如果你从来没玩过——现在入坑正合适。终极版包括所有内容，你拿到的是一个修补了四年多的完整游戏。在2026年，它的画质依然是顶级水准。如果你之前被首发版的灾难劝退了——是时候回来了，现在这些bug大多是"有个NPC姿势有点奇怪"而不是"你的存档被吃了"。

它不是一个完美的游戏。有些当初宣传的东西永远没实现，地图上有些门永远不会打开，地铁系统也是过了三年才加进来的。但就像K在《银翼杀手2049》里最终躺在那片雪地上——有些东西不需要完美，它只需要让你在那一刻觉得，这一切是值得的。

如果你曾经在深夜看着窗外下雨，觉得世界既美丽又绝望——那你会喜欢夜之城。

如果你只是想用螳螂刀把人切成小块——你也会喜欢夜之城。

这就是这款游戏的优雅之处。它同时在两个完全不同的频道上运行，而两个频道都在说同一件事：你在这里待得越久，就越不想离开。

*Ryan out.*

Joguei no lançamento e tive sorte de não encontrar muitos bugs. Mesmo com um PC mais fraco na época, consegui aproveitar muito o jogo e me apaixonei completamente por esse universo e pelos personagens. Agora terminei minha segunda jogatina, já com um PC novo e depois de todas as atualizações, e dá pra ver claramente o quanto melhoraram o jogo e adicionaram várias coisas novas.

A história e os personagens são incríveis. Tem missões em que você simplesmente quer continuar jogando só pra descobrir mais sobre aqueles personagens tão cativantes. Algumas quests são realmente memoráveis e ficam marcadas. Uma que me pegou muito, mesmo sendo simples, foi a missão de tocar com a banda — achei aquele momento muito especial e divertido.

A trilha sonora é impecável, tenho várias músicas do jogo na minha playlist até hoje. E os gráficos continuam lindos mesmo anos depois do lançamento. Night City ainda impressiona demais visualmente, e várias vezes eu simplesmente parava pra admirar o jogo e a atmosfera da cidade.

A exploração também é muito boa. O jogo é cheio de easter eggs, itens secretos, missões escondidas e até interações secretas espalhadas pelo mapa, o que deixa explorar Night City muito recompensador.

Tenho algumas críticas também. Achei o jogo relativamente fácil, principalmente pra quem gosta de explorar tudo. É muito tranquilo upar e chegar no máximo sem muito esforço. Também queria mais missões com os parceiros, porque senti que algumas histórias acabam rápido demais e dava pra desenvolver muito mais. Mesmo eles adicionando algumas coisas nas atualizações, ainda acho que caberia muito mais conteúdo nesse lado do jogo.

Além disso, sinto falta de atividades simples no mundo do jogo, como sinuca, jogos de cartas e outras interações pequenas que ajudam muito na imersão. NPCs mais vivos e inteligentes também fariam bastante diferença.

Mas, tirando isso, o jogo é excelente e vale muito a pena. Depois de todas as atualizações, ficou ainda melhor e hoje finalmente parece o jogo que prometia ser no lançamento.

这个世界既不黑也不白，而是一道精致的灰。
  为了成为夜之城的传奇，两个无名佣兵铤而走险，潜入顶级公司荒坂盗取 Relic 芯片，这场冒险最终却酿成悲剧：一位不幸殒命，一位被芯片侵蚀身体，还永久寄存摇滚歌星“强尼·银手”的意识体，只剩下6个月的寿命。为求生，V在夜之城不断挣扎前行，也因此认识了形形色色的人。对荒坂愚忠的武士竹村，重情重义的流浪者帕南，坐镇来生顶尖中间人罗格，以及狗镇相遇，始终挣扎求生的百灵鸟。这座夜之城从不存在真正的光明，霓虹灯闪烁，却温暖不了人心；街道上人群嘈杂，却掩饰不住孤独。繁华表象之下，藏尽无尽挣扎与万般无奈。
  游戏的主线与支线彼此交织。各地区的委托任务、赛博精神病案件与NCPD突发事件，共同拼凑出完整的夜之城生态，让这座冰冷的赛博都市仿佛拥有了真实的烟火与故事，也让整部作品宛如一部鲜活的赛博朋克编年史。
  人性的复杂，每个角色都有不同的执念和选择。帮派与企业的阴谋，街头边缘人的挣扎，以及V每次战斗，为生存出手都告诉我们，这座灰色城市没有所谓绝对的正义，只有每次选择后留下的伤痕与无法言说的遗憾。游戏的多重结局，没有一条是圆满的答案。杀穿荒坂塔后，V既可以让强尼留存于赛博空间，自己加冕为夜之城的王者；也可以选择永远沉寂于赛博空间，将肉身彻底交付强尼，让他代替自己离开这座夜之城牢笼。V也能携手帕南的家族冲破桎梏，远离纷争、彻底离开夜之城；或是成全他人，将百灵鸟交由新美国医治、归于平凡，或是送她奔赴月球，赠予她唯一的自由。亦或者，以残躯化烈火，孤身直面荒坂的庞大体系，不拖累任何人，以凡人之躯活成整座城市的传奇。
  无名小卒，还是名扬天下。我也不知道哪个结局是好是坏，游戏的哪一个结局似乎都包含着一丝沉痛。夜之城本就是典型的反乌托邦世界，注定所有故事的底色，都是悲凉与无奈。的确，现实中本没有皆大欢喜之事，得失与遗憾才是常态。也正是因此，这部作品也变得更加真实起来。
  纵使它有着开服时将半成品端上的仓促和诸多画饼只完成一半的失约。体验感不好的自动驾驶和过多的强光污染、视角抖动让人眼睛有丝许难受，以及部分场景昏暗所给人的无奈。不时遇到的bug，需要多刷几次才能解决，可我依旧愿意给它打上满分。其中的瑕疵从不能掩盖内核的光芒，它依旧是赛博朋克题材中毋庸置疑的封神之作。
  也许过段时间，无名小卒会重返夜之城，再次踏上这场沉浮之路，名扬于这座赛博城市中。现在，需要面对生活这更强大的“荒坂公司”了。

The story is also not as strong as many people claim. Much of the progression consists of being sent from one objective to another without enough depth to make the experience consistently engaging. The game repeatedly emphasizes that the protagonist is dying and running out of time, yet at the same time encourages the player to spend countless hours doing unrelated side activities.

Mas hoje, jogando no computador, é outra parada, um troço totalmente diferente. A CD Projekt Red arrumou demais o jogo e conseguiu reviver ele por completo. Hoje em dia, dá para dizer que ele bem dizer não tem defeitos. É um RPG muito f***, com uma história absurda, jogabilidade animal e que hoje está muito bem otimizado. É um jogo que, na minha opinião, compensa demais comprar mesmo que seja em preço cheio.

### 1. Uma Variedade Gigante no Combate de RPG

Poucos RPGs me pegam desse jeito por causa da liberdade. O combate dele é espetacular porque te dá possibilidade de coisa para caramba. Se você quiser ir na surdina de stealth, você consegue; se quiser meter o louco, ir de peito aberto e trocar tiro ou meter a porrada, dá também; e o sistema de hackear os inimigos e os cenários é f*** demais. Essa mistura de estilos deixa a gameplay sempre divertida e variada, dependendo de como você quer montar a sua build.

### 2. Narrativa F*** e Amizades que Impactam

A história principal e as missões secundárias são muito fodas. Por mais que a gente já saiba que o final tem apenas algumas alternativas específicas, as decisões que você toma durante a jornada realmente impactam no desenrolar das coisas. O ponto mais forte é a conexão que você cria com os personagens; depois de um tempo ali, a amizade que você faz com a galera e as companhias pelo mapa mudam a forma como você enxerga o mundo e o que você de fato vai ou não fazer. O elenco de apoio e o Johnny Silverhand carregam o enredo muito bem.

### 3. A Vida em Night City e os Carros

A ambientação dessa repaginada de um mundo cyber futurista é bem bacana e tem um impacto visual absurdo. No quesito de pilotagem, a direção dos veículos em si não é muito boa, a física dos carros derrapa um pouco, mas a variedade de modelos é excelente. E o interior dos carros é muito legal de você ver, cada veículo tem um painel futurista todo detalhado, cheio de telas e design único que dá uma imersão do caramba quando você joga em primeira pessoa.

### 4. O Custo-Benefício da Phantom Liberty

Além do jogo base ter renascido, a DLC dele (*Phantom Liberty*) é espetacular. Ela vira e mexe também está em promoção e dá um revival muito grande para o título, trazendo uma história de espionagem f***, um distrito totalmente novo e mecânicas que refinam ainda mais o que já era bom.

### Conclusão

*Cyberpunk 2077* saiu da lama do lançamento para se tornar um dos melhores e mais bonitos RPGs de ação da atualidade no PC. Ele entrega uma história emocionante, uma Night City viva e uma liberdade de gameplay que vicia. Seja no preço cheio pelo tanto de conteúdo que oferece, ou pegando o combo com a DLC em uma promoção, é um jogo que hoje em dia se tornou obrigatório no computador!

Cyberpunk was a wild experience for me. I was really pulled in by the very natural sounding and feeling interactions between npcs and just the general story, I have done every ending and Im glad I did. The themes explored in this game are so impactful and really resonated with me. 

Not to mention the absolute masterpiece of a DLC they released. Just a flat out improvement on the story telling of the base game with features and gameplay improvements on the side as well. 

On that note, this game as many know is one of the best come back stories in the video game industry. 

Whilst certainly a very accessible game, it does have a relatively steep learning curve in terms of what is actually possible. At worst its a on ok shooter game. At best, once u optimise and understand the relationship between the different tech and abilities in the game u can have some of the most cinematic and straight up rehearsed looking combat ever possible. The engine is very accommodating. 

The visuals on high settings are also very stunning ofc. There is a reason Cyberpunk since being released and patched up is present in most pc hardware and resolution benchmarking videos you can find on youtube. 

But ofc the game does have its flaws, at times repetitive game cycles, lack of many bosses and boss weakness in general, and a somewhat tedious platinum (an engaging achievement list is hard to achieve so many games fail regardless) are some of the issues the plague the game. 

But in my last run in which I did the "secret" don't fear the reaper ending I became actually terrified at the fact the CD project red can make good boss fights if they want, because ADAM smasher which lets be honest if you have levelled up enough and are relatively powerful and competent is a punching bag and a plot device at best, became the most terrifying experience I had in my almost 350 hours and truly lived up to his name. Moving at speeds I could not perceive, pulling moves that were actually hard to avoid and anticipate. Raining explosives on my head without a break, summoning foot soldiers that also sent 10 million smart bullets my way. I was also on the very hard difficulty so there is that. 

This however came at the cost of reducing my "Ultra powerful walk into a room and have everyone receive divine black wall punishment to a power weapon run and gun. I sadly had very high cost quick hacks and the dlc cyberdeck equiped which limited my options. 

Despite its flaws, I heavily recommend this game. Alot of the npc behaviour and world interaction flaws are just a mod or two away from being fixed anyway, do visit Nexus mods for those who care. 

Finally, one of my fave songs of all time. Phantom Liberty by P.T. Adamczyk, Dawid Podsiadło.

Around 200 hours over a few weeks. Multiple endings. Night City slowly stopped feeling like a game world and started feeling inhabited.

What stayed with me wasn’t the spectacle. It was the exhaustion underneath everything.

Reed and Songbird are probably two of the most tragic characters CDPR has written. Neither cleanly right. Neither cleanly wrong. Just damaged people trapped inside systems larger than themselves.

This game understands something uncomfortable: sometimes there are no “good endings,” only choices about what parts of yourself you are willing to lose.

I thought I’d 100% the game afterward. Instead I just sat there staring at the menu music wondering why I felt actual grief over digital people.

Rarely does a game earn that.

Cyberpunk 2077 and Phantom Liberty are not perfect. But together they became one of the most emotionally devastating experiences I’ve had in gaming.

剧情叙事是CDPR的王牌，也是《赛博朋克2077》真正封神的核心。游戏摒弃了传统3A“英雄救世”的流水线剧情，以宿命与抉择为核心，讲述了小人物V在夜之城的挣扎与救赎。玩家可选择流浪者、街头小子、公司员工三种出身，不同开局不仅影响初始剧情，更会在后续对话、支线互动中带来差异化细节，让角色塑造更具代入感。
主线围绕主角V与传奇摇滚疯子强尼·银手的意识共生危机展开：意外植入的Relic芯片，让两人意识共存于一具身体，倒计时之下，要么V吞噬强尼的记忆，要么被彻底取代，一场关于生存、自我与执念的博弈就此开启。整个主线节奏张弛有度，没有多余注水内容，全程紧扣“我是谁、我该如何活下去”的核心命题，充满成人世界的无奈与残酷。
相较于单薄的主线流程，游戏的支线内容堪称“神级水准”，也是2.0版本后玩家口碑翻盘的关键。不同于多数开放世界“跑腿式”支线，本作支线全部拥有独立完整的故事线与人物弧光：德拉曼的人工智能自我觉醒、竹村的隐忍与挣扎、帕南的自由与救赎、朱迪的温柔与执念，每一个配角都鲜活立体，没有工具人角色。大量支线会影响剧情走向与人物关系，游戏包含四大主线结局、隐藏结局及二十余种分支结局，没有绝对的完美结局，每一次抉择都伴随着取舍与遗憾，极致的沉浸式叙事，让玩家真正体会到“夜之城从不眷顾任何人”的残酷底色。
而《往日之影》DLC更是将剧情高度再次拉升，以谍战悬疑为核心，塑造了细腻复杂的人物关系，剧情反转不断、立意深刻，斩获TGA最佳叙事DLC奖项，补齐了本体剧情的深度短板，让整个故事体系更加完整饱满。
多年更新修复之后。2077终于达到了它应有的质量。这确实是一个好游戏

THE open-world

游戏在诸多核心维度都做到了行业顶尖水准，流畅丝滑的战斗操作、丰富多元的战斗流派，无论是枪械正面硬刚、黑客潜行入侵，还是义体近战搏杀，都能带来极具爽感的战斗体验；夜之城的场景构建极具沉浸感，霓虹闪烁的街头、错落林立的高楼，将未来都市的氛围感拉满；角色塑造立体鲜活，配角们的故事各有张力，剧情叙事的基础质感扎实，支线与主线的衔接也让这个世界显得更为真实，完全担得起大作的名号。

但在极致的感官体验之外，这款游戏也存在两处让我难以释怀的短板，即便整体品质出众，也依旧影响了对其核心立意与剧情共情的感受。

一、赛博朋克外壳之下，新瓶装旧酒的内核局限

《赛博朋克2077》顶着极具前瞻性的赛博朋克题材，打造了看似充满高科技感的未来世界，可深入游玩后会发现，它更像是套了层赛博朋克外皮的传统动作战斗游戏，并未真正深挖赛博朋克的核心内核，也没能满足我对高科技未来世界的想象。

游戏的核心玩法与剧情逻辑，依旧跳脱不开传统雇佣兵争霸、势力对抗的老套框架，本质上和经典的阵营对战、强者闯荡江湖的叙事模式并无二致。主角V的核心轨迹，依旧是凭借强悍的战斗能力在各方势力中周旋，完成任务、争夺资源、解决敌对势力，这套玩法逻辑放在任何一款动作冒险游戏中都成立。而赛博朋克题材本该重点展现的高科技深度应用、人工智能对人类社会的重塑、网络空间的极致博弈、资本与科技对人性的异化等核心元素，在游戏中都只是浅尝辄止。义体、黑客等设定更多是服务于战斗玩法，并未真正融入世界观叙事，结合当下人工智能的飞速发展来看，游戏对未来科技的呈现显得格外单薄，空有华丽的视觉外壳，却没有与之匹配的思想内核，难逃“新瓶装旧酒”的桎梏。

二、主角与强尼·银手的共生关系，共情缺失且极易出戏

强尼·银手作为游戏核心剧情人物，他与主角V的共生关系，是主线剧情的核心支撑，却也是最让我无法共情、频繁出戏的部分。

剧情设定中，V因意外将承载强尼意识的芯片植入体内，两人陷入身体争夺、意识共生的困境，这本该是充满戏剧张力的设定，可实际体验中，既没有感受到V对生存的强烈渴望、对驱逐强尼夺回身体的迫切，也无法理解强尼·银手存在的核心意义与角色价值。两人的共生更像是被动绑定的关系，缺乏循序渐进的情感铺垫与羁绊积累，彼此的互动既没有生死相依的羁绊，也没有针锋相对的张力，显得十分突兀。

更违和的是，在极致写实的高科技赛博朋克世界观下，这种“一体双魂”的设定，像极了玄幻小说中灵魂共生的老套桥段，与游戏主打未来科技的基调格格不入。强尼如同依附在V体内的“意识癌细胞”，不断侵蚀宿主身体，这种设定既没有用科幻逻辑做合理铺垫，也没有赋予角色足够的情感内核，让原本该扣人心弦的主线羁绊，变得生硬刻意，彻底打破了游戏的沉浸感，很难让玩家真正代入角色的情绪与抉择。

总体而言，《赛博朋克2077》凭借出色的画面、流畅的战斗和扎实的基础剧情，无疑是一款值得体验的精品游戏，但在题材深挖与核心剧情共情上，仍有着明显的缺憾。它用霓虹打造了令人惊艳的夜之城，却没能真正讲好一个属于赛博朋克未来的、直击人心的故事。

Nothing really new, nothing really special. Cybernetics? Meh, Deus Ex did it first and better.  Stealing/buying a variety of vehicles? Meh, GTA not only does what this does, but they even include aircraft! Buying a variety of hideouts/apartments? Meh, so many games have done it, the list wouldn't fit. Hacking? Meh, again the list of games that have it is too big to fit. Crafting and Modding? Meh, Fallout 4 is easily as good.  

The only way they could have brought any originality or real replay value to this since they chose to copy almost all the other core concepts from elsewhere(aside from the setting), was the story.  However, the story felt really forced. Many sections of it are set on rails and just totally ruin the immersion. Choices don't really seem to matter until you are at endings. The NPC's mostly suck. I don't want to talk to many of the folks I am forced to converse with for missions. I don't pick dialogue options on the drives with Panam because I just want her to shut up, so I wait it out in silence. There's this mission that I would rather just shoot my way in, but it isn't an option. The forced dialogue through that mission felt like some enforced moral lesson aimed at teenagers. Silverhand is more annoying than entertaining. 

I came back just cause I enjoy hunting bounties, the challenge of capturing and not killing the cyberpsychos, even just doing gigs. Unfortunately I got so sick of the game I no longer wanted to play to see the endings I missed, I just watched some videos.  The developer doesn't help their game any either... A few years back on my older machine an update had broken the game. The dev's response was basically "Caveat Emptor." (let the buyer beware) I had to go through steam archives to find out how to roll back to an older stable version(a more complicated process than it needs to be). There are some positives, but the negative got so overwhelming I had to vomit it all back out here.

Cyberpunk 2077 is one of the best comeback games ever.

Night City is easily the best part. The city looks insane, the atmosphere is amazing, and it actually feels like a place you want to explore instead of just a map full of icons. Driving around, doing gigs, finding random side stories, and just getting lost in the city is half the fun.

The story is also really strong. The main missions are memorable, the characters are well written, and a lot of the side quests are better than main quests in other games. The combat is great too, especially once you start unlocking better cyberware and builds. You can play stealthy, go full guns blazing, hack everyone, or just turn yourself into a walking weapon.

After all the updates, the game feels way more complete. It runs better, plays better, and has a lot more depth than it did at launch. Phantom Liberty also adds some of the best content in the whole game.

Overall, Cyberpunk 2077 is absolutely worth playing now. It has an amazing world, great characters, fun combat, and a ton of style. Not perfect, but easily one of the most memorable RPGs I’ve played.

Я бы поставил игре смешанный отзыв (спустя 3 прохождения), думаю, что Valve пора бы ввести такой формат обзора/ревью.

Говоря о самой игре, я бы её охарактеризовал так - "Умелец во всем, мастер ни в чём". 

В мире который сделали CDPR ты ни за что не ответственен и не несёшь никакой ответственности, твои действия не влияют на поездку по рельсам. Ты можешь оскорбить персонажа и он даже погудит в моменте, но вашу арку в сюжете это никак не повлияет. Ты можешь на максимум прокачать тело (20 пунктов) и попробовать использовать/впечатлить максимальной силой в диалоге персонажа, но (по требованию сценария) этот персонаж сдунет тебя с плеча как букашку и скажет - "Ок, кул стори, бро".
Сам V (главный герой) просто невыносимый профан, то что этот дурачок порой говорит и делает не входит не в какие ворота. Допустим я при повторном прохождении начал дико отшивать Джуди во всех диалогах и пытался отыгрывать эгоиста V, в итоге выйдя от риппера Фингерса мы с Джуди пособачились, вытащили Эвелин (подругу Джуди и по совместительству персонаж который может помочь "в теории" спасти жизнь ГГ), мы приходим в хату Джуди где лежит Эвелин (опять таки я постоянно ругался с Джуди, всегда ей отвечал поперёк как игра позволяла) и игра, в тупой своей манере, предлагает мне три варианта диалога "Почему вы с ней поругались?", "Я могу с ней поговорить?", "Как она себя чувствует" (или что то типа того), как эгоист я конечно же скажу - "Я могу с ней поговорить?", так как мне нужно узнать кто заказал налёт на Arasaka. Но как вы думайте какие из этих трёх диалогов были вторичными и какой был обязательным для продвижения, конечно же обязательным является - "Почему вы с ней поругались?", в данном примере вы видите, что игра не даст вам быть вами, даже близко, но ладно, Бог с ними, мы уже играли за Геральта, но V даже нет смысла спрашивать это, так как он понятия особо не имеет, что за лесбо-драма тут происходит, нам почти вообще не раскрывают их взаимоотношения, да и хотим ли мы знать и в этом участвовать? И так будет всегда, вы будете на рельсах, твои решения не будут иметь никакого значения и ты будешь счастлив.

Как RPG или даже ARPG игра не справляется с играми 10-15, да что там, 20 лет давности. Как клон GTA игра также не может потягаться с той же GTA4 2008 года, а иногда с GTA 3, прости меня Господи. Как иммерсив сим игра поломана на два первым Deus Ex. Как Адвенчура CP77 рассказывает слишком наивную, противоречивую историю с персонажами которые взяли свои моральный компас у пачки картошки в макдаке и фильмов от Marvel. Открытый мир в этой игре буквально как опухоль на лице красивой девушки, он просто мешает и ломает всё вокруг, тащит игру вниз за собой, в DLC были попытки уменьшить локацию и сделать всё более компактным, но похоже CDPR струсили поняв, что им придётся изменить весь корневой дизайн игры, что для DLC непозволительно по средствам и времени. Открытый мир очень красивый, в нём прекрасный вайб, но это музей, на него можно посмотреть, но нельзя трогать, только кататься по рельсам. Отмечу кучу недоделанных механик которые кинуты в игру "лишь бы чтоб было", например брейнданс который, как можно полагать, планировался быть чем то большим, а в итоге стал брехнёй на три раза, репутация которая при максимальном уровне (50) влияет на продавцов которые дают аж целых 5% скидки, никто, не одна душа никак не отмечает твою репутацию, даже сам V. Мы уже не говорим, про откровенную ложь от CDPR до релиза о состояние игры и фичах которые должны были быть и которых в итоге нет, да что там, они даже в твиттере сменили, после релиза, описание игры с RPG на Adventure так как даже тут соврали. 夜之城没有真正的光明。霓虹闪烁，却映照不出温暖；街道潮湿，却掩不住孤独。这不仅是一座城市，而是一部活生生的赛博朋克编年史。
	V 的存在是一种无声的悲剧。每一次拔枪、潜行、黑客入侵，都不仅是生存手段，更是一种对命运的抗争。义体的金属关节在动作中低鸣，提醒你——身体可以强化，灵魂却无法修复。战斗不仅是技巧，更是与孤独对峙的仪式，每一次交锋都在重新书写生存的代价。
	剧情线如暗河般蜿蜒：早期的选择在未来悄然回响，人物的理想与渴望常被现实碾碎。强尼·银手的孤独、街头边缘人的挣扎、帮派与企业的阴谋，都在提醒你，这里没有绝对的正义，只有选择后的伤痕与无法言说的遗憾。每一个任务、每一次偶遇，都让夜之城充满了鲜活感：雨水打在金属与皮革上，折射出的光影冰冷扭曲；霓虹在水洼里映出被拉长的梦，仿佛提醒你——未来的光亮，也许注定会折射出阴影。
	当游戏推进到最后，屏幕缓缓切入制作组名单，霓虹与城市的喧嚣退去，只剩下淡淡的电子光晕。《Never Fade Away》的旋律缓缓响起，像从遥远的记忆中飘来的告别。名单滚动间，全息电话亮起——V的好友们出现在虚拟空间里，他们声音颤抖，带着关切与惋惜。短短的片刻，却让孤独和失落具象化，提醒你：即便在钢铁与霓虹交织的世界，情感仍然真实而脆弱。
	《赛博朋克2077》的悲剧不仅在于夜之城的残酷，也在于每一次选择后的错过与无可挽回的命运。那首歌和那通全息电话，将V的终章定格成一曲无声的哀歌——短暂、深沉，却在玩家心中久久回响，让人无法释怀。

Firstly, I will talk about spoilers.

I have played through this game twice, once when the update after the Edgerunners anime released and once this past few weeks with the DLC. This review will almost completely be a negative one because the more I played this game the more I hated it. It might come as a surprise because I do recommend this game, I think it's a great game but it is a game I truly did not enjoy. The two praises I will give to this game are these:
1. The story is really well [b] written. [/b]
2. The gameplay is fairly fun. 
I think that most people who are looking for a basic but fun RPG in a cyberpunk setting will enjoy this game so I do very much recommend it.

Now with that said, why do [b] I [/b] dislike this game? Simple, this game is terrible from a TTRPG perspective. Cyberpunk is a TTRPG, this game is supposed to be a video game companion to Cyberpunk the TTRPG. And yet, it is simply a game in the cyberpunk genre. All it has to offer you is anything any other RPG in the cyberpunk genre can, it simply has names of the Cyberpunk TTRPG and nothing else.

First issue? Player choice. 
There are few choices you can make in this game, fewer choices that matter. The way you unlock 2 endings is simply by doing the side quests and not fucking up, the way you unlock the third is with just 3 dialogue choices that don't change much. The DLC did improve this, the way you get to the ending the DLC unlocks is still basic but more involved and I do like that. But considering 4 out of the 5 endings to the main story have prerequisites that are extremely basic and have very little to do with your actual choices sucks.
There is another level to this too however, your builds never matter in narrative. By the end of the game, I had 20 INT and the only thing I can do with that is just getting some throwaway lines in some missions. I can't be a proper Netrunner outside of combat because that's not the role CDPR wants V to play. And this isn't just an issue with INT, through the 2 playthroughs I've gotten 3 stats to the max, and it's all the same. 
I will reiterate, Cyberpunk is a TTRPG where the way your character is built can change so much and yet the video game that is based on Cyberpunk is unable to capture the same essence? At that point would this game have been any different if it was say Bladerunner, Akira etc. Sure there would be some aesthetic differences and the names would be different but there's no part of a TTRPG here.

Repetitiveness.
This gets into spoilers specifically so avert your eyes if you're reading this for some reason. 
Every time V gets close to finding a solution with the relic, we get told that no it won't work and everything is worse actually! Yay, yippie, hurah. Now the issue I have here is not that everything sucks and things are horrible, this is Cyberpunk that's to be expected. The issue I have is that it happening that many times is just frustrating. Going around in circles is not fun, especially not when it happens so many times.

Length. 
This game relies on its side stories to carry how short the main story feels. I don't have any problem with shorter games, I don't think more playtime equates to a good game. But what I have a problem with is that the main story straight up feels incomplete. When I got to the final quest I was genuinely confused and thought that surely there's more to do afterwards. Though well considering the development cycle of this game, it might genuinely just have been incomplete.
Now the side stories, first I'm gonna talk about the important multi quest romancable character side stories. I think they're all written really well. I really liked them all. One issue, they share the problem of the main story. You do one gig and then poof, that's all folks. They have you yearning for more, and not in a particularly good way I'd say.
And now the unimportant small side stories. They're fun enough, they're not meant to be anything massive, just interesting and fun quests and they do manage that.

Waiting.
Know what would've cut my playthrough by like at least a quarter? If I didn't have to wait for characters to slowly walk to mission objectives. At some point it starts feeling maddening you know? I shouldn't have to wait for a character to get to an elevator, then wait in the elevator and then wait for them to walk into a room.

Skill Checks.
Wanna know what's not fun? Being punished for leveling up. Did you know that before 2.0 the skill checks used to be static and depend on the area you're in. Now, they change with your level. You could be in the shitties area in town and it will still scale with your level. This was genuinely the single worst part of the game in 2.0 for me. 


In essence, it feels like this game is playing Cyberpunk the TTRPG with a spiteful controlling gm. Every lead you find? Empty and shit keeps getting worse. Narrative choice? Who needs that, I have the best ideas so you should just do this. You know, after I finished my second playthrough I was thinking and I remembered a bit from (Baldur's Gate 3 spoiler ahead) [spoiler] Baldur's Gate 3's ending. There's a bit there when you can attempt to take control of the elder brain with a bunch of checks increasing in difficulty. The final one is a difficulty 99 and there's no way to pass it other than rolling a 20 on the die. And your reward for passing that check? The reward for you doing a godly feat to take control of the elder brain? It is a bit of damage in the final boss battle. [/spoiler] This entire game to me felt like that bit. I was given the illusion of agency, but when I tried to push to see if I truly had it I found that it simply wasn't there. I truly think CDPR were the wrong people for this game. They have made a great game set in a cyberpunk world, but they made a terrible game set in the Cyberpunk world.


Anyways, all of this rambling was kinda to get my feelings out after I finished the game for the second time. I now hope to never look at this game again because I can confidently say I hate it and the experience of going through it is something I hope to not relive again. If CDPR release another cyberpunk game, I may give it a look but I hope to close the book of my life that is this game for good.

And yet the review is still a recommendation for a simple reason. This game is not made for me, nor was it made with me in mind. CDPR made a great game for the people who like ARPGs. Maybe had I gone into this game, knowing nothing of the Cyberpunk TTRPG or TTRPGs in general I also would have enjoyed it, but alas that is not my reality. As it stands, this is a truly amazing game that I would recommend to anyone that isn't like me and doesn't care much about the TTRPG genre, or just plain enjoy ARPGs. And yet it is also a game I loathe.

Cyberpunk 2077 isn’t just a game, and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners isn’t just an anime. On the surface, both present a hyper-stylized futuristic dystopia dripping in chrome, visceral violence, and the oppressive shadow of megacorporations. But if you strip away the sci-fi aesthetic, you are left with a mirror reflecting something painfully familiar: our own reality.

Today, we watch people burn themselves out at the altar of hustle culture, constantly chasing status, wealth, and systemic validation. In Night City, that desperate climb is literal, measured in dangerous cyberware, synthetic implants, and chrome. In the real world, the destruction happens in quieter, less neon-lit ways, but it hollows people out just the same. You see it clearly in the protagonists. David Martinez didn’t just want power; he wanted to prove his worth to a world that treated him like trash. Meanwhile, V didn’t want to conquer the world; they just wanted to survive a system that was stacked against them from day one. It begs the question: how many of us are living our own versions of that exact same struggle right now?

The ultimate thesis of the Cyberpunk universe is a warning that when ambition goes blind, it ceases to motivate and begins to consume. Characters stop living for themselves and start chasing a ghost, desperate to fill an emptiness that no amount of chrome or eddies ever will. That is the secret ingredient that makes this universe so profoundly special. Behind the blinding neon, the chaotic action, and the aggressively unhinged, NSFW energy of Night City, lies a raw, bleeding heart. It is a masterclass in exploring humanity, trauma, loneliness, and the astronomical price of trying to "win" in a fundamentally broken world.

There are no happy endings in Night City. It is a rule the franchise refuses to break. Just like in real life, closures are rarely neat, and endings are rarely perfect. Yet, despite knowing the house always wins, the people of this world still choose to love, still dare to dream, and still fight like hell anyway. Maybe that is the real message of Cyberpunk. It is not about surviving the city; it is about holding onto your humanity while it tries to tear you apart. It is a masterpiece of existential dread disguised as high-octane sci-fi—one that makes you want to overthrow a corporation, cry over a radio song, and realize that while half the city desperately needs a therapist, the other half just needs to log off and touch some grass.

Найт-Сити — это место, где буквально всё выглядит ахуенно… пока не начинаешь жить в этом городе дольше пяти минут.

С первых часов игра тебе говорит:
"Ты можешь стать легендой."

А потом:
— тебя обманывают
— стреляют в лицо
— импланты стоят как почка
— тачку разбивают
— и какой-то киберпсихопат бегает с катаной быстрее твоего фпса.

V — это вообще олицетворение человека, который просто хотел нормально пожить, но судьба сказала:
"Не, братан, сегодня ты страдаешь."

И тут появляется Джонни Сильверхенд — цифровой Киану Ривз у тебя в голове.
Мужик буквально как внутренний голос в 3 ночи:

— «всё хуйня»
— «корпорации зло»
— «давай взорвём что-нибудь»
— «пошли бухать»

И самое страшное — иногда он реально прав.

Геймплей в игре — это отдельный прикол.
Ты можешь быть:

скрытным хакером
терминатором с дробовиком
самураем с катаной
или ебанутым психом, который врывается голый с битой и всё равно каким-то образом побеждает.

А машины… бля, машины в Cyberpunk — это когда едешь красиво под музыку ночью, чувствуешь вайб будущего…
и через 10 секунд влетаешь в столб, потому что миникарта решила показать поворот за полметра до него.

Но настоящий пиздец — это сюжет.

Потому что игра постоянно делает вид, будто у тебя есть время.
Хотя буквально у героя в голове цифровая бомба замедленного действия.

И ты такой:
"Надо срочно спасать свою жизнь."

Тоже ты через 3 минуты:
— фоткаешься с бомжом
— помогаешь автомату с личностным кризисом
— покупаешь куртку за все деньги
— и идёшь делать татуировку, потому что «ну стильная же».

А ещё в этой игре настолько живые персонажи, что после некоторых концовок сидишь молча, смотришь в титры и думаешь:
"Ебать…"

Не потому что всё грустно.
А потому что Найт-Сити — это место, где даже счастливый конец ощущается как кредит с маленьким шрифтом.

Итог:
10/10.

Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world RPG that has improved a lot since its original launch. The game takes place in Night City, a huge futuristic city filled with crime, corruption, technology, and different groups fighting for power. The world is one of the strongest parts of the game because it feels detailed, dark, and full of personality.

One of the best parts of Cyberpunk 2077 is the story. Playing as V, you get pulled into a dangerous situation involving Johnny Silverhand, and the game gives you a lot of choices in how you handle missions, conversations, and combat. The characters are memorable, the side missions are strong, and the story can feel emotional and intense at times.

The gameplay is also very fun because there are many ways to play. You can use guns, stealth, hacking, melee weapons, cyberware upgrades, or a mix of everything. The upgrades and skill trees make your character feel more powerful over time, and customizing your build adds a lot of replay value. Driving around Night City, taking on gigs, and upgrading your gear makes the game easy to sink hours into.

However, Cyberpunk 2077 is not perfect. Some bugs can still happen, and the open world can sometimes feel more visually impressive than fully interactive. The game also takes time to get into because there are many systems, menus, and upgrades to learn. Still, compared to how it launched, the game feels much more polished and complete now.

Overall, Cyberpunk 2077 is a great RPG with an amazing setting, strong story, fun combat, and a lot of customization. It is especially worth playing if you like futuristic open worlds, deep character builds, and story-driven games.

# 夜之城，或者说我们自己的倒影 ——《赛博朋克2077》评测

## 写在前面

2020年12月10日，《赛博朋克2077》在历经三次跳票后终于发售。其结果众所周知：PC版尚且勉强可用，主机版几乎无法游玩，bug多到成为互联网狂欢的素材，CD Projekt Red股价暴跌，公司公开道歉，甚至惊动了波兰政府监管部门。

这与2018年E3展上那部燃爆全场的45分钟实机演示形成鲜明对比。那部演示至今仍刻在我记忆里：夜之城霓虹璀璨，V从垃圾堆里爬出，Jackie开着那辆破旧的Hella Eclypse，两人聊着“去来生”酒吧喝一杯的梦想。彼时没人会想到，三年后的评测会不得不花大量篇幅讨论“游戏到底能不能跑起来”这种基础问题。

但我今天想聊的，是那些bug之外的东西。因为在我断断续续玩了数百个小时、经历了三次重新开档之后，我发现《赛博朋克2077》是一个极其奇怪的案例：它既是游戏工业过度承诺与资本驱动的典型案例，又是我近年玩过的最动人的赛博朋克叙事之一。这两个判断并不矛盾。

## 夜之城：一座有灵魂的城市

先说最值得称道的部分：夜之城。

坦白说，在发售后的头十个小时里，我对这座城市是无感的。因为我一直在和导航系统打架、看着行人在车前瞬移、目睹两辆车融为一体这种荒唐场面。但当bug逐渐被修复（发售一年后终于到了“正常玩”的程度），当我不再急着推主线、开始散步式地游荡时，夜之城开始展现它的魔力。

CDPR的环境叙事能力是顶级的。整座城市分为六个行政区，从威斯伯区那些俯瞰全城的富人别墅，到海伍德区弥漫的拉美文化气息，再到圣多明各的工业废土感，每一片区域都有自己的视觉语言和阶级密码。你不需要任何一个NPC告诉你夜之城贫富差距有多大——你只需要从日本街的霓虹小巷驱车五分钟，开到太平洋区的废弃商场和流浪者营地，身体就能感受到这种撕裂感。

而真正让夜之城“活”起来的，是那些无处不在的、与主线完全无关的小叙事。在一个隐蔽的地下停车场，你会找到一辆后备箱塞满尸体的车，通过读取芯片，你能拼凑出一个关于公司暗杀、背叛和逃亡的完整故事。在某个楼顶，一对恋人相拥而亡，身边是两颗药瓶和一封遗书——因为其中一人被查出患有致命的神经疾病，而他们的保险不足以支付治疗费用。这些故事没有任务标记，没有奖励，可能99%的玩家永远不会发现它们。但它们就在那里，安静地腐烂，像夜之城无数个普通人的结局。

这就是CDPR最擅长的东西，也是《巫师3》之所以伟大的原因：用海量的细节让一个虚构世界拥有真实的历史感和人情味。夜之城并不是一个空荡荡的开放世界游乐场，它是一个活着的、破碎的、让人又爱又恨的家。

## 叙事：关于末路与选择

主线剧情评价分化严重。有人觉得太短、太线性，与“网状叙事”的期待相去甚远。有人觉得基努·里维斯饰演的强尼·银手戏份太多、太抢镜。说实话，这些批评都有道理。

但我想换个角度。

《赛博朋克2077》讲的是一个关于“时间”的故事。主角V的脑子里有一颗Relic生物芯片，正在逐步改写V的神经元以适配强尼·银手的人格——换句话说，V正在被另一个人缓慢取代。这个过程是不可逆的，游戏用多个结局反复强调这一点：V几乎必死，差别只在于怎么死、和谁一起死、死之前做了什么。

这种设定让整个游戏的叙事节奏产生了一种奇特的张力。一方面，你被“只剩几周可活”的紧迫感推着往前走；另一方面，夜之城广阔得不像话，支线任务丰富得令人咋舌，每个街头委托都可能引出一个小型故事弧。这种叙事与玩法的矛盾，恰恰是赛博朋克核心主题的完美隐喻：在资本主义晚期和科技异化的夹击下，个体生命的意义被不断压缩。你的时间从来不属于你——它属于公司，属于账单，属于你体内那块正在杀死你的芯片。

而V的选择，说到底，不是“拯救世界”还是“毁灭世界”这种史诗级选项。V的选择非常渺小、非常私人：是相信荒坂公司那个不一定可靠的“救赎”承诺，还是接受命运、把身体让给强尼？是选择和帕南在荒漠中寻找新的家庭，还是选择和罗格一起完成一场最后的演出？甚至，是选择在太空赌场里孤独地等待死亡，还是回到地球、在仅剩的几个月里平静地活下去？

这些结局没有任何一个让我感到“爽”。每一个都痛，每一个都像是一种妥协。但正是这种痛感，让我相信CDPR真的理解了赛博朋克的灵魂。这个子类型的核心从来不是炫酷的义体和霓虹灯，而是一种深刻的悲观主义：系统无法被推翻，你唯一能做的，是在崩坏中找到对自己有意义的方式活下去——或者选择不活。

## 强尼·银手：叛逆的悖论

单独聊一下基努·里维斯扮演的强尼·银手。

平心而论，这个角色的存在确实影响了叙事结构。因为基努的咖位太大、太贵，导致很多剧情必须围绕他展开。结果就是，你以为是关于V的故事，到后来变成了V和强尼的双主角戏。而强尼这个人物的性格设定——暴躁、自恋、理想主义到近乎幼稚——并不是所有人都能接受的。

但我想说，强尼·银手恰恰是赛博朋克精神的某种“搞笑版镜像”。他是2023年用一颗核弹炸毁荒坂塔的传奇摇滚歌手，是夜之城反抗精神的化身。然而五十年后，当他从芯片中被唤醒时，他发现自己炸掉的东西早已重建，荒坂比以前更强大，而他的“牺牲”成了一个被消费的符号——街头有人穿他的周边T恤，却不知道他代表什么。

这种设定极具讽刺意味。强尼的愤怒是真实的，但他的方式却是过时的、无效的、甚至有害的。在多个结局中，如果V选择让出身体给强尼，他会用这把二手生命去做什么？他会……离开夜之城。不是去继续革命，不是去推翻体制，而是像一个终于获得自由的老人一样，坐上公交车，消失在公路上。

这个细节让我对强尼·银手的所有反感都变成了一种复杂的共情。他可能自己都不知道，他已经被夜之城彻底消耗殆尽。他的怒火是真货，但他本人已经成为他曾经反抗的那个东西的一部分。这种角色弧光，是很多“英雄叙事”做不到的。

## 玩法：潜力和落差

不得不承认，相比叙事和世界构建，玩法是《赛博朋克2077》最让人感到可惜的部分。

先说好的：流派构建是有深度的。黑客流（快速破解）、技术流（无人机和炮塔操控）、力量流（大猩猩手臂砸门）、敏捷流（斯安威斯坦时停）——每个流派都有完全不同的游戏体验。我三周目分别玩了纯黑客、时停武士刀和狂暴霰弹枪，战斗节奏完全不同，都有各自的爽点。黑客流那种用“传染”快速破解让整栋楼的敌人同时自相残杀的体验，是我在开放世界游戏中从未有过的。

但问题也显而易见。首先，敌人的AI非常平庸。潜行时，敌人的视野和反应模式极其简单；战斗中，敌人基本上只会直愣愣地冲过来或躲在掩体后面探头。很少有那种需要你真正动脑、利用环境或组合技能的遭遇战。相比《DOOM 永恒》那种把战斗设计成一道动态谜题的做法，《赛博朋克2077》的战斗只是“够用”，远达不到“出色”。

其次，成长系统曾一度混乱不堪。2023年推出的2.0大更新和“往日之影”资料片对这一块进行了彻底重做，但如果你玩的是早期版本——那个技能树逻辑混乱、数值膨胀到莫名其妙的版本——你可能已经被劝退过一次了。2.0之后的技能树更简洁、更有意义，每个技能点都会真正改变你的玩法，而不是像之前那样给你一堆“手枪伤害+1%”的垃圾。

但即使是在2.0之后，开放世界的填充物依然单调。NCPD警用小任务本质上就是“到这个点，清怪，拿奖励”的公式化设计。这些内容在头十几个小时还行，到后期就变成了纯粹的体力劳动。你可以说它们是可选的、不影响核心体验——但这并不能改变CDPR在开放世界设计上并没有太多创新的现实。

还有一个一直被吐槽但始终没解决的问题：载具手感。开车像在冰面上滑行，摩托车稍好一点，但整体上，夜之城的驾驶体验远不如五年前的《GTA V》。考虑到夜之城是一座为车而建的城市（大量长途驾驶不可避免），这点真的很影响沉浸感。

## “往日之影”：游戏应有的样子

2023年9月，资料片“往日之影”发售。我必须说，这是《赛博朋克2077》真正的、应得的翻身仗。

资料片的故事发生在新美利坚合众国控制下的狗镇（Dogtown），一个被高墙围起来的法外之地。V受命拯救一位被困在墙内的新美利坚总统，从而卷入了一场涉及情报、背叛和身份认同的间谍游戏。

比起本体，“往日之影”在叙事上成熟了很多。更强的人物塑造（伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴饰演的特工所罗门·里德是全游戏最复杂的角色之一）、更紧凑的节奏、更艰难的选择。资料片的核心抉择几乎让所有玩家都陷入了长时间的犹豫，而且无论选哪边，你都会后悔。这是CDPR曾经最擅长的东西——那些“没有正确选项”的灰色道德困境。

玩法上也有明显提升。狗镇的设计密度远超本体任何一个区域，每一栋建筑、每一条小巷似乎都有故事可讲。新加入的Relic技能树和任务链增强了RPG维度，而几个主线任务（尤其是“伤害倍数”中那段类似《控制》的诡异场景）展示了CDPR在关卡设计上的潜力——可惜这种创意在本体中很少见。

如果把“往日之影”单独拿出来打分，在我这里可以到9/10。它证明了《赛豹朋克2077》的内核是真正优秀的，只是被糟糕的发行策略和项目管理埋葬了。

## 技术问题：永远绕不开的话题

我必须聊一下这些问题，尽管它们已经快被说烂了。

2020年首发时的《赛博朋克2077》，在PS4和Xbox One上几乎无法游玩。帧数低至15帧，贴图加载延迟严重，bug多到每五分钟触发一个。CDPR明知这样的状态，仍然选择发售，甚至没有向主机评测者提供主机版本以供提前测试。这是游戏史上最灾难性的产品发布之一，对消费者信任的伤害是长期的，即便到了2024-2025年的今天，仍然有很多玩家对它心存芥蒂。

即便是在PC平台，首发版本也远远谈不上“完善”。主线任务中会有无法触发下一步对话的严重bug，车辆会卡在地形里，NPC的动作动画会在过场中诡异失控。我当时的主线流程卡了两次，需要用控制台命令强制跳阶段——这不是“开放世界bug多很正常”可以解释的程度。

好消息是，经过多次大型更新（1.2、1.3、1.5、1.6以及最终的2.0版本），PC和次世代主机版本已经相当稳定。我在2.0版本完整通关的50多个小时里，只遇到了不到10个bug，且没有任何一个影响任务完成。PS5和XSX版本的性能模式可以达到动态60帧，画面表现优秀。PS4和Xbox One版本也获得了最后一次大型更新，但我不建议任何人在上世代主机上玩这个游戏——它从一开始就不该登陆那些平台。

## 总结：它值不值得？

这是一个很难直接回答“是”或“否”的问题。

如果你期待一个完美的、没有bug的、玩法革新的开放世界RPG，我无法向你推荐《赛博朋克2077》。即使在2.0版本之后，它仍然有一些固有的问题：平庸的AI、公式化的开放世界填充物、不够完善的载具手感、以及一条相对线性的主线。

但如果你是一个重视叙事、世界观和角色深度的玩家，如果你能被一个好故事（哪怕它包装在一个有瑕疵的产品里）打动，如果你愿意花时间去探索那些没有任务标记的、安静地腐烂着的小故事——那么《赛博朋克2077》很可能是你玩过的最好的赛博朋克游戏之一。

“往日之影”应该是一个重要的参照。如果你要入坑，我强烈建议直接入手包含资料片的完整版，并在新档中从本体玩到资料片。整个体验（从序章到狗镇再到结局）大约需要70-80小时，是近些年最让我投入的叙事旅程之一。

我想用游戏中的一个场景来结束这篇评测。在一条支线中，V会接到一个任务：一个叫Joshua的死刑犯请求V陪他走完最后一程。Joshua是一个虔诚的基督徒，他认为通过录制自己在被钉十字架过程中的“救赎”经历，可以感化世人。V可以选择配合，也可以选择退出。如果选择配合，你会亲身体验一场长达十分钟的、几乎令人无法直视的残酷仪式。整个过程没有动作场面，没有QTE，只有缓慢的、真实的痛苦和对话。结束后，屏幕上会出现一行字：“任务完成：救赎。”

这是我玩过的所有游戏中最令人不安、最让人长时间沉默的一段体验。它和赛博朋克有什么关系？它和义体、公司、高科技有什么关系？从表面上看，什么都没有。但从更深层次看，它关于的是一个个体在失去一切希望时，如何为自己寻找意义的过程——而这不就是V正在做的事吗？这不就是我们在一个不可控的世界里正在做的事吗？

《赛博朋克2077》不是一个好游戏应该有的样子。它是一个关于“本可以更好”的永恒案例。但正因为如此，它也恰恰是关于失败、关于妥协、关于在有限时间内寻找意义的最好寓言。

夜之城是一座破碎的城市。而它值得我们记住，恰恰不是因为它的光鲜亮丽，而是因为它的伤痕累累。

My background with cyberpunk 2077:
I have played through the game 3 times now, starting since update 1.5, and most recently after 2.2. I am experienced with shooters and would recommend those who are play on the "very hard" difficulty. My first playthrough was a body/tech shotgun build (4.5/5, slightly overpowered), my 2nd was primarilly a combat netrunner (3.5/5, DEFINITELY overpowered), and my 3rd was a cool/reflexes glass canon with throwing knives and stealth (5/5, very challenging but rewarding). To say I was obsessed with this game for a while is an understatement.
The TL;DR here is I strongly recommend CP2077, and would give it my highest recommendation to mostly anyone.

The Good:
combat - excellent. different enemies fight differently, and the variety is refreshing. Vehicle combat feels good too, although vehicle durability leaves something to be desired.
weapons - ALL weapons feel relatively good. ARs and smart weapons feel moderately underpowered. Shotguns and late-game quickhacks can feel overpowered. Most any weapon you pick up will be servicable. I strongly recommend you do not settile into the same 3.
open world - EXTREMELY IMMERSIVE, due mostly to a COMPLETE LACK OF LOADING SCREENS (exceptions; initial load-in, fast travel, and metro system). Vibrant and detailed world with a vast intricate map, distinct districts with their own style, gangs, aesthetic, etc. Sometimes assets are reused but this is infrequent enough that it does not ruin immersion. Night City feels like the main character of the game. Very easy to fall in love with the place.
Animation - NPC mannerisms in dialogue are quite lifelike, or at least not bethesda-stiff. At no point did I feel like gestures or speech were wooden or inhuman.
Perk/build system - With update 2.0, perks were completely reworked so that some abilities now synergise well with others, leading to a "build" system. A well-thought-out build inspires confidence through competence.
Music - Gangs have themes, corps have themes, characters have themes. They're all fire, and react dynamically to combat. The music that was made for the game that plays on the radio stations is also great. Please note that if you disable copyrighted music, some stations (Impulse and Royal Blue for sure) will be silent during times when copyrighted music would play.

The Neutral:
lack of NG+ - frustrating for a seasoned player wanting to return to play more, but I understand this would likely be difficult to balance
heavy subject matter - this is a mature game, and some quests can be rather dark at times (themes of rape, human trafficking, suicide, etc).
Attribute point re-specc-ing is limited to one time per playthrough. Plan accordingly.
Stealth - Fair and balanced IF you take the "gag order" perk. I'd call this perk necessary, even if you aren't maining a stealth playthrough.

Nitpicks/ The Bad (VERY minor spoilers for act 1):
Information overload at the start - CP2077 has SO MUCH TO DO, that to get the player properly acclimated, they are bombarded with information at the start of the game. This pushes the player to just tune out and ignore phone calls. Some unskippable calls at the start, notably Regina and Mr. Hands calling you, feel out of place and rushed.
lack of utility in player homes - There are multiple player homes throughout the city, of differing levels of luxury. These function as closets, storage lockers, and places for romantic partners to hang out through repeatable mini-missions. Although immersive, the storage locker can be accessed from any owned vehicle, and clothing/outfits can be customized directly while at a clothing vendor.
Waypoint auto-update - when receiving a new quest through proximity, phone call, etc., it is automatically marked as active. This can be frustrating if you pick a quest and are interrupted by an occurance that updates the waypoint you selected.
Rarely, the writing - I'm not forgiving "amazeballs". Some NPCs function more as a utility, rather than a person, even though the writing starts off making you believe that you have a pre-existing relationship with these people (see Wilson, Coach Fred, Mama Welles, Padre if you do streetkid start, etc).

my recommendations to maximize your enjoyment and immersion:
Turn off subtitles, you miss so much happening in the world if you spend all of your time reading.
Turn off enemy markers, they make the game feel too easy and arcade-y. Learn to recognize enemies from their style and behavior. You can always scan an enemy to confirm their identity.
The max level being 60 lets you can get 3 attribute points to max level, so specialize, don't generalize. I recommend reading through the perk trees, especially the highest level perks, to see what sounds appealing, and heavily invest your attribute points into those attributes. A jack-of-all-trades approach will leave your character feeling mediocre at everything.
turn off hud elements to mark chests, etc (2nd+ playthrough only)
Disassemble weapons once you start collecting ones that are tier 4 & 5 instead of selling them. You'll need the components for upgrades to your weapons/cyberware more than the money.
