Öncelikle ben bu oyunu 2020’de ön sipariş olarak aldım ancak o zamanlar sistemimin yetersizliğinden dolayı oynayamadım. Bu sene sistemi yeniledikten sonra oynayabildim. Evet, tam 6 yıl sürdü.

Çevre ile başlamak istiyorum anlatmaya. Şehrin yapısı, görüntüsü ve şehirde bulunan atmosferden bahsedeceğim. Cyberpunk 2077 için cidden mükemmel bir dünya yaratmışlar. Her yerde bir şey oluyor ve şehrin canlı olduğunu size çok iyi bir şekilde yansıtıyorlar. Örnek vermek gerekirse; polislerle kapışan çeteler, yaralanmış bir NC vatandaşını kurtarmaya gelen sağlık ekipleri, olay yeri inceleme ekipleri, çetelerin kendi içerisinde takılma alanları, restoranlarda, kafelerde ve büfelerde yemek yiyip içen insanların varlığı ve bunun gibi saymakla bitiremeyeceğim bir sürü unsur var. Kısacası yoğun, kalabalık ve yaşayan bir şehir atmosferini mükemmel derecede vermişler. Arabaya atlayıp saatlerce şehrin sokaklarında gezilebilecek bir oyun yapmışlar, tebrik ederim bu konuda.

Oynanış tarafında çoğunlukla aklınızdakini yapmanıza izin veriyor oyun. Oynanış olarak bir derinliği var, bölüm tasarımları da aynı şekilde buna elverişli bir şekilde tasarlanmış. Sadece ana hikâye değil, en basit yan görev veya içerik bile buna göre hazırlanmış. O konuda bir sıkıntı yok ancak oyunda bir süreden sonra inanılmaz güçlü oluyorsunuz. Oyun bir anda kedi-fare oyununa dönüyor; bir zorluk veya mücadele hissi kalmıyor. Bunun biraz daha dengeli dağıtılmasını isterdim. Kaldı ki 2.0 ile gelen düzenlemelerde karakterimiz nerflenmiş olmasına rağmen hâlâ çok güçlü.

Yan hikâyeler dışında kalan yan içerikler ise maalesef biraz sığ. Oyundaki onlarca NCPD tarayıcı görevi, sanki bir Ubisoft oyunu oynuyormuşum gibi outpost temizliyormuş hissi veriyor. Ama işbitiricilerin verdiği kısa süreli işler daha derinlemesine ve içerik olarak daha dolu görevler sunuyor. Oyun biraz kendi açığını orada kapatıyor. Özellikle kısa süreli işlerde, görevlerin sonuna geldiğinizde sizi biraz daha zorlayıcı objective’lerle karşılaştırıp farklı yaklaşımlarda bulunmanıza olanak sağlayan görev yapıları verilmiş. O konuda bayağı emek harcanmış.

Başta belirttiğim gibi karakteriniz için bir sürü farklı oynanış şekli var. Oyunu tamamen gizlilik odaklı, çatışma odaklı, yakın dövüşçü veya hacker olarak oynayabilirsiniz. Yaptığınız build’e göre alacağınız özel pasifli silahlarla beraber oynanışı çok farklı yerlere çekebilmek mümkün.

Boss savaşları için maalesef pek iyi şeyler diyemeyeceğim, özellikle de ana oyunda. Çünkü bir zorlukları veya etkileyicilikleri yok. Son boss hariç, onda da oyun biraz hileye başvurmuş ama spoiler olabileceği için anlatmayacağım. Aklımda kalan bir tane bile unutulmaz boss savaşı olmadı oyunda. O konuda aşırı zayıf kalmışlar maalesef. İnsan böyle bir evrende ciddi anlamda havalı boss savaşları bekliyor ama maalesef zayıf. Şimdi bunu yazarken aklıma bir tane geldi; DLC başlangıcındaki sinematik boss savaşı. Ama dediğim gibi, çok akılda kalıcı bir boss’u yok bu oyunun.

Araba mekaniklerini ayrı ele alacağım çünkü kafam girsim bu mekaniklere. Oyunda adam akıllı kullanabileceğiniz bir tane araba var, o da oyunun en pahalı aracı. Diğerleri sanki sürekli araçların arkası kayacak şekilde yapılmış. Motorlar biraz daha kabul edilebilir ve kullanışlı ama arabalar için aynısı geçerli değil. Bir de o kadar uçan araç var, bir kereye mahsus bile kullandırmadılar. İnsan bari tek bir bölümlüğüne koyar.

Hikâye kısmında zamanında “Yaptığımız seçimlerin çok büyük etkileri yok.” diye yorumlar okumuştum. Oyunu bitirdikten sonra şunu diyorum: Bu yorumu yapan insanlar gerçekten gerizekâlı. Hem ana hikâyede hem yan hikâyelerde yaptığınız seçimler ciddi anlamda fark yaratıyor. Yaptığınız seçimler; sonradan göreceğiniz, konuşacağınız kişilerin diyaloglarını ve hatta oyundaki varlıklarını bile değiştiriyor. Oyunu farklı şekillerde bitirmenin bir sürü yolu var. Ben bilmem kaç kez “Acaba bunu deseydim ne olurdu?” diyerek kayıt geri aldım ve her seferinde gerçekten farklı yollara çıktığını gördüm. Hem bulunduğum görevde hem de sonradan karşıma çıkan yan görevlerde farklı gidiş yolları veya engeller olarak karşıma çıktı. Bu konuda kesinlikle övgüyü hak ediyor oyun ve o saçma yorumlara sakın aldanmayın. Biraz merakınız varsa benim gibi deneyerek oynarsanız bayağı ilgi çekici oluyor.

Karakterimiz V’den de biraz bahsedecek olursak; şahsen V’yi 3 farklı kişilikte oynayabiliyorsunuz diye düşünüyorum. Benim yakaladığım kadarıyla; biri daha agresif ve ergence tavırlara sahip bir V, diğeri daha mantıklı yaklaşabilen bir V, sonuncusu ise daha soğuk, kimseyi umursamayan ve sadece parasına bakıp yoluna devam eden bir V. Tabii bu da  sizin oyunu nasıl oynamak isterseniz ona göre ilerleyebilirsiniz

Ana hikâyeye rush atarsanız çok uzun bir oyun değil, hatta bayağı kısa aslında. Ama inanın, böyle bir oyunda ana hikâyeye rush atmak istemezsiniz. Gerçekten çok farklı yan hikâyeler ve içerikler var, yapmanızı tavsiye ederim. Hem oyunun dünyasıyla ilgili bir sürü şey öğreniyorsunuz hem de bayağı ilgi çekici oluyor.

Grafikler taş gibi, ne diyeyim yani. 6 yıllık oyun ama şu anda bile çoğu oyundan daha iyi gözüküyor. Bu arada hayatımda gördüğüm en iyi yüz modelleri bu oyunda olabilir. Karakterlerin alnındaki kırışıklıklara kadar işlemiş adamlar. Görsel anlamda müthiş iş çıkarmışlar.

Kısaca toparlamak gerekirse; oyun güzel. Hikâyesine genel bir tablodan bakarsan aşırı mükemmel değil ama sürüklüyor ve merak ettiriyor insanı. Çevre muazzam, canlı ve yaşayan bir şehir algısı yaratılmış, bayağı başarılı. Grafikler taş gibi. Oynanış farklı tarzlara göre güzel dizaynlanmış. Araç mekanikleri ise zort. Yapay zekâ tarafında çatışmadaki NPC’ler fena değil; sizi sıkıştırmaya veya olduğunuz yerden çıkarmaya yönelik bir sürü farklı yol deneyebiliyorlar. Ama aynısını yolda yürüyen NPC’ler için diyemem. GTA 3’ten hallice yapay zekâları var. Araba yanlarından geçince kendilerini arabanın önüne atıyorlar. Kaç kere bu yüzden polis peşime takıldı.

Oyun hâlâ bug’lı arkadaşlar, ona göre alın. İlk zamanlarındaki gibi oyunu kıran bug’larla karşılaşmadım ama bir sürü farklı tarzda bug gördüm. Havada duran düşmanlar, yerin içine giren NPC’ler veya durduğunuz yerde patlayan araçlar gibi örnekler var. Ama oyunu ciddi anlamda kıran hiçbir durumla karşılaşmadım.

Evet, aklıma bu kadar geldi. Benden 8.25/10 aldı. Kötü asla değil ama can sıkıcı bazı unsurları da yok değil. Biraz daha traşlanmış bir oyun olsaydı kesinlikle daha yüksek verirdim, orası kesin.

I've been gameing for more than 30 years. And this game surely takes place in the list of the best I've ever played. Verty fruitful and exciting. Passed it 2 times, 40-50 hours of juice. Let me introduce prod/cons as I see them:
+ The plot, arcs, characters, dialogues, several intros and several endings, the style. Maybe times this game made me laugh and several cry. When I say "characters", I also mean their model, animations, voicing and so on. Including the character that you play for. The style of everything in the game is a 100% hit. Including advs, signboards and so on, my respect to the designers and story authors.
+ Action. There is a lot of action. Yes, this is real 3-D action game, where you can set the difficult challending enough for you. Shooting, fighting, moving, all the stuff. Driving from the first-player-view is also implemented quite well.
+ Mechanics. There are several ways to evolve and become more dangerous. I played 2 times and 2 totally different combat experience. And I know at least 2 more ways. The cyber-related options and mechanics are implemented in an interesting and well-played ways (on of my game completions done with cybernetics maxed).
+ The level/map. Yes, the city and its outskirts are rather huge, their design, road net, fast travel map - all looks and works quite fine. There are main story lines, additional story lines, separate missions and additional engagement, enough things to take care about.
+ Graphics. I'm not the most demanding player but I'd call this nice. Rather huge map with seamless traveling across by foot/car or fast-travel with short loading. City views, well-looking models during dialogs and so on.
+ UI/UX. Interface is good. I did just a pair of key remappings but the whole interface worked well for me, maybe some minor improvements could be done but really not that important.
- There are still some bugs. Non of them prevented me from progressing stories neither crashed the game so they are quite minor. Mostly related to some transport.
I heard the the amount of bugs was greater in the beginning. But now it is quite low.
So it definitely worths the price!

폴란드 정부까지 나서서 중재하면서 공약했던 개발 로드맵은 개나줘버리고 결국 미완의 병신게임으로 남았음.
출시 전, 출시 직후 광고하던 수준의 반의 반도 안되는 반푼이 게임이지만 ㅈㄴ 웃기게도 적극적인 할인 정책에 의한 가심비 상승, 게임이 아닌 애니메이션으로 인한 엄청한 홍보 효과 및 이미지 개선, 유비소프트의 개병신짓으로 인한 오픈월드 게임들의 하향 평준화 등등 우주의 기운이 CDPR을 도우며 온갖 사건들이 간접 호재로 작용하여 수작이 된 케이스.

결국 온갖 건물들은 그냥 모형이고 무기는 밸런스 좆박아서 쓰는 무기만 쓰게되고 임플란트 사이버웨어도 몰개성해서 게임 플레이의 다각화에는 실패함. 결국 그래픽 좋은 미래 GTA 정도... 압긍은 할인+모드질 덕택에 올려쳐진 결과고 나 같이 풀프라이스에 구매해서 바닐라로 플레이하는 유저에게는 8년전에 나온 어크 오디세이나 이 게임이나 큰 차이는 없는 수준의 게임인듯.

그리고 뭐라고 해도 칭찬이 힘든게 CDPR 이 씨발년들은 모든 게임을 애시당초 제대로 완성해서 출시할 생각조차 없음. 
좆같이 만들어서 일단 출시하면 개돼지들이 사서 좋다고 MOD로 추가 개발까지 해서 잘 만든 게임이라고 억빠를 존나 해주니까 싸펑도 결국 대놓고 미완의 쓰레기로 출시했음. 진짜 회사 부도 직전까지 여기저기서 압박 들어오니 어쩔수없이 보수하는 척 1,2년 시간 끌다가 결국 약속의 반도 안지키고 추가 개발 중지한 게임이라서 이후 게임도 이딴 좆같은 장난질을 할게 뻔함. 불따로 응원하도록 하자.

그리고 이 씨발년들이 만든 게임보다는 광고에 돈을 쓰는게 흥행에 도움이 된다는 공식 때문에 온갖 초거대 예산의 괴작들이 탄생한거임. 콘코드, 포스포큰같은 게임들이 게임 개발에는 꼴랑 예산의 60% 미만을 쓰고 광고에 40%이상 쓴 건 조금이라도 이 업계에 관심있는 사람들은 아는 사실임. CDPR 이 씨발련들은 성공하면 안되는 부류의 쓰레기임.

하지만 결론적으로 추천하냐고 물어본다면 오픈월드 좋아하는 사람들에게 이 정도 게임을 찾기가 힘듦. 
어느 순간부터 오픈월드 게임이 돈이 된다고 판단한 대기업들이 우후죽순 게임을 뽑아내면서 정말 말로 표현도 안되는 쓰레기 게임들이 봇물(보짓물 아님) 터지듯이 나오면서 양적 완화에 의한 질적 하락이라는 경제학 표본으로 써도 될만한 흐름이 만들어져서 요즘은 오픈월드 액션게임 자체가 한물가서 거의 안나오는 추세지만 나오는 게임들 꼬라지보면 그래도 선녀임.

TLDR: Having never played it before this, I don't have bad memories of a broken and unplayable game. Instead I was able to go in almost completely blind and enjoyed the game a lot.

The game actually surprised me quite a bit, as I was expecting a bland or shallow game (entirely due to residual internet disdain that I was exposed to), but in truth the story was great and had a lot of fun moments. The actual gameplay is really fun and more dynamic than something like Skyrim or Fallout, which are the closest games I've played to this sort of thing. Mixing fast movements with quickhacks and fun abilities makes this game really good in and out of combat. Katanas especially... those felt really fun to parry bullets with.

The driving is SO fun in this game, which is good because they love to do sidequests that involve a LOT of back and forth. Even playing on the standard difficulty I felt super overpowered for most of the game, which resulting in clearing enemy hideouts really quickly. That almost meant I spent even more time driving, which I was able to enjoy. It's especially fun when you save up enough money to get a car with tons of health and built-in machine guns, purely to cause mischief.

The game has some flaws here and there, but they're pretty minor gripes. Most of them involve slow elevators, and the fact that your character flashes you every time you change gear. Outside of that, I enjoyed the game enough that I immediately went and watched Cyberpunk Edgerunners after finishing this game, and was sad when there weren't any more quests to do. Highly recommend this if your computer has the specs to run it.

《赛博朋克2077》通关随笔

说起来惭愧，《赛博朋克2077》我其实很早就通关了，但当时打完光顾着发呆，一直没正儿八经写点东西。现在趁补评测的机会，把欠它的这笔账还上。

先说明白，我是2021年初玩的，那时候游戏已经被骂了不知道多少轮了。但我运气好，PC版没遇到太多恶性bug，除了偶尔人物T pose、车卡进地里、电话打不通之外，基本能玩。当然，那时候的版本跟现在2.31加往日之影没法比，我玩的是一个不完整但已经足够让我震撼的夜之城。

一开始进游戏，那个开场——V坐在车里跟杰克进夜之城，霓虹灯、全息广告、浓雾、雨水，配合着那个低沉的电子乐，我整个人鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。你很难想象，一个游戏能把“赛博朋克”这四个字呈现得这么彻底。贫富差距、义体泛滥、资本垄断、人性异化，所有你在这个类型里想看到的东西，夜之城全都有。我经常开着车在城里漫无目的地转悠，不去做任务，就是看风景，看那些巨大的 hologram 广告在楼宇间闪烁，看底下街道上拥挤的人潮和永远泥泞的路面。这种感觉，没有一个开放世界给过我。

剧情方面，主线其实不算长，但质量是真的高。从跟杰克干那一票大的开始，到V被银手缠上，再到最后抉择身体归宿，整个节奏紧凑得一批。强尼·银手这个角色，基努·里维斯演得真好，那个毒舌、自大、愤世嫉俗的老混蛋，一开始我真想把他从脑子里抠出去。但随着任务推进，看他的过去，看他和V慢慢从互相骂娘到互相理解，到最后我居然有点舍不得删他。那种两个灵魂挤在一个身体里，互相救赎的感觉，比很多正经讲友情的游戏都动人。

支线更是波兰蠢驴的拿手好戏。帕南那边的阿德卡多帮，我直接当成赛博朋克版荒野大镖客来玩的，那片荒漠和夜之城形成鲜明对比，帕南的性格也让人喜欢，最后跟她开车冲出地洞那一幕，爽。朱蒂的支线全程水下潜水那段，安静得不像是在2077年，有种末日前的温柔。还有克里、瑞弗、竹村的支线，每个角色都活生生的，做完任务之后偶尔还能收到他们的短信，这种细节让你觉得夜之城不是一个空壳，里面确实住着人。

玩法上，我玩的是黑客流，开局点满智力，拿着蓝色品质的接入仓就开始当上帝。隔着一堵墙让敌人互相残杀、引爆一堆设备炸死一片，那种感觉确实爽。但说实话，战斗的手感一直不是CDPR的强项，枪械打起来飘，近战打击感也一般，跟正经的动作射击游戏没法比。好在义体系统和天赋树够深，中期开始打法花样很多，就弥补了手感的不足。

当然，缺点我也得说。当年首发那会，bug是真的多，我遇到的最经典的一个：做完某个任务之后，我的V就一直半蹲着走路，怎么都恢复不了，最后只能读两个小时之前的档。还有警察系统，刷在你脸上的设定太弱智了，开车手感也像肥皂，这些都属于当初被骂得不冤的地方。另外主线后半段明显有赶工的痕迹，荒坂塔的决战虽然演出炸裂，但能感觉很多分支被砍了，结局的选择也有点突兀。

但即便如此，我还是打了80多个小时，清了大部分支线之后，选择了把身体留给强尼，自己跟奥特进黑墙的那个结局。V坐在露台上，看着夜之城的万家灯火，嘴角带着一点笑。强尼拿起吉他，低低地唱了几句。那个画面，那个氛围，我盯着屏幕好久没动。

最后说一句，现在2077已经更新到2.31，往日之影我也补了，那个资料片的质量简直是另一个层次的。但最初的感动还是来自于本体——即使它当年有很多问题，它依然在我心里留下了夜之城的样子。那不是一座完美的城市，但它是一座活着的城市。

好了，评测补完了。开个新档，再回一次夜之城。这次玩个刀剑流，砍个痛快。

Easily the best AAA game I played in the last ten years, and probably one of the best action RPG and open-world game too.

Didn't finish the main story yet, nor played the DLC, though the story and narration is solid. The choices feel interesting and impactful. 

The city really feel alive, dangerous, and overall represent well the ultra capitalist corporation-dominated dystopia its supposed to be. The universe is interesting with a lot of detail and fluff being present in the game.

Encountered very few bugs during my playthrough for now.

Playing a stealth build with some support netrunning is really fun, feel like HITMAN but with a giant open-world and plenty of interesting zone to explore different approach. For instance some areas of the cities offer a great environnement for outdoor long-range snipper shots, while other are more compact and enclosed, perfect for infiltration.
I like how the game use its setup to offer levels with verticality, and a really good amount of plausible physics, move and tools to make the most out of them.

On the negative side, the progression curve is a little weird, in particular in Very hard difficulty but not only. Basically, it's really hard at the beginning, but suddently after the 20 first levels everything feel quite easy and less challenging.
The voice acting and dialogue are quite inequal, the protagonist for instance has sometime quite unsufferable edgelord lines which does not really feel in-character or fitting the condition they are facing. They are sometimes way too phlegmatic for the stuff happening around them. Otherwise the most important NPC are way better, with strong identity, struggles, goals, development during the story and various way of dealing with what's happening. You can easily feel attached (or repulsed) to them.

Overall the tone remain quite edgy, sometimes boomer-esque, but that fit the Cyberpunk universe, which is so maximalist it becomes really goofy at some times, lightyears away from the very serious and eerie neo-noir aesthetic of Blade Runner or the first Deus Ex and its never ending socio-political schemes and conspirations. That is not a problem at all, just don't expect any profound political or metaphysical meditation from this game because it will not deliver that. Though, I think the setup (and the game !) is really good at exploring the unheimlich/unhomely aspect of cybernetics due to how common it is in the universe and the first-person perspective.

Jeder der überlegt sich dieses Spiel zu kaufen… JA VERFICKT NOCHMAL JA HOLT ES EUCH. Ich war erst skeptisch, alleine wegen dem erstmals schlechten Ruf des Games und weil ich diese Future/since fiction Setting nicht so gerne mag. Ich hab mir das Game gekauft aufgrund der detaillierten und hochlobenden Bewertungen. Außerdem wegen der OpenWorld. Ich habe die Story nun einmal durchgespielt und schon in den ersten Stunden merkt man, dass dieses Game nicht nur enorm tiefgründig ist, es spielt auch mit deinem Emotionen. Als Spieler hat man das Gefühl Teil dieser Welt zu sein. Es ist nicht einfach nur „eine Story“, es ist ein Leben, dass man dort verkörpert und man fiebert bis zum Ende mit. Und dass war’s dann noch nicht. Das Spiel ist nicht mit einem durchspielen erledigt und wird nie wieder angefasst. Im Gegenteil, man kann durch die Entscheidungen im Spiel maßgeblich die enden variieren. In der Theorie hat man hier jahrelang Spaß mit. Das Setting holt ein wirklich ab. Es ist so ein lebendiges Spiel. Klar gibt es hier und da bugs. Die gehen in dem Erlebnis aber total unter. Dieses Spiel hat mich wirklich unfassbar berührt, sehr viel mehr als ich mir beim Kauf vorstellen konnte. Da Rolle während der Story auch die ein oder andere Träne. Den Charakter kann man sich je nach Spielstil zusammenstellen und auch der Skillbaum lädt zu mehreren durchlaufen ein. Ich freue mich schon darauf das dlc zu spielen und danach die Fortsetzung, die hoffentlich ebenfalls so gut wird. Dieses Spiel ist in meinen Augen ein Meilenstein und setzt neue Maßstäbe. Viele Entwickler/Publisher sollen sich hier dran ein Beispiel nehmen. SOO schafft man ein fesselndes Epos. Ein Spiel hat mich nicht mehr so berührt seit kingdom hearts und der ersten modern warfare Reihe. KAUFEN KAUFEN KAUFEN. Vertraut mir und den anderen,: es wird euch abholen.

你是一个三流雇佣兵，当你知道你只有几周能活，时间一到你会被另一个人完全取代，你就此湮没，你心里想的是什么？
我感到恐惧，被鸠占鹊巢的恐惧，对死亡的恐惧。
我想活下去，把他妈的别人从我脑袋里踢出去，尽管这是我已经死过一回还能活下去的代价。
拜托，我只是个普通的佣兵，夜之城里扔块砖头都不知道能砸到多少我这样的佣兵。
但是我想活下去，我还没有真正看看这偌大的夜之城和城外世界，几个月时间能做的还有很多。
我从西边的油田跑到东边的恶土，赛车拉爆了所有人拳击打败了所有人；从北部的宪章山砍到南部的太平州，杀得人头滚滚杀得所有帮派看见我胆寒狗腿都发抖。找我的不管是拿不出分毫的赛博僧人还是住豪华大厦顶层的市长候选人我都一视同仁，要干的不论是调查老婆出轨还是杀穿公司工厂我都欣然接下，NCPD解决不了的组织犯罪我一一摆平，赛博精神病为非作歹我一个个找上门。流浪者家族与我建立深厚的联系，各地区话事人提起我都充满了尊敬与敬畏。
我变得强大，不再岌岌无名，但当我在楼顶露台吹着风享受蓝调伏特加，在过山车上冲向落下帷幕的夕阳时我还是感到困惑：
如果只知道破坏但建立不起新的秩序算不算恐怖活动？那前赴后继给公司添点不大不小的麻烦是不是没有意义？从五十年前到如今仍是如此，这个世道真的能被个人的意志和力量所撼动吗？
但留给我思考的时间不多了，病情愈发严重，我要活下去，无论代价是什么。
坐在楼顶作出选择的时候，我选择相信公司一回。公司没有让我失望，这个该死的芯片从我脑子里出去了，我的小命保下了。
当我傻乐地看到小电视的新闻，荒坂三郎人格转移永生时，有什么东西击穿了我。
我突然想到了混乱无序的社会治安，永无出头之日的贫民，骄奢淫逸的富人，肮脏的街道，满地的虫子，放肆的邪教，想到有理想有正义的警察瑞弗，想到摇滚音乐会嘶吼的年轻人，想到一个个夜之城的传奇像流星般划过漆黑如墨的夜空。
我的命，也许真没这么重要。
这个一流的佣兵，曾轰开了亚当重锤的脑袋，在苟延残喘的时候，竟回头认真掂量那句“无名小卒还是扬名立万”，不过他在乎的不是名声，是那足以让夜之城所有人都口口相传的事业，哪怕他只是飞蛾扑火。
只是他累了，他已经坦然接受了自己剩下的命运，他有在乎的人，他要回去守护关心他的义体医生和他的恋人。
或许在另一个时空里， 充满干劲的他会为了理想和脑子里的疯子一样——

I spent more than 208 hours in the world of Cyberpunk 2077, and during that time I managed to earn the platinum trophy as well — I think that alone says a lot about how immersive and engaging this game is. Night City is incredibly detailed, alive, and atmospheric, always offering something new to discover, whether it’s a quest, a story, or an interesting character.
The story and characters are outstanding, especially the depth of both the main storyline and the side quests. It’s rare to find a game where you genuinely care about the characters and where your choices actually feel meaningful. The progression system and the variety of builds kept the gameplay and combat fun even after hundreds of hours.
The game has improved massively since launch, and today it delivers an amazing RPG experience. The graphics, soundtrack, and overall cyberpunk atmosphere are simply incredible. For me, getting the platinum trophy never felt like a chore — it felt like completing an unforgettable journey that I enjoyed every step of the way. I can highly recommend it to anyone who loves story-driven open-world games.

This game is a solid 9.0/10 for me. I was expecting an almost Hollywood-level sugar-coated narrative you would see in generic action flicks. To my surprise, it made me really sad that V lives in a world with choices and trade-offs that come to a bitter end, simulating reality in that regard really well. The surrounding characters are also very well written and never stick out one bit in the plot at all, all their personalities resonate well with what they deal with or what they will deal with as the plot goes on. I couldn't get past completing more than two endings because I would just get grief. This game really captured what it's like living in a big city where everyone is a blip in a large population. It also captured what people always say about good stories in games that I've never seen in the usual genres i play until the point i felt empathetic with how everything transpires.

The gameplay is good, especially for an RPG. It has the most action-packed combat depth compared to the limited selection of RPGs I have played. There is some jank that isn't game-breaking, although it still requires some TLC. No, thanks to it being a rush job, I'll hedge my bets that needing to be a console release made it very hard to optimize as well. I heard from multiple people that CD Projekt Red cared enough about their product to fix it instead of shilling it to a community of fans that become both nostalgic and jaded over time because they have to fix it themselves to then make it playable like classic fallout games.

The graphics are good, nothing out of this world, especially in the case of the rendered models of the characters, they pale in comparison to the world around them. Where it does ramp it up is how the developers really captured the claustrophobic layout of cities, with buildings forming small bazaars on street levels. The buildings themselves had a lot of signs, pipes and other small details caked on them for that extra pop giving u the stimulation from city settings u would picture irl, and the detritus all around the city adds to the world-building really well. I would say it's the best modern city layout I've seen in an open world game yet, with the added flair of a futuristic cyber punk aesthetic.

2020年，大学还没毕业，当时的电脑还是暗影精灵3，当时预购拿下了2077，因为配置比较低+当时BUG满天飞，就先搁置了，当时的想法是毕业后配了台式机了再来爽玩！22年，新电脑加上经过几次大更新后口碑回暖，通关了本体主线剧情，完成了上太空当大佬的那个结局，心里并没有什么波澜，只记得拿着一把太刀从头砍到尾，除了帕南之外也没有印象太深的角色（但女v还没法和她谈恋爱），对2077也单纯只是觉得特别酷，大受好评的往日之影出了之后第一时间买了，但也一直没玩
26年，一次偶然的出差，刷到了边缘行者最经典的音乐，尽管在那之前就已经听过了，lucy那张经典月球回眸的图也一直是我的电脑壁纸，但是却一直没看过原作，基本一路加速，一次飞行的时间就全部看完了，对于结局只是有点懵逼，为什么David后期要疯狂的改造自己的义体，适时收手和lucy去月球不是更好吗🤔当然也有一些其他的，为别人而活/你的生命比我的更加重要/以为自己是特别的普通人终究无法撼动公司一丝一毫等等，算是真的有了解到赛博朋克这个世界观想表达的东西。
带着这些想法，我又回到了夜之城，启动了往日之影，流程不算长，印象特别深刻的反而是汉森的委托，每个委托都给了V很多选择和决策权，包括在主线中也一样，选择会直接影响到NPC的命运，这种超高自由度的RPG+高质量开放世界真的让我欲罢不能，高强度熬夜通关了，甚至清了地图上所有NCPD委托。结局选择了送百灵鸟上月球，单纯觉得李德愚忠，主线给我的印象完全比不上那些优秀的支线。整个DLC印象最深的点反而是在宝石青参加派对的时候，整个会场走了好几圈，和各种各样的NPC对话，以及那些有趣的支线，还有刚烈乐队超洗脑的用户友好性...切换各个电台清NCPD委托都觉得特别有意思

es de esos juegos que te dejan pensando incluso después de apagar el PC o la consola. La primera vez que entré a Night City sentí que estaba entrando a un mundo vivo de verdad: luces por todos lados, anuncios gigantes, música sonando en cada esquina y una sensación constante de que algo malo puede pasar en cualquier momento. La ciudad es impresionante, pero también se siente vacía y triste a ratos, como si todo el mundo estuviera sobreviviendo más que viviendo.

La historia fue lo que más me atrapó. V no se siente como el típico protagonista perfecto; es alguien intentando encontrar su lugar en un mundo donde las corporaciones controlan todo y la vida humana vale muy poco. Y luego está Johnny Silverhand, que honestamente pensé que iba a ser un personaje molesto, pero terminó siendo de lo mejor del juego. La relación entre él y V cambia muchísimo durante la historia y hace que muchas decisiones pesen de verdad.

Algo que me gustó mucho es que el juego te deja jugar a tu manera. Puedes ir como hacker, sigiloso, tanque, usar cuchillas, armas pesadas… y cada estilo cambia bastante cómo se sienten las misiones. Hay momentos donde te sientes imparable y otros donde el juego te recuerda que Night City puede destruirte en segundos.

No todo es perfecto. Aunque hoy está muchísimo mejor que en su lanzamiento, todavía tiene algunos bugs raros o NPCs que actúan extraño. También hay sistemas que parecían prometer más profundidad, como la policía o algunas actividades del mundo abierto. Pero sinceramente, después de varias horas, terminé perdonándole muchas cosas porque la atmósfera, los personajes y la historia compensan bastante.

Y algo que creo que el juego hace increíble es el sentimiento de soledad. Aunque siempre estás rodeado de gente, carros y ruido, muchas veces Night City se siente fría, como si nadie realmente pudiera tener un final feliz ahí. Pocos juegos logran transmitir eso tan bien.

[h1]Кажется, будто я видел все жизненные циклы этой игры...[/h1]

...И это правда.

Я прохожу [b]Cyberpunk 2077[/b] уже в третий раз. Первый раз был на PS4 почти сразу после релиза, второй — уже на PS5, и вот третий, наконец-то, на ПК.

Каждый раз мой опыт кардинально отличался: начиная от работоспособности игры и её визуала, заканчивая различными геймплейными особенностями, построением билдов, отыгрышем и выбором концовок как в основном сюжете, так и в сайдах.

Опыт на PS4 был весьма удручающим. На PS5 я уже по полной получил кайф от игры. А на ПК смог реализовать свою давнюю мечту: поиграть на ультрах, с трассировкой лучей, в стабильном FPS и, так сказать, по полной впитать в себя красоты Найт-Сити.

Но знаете, что объединяет все эти три прохождения на разных платформах?

[b]Удовольствие от самой игры.[/b]

Все три раза я испытывал невероятный кайф от достаточно уникального и интересного сюжета, вариативного геймплея, отличного отыгрыша и заметных последствий от выборов. Каждое прохождение отличалось. С годами игра становилась лучше, но её ядро всегда было неизменно хорошим. А с выходом DLC, про которое я расскажу в отдельном обзоре, это ядро стало ещё сильнее, красивее и целостнее.

[h1]Коротко о главном[/h1]

Тема киберпанка и жизненный цикл этой игры уже обсосаны в сотнях обзоров, и здесь вряд ли получится быть каким-то оригинальным или рассказать что-то, о чём вы ещё не знаете.

Поэтому я буду краток:

[b]Cyberpunk 2077 — это невероятно поучительная история.[/b] Сюжетно концентрированная, насыщенная и вобравшая в себя все соки нарративного великолепия — как в рамках основной истории, так и в огромном количестве мини-историй и сайд-квестов.

Это настоящая песочница в плане геймплея: построения билдов, подбора оружия, одежды, имплантов и стиля прохождения. Заказы, запросы и случайные события дают чувство прогрессии, ощущение собственного пути, вариативности и отыгрыша наёмника.

[b]Cyberpunk 2077 — это уже классика.[/b] Это атмосфера. Это стиль.

И в 2026 году я настоятельно рекомендую ознакомиться с этой игрой. Она бывает практически на всех распродажах и часто стоит в районе 10 долларов, что является отличной сделкой.

Любой фиксер вам это скажет: взамен вы получаете десятки, а то и сотни часов хорошей игры, которую наконец-то починили, залатали и довели до того состояния, которого она заслуживала с самого начала.

I can’t put into words how good this game is. It is not perfect, the start was VERY rough, but in 2026, it is one of if not the best game you can play. Depends on what you like.

-RPG elements : Not the most fleshed out, after all you are playing as your V and not a completely made-up character. Still, they’re very, very good. Also it‘s important to mention that this decision opened many great possibilities in the game development that otherwise wouldn’t be possible.

-Combat : I would say a benchmark. The way you can customize your fighting style to what you want to do is ridiculous. Everyone can find their style.

-Visuals, graphics : THE benchmark. Demanding, of course, but in 2026, doable. And stunning. The game is extremely beautiful.

-The story, worldbuilding : This is the best part of the game by a longshot, and that’s saying something. The game treats you like a fucking adult for once, and you go through so many difficult, nail-biting, decisions that genuinely make you question who you are as a person. Not only is it very entertaining and downright inspirational, but very believable as well. You genuinely feel like a part of the story that is happening, somewhere, not so far away. 

Overall, i have not played a better game in my life. And honestly? I’m pretty sure that if CDPR doesn’t knock it out the park with the Witcher 4 or project Orion, i’ll never will :)

Играл спустя 5 лет после выхода на указанном ПК. Если выбирать время для этой игры, то как раз сейчас, ибо количество багов оставляет желать лучшего, даже в нынешнем патче очень часты баги которые руинят геймплей(чаще всего застревал в текстурах и приходилось перезаходить). Тем не менее игра сделана на высшем уровне:
-Геймплей(9/10) кнш не для всех, но выбор стиля игры в рпг всегда приятен, тем-более когда он настолько вариативен.
-Открытый мир(7/10) объективно опен ворлд однотипный, куча одинаковых нарисованных злых человечков которых если убить то можно облутать. Как всегда в играх от сд проджект радуют доп активности, заказы закрываются быстро и с хорошим билдом не сильно сложно. Доп. задания очень интересные, имеют свою хорошую, проработанную ветку, часто с разными концовками.
-Сюжет(6/10) вообще в таких играх сюжет не особо важен, но все таки немного про него скажу. Типичный, без остросюжетности, нужен только ради понятия мотивации главного героя, радует опять же вариативность концовок.
-Графон(?/10) у игр после 2020 графон сравнялся, хз как его можно оценивать

And that's a big deal too because this game makes you spend so much time on the story. Many hours of dialogue options that mostly lead to the same outcomes anyway and cutscenes and walking with super slow NPCs or being a passenger in their car. 

I do actually have fun with the gameplay when the game lets me play. But everything to do with this story, V's motivations or personality and my inability to make any real decisions in the story made me so bored. I finished the main storyline and wasn't a fan of any part of it.

I know a lot of people love this game, but this game kind of blows and every aspect is really subpar.  Some individual things:
1. All the characters are pretty edgy and I didn't super like any of them except River
2. The entire open world is fairly pointless as the main quest line is fairly short and only brought me to a few places
3. The entire car and driving aspect is fairly pointless as there are no quests where I needed a great car, and I mostly just fast traveled around using the fast travel points.
4. I played on the hardest difficulty and most of the game was extremely easy.  Rarely upgraded my enhancements or added mods to my guns.  Just one-tapped enemies with takedowns or snipers.  Takedowns are completely overpowered and allowed me to insta-kill any enemy if I was behind them undetected, even crazy jacked up brutes.
5. Final boss hard counters stealth and long range builds, required re-watching a cutscene every time I died, and was so difficult that my choices were to either load a save before I started the final mission and do a lot of build tuning + spending >60 minutes replaying the final mission, or lower the difficulty.  I chose the latter.
6. Cutscenes involving cars are pretty bad.  Vehicles move in very unrealistic ways.  People in a car don't even bob their head as the car moves.  Really unpolished.
7. The AI is bad.  Like, ridiculously bad.  Super super simple.  So bad that in the final mission, when there are a ton of reinforcements coming, a good number of them just sat there beyond the final wall and just stood there as I slowly peeked and one shot each of them with a sniper.
8. Cyber enhancements are largely minor and don't really make a lot of difference for the build I did, as the AI is super bad.
9. The game almost feels like Borderlands with its tiered guns, bright colors for component loot, and damage pop-ups.
10. Story is whatever.  Lots and lots and lots and lots of waiting for characters to talk and to walk.  Holy moly so much waiting.

I'm sure there's more that I'm missing, but I'm tired of playing this game and tired of writing this review.  Overall, everything that's done in this game was just done better in other games.  GTA has a far better open world.  Deus Ex has far better gameplay and story.  Borderlands has far better loot.  Almost any game out there has better AI.  It's just really annoying to be playing such a mindlessly easy game, filled with waiting sections, and then get to a final mission (that's actually super quick if you ignore side content) that is again super easy but then get to a final boss that is ridiculously hard.  At no point in the game did I feel that I had experienced something new, something innovative, something polished, or something meaningful.  It's an arcade style game that tries hard to be taken seriously, but lacks the depth to do so.  Truly the definition of a game that is as wide as the ocean but as deep as a puddle.

=== Resumen ===
✔️Aunque no lo parezca, el juego actualmente cuenta con una buena optimización, y con varias configuraciones que ayudan a que el juego pueda correr de una manera mas que decente.
✔️Una historia muy interesante y aunque tiene sus puntos bajos, tambien es una historia bien entretenida (osea como no va a ser interesante una trama donde tu y el fantasma de keanu reeves tienen que convivir?)

✔️La música, la ambientación y todo el mundo esta excelentemente logrado, literalmente te sientes como en la película Akira.
✔️Si bien no sucede con todos los personajes, los que si logran tener sus mejores momentos en pantalla hacen que les tomes cariño y quieras saber mas de ellos, en especial los mas cercanos a el/la protagonista.
✔️La personalización es mas que decente y las tiendas de ropa, armas, etc son bastas y seguro encuentras tu estilo, ya que el juego te permite jugar de la manera que tu quieras el 90% de las veces, (por ejemplo hacer las misiones en modo sigilo o entrar haciendo una mat4nza).
✔️Hay como 10 tipos de escopetas
✔️El lore del mundo es muy interesante y te invita a leer mas de él e indagar dentro de este

❌Al ser un juego tan grande, el hecho de que el nivel limite sea el 50 (sin el dlc) y 60 (con el dlc), osea apenas te alcanza para el llenar una o dos ramas del árbol de habilidades pero al haber tantas habilidades interesantes es un disparo a los pies que solo te dejen seleccionar algunas limitandote con el nivel de tu personaje. Hay potencial pero el propio juego se para solito.

❌El juego tiene muchísimo diálogo, y eso puede espantar a varios. Hay misiones donde solo te la pasas escuchando sin pegar ni un tiro, lo cual se siente pesado al principio, especialmente si esperas algo tipo GTA con acción constante. ❌Si bien no se compara a como salió el juego, sigue teniendo sus bugs, muy pocos pero es casi seguro que te encuentras con alguna textura mal cargada o de plano alguna textura que no carga, no molesta a la partida ni te la jode pero siguen ahí xd.

❌Para ser un juego tan grande, el numero de misiones principales que tiene es muy poco, con solo 33, para comparar, watch dogs 1 tiene 43, y gta 5 69, y si lo comparo con red dead redemption ni te digo, pese a que haya bastantes misiones secundarias, encargos y otras cosas interesantes que hacer, ese sentimiento de que la historia principal se termino muy rápido es presente.

Si alguna vez has querido sentirte como un mercenario futurista con más implantes que sentido común, Cyberpunk 2077 es tu sitio.

Llegas a Night City pensando que vas a ser el rey del barrio… y a las dos horas ya te han timado, disparado y metido en problemas existenciales. Básicamente, vida normal pero con neones.

Pero hablemos claro: este juego cuando salió estaba más roto que mi horario de sueño. Bugs, caídas, NPCs haciendo parkour en el aire… un espectáculo. Era prácticamente injugable.
Peeero… el glow up que ha tenido es de locos. A día de hoy es una auténtica joya. De esos juegos que dices: “vale, ahora sí”.

El juego tiene de todo:

Misiones que empiezan como “ve a hablar con este tipo” y acaba explotando todo.
Personajes que parecen más reales que tus propios amigos.
y un combate que es un caos maravilloso: puedes ir en plan sigiloso… o entrar como un loco pegando tiros y hackeando hasta la tostadora del enemigo. Ambas opciones acaban mal, pero de formas distintas, que es lo bonito.
¿Bugs? Sí, alguno queda… pero ahora son como ese colega raro: ya no molestan, hasta tienen su gracia.
En resumen:
Un juegazo con historia brutal, ambientación increíble y una redención digna de película.

Nota final: vienes por los disparos… te quedas por la depresión existencial futurista.

Hated this game at launch. Now I can't stop thinking about Night City.
Bought it day one in 2020, crashed every 20 minutes, refunded it, swore I'd never go back. Four years later I came back. Easily one of the best gaming decisions I've made.
Night City feels alive in a way no open world has for me. Not because it's massive but because it's dense. Every alley, rooftop, and abandoned room has something to say. Once I wandered into a random apartment with no quest marker, no objective, and found a heartbreaking story told entirely through text messages on a laptop someone left behind. No game has given me a moment like that before.
The characters are something else. V and Johnny Silverhand's dynamic has a depth I genuinely didn't expect going in. The side quests aren't filler either, some of them are more memorable than the main campaigns of other RPGs I've played.
Phantom Liberty is legitimately great. No regrets.
Honest criticism: crowd AI still feels thin. NPCs don't react dynamically enough when things go sideways around them. The city looks alive but the interactions beneath the surface are still shallow. And a lot of choices feel weighty in the moment but don't actually ripple outward into the world. For the sequel I'd love to see CDPR build something truly reactive, not just at major story beats but in the small everyday texture of living in that city. That's the version of Night City I want next.

Joué en mode nomade-infiltrateur et promenade, difficulté max.

En résumé, LES PLUS :
- le nombre de missions principales, secondaires, inattendues, à faire quand on veut en explorant.  De quoi s'occuper un looong moment.
- bonne histoire, bons persos et looks au choix, dialogues parfois marrants avec options, et différentes fins à tester.
- gameplay agréable, bien aimé les options de scan et d'action sur le matos et les ennemis.
- on peut déplacer les ennemis neutralisés (j'aime bien ranger des corps évanouis).
- sauvegardes libres sauf pendant les phases de combat, le meilleur système à mon goût.
- la possibilité de voyage rapide quand flemme de conduire à travers toute la map pour la dixième fois.
- le choix des nombreuses armes et méthodes de combat (perso, étranglement, lancer de couteau et sniping mais j'imagine que le trip katana only doit être jouissif).
- un VRAI dlc, riche en missions avec une bonne durée de vie, plus orienté baston mais pourquoi pas.
- bonne rejouabilité en testant d'autres caractéristiques et aptitudes de V.

LES MOINS :
- l'étranglement trop facile avec tous ces méchants qui me tournent le dos exprès ! Ne vaut pas les Dishonored, Splinter Cell ou MGS5 sur ce plan (d'accord, ce n'est pas l'adn de Cyberpunk).
- le piratage des bornes simplissime et similaire du début à la fin perd tout intérêt (le contraire de celle des BioShock par exemple)
- Johnny ta gueule ! Insupportable à venir bavarder tout le temps dans le jeu principal, mais heureusement plus sympa dans Phantom Liberty, voire attachant
- un ou deux passages de boss pénibles ou limite jouables (cf la poursuite en voiture avec une pétoire contre les drones en début de jeu) Au pire, oblige à baisser la difficulté.
- beaucoup trop d'armes récupérables sur les ennemis neutralisés, c'est la fête du slip mitraillette   
- le jeu fait exagérément chauffer le CPU (en plus du GPU, mais ça c'est normal)

Bilan global très positif donc ! Donne évidemment envie du numéro 2, mais 2030 c'est si loiiiiiin...

God I could write a novel on my mixed feelings on this one - approaching 6 years of 2077 here, good lorde.

Few games had me as hyped as Cyberpunk 2077. From its 2015 reveal to the delayed 2020 launch, I was completely locked in, in 2015 I basically discovered the cyberpunk genre through the world Mike Pondsmith created. It felt like the perfect middle ground between overdone fantasy and surface-level sci-fi.

This was the only game I have ever preordered. I played it at launch on PC and, despite bugs like T-posing, broken AI, and weird visual glitches, I still enjoyed my first run. A lot of the bigger issues felt fixable, and I was more excited for what the game could become. Things like deeper RPG systems, meaningful AI, gang dynamics, and customization all felt like they were coming later.

That is where the disappointment really sets in. Even now in 2026, after patches and Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty, it never became the RPG it was presented as. If you were (like me) expecting something closer to The Witcher but in a cyberpunk setting, this is not that.

And yet I have played through it six+ times.

Because what is here is still incredible. Night City is one of the most detailed and immersive worlds ever made. Just driving around, watching the skyline, and existing in that space is unmatched. It honestly feels like the scale and ambition of the world came at the cost of the systems meant to support it.

Amazing world, unforgettable vibe, but a missed RPG opportunity, and they clearly knew it from how they focused on all its positives in Phantom Liberty.

Se Cyberpunk 2077 fosse uma pessoa, ele seria aquele amigo estiloso, cheio de implante tecnológico, que fala “relaxa, tá tudo sob controle”… e 5 minutos depois você tá hackeando um prédio, com um terrorista digital na sua cabeça e questionando sua própria existência.

🌆 O mundo (Night City)
Night City é tipo:
° metade futuro tecnológico absurdo 🤖
° metade “tudo vai dar errado, e rápido” 💥

Você sai pra fazer uma missão simples…
E termina:
° implantando um braço novo 🦾
° se metendo com gangues 🔫
° repensando sua vida às 2 da manhã 🧠

👥 Os personagens
Aqui ninguém é “normal”, e isso é perfeito:
° V: você tentando não surtar no caos 😅
° Johnny Silverhand: o inquilino mais inconveniente da sua mente 🎸
° NPC aleatório: mais profundo que muito protagonista por aí 🤯

E claro, Keanu Reeves basicamente sendo seu coach existencial (ou só te zoando mesmo).

🔫 Combate (estilo acima de tudo)
Lutar em Cyberpunk é assim:
° furtivo igual um ninja 🥷
° explosivo igual um tanque 💣
° ou hackear tudo e vencer no Wi-Fi 📡

Escolha seu estilo… ou faça tudo ao mesmo tempo.
🧠 Implantes (ou “parei onde mesmo?”)
Você começa humano…
E quando vê já tá:
° com olho que escaneia tudo 👁️
° braço que vira arma 🔧
° reflexo absurdo ⚡

Resumo: upgrade atrás de upgrade.

🚔 Polícia (melhorou… mas né)
Funciona mais ou menos assim:
° fez besteira → polícia aparece 🚓
° correu um pouco → eles cansam 😴
° sumiu → “quem?” 🤨
Memória seletiva ativada.

💰 Economia do jogo
Você faz dinheiro…
Fica rico…
E gasta tudo em:
° carros futuristas 🚗
° implantes caros 🦾
° roupas estilosas demais 👕

Educação financeira foi de base 📉

🎯 Missões
Começam assim:
° “vai ali conversar” 🗣️
E terminam:
° conspiração gigante 🕵️
° decisão moral pesada ⚖️
° crise existencial gratuita 🧠

Tudo isso com alguém falando “isso não tava no plano”.

🌐 Expansão
Com Phantom Liberty, o jogo virou:
° mais sério 😎
° mais intenso 🔥
° mais “isso vai dar ruim” 😬

E você vai… mesmo assim.

🧠 Conclusão
Cyberpunk 2077 é o simulador oficial de:
° “vou jogar só 20 minutinhos” ⏱️

E horas depois você:
° tá imerso no caos 🌆
° emocionalmente abalado 😵
° sendo julgado por um rockstar imaginário 🎸

Cyberpunk 2077 ist ein sehr gutes Spiel, das zwar kein Meisterwerk darstellt, 
aber dennoch zu den herausragenden Rollenspielen der letzten Jahre zählt.

Die deutschen Sprecher liefern durchweg eine überzeugende Leistung und 
tragen maßgeblich zur Atmosphäre bei. 

Auch das Gunplay weiß zu überzeugen: Die Schusswechsel fühlen sich wuchtig und direkt an, auch wenn einige Waffendesigns geschmacklich nicht jedem zusagen dürften.

Besonders positiv fallen die meisten Quests auf. Abgesehen von den eher repetitiven NCPD-Nebenmissionen sind die Aufträge abwechslungsreich gestaltet und bieten häufig Entscheidungsmöglichkeiten, die sich spürbar auf den Verlauf und Ausgang auswirken. 

Ebenso gelungen ist das Gegnerverhalten, das sich je nach Schwierigkeitsgrad "verändert"
und so für anhaltende Motivation sorgt.

Das überarbeitete Polizeisystem funktioniert insgesamt gut, reagiert jedoch teilweise überempfindlich, da selbst kleine Vergehen schnell eskalieren. 

Auch die ikonischen Waffen wurden sinnvoll verbessert und bieten nun einen echten Anreiz, sie aktiv zu nutzen. 

Das Fahrverhalten der Fahrzeuge ist ebenfalls gelungen, 
da sich die einzelnen Wagen spürbar unterschiedlich steuern.

Ein großer Pluspunkt ist die technische Aufarbeitung seit dem Release, der ursprünglich von zahlreichen Problemen geprägt war. Die Entwickler haben hier sichtbar nachgebessert. Dennoch bleibt das Spiel nicht frei von Fehlern, was verhindert, dass es den Status eines Meisterwerks erreicht.

Zu den Schwächen zählen diverse Bugs: NPCs bewegen sich oft unnatürlich, etwa indem sie in die Fahrtrichtung des Spielers springen. Gerufene Fahrzeuge können fehlerhaft spawnen, teils aus der Luft fallen und dabei Chaos verursachen. In Zwischensequenzen kommt es gelegentlich zu Darstellungsfehlern, bei denen Figuren ineinander stehen oder Dialoge überlappen. Manche Quests hängen sich auf und erfordern einen Neustart, und vereinzelt treten Abstürze auf. Auch HDR-Probleme sorgen stellenweise für zu dunkle Bildbereiche.

Diese technischen Mängel beeinträchtigen vor allem die Immersion. In dieser Hinsicht erinnert das Spiel an ein modernes Skyrim.

Trotz dieser Kritikpunkte läuft das Spiel größtenteils stabil und flüssig, insbesondere auf hohen Einstellungen. Insgesamt bleibt Cyberpunk 2077 ein Titel, den man gespielt haben sollte.

Cyberpunk 2077 is an amazing game and easily one of the most immersive experiences I’ve played. The story, the characters, and the overall ambiance are truly unique, and it feels personal in a way most open-world games don’t even try to achieve.

The characters are also a huge highlight. They feel human, well-written, and memorable, and the relationships you build throughout the story actually matter. The game does a great job making you feel connected to what’s happening, instead of just being a random hero saving the world.

[h1]Cyberpunk 2077[/h1]

Cyberpunk 2077 to ambitna gra RPG stworzona przez CD Projekt RED, która przenosi gracza do futurystycznego Night City, tętniącej życiem metropolii przyszłości.
Po burzliwej premierze tytuł przeszedł ogromną ewolucję, stając się doświadczeniem, które dziś można śmiało stawiać obok najlepszych produkcji studia.

[h3]Fabuła[/h3]
Fabuła gry jest jedną z jej najmocniejszych elementów, podobnie jak w „Wiedźminie 3”. Gracz wciela się w V - najemnika próbującego przetrwać w bezlitosnym świecie korporacji, gangów i technologii przekraczającej granice człowieczeństwa. Historia skupia się na tajemniczym biochipie oraz relacji z Johnnym Silverhandem, co prowadzi do licznych zwrotów akcji i trudnych wyborów moralnych.

[h3]Postacie i dialogi[/h3]
CD Projekt RED ponownie udowadnia, że potrafi pisać postacie z krwi i kości. Johnny Silverhand, Panam Palmer czy Solomon Reed to bohaterowie, którzy zapadają w pamięć na długo. Dialogi są naturalne, pełne charakteru i często balansują między humorem a dramatem, co sprawia, że relacje z postaciami są niezwykle angażujące.

[h3]Rozgrywka[/h3]
Rozgrywka opiera się na trzech filarach: walce, eksploracji i wyborach fabularnych, znajoma struktura, ale w zupełnie nowym wydaniu. System walki daje dużą swobodę: od bezpośrednich starć z użyciem broni palnej, przez skradanie się, aż po hakowanie przeciwników i otoczenia. Rozwój postaci pozwala dostosować styl gry do własnych preferencji, co znacząco zwiększa szanse na kolejne ogranie tytułu.
Eksploracja Night City to czysta przyjemność, zarówno pieszo, jak i za kierownicą futurystycznych pojazdów. Każda dzielnica ma swój unikalny charakter, a świat jest wypełniony aktywnościami, które nie są jedynie „zapychaczami”, lecz często kryją ciekawe historie.

[h3]Klimat[/h3]
Night City to jeden z najbardziej dopracowanych otwartych światów w historii gier. Neonowe ulice, kontrasty między luksusem a biedą oraz wszechobecna technologia tworzą unikalny klimat cyberpunkowego dystopijnego świata. Miasto żyje, od zatłoczonych centrów po mroczne zaułki, każdy element ma swoje miejsce i znaczenie.
Pod względem audiowizualnym gra stoi na bardzo wysokim poziomie. Oświetlenie, detale otoczenia i animacje tworzą niezwykle immersyjne doświadczenie. Muzyka, łącząca elektronikę z cięższymi brzmieniami, idealnie oddaje klimat przyszłości, a dubbing polski prezentuje najwyższą jakość.

[h3]DLC[/h3]
„Widmo Wolności” to rozszerzenie, które można porównać do najlepszych dodatków „Wiedźmina 3”. Oferuje nową dzielnicę, świeże mechaniki oraz wciągającą historię, która potrafi zaskoczyć nawet doświadczonych graczy. To nie tylko dodatek, ale pełnoprawne rozszerzenie doświadczenia, które znacząco podnosi poziom całej gry.

[h1]Opinia[/h1]
Cyberpunk 2077” po latach rozwoju stał się grą, która spełnia swoje pierwotne ambicje. To rozbudowane RPG z wciągającą fabułą, świetnymi postaciami i jednym z najbardziej imponujących światów w grach. „Widmo Wolności” tylko utwierdza w przekonaniu, że CD Projekt RED potrafi tworzyć historie na najwyższym poziomie.
[b]To tytuł, który zdecydowanie warto przeżyć, zarówno dla fanów RPG, jak i dla tych, którzy szukają dojrzałej, angażującej opowieści.[/b]

我初中时第一次看到2077的宣传片就觉得哇塞这游戏真的牛逼坏了，于是我发誓等我有了电脑一定第一时间买下这个游戏狠狠玩几个通宵
我也确实做到了，拿到电脑安装完steam后第一件事就是搜索2077，加入购物车，买下，结果发现需要帮了银行卡的微信，于是我找了10000000个同学，都没有绑的，最后踏破铁鞋无觅处我的小号居然就绑了。扫码，支付149元（只有本体），2077成了我库中的第一个游戏，同时也是第一个原价买下的游戏（我感觉大概率可能是最后一个了）。
刚拿到电脑没有调配置，下载了3个小时，很难熬，但是很期待，就和我上了两周课终于放周末了一样。
刚玩的那几天我可以说是废寝忘食，每天平均6+h，推主线，做支线，没事就砍几个路人。
几次回家后我推完了主线，开始搜教程，凑成就，说实话有点枯燥，不过跳杯的时候很有成就感。自己学怎么加mod，怎么不作弊用bug卡各种东西，感觉真的很爽。
网上有很多关于2077的评价：自由度比不上gta，剧情比不过大表哥。对于一个（自认为）资深的2077玩家，我可以告诉你：是真的。这本质上可以说是一个加入了牛排蔬菜鱼虾米饭面条馒头猪肉鸡肉的罐头，很精致，很好吃，但本质还是罐头。但是挡不住我喜欢。
读到这可以看出来我不是因为2077好玩才写的，这款游戏对于我来说就像超市里面的健达奇趣蛋，别人和你说这个不好吃，太贵了不值当，但是我就是想吃，我馋了将近三年，现在就算你和我说里面装的是狗大便我也高低尝尝咸淡。
但是不可否置这款游戏很好玩，完整的世界观，各种小支线里面人物的对话，很酷的武器，多结局的主线。现在130左右就可以拿下本体加dlc，体验到椰汁城第一破烂王v的故事，非常值当。
借用我初中看到宣传片上面的一句话
"You wanna be a nobody, or you wanna be a legend?"
"We all make choices, but in the end, our choices make us."

Основная концовка ( Мир ):
"Тихая жизнь или смерть в лучах славы, м?" Нам показывают то, что нет ничего важнее своего мнения, своих принципов. Ты можешь жить всю жизнь шестерней под крылом у пиджака, но будешь ли это ты? Ханако Арасака. Еще один пример из нашей жизни. Когда в наших глазах есть огонек надежды, то за него обязательно зацепиться какой-то недоброжелательный человек и потушит его. Во времена будущего, а также, уже, в наше время, очень сложно кому-либо доверять, приходится делать это на свой страх и риск. Нет гарантии вечной дружбы. Проблема будущего >/<

Исследования врачей. Имели ли они какой-то смысл? Нет. Нам показывают ежедневную рутину, то что мы делаем каждый день, но это не приносит ни радости, ни пользы. Нам показывают то, что Ви не может выбраться, описывая наши духовные страдания физическими действиями ( Ви далеко от дома. Один. Он не может никуда уйти. Его жизнь заключается лишь в ежедневных бесполезных исследований врача )


Вернуться в свое тело без Джонни ( Солнце ):

"Выжить, но ради чего?" В этой концовке важно подцепить важную деталь, что было описано в предыдущем абзаце. Дружба. Всем желаю найти себе такого же друга, как Бестия. Джонни знал что мог на нее положиться. И он положился. И она готова была отдать свою жизнь ради, по факту, для нее бессмысленного дела. И все же, Ви выживает, но обретает ли он счастье? У него появилось кучу денег, он стал легендой города. И также ему остается жить всего лишь полгода и как мы видим в конце, он так же, как и в первой концовке, остается в кругу. Да, этот круг огромный, над ним нет власти, он сам себе хозяин, но разве это меняет дело?


Уступить тело Джонни ( Умеренность ):

В этой концовке мы уступаем тело Джонни. Ви проглатывает Альт. Джонни остается на улицах, но уже не Найт-Сити. Есть ли смысл продолжать ему жить дальше? Ему теперь незачем спешить, но сможет ли он забыть своих погибших друзей или это проклятье останется с ним до конца дней? Эта концовка является незавершенной и единственное что можно сделать, это гадать о том, что будет с Джонни в теле Ви дальше -.-


Подводя итог, хочу сказать, что несмотря на некоторые баги, ужасно однотипные заказы фиксеров и заявки на расследование сюжет получился крутой. То есть можно разделить киберпанк на версию "Чисто сюжет" и "Фулл зачистка" . Сюжет правда получился хорошим, что-то родное, что-то что дает задуматься о будущем, о настоящем, о том кто нас окружает и кто мы сами есть. Может не каждый это осознает, но у каждого из нас есть этот "Джонни", с которым мы спорим каждый раз, просыпаясь с утра, делая свою рутину, учась, работая, засыпая. Спасибо киберпанку за недельку моего времени, возможно когда-нибудь мы снова увидимся... Но а пока что, пока, Найт-Сити!

Другими словами, возникает ощущение, что игра сделана для игроков, от игроков — это сразу выделяется, и в ней приятно провести время. Сама по себе игра несложная: никогда и нигде не ставят настоящее испытание, но при этом предоставляют множество различных способов решения возникших ситуаций.
На фоне всего контента основная сюжетная линия, на мой взгляд, относительно короткая, однако здесь полно второстепенных заданий, наполненных продолжительностью, качеством и деталями. За этими историями интересно наблюдать: персонажи харизматичны, сюжеты продолжительные и детализированные, а также зачастую оставляют вопросы, о которых можно подумать. Причём эти вопросы касаются не только игры, но и в целом ситуации в мире, людей, неоднозначности решений и их последствий.
Временами встречаются баги, но я не наткнулся ни на один софтлок, и в большинстве случаев они даже слегка забавляют.
Однозначно рекомендую ознакомиться тем, кто хочет провести время в качественном RPG и лишний раз поразмышлять над вопросами, которые в ней возникают. Однако я не думаю, что через 10+ лет после выхода её будут называть культовой.

Cyberpunk 2077 isn't a game "for the ages." I doubt many people will want to return to it in a decade, but at the same time, you can feel that the developers poured their hearts and souls into it, and players will get plenty of positive impressions. In other words, it feels like a game made by players, for players — that stands out right away, and it's genuinely enjoyable to spend time in. The game itself isn't overly difficult: it never throws real challenges at you, but it offers a ton of different ways to tackle emerging situations.
Against all the content, the main storyline seems relatively short in my opinion, but there are loads of side quests packed with length, quality, and detail. It's fascinating to follow these stories: the characters are charismatic, the plots are drawn-out and richly detailed, and they often leave you with questions to ponder. Moreover, these questions go beyond the game — touching on the state of the world, people, the ambiguity of choices, and their consequences.
Bugs pop up from time to time, but I didn't run into any softlocks, and in most cases, they're even mildly amusing.
I definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to dive into a quality RPG and mull over the questions it raises. That said, I don't think it'll be called a cult classic 10+ years after release.

I'm glad I waited for so long to give this game a try because at this point it feels like a complete game and one great RPG to dive into. I've played all the previous CDPR games and you can feel the the through line that get's them to this point and some of the lessons they must have learned with adapting the Witcher. They have a fantastic ability for your character to be a living and breathing personality before you even start making choices that would sway them. V isn't as characterized as Geralt was, but they are a veteran of the world they are thrown into and it shows by the options you are given. 

Gameplay wise, they are focusing on a shooter/RPG hybrid where you have plenty of abilities to mix and match to make it the way you want to play. For myself, I did a stealth hacker and not sure if by default that is one of the more powerful ways to play the game, but wow you really start to wipe the floor soon. Beyond some set pieces, I realized early on that you can level very quickly and that sets you well above most enemies you will encounter. You will probably need to turn up the difficulty a bit to have that dangerous feeling they are intending their to be in the world. Cause by the end I'm hitting overdrive and forcing enemies to kill themselves before wiping out the remainder of enemies with a smart gun. f

As far as the story goes, its fantastic, but it has almost no build up unless you take the time to dive into the side missions. I would not rush the main story here as I think you will find that it is a pretty unsatisfactory trip without all the details you find in the side missions. The choices wouldn't have the weight they do without V having established the identity that he did. Though there are some filler quests in there so it might be best to play it by ear as well so you don't just get lost in the more boring quests. 

Finally, Phantom Liberty is probably the best part of this game and I hope that the story it tries to tell and it's themes are something you see again. It's gritty, serious, and full of conversations with hidden depth. If you buy this game, don't miss this DLC with it.

As a big fan of the Witcher 3, I went into Cyberpunk 2077 with high expectations, but I can definitely say that those expectations were met. This game is a true work of art, the map is large and incredibly fun to explore, and Night City feels alive with beautiful graphics and atmosphere. I often found myself wandering around the city for fun, just to appreciate the scenery and check out the random tiny details the developers included that really makes everything come to life. The story is also excellent, I like the flawed personalities of the characters and the ethical dilemmas the game makes you consider, and the missions feature unique mechanics that I thought were a lot of fun. The combat system is also very flexible with many different weapon types and cyberware options for all sorts of different builds, and the game features a nice variety of enemies you can test your skills on. I also thought the soundtrack and radio songs were great, and appreciated the excellent voice acting in the quests. My only complaint about the game is that although most of the bugs were fixed since its initial release, I still encountered a few crashes and weird glitches throughout the gameplay, some of which were pretty funny. Overall, I'd give this game a 9.5/10, definitely an incredible and memorable experience!

DLSS 4 Makes It Playable
Path tracing murders GPUs, but DLSS 4? Magic. 4K Overdrive at 100+ FPS on decent RTX cards. No more ghosting or blurry messes textures stay crisp even moving fast. RTX 5090 hits 9x performance boosts.

The Game Slaps Now
Update 2.0 fixed everything combat's buttery, story with Keanu hits hard, Phantom Liberty's spy thriller with Idris Elba is peak gaming.

At the beginning, things were honestly not great but the way the developers turned it around deserves real respect. Right now, it’s easily one of the top games.

Честно говоря, когда я только запускал Киберпанк, у меня не было каких-то завышенных ожиданий. Да, слышал много - и хорошего, и плохого. Но уже спустя пару часов понял: это та игра, в которую ты не просто играешь - ты в ней живёшь. И если быть честным, в эту игру я зашел только потому, что мне ее очень настойчиво рекомендовал лучший друг. Он прям говорил "Простой попробуй, это твое"

Найт-Сити - это вообще отдельный разговор. Я не знаю, как разработчики это сделали, но город ощущается настоящим. Не как декорация, а как место, где реально кипит жизнь. Едешь ночью по улицам, неон светит, музыка играет, люди куда-то идут - и ловишь себя на мысли, что просто катаешься без цели и тебе уже кайфово.

Сюжет - это то, что меня зацепило больше всего. Он не про “спасти мир”, а про что-то более личное. Про жизнь, про выбор, про последствия. Ты реально начинаешь привязываться к персонажам, переживать за них. Некоторые моменты вообще пробивают - сидишь и думаешь после миссии, а правильно ли ты поступил.

Отдельно хочу сказать про персонажей. Они не картонные, у каждого есть свой характер, свои проблемы, своя история. С ними хочется общаться, узнавать их. Некоторые диалоги вообще ощущаются как разговоры в реальной жизни, без пафоса, просто по-человечески.

Геймплей тоже радует. Можно играть как хочешь - хочешь, идёшь напролом, хочешь - по-тихому, хочешь — прокачиваешься в хакера и вообще никого руками не трогаешь. И это не просто “для галочки” - это реально работает, и каждый стиль ощущается по-разному.

Музыка и звук - отдельный кайф. Иногда просто стоишь где-нибудь на крыше, смотришь на город и слушаешь, что играет на фоне. И в такие моменты игра прямо попадает в настроение.

Да, у игры были проблемы на старте, это факт. Но сейчас это уже совсем другой уровень. Видно, что в неё вложили душу. И если дать ей шанс - она реально может затянуть надолго.

В итоге для меня Cyberpunk 2077 - это не просто игра. Это история, это атмосфера, это эмоции. Это тот случай, когда ты выключаешь компьютер, а мысли всё ещё там, в Найт-Сити.

Если коротко - я вообще не пожалел ни минуты, проведённой в этой игре. И точно буду возвращаться в неё ещё не раз.

Cyberpunk 2077 é uma montanha russa. Eu estou dividido se amo ou se odeio esse jogo. Não o peguei no lançamento, peguei após todas as atualizações então o jogo está funcional divertido e é uma experiência maravilhosa e quando a história acerta, ela acerta muito. O Meu maior problema com ele se chama Johnny Silverhand. A onipresência desse personagem no jogo após o Ato 1 se provou uma constante fonte de irritação e odio para mim, e isso fez minha experiência nesse jogo ser extremamente conflitante. Por um lado, eu estava comprando a fantasia e imerso em night city e adorando ser o V, um mercenário Bad ass que o jogo me permitiu fazer um roleplay consistente, encontrando personagens carismaticos mesmo nesse mundo tão deprimente (Me apeguei tanto ao Kerry, a Judy, a Panam, o Jackie, a Claire, a Misty, o Viktor e River como me apeguei a personagens da trilogia Mass Effect, coisa que nenhum jogo tinha conseguido fazer até agora), e me fazendo querer continuar por eles e pelo meu V... e o jogo constantemente torna tudo sobre o Silverhand, o fantasma egocêntrico e narcisista na minha cabeça. Isso tornou minha experiência no jogo cada vez mais miserável, por que o jogo queria que eu respeitasse o legado desse personagem , fosse o terapeuta dele, me tornasse ele, e mesmo que (SPOILERS), no fim, eu tenha escolhido me livrar dele, o jogo quer que eu me sinta mal por isso,  e ainda termino com um V querendo fazer cosplay de Silverhand. Frustrante. Tambem senti falta de nuance nas escolhas de diálogo, principalmente em momentos de conversas profundas e emocionais, que são abundantes nesse jogo (principalmente nas sessões de terapia com o fantasma fedorento do Johnny). 

Mas como disse, quando o jogo acerta, ele acerta muito. Eu não sou muito fã de FPS, mas o combate desse jogo me viciou. Terminei com uma build hibrida de Trilharede de combate que estourava os miolos de todo mundo com uma escopeta ou fatiava os inimigos com as icônicas laminas de louva deus. Em termos de gameplay e imersão na cidade, o jogo é excelente, cada missão secundâria conta uma história paralela e bem interessante, e foi por isso que consegui ficar 191 horas nesse jogo, até por que aqui ele brilha, é a História do V como mercenário lendário, A trilha sonora é um show a parte, adorei todas as composições da banda fictícia The cartesian duelists e do prórpio Kerry Eurodyne (A chippin in dele é perfeita, perdoem-me metaleiros puristas kkk) e até Pon Pon Shit acabou me agradando, e eu sem ironia acabei usando como trilha sonora de combate, é hilario explodir inimigos com J-Pop chiclete. 
Se eu recomendo esse jogo? Absolutamente! Mas se prepare pra passar muita raiva e sair com traumas acumulados, muitos momentos da narrativa são extremamente nihlistas.
Agora, eu provavelmente não vou mais voltar a night city. Infelizmente a onipresênica de Johnny Silverhand azedou a experiência pra mim, e eu to pronto pra partir pra outra. Muita gente conseguiu gostar desse personagem (não consigo entender como) então provavelmente eles tiveram uma experiência muito melhor que a minha com esse jogo, Se for o seu caso, ótimo. O jogo é ótimo e eu queria não ter tido esse problema. E olha que eu sou muito fã do Keanu Reaves.

This game has come around in a way that's hard to quantify.  While it was utterly broken on launch, over the intervening years it's become one of the best RPGs ever made, and handily meets the high bar left by CDPR's previous masterpiece, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt.

Even more impressive than the base game is the quality of the expansion, Phantom Liberty.  More than just adding content, it expands the already unmatched world of Night City, adds new characters, conversations, etc. but most of all, it's just got that sauce where you know you're engaging with something special.  That lift in quality has spilled over into the rest of the game, and now it not only feels feature-complete, but even a bit transcendent.  When you play this game, you don't feel like you're watching virtual puppets.  Those first-person conversations are so immersive, the biggest flaw is that you can't choose to respond however you please.

The gameplay experience is straight out of Deus Ex.  It's an immersive sim with deeper RPG elements than most games of the genre, and with more satisfying moment-to-moment combat than most as well.  The animations and sound design are stellar, and the visuals are simply among the best to ever be seen in a video game.

One aspect that deserves special praise is the music, which ends up conjuring the same transportive vibe as something like Grand Theft Auto, except instead of transporting you to Los Angeles in 2013, it transports you to a fictional futuristic city.  They do this by inviting tons of real-world artists to make music as in-world musicians, a creative challenge that leads to a suite of music that feels like you stepped into a Spotify playlist from an alternate timeline.  The effect is undeniable: the moment you're in a car driving through the city and you hear I Really Want to Stay at Your House, it feels like returning to a city you've been away from for a while.

I think that's the strangest great thing about this game: it could have easily been purely shock factor and spectacle, porn-adjacent slop with no artistic value.  And ironically the game dabbles in this regularly, but there's always a feeling of intent behind it.  The awkward, piercing moans of an orgasmic energy drink advertisement say more about the depravity of Night City than any monologue could.  In fact, with gore and nudity being so inescapable, it means that the moments of the game that really shine are those moments of deep, abiding humanity.  When a character opens up to you about her past, and lets you explore her home, you have a moment of realization that I've experienced numerous times in real life, "Oh thank God, I've found someone real in this place."  For a fictional video game to make me feel that way about characters made of polygons and pixels is perhaps the highest praise I could possibly give.

There will be unique dialogues for each life paths when having conservation with people all over NC and there will be certain consequences that you will love or regret choosing. OK.
Cyberpunk 2077 was a tough one for me.
I started this game years ago, when it was still a buggy mess. I couldn't get into it. And not only because of the bugs. I couldn't get into the story. There was too much happening, too many characters introduced, too much cyber-lingo I didn't understand, until I was phasing out during the conversations. I gave up after the first 15-20 hours.

Came back to the game after Phantom Liberty, and decided to start a new character. It was a bit better, less bugs, and I had a better grasp of the world, story and characters. But it was still a bit much. I got lost with how much the game was throwing at me. I forgot who each person was, Got calls or messages from people I was supposed to know, but didn't remember, and couldn't give a s*** about. And I realized I wasn't enjoying the most important part of the experience: the world, the characters, the story. I was enjoying the combat, but going through the game just checking every icon on the map, not caring about anything or anyone.
I stopped, and uninstalled.

After two years without thinking about it, I stumbled upon the great Edgerunners show. And it pulled me back into this world. I decided to do things right this time. Installed the game, and modded it to improve the experience as much as possible with the "Welcome to Night City" mod list.
Started a new game, and went in with my mind set on really paying attention to the stories, not just completing tasks. And the game finally clicked for me.

This was a hard game to get into, specially since I am more of a casual player nowadays, being a dad and having two jobs. It took me 9 to 10 months to finish it, because I can't just do the main missions. I like seeing as much as possible, completing every fixer gig and side mission. The only things I didn't fully complete were the crimes, assaults, criminal activities and races.

Well, after so many hours, I was on the final stretch, and I couldn't stop. Stayed awake all night. I needed to see how it ended. And I am so glad I did it. It was rewarding, exhausting (in a good way). There are so many little things that make the world so authentic. Little call backs to previous events, characters I crossed paths with that show up, and recall what happened previously. It's fair to say, doing all those missions was worth it.

I really enjoyed some of the side content, and some deep, strong and uncomfortable topics the game touches on. I liked the moral ambiguities that are depicted. (Almost) nothing is ever black or white, and you're faced with some nerve racking decisions to make, many times not fully knowing the consequences of your actions. These are the things that stayed with me the most.

The ending was bitter sweet, but so fitting to this world. And I'm happy with the one I got. V's story ended on a sad but hopeful note, and open enough to interpretation that leaves room for me to imagine what comes next. Also, the people I cared about (mostly) got their stories wrapped up in a satisfying way, and I'm so happy I got to know them. 

Although I'm NOT PLAYING THIS GAME EVER AGAIN, or any other open world RPG in the near future, I couldn't be happier of having decided to come back and giving Cyberpunk this last chance. It finally did it for me.

Can I recommend this game? YES. ABSOLUTELY YES. Specially with a few mods to improve the experience.
It's not for everyone. It's very hard to get into, it demands too much of your time and energy, it has too many characters, too many stories, and they don't always work in sync with one another. It can get messy and confusing. The gameplay systems can also be a bit overwhelming, specially if you're not familiar with RPG mechanics.

But Night City is a place I'll never forget, and its people and stories will be in my mind for many, many years.

600小时 最爱的游戏

［GE15］《赛博朋克2077》
价格：缺 游戏时间：176.8h 周目数：三周目 通关时间：2026.5.2 评分：8.5
赛博朋克一直以来人类科幻未来高度数字化社会的典型代表，但在文娱作品中却一直不温不火，犹记得还是大学期间看的《银翼杀手2049》使得我对赛博朋克这一概念有了具体的画面感，城市高饱和的霓虹灯，破败的小巷子，大量的贫困人口，人工智能高度发达等标志，尽管赛博朋克概念早已不太稀奇，但在现代游戏体系下，高水平3A方面赛博朋克类型直接查无此人，直到CDPR端出来了划时代的本作——《赛博朋克2077》.
尽管游戏数次跳票，以至于诞生出游戏圈的名人名言，“没人会记得那些按时发售的垃圾游戏。”起码在我看来，此后的游戏或多或少都会跳票，以此向CDPR灵魂人物马尔钦证明自己不是垃圾游戏，终于2020年12月10号，本作发售，可惜游戏的首发依然堪称灾难级的，大量的bug使得游戏能玩都是一种奢求，以至于破天荒的让索尼开通退款渠道，好在游戏捞都是善良的，给了CDPR机会，缝缝补补过去两三年，游戏终于到达能玩的地步，我的一周目也是2023年4月开坑的，可惜，大量的类容缺失，无尽的bug，还是给了我糟糕的游戏体验，最近三周目结档，特此浅聊几段，留作纪念。
玩多了电影化叙事的游戏，反倒对这种第一人称叙事方式不太感冒，因为冗长的对话使得逐渐失去耐心，大部分情况下，就是找手机，使得这段剧情一知半解，这就是前两周目最大的感受，但在三周目中，我开始有所改观，我真的沉浸在故事中，虽然还是有些剧情云里雾里，但对于故事有了很大的了解。
剧情：本作主线剧情可以说非常短，偷芯片，找华子，以至于大部分没玩过的玩家都知道华子的等待这个梗，我也很佩服CDPR主线如此之短，没有优秀的支线，谁会愿意花大价钱去玩这么短的游戏，好在玩家们并不担心，因为有《巫师3》在珠玉在前，大家相信CDPR的能力，同样，本作的的支线任务比主线更为精彩也不为过，四季宝，边缘行者联动，德拉曼、和尚冥想等等等等，甚至在我通关后才知道有售货机和利兹的支线，可以说在支线设计上，CDPR绝对算得上佼佼者，对比我最喜欢的《最终幻想》系列和《刺客信条》系列，我还是更愿意玩一遍《巫师3》.
画质：作为英伟达战略合作伙伴，看着老黄每出一代卡，就拿本作做画面表现就绷不住，合着CDPR再不管了呗，全靠老黄各种AI加持优化，使得现在打开本作画质设置，密密麻麻的的调整项看的人头皮发麻，不过按流程还得提句，在4070L与DLSS的加持下，游戏关闭光追，画质最高下，可以达到120帧左右，不过在某些场景，会大幅回落到80帧左右，值得一提的是，本作不论如何总有一种糊糊的感觉，拍照模式中也是如此，明明锐化调最高了，这个现象还是改变不了。
玩法：本作全程采取第一人称叙事模式，对于我来说是个极大的扣分点，虽然极大加强了代入感，但在某些重要剧情转折点我还是喜欢电影化叙事，起码在电影化叙事中，人物环境都是官方预渲染的最好摸样，而不是在我那糊糊的画面里看朱迪那左边快秃的头皮。
音乐：怎么说呢，没有《巫师3》那么多动听的音乐，但还是有能值得一提的，《Hardest to Be》这首歌我总感觉早在本作以前就听过，《Never Fade Away》、《此生相爱，来生相遇》、《V》等，总体来说，本作重要剧情节点的音乐还是不错，日常打架时的也还好。
结局：自杀结局：当玩家玩到此处的时候，无论找谁帮忙，都意味着朋友要承担巨大的危险，而我不愿意让朋友陷入这种局面，选择自杀也许对朋友来说，是最安全的方法，可是当我们选择放弃自己的时候，结尾的朋友们却并没有我们想象中的那么快乐，相反，所有人都是无尽悲伤的状态中，帕南痛斥V背叛了她，所有人做的所有努力都化作了泡影，这也是从玩家角度讲最不可能选的结局，但从当事人的视角看，从V顺手拿枪的时候，V就已经选了这条路了吧。
恶魔：无论怎么选，这条线是最没用的，不仅是结尾，就在选了这条线的时候，各种表现都让我坐立难安，在太空舱中，医护人员那冰冷没有人情味的对话，使得V不仅不像病人，而像一个没有生命的实验品，你拒绝荒板，回到地球等死，答应荒板，则成为字面意义上的实验品，毕竟自己的灵魂都成为了荒板的自由，前面玩家的几十个小时都成可笑的讽刺。
高塔：DLC结局，高塔同样令人唏嘘不已，虽然新美国治好了V,但昏迷了两年，醒来后物是人非，朱迪都嫁给他人，而V也装不了任何战斗义体，老维也成为了泽塔科技品牌旗舰店，与信奉的自由理念背道而驰，最终V消失在茫茫人海。
节制：把身体交给强尼，让强尼代替自己活下去，但我不喜欢这个结局。
太阳：以罗格之死让V成为来生老板与夜之城活着的传奇，最后答应蓝眼睛先生请求，去水晶宫干最后一票，不过最后一幕，V的宇航服的喷气却朝反方向喷出，加上V咬紧牙关的表现，合理怀疑蓝眼睛先生动了手脚弄死V，或者单纯的制作者的疏忽。
星星：我个人最喜欢的结局，在最后，V与朱迪加入了帕南领导的流浪者，离开了夜之城，一起走向远方，这条线除了阿卡德死了，算是最好的结局了，离开了这个是是非非的地方，未来的一切都是未知的，最重要的是，朱迪也一起来了，而且老维打电话也是非常开心的样子，与恶魔结局形成了鲜明的对比。
本作开场了3A级别的赛博朋克类型，起码以后有同类型游戏，都少不了与本作做对比，也是此类型中一座大山伫立在那，等待着后来者翻越，优秀的支线与主线撑起了这个虚构的世界，而大量赛博朋克的城市设计使得我们能够一眼分辨出来这是2077年，而不是2026年，可以说，CDPR把赛博朋克这个元素嵌入了这个游戏的方方面面，不过，至今还有大量的bug就显得格格不入，在狗镇劫持法国兄妹的任务中，第一次碰见开车视角是第一人称后备箱的，第二次发现车库门打不开，无奈大退重做，野人王打一半突然不掉血，不动不说话，活活被黑客耗死这种恶性bug本不应该出现的，而大量的穿模问题已经不算是bug了，第一人称的叙事方式还是非常挑人的。
聊至此，本作故事已经结束，打完后，感触还是挺大的，想到或许这种场景就在不远的未来，就对本作的故事有了更多的感想，赛博朋克这个概念中，发生这种现象的原因简单明了，但如何改变这种现象却没有一个科幻作家提出。

A flawed masterpiece...

Pros:
- Graphics are gorgeous. Played without raytracing (didn't feel it added enough to warrant the drop in FPS), mix of high to very high otherwise, 4k around 100 fps throughout the whole game with one exception near the end where fps tanked in one scene (but it fixed itself before combat started).
- The gameplay is great with many ways to play. Gunplay is good, but melee feels very satisfying as well with different options. Netrunning is also a very valid option, turning you into a god towards the end if you want, and more fun than you might expect.
- Stories are interesting. The main one is pretty good, but especially many of the side quests. CDPR clearly is still very good at making things interesting. There are also some 'go here, shoot him, collect that' quests, but many are truly good stories.
- Acting is very good overall, and it was fun having Keanu around (not to say his character is especially likable, but he has depth and development).

Cons:
- BUGS! Oh my god, I can't even imagine how bad it must have been at launch since people say they fixed it up so bad. It's not like it's unplayable, but I've had many issues. Cars spawning upside down falling from the sky, camera stops following you while driving, getting hit in the street by invisible cars, getting ragdolled for no reason, motorcycle suddenly teleporting somewhere else the moment you get on... it goes on. I've not encountered many gamebreaking bugs, only had to load an old save once or twice (aside from quick save and quick load to fix things like the camera when driving), but it's still annoying.
- Driving is really mediocre. Speed is faked, you apparently only drive about half the speed it says (someone did the math), and it doesn't feel fast at all. At one point I tested, I was passing other cars going 240 km/h and it felt like there was maybe a 30 km/h difference between us. Slowed down, they were going 70... Cars also have pretty bad handling. The traffic also has an issue where in the distance it will show fake cars... then when you get closer they disappear and when you get closer still, other cars (less) will spawn in. It's very jarring and not handled well at all.
- The endings suuuuuuuuuck... I've seen a couple now, not all of them, but from looking online it doesn't seem like it gets much better. For some reason, CDPR seems to REALLY want to make sure you end on a low note. No happy ever after for V... The problem with this is, it makes everything feel futile. And that might not matter the first time, but this is a game made to be played many times. 
- The worst was (minor SPOILER) when I'm making all my decissions just to get back to my in game girlfriend, as we said we would get away and leave the city together once my problem was fixed... only to get a voicemail during the credits that she's left already and wishes me a nice life... WTAF?! I felt so cheated and it made no sense at all. It just felt like CDPR saying FU to my face. Well FU2.
- There are also annoying design decissions like how after every quest, the game automatically switches you to the main quest again. But the main quest is actually not that long and if you push too far in it, you get locked out of the rest of the game (and towards one of the unhappy endings). Also when you get a call about some other quest, the game switches you to that quest and you have to manually switch to what you were doing if you don't agree. There is a setting to have fixers not call you but only text, but I don't want to deny myself content just to fix this stupid design.
- Quests also lack proper descriptions. In your journal you only see Johnny's ramblings. That in itself is pretty cool, but with how many side quests there are, often I will not remember why I have a certain quest and Johnny does not really tell me. So then a cool story might still devolve into a fetch quest again because you have no idea what's going on.
- Cops are mostly still irrelevant... They are VERY easy to run from, they give up chasing you real fast. But, the one time I decided to try fighting them, already being a netrunning god, I died within a minute because the game escallates insanely fast. I was out in the desert, and infinite cops just spawned around me, until maxtaq showed up and just flatlined me (right through several cheat deaths, didn't stand a chance at all). This means there is zero reason to fight them, and zero reason to fear them when you don't actively engage them. So they're irrelevant, bad design.

All in all... yeah, it's still a great game and anyone that likes this type of game should at least give it a chance. I just think it's such a shame that they made certain decissions that actively make it worse than it could and should have been.
