Reconheço que posso não ser totalmente imparcial ao me expressar dessa forma, pois sou fã das franquias da CD Projekt, sendo The Witcher minha saga favorita entre todas. Ainda assim, considero válido compartilhar minha experiência.

Como ocorreu com grande parte do público na época, criei uma expectativa extremamente elevada em relação a Cyberpunk 2077. Realizei a pré-venda, adquiri a edição Steelbook e pretendia jogá-lo no PC. Contudo, no lançamento, diante dos inúmeros problemas amplamente conhecidos e das limitações de configuração do meu computador à época, infelizmente não foi possível aproveitar o jogo. O que restou foi acompanhar, ao longo do tempo, as críticas severas que o título recebeu, muitas delas justificadas.

Apesar disso, foi positivo observar que a CD Projekt não abandonou o projeto, postura que eu esperava da empresa. Em 2022, antes mesmo da atualização 2.0, após trocar de computador, finalmente consegui jogar o título. Desde então, minha percepção foi extremamente positiva: mesmo naquele momento, o jogo já se mostrava uma experiência notável.

A partir daí, a trajetória foi de constante evolução, com o lançamento de Edgerunners e, posteriormente, da expansão Phantom Liberty, que apenas enriqueceram ainda mais o conteúdo e a narrativa do jogo.

Dessa forma, para aqueles que ainda mantêm receio em relação a Cyberpunk 2077 por conta de seu lançamento conturbado, recomendo que deem uma nova oportunidade ao título. Espero sinceramente que possam aproveitá-lo tanto quanto eu. Minhas horas de jogo falam por si, mas é importante ter em mente que, em Night City, não existem finais verdadeiramente felizes, mas felizmente Cyberpunk 2077 como título teve.

Una vez pasada la emoción de haberlo completado al 100% y con algo más de distancia, creo que vale la pena volver a Cyberpunk 2077 desde un lugar más frío y dejar una reseña un poco más objetiva, que no se limite solamente a marcar que me gustó.

Cyberpunk 2077 es, ante todo, una carta de amor al género que le da nombre. No busca reinventarlo ni sorprender con ideas completamente nuevas, sino que se apoya con mucha claridad en obras literarias y audiovisuales clave. La influencia más evidente es Blade Runner, aunque el juego no se queda ahí y también mira con fuerza hacia referentes japoneses como Akira o Ghost in the Shell. Todas comparten una misma base: un avance tecnológico desmedido y las consecuencias profundamente deshumanizantes que eso trae consigo.

El juego no romantiza el futurismo. Desde el primer momento deja claro que el mundo que propone es una distopía dura, casi apocalíptica. Muestra el costado más oscuro del capitalismo sin caer en un discurso panfletario, y lo hace de forma bastante natural. Como en sus principales inspiraciones, Night City es violenta, fría y contradictoria, es una sociedad que se vende como libre, pero que en la práctica vive a merced de corporaciones gigantes y completamente impersonales. La tecnología tampoco aparece como una promesa de algo mejor pues es cotidiana, defectuosa, comercial y sucia, integrada a la vida diaria hasta el punto de volverse casi invisible.

En resumidas cuentas, el juego tiene un world building increíble y muy bien escrito. Es disfrutable, nada genérico, con personalidad, pero sin esa necesidad constante de querer demostrarla.

Si hablamos de gameplay, funciona muy bien como RPG. Es un gran juego dentro del género y, al mismo tiempo, un RPG claramente moderno. No intenta ser excesivamente complejo ni abrumador, pero tampoco se queda en lo superficial. Encuentra un equilibrio muy sólido entre profundidad y accesibilidad, algo que no todos los RPG logran.

En cuanto a la estética, Cyberpunk 2077 está, sin vueltas, entre lo mejor que vi en un videojuego. Es difícil discutir lo bien que funciona su identidad visual y lo consistente que se mantiene de principio a fin. No es solo vistosa ni puro impacto visual para clips, tiene una lógica clara y una personalidad muy marcada.

Tuve la oportunidad de jugarlo cuando el juego era un desastre, y también de jugarlo en su estado actual. La conclusión a la que llego es clara: es uno de los mejores juegos de la historia. No estoy diciendo top 3 ni top 5, pero arriba seguro que está. No se dejen llevar únicamente por lo que pasó en su lanzamiento y anímense a probarlo con la cabeza abierta.

The large arsenal of weapons felt good to use, but most fights still felt a bit dull and unengaging to me. The only times my pulse actually quickened was when I got aggravated by my character getting stuck on ridiculous little objects during a firefight, like a plastic chair. I’m a powerful semi-cyborg; I should be able to kick that thing into next week.

I’d heard the game USED to be buggy and glitchy, so while the excellent visuals provide a foundation for an immersive experience, I was surprised by the glaring issues that remain. Whenever a dialogue with an important NPC turns into a "walk-and-talk," they glitch right through other random NPCs.

One of the most entertaining moments of my playthrough was sitting in the passenger seat while Takemura told one of his very long-winded stories. He crashed into the rear of a truck, and flames started gushing into the cabin through the windshield, but Takemura kept the pedal to the metal. He just kept calmly talking to me while soothing music played on the car radio. Good times.

It's a good game, but a bit too heavy on story/dialogue and too weak on FPS mechanics for an old brute like myself.

在夜之城，你最初杀掉的一个变态，以为只是简单的委托。直到很久以后，你读懂了散落在芯片里的线索，才惊觉自己只是扯断了一张巨大情报网上的一根线头。

正法承太郎就是这样的线头。大多数玩家接到追捕怪物这个委托后，果断杀进他的凤凰俱乐部，干净利落地解决掉他，就像踩死一只蟑螂。但你如果有心，会在之后十多个看似无关的委托、NCPD案件甚至路人对话里，反复撞见他的名字。你会发现，这个变态不是孤立的怪物，而是一个庞大黑色网络的心脏。有李宰贤这样的人贩子负责备货和安装定位器；有黑警卡勒姆·布莱克把失踪者从警车直接送上他的流水线；有走私犯彼得用集装箱像运货一样运送活人；甚至连你早期帮助过的正义女警安娜·哈米尔，她调查的走私案最终也指向这里。你早期在维克多诊所附近撞见的第一个NCPD案件，那个叫惠子的可怜女孩，就是从这个网络里逃出来又被抓回去的牺牲品。


这简单的案件缩影，就是我对2077的态度，这也是我喜欢2077的原因，所以我更为2077惋惜……

因为赶工，大量的任务被舍弃，变成废案；保留下的任务也被简单的拆分，被压缩些芯片的文案里，被省略到场景里。蠢驴不得不把一个个完整、黑暗、细思极恐的故事，打碎成十几片，随手扔在城市各个角落的芯片、电脑和尸体上。你不去主动拼图，它就只是一个背景噪音……你必须去解密，去考古，你才能完整了解每一个任务的脉络和细节。这也是本体一直被诟病罐头的原因，但在DLC里，蠢驴显然吸取了教训，把支线、选择和关卡演出结合得更加紧密、有力，那股子让人欲罢不能的感觉又回来了。

Cyberpunk 2077 is more than a game — it’s a world that pulls you in and refuses to let go. One of those rare digital universes that you don’t just play, but truly live in. Night City isn’t a backdrop; it’s a character. It breathes, pulses, seduces, and hurts. Beautiful and cruel in equal measure, and the more time you spend there, the deeper it marks you.
With 500 hours on Steam and another 1000 on console, there’s no exaggeration in saying this game became almost a second home. Not because it’s comfortable, but because it feels real within its own fantasy. Every neon-lit street, every throwaway conversation, every song playing while you drive with no destination — it all builds an unmatched sense of immersion.
Cyberpunk 2077 shines because it knows exactly what it wants to be. It talks about identity, loss, ambition, freedom, and what it means to exist in a world that wants to chew you up and spit you out. The characters are intense, human, and flawed — Johnny Silverhand, V, Panam, Judy, River, Kerry — they all leave their mark. They’re not NPCs; they’re stories that walk beside you.
And even after hundreds upon hundreds of hours, Night City never loses its impact. There’s always a new detail, a different route, a line of dialogue that hits harder, a mission you see from a new perspective. The game doesn’t run out — it grows alongside you.
Loving Cyberpunk 2077 means loving a broken, stylish, loud, and deeply melancholic world. It means accepting that not every ending is happy, but that the journey is worth every second. And with 1500 hours combined, one thing is clear: this isn’t just admiration. It’s connection. It’s passion. It’s the kind of game that stays with you long after the screen goes dark.

Cyberpunk 2077 fue un juego que compré por recomendación y, siendo honesta, no le tenía mucha fe. Siempre he sido más de juegos como Resident Evil, así que entré sin expectativas y sin saber muy bien en qué me estaba metiendo. Grave error… porque el juego me sorprendió desde el inicio y no me arrepiento ni un segundo de haberlo jugado.

Al terminarlo, me quedé con ganas de más. A nivel narrativo, Cyberpunk 2077 ofrece muchísimo más que la mayoría de los juegos actuales, y no solo eso: lo lleva todo a otro nivel. Aquí cada decisión, cada conversación y cada detalle importan. Night City es una ciudad cruel, caótica y llena de brutalidad. Siempre está pasando algo: en un callejón oscuro, luces cegadoras, ruidos constantes, música que te envuelve y te mete de lleno en este mundo. Es curioso cómo, a pesar de ser un lugar tan ajeno y despiadado, termina sintiéndose como casa. Una casa peligrosa.

La exploración es increíble y el combate resulta bastante entretenido; literalmente puedes pelearte con quien sea si te da la gana (La cantidad de veces que hice enojar a la poli...). Incluso en los momentos más duros del juego, más de una vez me encontré pensando: “Johnny tenía razón”, lv Johnny btw, y seguía adelante. Cyberpunk 2077 tiene algo que no se ve tan seguido: una brutalidad honesta. Políticos corruptos, corporaciones gigantes, un mundo dominado por el caos. Y el DLC… ni hablemos. Sin exagerar, fue de las mejores compras que he hecho.

I want to start this review by saying that Cyberpunk 2077 is my favorite game all time, so far. One of the best comebacks in history CDPR did.

The atmosphere in this game is just wow, I was driving around Japantown and one song kicked in, ISOMETRIC AIR by Bryan Aspey & Quantum Lovers. I just can't describe the vibe, it felt beautiful, it felt real. Also the song that plays mostly when you speak with Johnny and you have to make a decision, is incredible. I love it because it establishes a sense of impending doom and you feel like your hopeless to stop it. Also I have to mention the song that plays when you "free" Songbird. Songbird broke my heart into a million pieces. Incredible written character, you just can't hate her. I won't write about Johnny because i feel like he deserves his own separate review, all I can say is that I love that son of a bitch. You start your playthrough with your own personality, thoughts, ideas, and this bastard starts to question every single step you make, and how you do it.
Solomon Reed also a great character, Idris Elba did a fantastic job. Reed sometimes got me like he's more fucked up than V. Phantom Liberty is one of the best DLC I played ever. The way you play the DLC gives new dynamics to the "main" story. Rough choices you have to make. Se você jogou no lançamento ou ouviu falar dos problemas iniciais, esqueça tudo isso. O Cyberpunk 2077 de hoje, especialmente após a atualização 2.0 e a expansão Phantom Liberty, é uma experiência completamente transformada. É, sem dúvida, um dos RPGs de ação mais imersivos e visualmente impactantes já criados.

Night City: Um Personagem Vivo A primeira coisa que choca é a atmosfera. Night City não é apenas um cenário; é uma entidade viva, opressora e fascinante. A verticalidade da cidade, o design de som (o barulho do trânsito, os anúncios distópicos, a música industrial) e a iluminação criam uma imersão que poucos jogos conseguem atingir. Você se sente pequeno dentro daquele mundo, o que é essencial para a narrativa "punk" de luta contra o sistema.

Narrativa e Personagens A história de V e Johnny Silverhand é escrita com uma maturidade rara. Não há heróis perfeitos aqui. Os diálogos são orgânicos e as escolhas que você faz têm peso real, não apenas no final, mas em como as missões se desenrolam. A atuação de voz e as animações faciais transmitem emoções sutis que te fazem se importar genuinamente com personagens secundários, como Panam, Judy e River. A trama aborda temas pesados sobre transumanismo, corporativismo e o que significa ter uma alma, mas sem ser pretensiosa.

Gameplay Refinado (Pós-2.0) O combate, que antes podia ser meio travado, agora é visceral e fluido. A árvore de habilidades foi refeita para permitir "builds" que realmente mudam o jogo. Se você quer ser um ninja cibernético que deflete balas com uma katana, você pode. Se prefere ser um netrunner que frita o cérebro dos inimigos pelas câmeras de segurança, é igualmente viável e satisfatório. O sistema de polícia e o combate veicular adicionaram a camada de caos que faltava no mundo aberto.

Aspectos Técnicos e Visuais Visualmente, é um marco na indústria. A direção de arte mistura o futurismo sujo dos anos 80 com tecnologia moderna de forma magistral. O uso de Ray Tracing (para quem tem hardware compatível) transforma a iluminação em algo quase fotorrealista, mas mesmo em configurações mais modestas, a direção de arte carrega o visual nas costas com muito estilo.

Veredito Cyberpunk 2077 não é apenas um jogo sobre atirar e dirigir; é sobre viver em um futuro sombrio e tentar deixar sua marca nele. A CD Projekt Red conseguiu polir o diamante bruto. Se você gosta de narrativas profundas, liberdade de abordagem no gameplay e mundos abertos densos, este é um título obrigatório. É uma obra-prima de design de mundo e narrativa interativa.

遊戲本身基礎跟一般FPS一樣，但不同的是有速駭這個打法，可以透過駭入別人的腦機面板做到非常多花式的操作（例如遠端遙控別人的車子再去碾人），或是潛行、搭配有消音器的手槍把所有人摸掉；又或是加入動畫邊緣行者主角David的沙德威斯坦流配刀劍操作，整體而言因為能力點是用有限的分配方式，因此戰鬥方式的選擇對新手來說不算友善，但一旦搞懂且找到自己喜歡的流派之後就會非常好玩。

遊戲本體主線的精彩程度可以說是無死角的S級，能跟他打的的確不多，支線也不敷衍，根據不同的選擇跟臨機應變往往對劇情有很大的影響，這方面有點像是西元2077年的RDR2，根據不同的選擇，即便是支線常常也會造成無論好壞都影響嚴重的後果，此外根據主線的每一步細微選擇，就算最後收束的是同一結局，劇情對話也都會有細微的差異，因此根據每個玩家遊戲方式的偏好不同，即可造就獨一無二的劇情體驗，且對話下的回饋感非常明顯；此外，也包含隱藏結局，這些路線上的選擇可以很好的去體現玩家的個性和偏好，讓人非常有在夜城生活的實感，很難不產生感情。

綜合來說，我完全可以理解為什麼當初很多人都跟我說這是神作，因為的確是；少數我認為的缺點就是前期真的很慢熱吧，老實說前3-5小時我真的覺得有一點無聊，因為遊戲的元素實在是太多了，會讓人有點抓不到重點的感覺，例如動畫裡有提到的幻智之舞/幻舞（braindance)，遊戲中就有另外設計一套玩法，我以為這會是很重點的劇情進行方式，但倒也不是，更像是體現在2077這些科技在日常能做到的變化。

開頭的許多部份不只是新手教學和劇情導向，而是為了讓你體驗西元2077的生活，深入帶入夜城的生活；理解這點不要太糾結許多後會突然變的非常好玩；綜合來說我甚至會覺得沒什麼好評分的，實在完美，當然遊戲類型喜好不同是個問題，但反過來說要是你喜歡劇情豐富的動作類型3A，這款遊戲無可挑剔。

補充：因為DLC推出後價格折數不如本體那麼低，因此價格可能讓人退卻或是想單買本體，但以劇情和可玩內容來說強烈推薦購買DLC，綜合來說這個套組售價1000，能有這個等級的劇情和體驗是非常值得的。

=======================================================================
此外，本人在巴哈專版有整理塔羅牌的釋義；若是對劇情有興趣，歡迎加入討論。

Графика и дизайн
Когда я запускал игру, впервые ощутил погружение в яркий, живой и детально проработанный ночной город Найт-Сити. Мегаполис выглядит потрясающе: неоновые огни, футуристические здания, анимации персонажей — всё на высшем уровне. В некоторых местах встречаются баги с моделями или анимациями, но это скорее исключение, чем правило.

Геймплей и механики
Квесты разнообразные: от классических рейдов и разговоров до ролеплея с выбором решений, которые влияют на сюжет. Боевая система местами кажется немного хаотичной, и мне пришлось немного привыкнуть к динамике. Есть масса опций кастомизации персонажа, а также технологии — некоторые из них действительно добавляют глубину в геймплей.

История и сюжет
История насыщенная и атмосферная, она цепляет своей мрачностью и философскими размышлениями о человеческом «я» в мире технологий. Но некоторые побочные квесты оказались немного однообразными. Главные мифы и персонажи действительно запоминаются.

Производительность и баги
На моем ПК игра шла хорошо, за исключением небольших просадок при большом количестве эффектов. В первые релизы было много багов, но на текущий момент многие исправлены патчами. Всё равно иногда встречаются недочёты, которые в будущем вероятно исправят.

Общий вывод
Cyberpunk 2077 — это амбициозная игра с шикарным дизайном и богатым миром, который хочется исследовать. Несмотря на некоторые технические недочёты, она стоит того, чтобы потратить время. Для тех, кто любит глубокий сюжет, хорошо прописанных персонажей и открытые миры — это отличный выбор.

Рекомендую — надеюсь, разработчики продолжают работать над улучшением и добавят ещё больше контента.

Cyberpunk 2077 é uma verdadeira obra-prima da CD Projekt Red, que trouxe ao mundo um universo de ficção científica rico e imersivo (embora não tenha veiculo voadores pilotáveis). Após um lançamento conturbado, o jogo evoluiu de maneira impressionante, e hoje é um dos títulos mais impressionantes pelo menos para mim e detalhados que você pode jogar (embora ainda seja um cyberbug ''ainda tendo alguns bug''). A narrativa é envolvente e cheia de reviravoltas, com escolhas que realmente impactam o rumo da história. A sensação de estar dentro de Night City é única, graças ao seu mundo aberto vibrante e repleto de vida, detalhes e segredos para descobrir.

O jogo oferece uma liberdade enorme, desde a customização do personagem até a maneira como você escolhe abordar as missões – seja com combate intenso ou explorando as várias opções de hacking e diálogo.

Agora, Phantom Liberty, a DLC que chegou para expandir ainda mais essa experiência, é um complemento perfeito. Ela não apenas adiciona uma nova área de exploração, mas também traz uma trama cativante com novos personagens e missões que aprofundam a história e o universo de Cyberpunk (queria muito a da lua pena que não ira mais para frente).O enredo, repleto de intrigas e reviravoltas, mantém o jogador preso à tela do começo ao fim, e as novas opções de combate e habilidades tornam a jogabilidade ainda mais divertida e dinâmica.

Concluindo, tanto Cyberpunk 2077 quanto Phantom Liberty oferecem uma experiência abrangente e da mais alta qualidade. Se você gosta de RPGs de mundo aberto e aprecia uma história envolvente, este é um jogo que vale a pena ser jogado e aproveitado ao máximo.

Cyberpunk 2077 isn’t just a game — it’s a religious experience, a neon-soaked fever dream, a masterclass in art, storytelling, and pure vibes that has permanently rewired my brain. I didn’t play Cyberpunk 2077. I moved into Night City, paid rent in eddies, and emotionally bonded with streetlights.

First of all: Night City. My god. This is not a setting, it’s a living, breathing, hyper-capitalist nightmare utopia that might be the greatest open world ever created. Every alley hums with stories. Every billboard screams personality. The city doesn’t just look good — it judges you. You walk through it and feel small, swallowed by neon, chrome, and corporate despair in the most beautiful way possible. I’ve stood still for minutes just watching NPCs exist. EXIST. That’s world-building dominance.

The story? Absolutely unhinged in the best way. Deep, emotional, philosophical, tragic, funny, angry, tender — sometimes all in the same conversation. Cyberpunk 2077 doesn’t ask shallow questions like “good vs evil.” It asks “What is identity when your soul can be copied?” and then punches you in the chest with it. The writing is razor-sharp, unapologetically human, and brave enough to let things be messy. Choices don’t just branch — they linger. They sit with you. They haunt you.

And Johnny Silverhand. Are you kidding me? Keanu Reeves didn’t just act — he possessed this role. Johnny is chaotic, brilliant, broken, infuriating, charismatic, and painfully real. The dynamic between Johnny and V is one of the most compelling relationships I’ve ever experienced in gaming. It evolves. It breathes. It hurts. I cared. Deeply.

The characters across the board are absurdly good. Judy, Panam, River, Kerry — these aren’t side quests, these are fully realized human beings with dreams, flaws, and emotional gravity. Their arcs feel intimate, personal, and earned. When they laugh, you smile. When they hurt, you feel it in your gut. Cyberpunk 2077 respects the player enough to let relationships grow naturally instead of gamifying emotions.

Let’s talk gameplay, because wow. The freedom is intoxicating. You want to be a katana-wielding cyber-ninja? Done. A stealthy netrunning god who melts brains from across the room? Say less. A chrome-plated guns-blazing psychopath? Welcome home. The builds are deep, flexible, and insanely fun, and the combat feels weighty, stylish, and endlessly replayable. Every encounter feels like your encounter.

The music deserves its own shrine. The soundtrack is a flawless blend of industrial, synth, punk, and melancholy that doesn’t just play — it defines the soul of the game. Cruising through Night City at night with the radio on is pure transcendence. There are moments where the music hits so perfectly that you forget you’re playing a game and just exist in the vibe.

Visually? Unreal. Jaw-dropping. Insane. The lighting, the character animations, the rain on chrome, the way neon reflects off wet streets — Cyberpunk 2077 is art. It’s a screenshot generator. A mood board. A city that looks just as good at 3 AM as it does at noon, which is exactly how it should be.

But what truly elevates Cyberpunk 2077 is its soul. This game has something to say. About power. About freedom. About capitalism. About technology. About what it means to be human in a world that treats people like hardware. It’s bold. It’s raw. It doesn’t play it safe. And that ambition radiates from every corner.

Cyberpunk 2077 is flawed, fearless, beautiful, and unforgettable — just like Night City itself. It’s a game that sticks with you long after the credits roll. A game you think about randomly. A game you miss when you’re not playing it.

In short:
Cyberpunk 2077 is a masterpiece.
A neon-drenched, emotionally devastating, endlessly stylish triumph that I will defend, replay, and fanboy over forever.

Cyberpunk 2077 is like a fever dream I had of all the cyberpunk movies from the 80s and 90s mixed into one: Johnny Mnemonic, Strange Days, Blade Runner, Akira.

The strongest features of Cyberpunk 2077, and the things that most likely earned it its dedicated fanbase, are the characters and world-building. The devs clearly went far to flesh out the characters you meet, and many of them have questlines where you continue to work together. The quality of dialogue varies greatly from quest to quest, but it is good in places. The world is very detailed, especially the back alleys of the God-forsaken Night City. Following the disastrous launch, many patches have been released to fix the game up, and it now has mod support. On the surface, the game seems pretty full-featured.

Unfortunately, once you really start playing and step out of the main story to have some open-world fun, the game shows just how underbaked it still is, even after all the patches and fan-made mods. Cars randomly crash into one another, especially police cars that arrive after the wanted level gets high enough. Features are missing that seem like they were once intended to be included. For example, one of the quest lines abruptly ends after introducing a major conspiracy. All NPCs disappear from a location where you just completed a mission a minute ago.

Fixers give you side jobs, and you get them as contacts in your phone, so you’d think that you would have to call one of them to get a job. Nope. Going to the fixer’s office also does nothing. It turns out there are exclamation marks on the map. Those are the jobs. You have to get close enough to one of those locations, and a fixer calls you out of nowhere. The devs just didn’t fully tie the side quests to the NPCs in the world or to your phone.

The menus are messy and somewhat random. The various leveling and perk systems can be confusing and disjointed. I constantly felt like I needed a manual to figure out how the game works. For example, at one point I got a grenade and was trying to figure out where to get more. It turns out the grenade is a rechargeable item! In what world? The ammo for guns isn’t rechargeable. What sense does this make?

On a more personal note, there are some issues I have with the story and the characters, which are worth discussing. It’s no secret that the origins of the cyberpunk genre lie in a dislike of corporations, globalism, and technology. This is very visible in the plot, the characters, and the way quests are guided. It means that if you want meaningful narrative choices, you’re mostly out of luck. If you want to play a cool guy in a suit working for a corporation, you’re out of luck. You can choose a character with a “corpo” background, but then you get fired within the first 10 minutes of the game, and for the rest of it you’re being preached to about how evil companies are. The quests often emphasize emotions over reasoning and realism.

There is the character of Johnny Silverhand, played by Keanu Reeves, who accompanies you for most of the game. He is a raging alcoholic, drug addict, anarchist, and a terrorist (one of the “cyberpsychos,” as the game calls them), but the devs also designed him as a cool rock star with hot girlfriends and a big… gun. Even though you can ignore Johnny most of the time, the dialogue choices increasingly indicate that the devs intended for you to talk to him and become buddies, as if this guy is some misunderstood hero deserving of forgiveness. Johnny is not a good person, yet his and other characters’ anti-corporate rhetoric is somehow meant to be seen as an excuse for their bonkers behavior.

This even carries to the main character V himself, whose goal of survival is admirable, but all the damage he does and all the people he kills or causes to die on his path to find a cure for himself clearly makes him a villain.

So, whenever Cyberpunk 2077 is being most true to its Neuromancer roots, that’s when I get most annoyed by its story and dialogue. The art is great, but the politics are horrendous.

The quest writing is all over the place—some good, some bad. There is this side quest where you follow a wife suspected of cheating. What would this normally entail? A private detective follows the person, makes notes and recordings, then reports back to the client, right? He would certainly not let himself be seen, let alone talk to the target, right? But that’s exactly what the game makes you do. Not only that, but the dialogue choices don’t correspond to the events they cause.

The graphics are a mixed bag. The art is a strong point of the game. Night City’s busy Asian-themed back alleys look great. With the right NPC density, the streets look alive. Characters are well animated. But the graphical fidelity is rather average. You can find videos on YouTube where this game looks like real life, but that’s with heavy modding on extreme hardware. That is not how your game is going to look. The performance is mediocre, so even with a brand-new machine in 2026, I am still not able to play the base game with maximum settings, let alone with heavy graphic mods.

This game is incredibly slow.  I understand the desire for world building, but in the hour I had to play today I had like 3 or 4 conversations in game.  That was it.  No intervening action or breaks for something else.  Just minute after minute of unskippable dialog and accompanying slow movement.  Maybe if I were a full time streamer or someone else with dozens of hours a week to dedicate to exploring the world, I'd have a higher opinion, but as things stand I can't recommend this one.  It's just too much setup for not enough payoff.

And wow, it gets even worse as time goes by.  I'd estimate that maybe ten percent of the time I've spent in this game is time I've spent doing something active or interesting, and the rest of it has been travelling from place to place and slogging through conversation after unskippable conversation.  In addition, most set pieces (maybe all?) so far have removed all my equipped weapons before the action started, so all that time I spent figuring out which specific rifle and blade matched the style I wanted to play, customized with scopes and silencers and all the cool stuff that was going to match my stealthy cyber assassin, was completely wasted.  Instead, I had to use my bare hands or whatever random weapons I could find lying around or take from enemies.

Man, this game is such a bummer, because there's a really cool game inside it.  There are a lot of potentially fun mechanics and tons of character customization.  And none of that matters, because the game is boring.

Overall it is a game I think everyone should play at least once, and definitely worthy of your money, along with the DLC.

Как человек, что ждал эту игру ещё с того самого показа демо, у меня были ожидания, что Cyberpunk 2077 подарит мне незабываемый опыт. И отчасти так оказалось. Но есть нюанс...
Начать хочется с сюжета. Написан он хорошо, персонажи прописаны прекрасно, чего уж стоит Джонни Сильверхенд, которым действительно проникаешься. Концовок предостаточно, но они в целом дают безысходность, привычную для жанра киберпанка. Геймплейные ситуации в сюжетных квестах разнообразны. То вы используйте брейданс ради расследования или планирования операции, то вы стелсом проникаете в тыл врага, то вы штурмуете Арасака - Тауэр.
Ролевая составляющая в игре... Ну... Она явно присутствует. Но это уже многое обсосали. Если на что ваши статы и влияют, то скорее на билд, а не отыгрыш. Хотя, справедливости ради, какие - то квесты, как основные, так и дополнительные, можно закончить по - разному. 
Занятия в Найт - Сити. А вот тут уже всё очень спорно. Если вы хотите закрыть игру на 100%, то большую часть времени вы будете: убивать, убивать и ещё раз убивать. Дополнительных квестов не то, чтобы слишком много, да и добрая их часть короткая. Заказы фиксеров иногда дают необычные геймплейные ситуации, но вот именно, что иногда. Из - за такого качества контента, доступного в Найт - Сити, по завершению игры у меня было чувство пустоты. Если ещё в начале я удивлялся масштабу местного города будущего, его детализации, его жителям, то перед финальным квестом я попросту перестал во всё это верить. Ни в Нью Вегасе, ни в Кингдом Каме после зачистки контента у меня не было этого ощущения пустоты. А вот в Cyberpunk 2077 есть.
В общем и в целом, этот проект можно смело назвать хорошим, я могу легко понять людей, что считают данную игру шедевроом, а то и современной классикой, но это мнение лично я никак не смогу разделить. Уж слишком сильно во мне чувство фальши в Найт - Сити, уж слишком не хватило мне дополнительных квестов. Потому я надеюсь, что в сиквеле Рэды углубятся в то, что они лучше всего умеют - в качественную писанину.

 [h2]ПЛЮСЫ:[/h2]

今までプレイしたオープンワールドゲームの中で一番面白かった。面白過ぎて三種類の素性それぞれで一回りしました。つまり三週しました。
　最も良かったのは移動がスムーズな点。走るのはもちろん、二段ジャンプや回避などのモーションも素早く、従来のオープンワールドと違ってもっさり感を一切感じないので操作してて楽しかった。
　それにオープンワールドのネックとなりがちな移動手段について、近距離なら二段ジャンプして回避すると慣性でぶっ飛んで行くので走るよりも快適で早く、道路に面していればボタン一つで車やバイクを呼び出せるので長距離もそれほど苦にならなかった。FTポータルもそれなりに配置されているので一度発見しなければならないという制約はあるもののそれなりにスムーズな体験を得られた。

　本作はレベル製のポイント割り振り型で、OWにありがちな能力値で選択肢が解放されるタイプ。これは会話だけに限らず、扉をこじ開けるとか、ロックを解除したりするのにも必要になる。一度だけ振り直し可能。
　ポイントを割り振っていくと段階的にスキルが解放されて、それらを得る事でプレイフィールがより快適になっていく。こちらは何度でも振り直し可能。

　サイバーパンクという世界観柄、敵として出てくるのは人間やサイボーグ、ドローンなどの未来的なものでばかりで動物等はいない。

　プレイスタイルについては大きく分けて四つ。
・敵をハッキングして倒すスタイル
・ガンナースタイル
・脳筋
・隠密暗殺スタイル
　とあり、どのスタイルも特色があって面白い。ビルドによっては二つくらいは兼用できるし、全部平均して振っても攻略はどうとでもなるので後悔などはしないと思う。それに装備によっては自動で回復アイテムを使ってくれたりクールダウン制の蘇生装備もあるのでかなり死に辛い。

　当初はバグや最適化不足で炎上していたようだが、自分が出会ったバグは特定の条件下で特定のポータルにアクセスするとゲームが落ちるという一か所だけでそれ以外は気付かず、全イベントをこなしてエンディングも全て見れたので進行不可能になるようなバグに出会う可能性は低いと思われる。

　結論としてファーストパーソンゲームにありがちな動きもっさりしててウザい、使ってて楽しくないという印象を綺麗に払しょくしてくれた良いゲームだった。またゲームシステムとして前述したハッキング画面に鑑定のような効果があり、拾えるアイテムを表示してくれるのも優しい仕様だと思った。
　サイバーパンク077はOWに飽きていても一度触ってみるのも面白いかもしれない。

操作上挺好玩的（虽然你不能说这是多么大的创新，但这确实是某种意义上的还算可玩的游戏机制的合订本），但是数值膨胀太厉害了，难度曲线设计非常糟糕，敌人没啥特色，所以变得没那么好玩。dlc的两条线我认为在游戏性上是有所提升的，难度也高了一些。载具手感和默认键位都是一坨屎，但是这都算小问题吧。哦对了新手开荒只推荐极难或者困难难度，再低的难度和割草差不多，本人fps苦手这句话绝不是为了装b，真的是rpg允许玩家叠数值导致的通病。或者说开荒低难度后面调高也可以。

本体叙事很平庸无聊，能燃起来但也就燃一燃了。dlc的主线和委托都设计的很精细，鸟和李德的塑造比主线的什么杰克强尼帕南强多了，本体主线角色几乎没有来自自身历史的痕迹，行动缺乏必然性，过于样板戏了。而故事本身，很赛博，很朋克，但是不怎么赛博朋克，即使dlc确实讲了一个好故事，但是仍然不如边缘行者。不得不说还是东亚壬或者美国佬来写控制论社会比较对味

大量的对话和小剧情藏在对话和分离芯片里，这样的塑造见仁见智吧，我个人觉得是很奢侈的，但是每个小故事又通常不会用心到值得强迫玩家看完过场动画的水平。事实上后者正是这游戏最缺乏的，大部分支线费劲儿清干净了还是记不住名字也对角色没啥塑造。缺乏草蛇灰线的惊喜。委托量大而大部分没啥营养，我觉得都能像Papers Please一样搞个无尽模式自动生成。我个人是不反对塞入大量低水平小任务的，但是取代不了精细的支线小人物塑造。

中文配音里只有牢维特别动听，强尼和李德算是能听，别的都挺糟糕的。人均普通话字正腔圆地讲一些不痛不痒的脏话真的听上去很难绷。想一想最大的问题其实是过场动画的时间和不同语言的时间对齐问题，中文用的语速低得不正常，绝对会不自然，也没啥好的解决办法，还是听英配罢。

自动驾驶系统作为一个半成品不该放出来，一个5年前的游戏一直有这么个半成品吊在外面实在是很不应该。所有看超梦找线索的任务都做的很粪，全都是找攻略过的，任务提示、趣味性和对于角色塑造的必要性都非常差，这种东西竟然还能反复出现个几次，设计者是觉得自己费劲巴拉搞的这套折磨玩家的系统很自豪吗，哪怕往里面塞点解谜要素呢。对话跳过系统我玩了一百多个小时没搞懂，有时候能跳，有时候不能跳，我眼瞅着有一些很重要的对话随便跳，反倒是不少和npc的无聊small talk强迫你一直看，这真的很诡异

有很多不满意之处，但是身体还是很诚实打了好几天，毕竟这个战斗系统的底子在这里，没事上号割割草杀杀暴恐机动队都能解压。而且就算不赛博朋克，至少它很赛博，也很朋克，我可以为了游戏的画风和爽点掏钱，但是我不会高呼这钱画的很值。塔罗牌倒是非常好看，这对我来说算是个很奇怪的加分点，打算otl入手一套游戏风格的塔罗牌。

哦对了玩这个游戏最好有个带侧键的鼠标，否则键位严重不够用。

[h1] Cyberpunk 2077 - качественная игра, просто не для всех [/h1]
Я провёл в Cyberpunk 2077 достаточно времени, чтобы составить впечатление, и могу сказать честно: игра сделана на высоком уровне, но лично для меня она просто не попала в мой любимый сеттинг.

[h2] Что сделано действительно хорошо [/h2]
[b]Night City[/b] - это одна из самых детализированных и атмосферных локаций в играх за последние годы. Город живёт своей жизнью: реклама, неон, архитектура, музыка - всё работает на погружение.

[b]Сюжет и персонажи[/b] заслуживают отдельного упоминания. Истории прописаны качественно, диалоги живые, а второстепенные квесты иногда цепляют даже сильнее основного сюжета. Некоторые персонажи действительно запоминаются надолго.

[h3] Геймплей и механики [/h3]
[u]Стрельба, прокачка и вариативность билдов[/u] сделаны добротно. Можно играть по-разному: скрытно, агрессивно, через хакинг или комбинацию всего сразу. Видно, что разработчики старались дать свободу выбора. После крупных обновлений игра стала ощущаться значительно стабильнее и приятнее, чем на релизе.

[h2] Почему игра не зашла лично мне [/h2]
[i]Это исключительно субъективно[/i], но киберпанк-сеттинг - не совсем моё. Несмотря на качество исполнения, мрачное будущее, корпорации и неоновая эстетика не смогли удержать меня надолго. Это не претензия к игре, а вопрос личных предпочтений.

[h2] Итог [/h2]
[b]Cyberpunk 2077 - это хорошая, качественная RPG[/b] с сильной атмосферой, интересными историями и большим объёмом контента. Если вам нравится киберпанк, научная фантастика и сюжетные игры - с большой вероятностью она вам зайдёт.

It took me 500+ hours to finally visit Hanako at Embers,  because I just did not want the main plot to end, for years. 
I started like 8 or 9 playthroughs (on the 4th different gaming PC now since the game released lol) in the last 5 years. And today, I FINALLY finished the Phantom Liberty storylines as well now.

And damn, some of the endings hit really hard. Great storytelling and emotional bonding with the characters.
While the credits rolled I felt "empty" like I did with Clair Obscure Expedition 33. 
Only a handful of games have *that* impact on me.

And we remember: 
Cyberpunk had a rough start at release, and while it was a Nvidia tech showcase very often, it now (Patcth 2.3 with Phantom Liberty content) became one of the best RPG gaming experiences ever, with easily 150+ hours of content if you play it the first time and try out the different endings.
They went from 70% bad reviews to 90% positive ones. That's a redemption arc if anything.

To be honest: Cyberpunk still is not perfect, not even close.
The two biggest negative aspects I personally found: 
1. The world's atmosphere and setting are great, but there are not really interactive encounters or ways and stuff to "explore". There are some eastereggs and neat lorepieces all over the world and some quests, but RDR2 and GTA V are on another level here.

2.) The illusion of choice: Only few decisions really matter , so it is not a "real" oldschool RPG

To bend it positively: There *are* some crucial choices that are fundamental for making Cyberpunk so replayable.
On top of that some side quests and missions are perfectly crafted, don't ignore those. And just be aware, there is some missable content if you do not get the timing of the quests triggers right. But that's a pro argument for another replay :)

TLDR: 
Today I finally finished all ~ 300 missions + jobs + gigs + NCPD stuff in one "final" run that I started over the last 2 months
And my verdict is this: 
CDPR did their part to push the boundaries of PC gaming; they did stuff wrong at release, they reworked content, they fixed the issues and delivered us a masterpiece of gaming.
It is a 10 of 10 game for me despite some flaws .
And it won't be my last run, mods are next I guess.

Wo soll ich anfangen... Es könnte ein wirklich gutes Speil sein.
-Tolle Story, abwechslungsreiche Quests, solides Gameplay, schöne Grafik, interessante Charaktere und Orte.
-Das Levelsystem ist cool und es macht Spaß, sich da auszutoben. Die vielen verschiedenen Waffen und Kampfmöglichkeiten sind Klasse!

Aaaaber es gibt so einen Haufen Nachteile, die mir den Spielspaß komplett zerhauen:
-Wer immer euch erzählt, dass das Spiel jetzt bug-, glitch-, fehler-, und crashfrei läuft, lügt schlicht und ergreifend einfach! Es ist das reinste Bugfest! Crasht immernoch regelmäßig und es ist eine absolut krank verglitchte Schei*e!
-Als nächstes ist die Fahrzeugsteuerung einfach nur übel und absolut inakzeptabel. Die Kameraeinstellungen sind Schrott, das Schießen aus dem Auto heraus ist kompletter und absolut hirnverbrannter Müll. Ich weiß nicht, wer sich sowas ausgedacht hat.
-Die Menüführung ist durchwachsen, geht also noch deutlich besser. Waffen und Gegenstände sortieren, markieren, vergleichen, wechseln usw, ist teilweise verwirrend und unübersichtlich.
-DAS TELEFON IM SPIEL NERVT ABSOLUT! Ich kann nicht beschreiben, wie mir diese PERMANENTEN Anrufe und Nachrichten auf den Sack gehen! Pausenlos wirst du von irgend jemanden angerufen oder angeschrieben. Oft wegen absolut NICHTS! Und wenn du neue Missionen bekommst und die falsche Taste drückst, wechselst du einfach mitten in einer Mission zur nächsten. Oh meine Fr*sse ist das ein Dreck.
-Du wirst von den Cops angegriffen, wenn du ihnen in einer Schießerei hilfst. Die fangen dann einfach an, auf dich zu ballern. Was zum Geier soll das!?
-Oh, versuche erst gar nicht zu schleichen, wenn du nicht genau darauf levelst. Jede noch so kleine Aktion wird bemerkt. Entweder ballerst du, oder du schleichst und hackst. Es gibt nichts dazwischen. Ich hab noch keinen Schleichkill geschafft, ohne dass es bemerkt wurde und sofort Chaos ausbrach.
- Edlos viel Gerede! Es wird soooo viel geredet, es ist unglaublich.

Zum Glück hab ich es im Sale bekommen. Aber 20 Euro waren immernoch zu viel dafür. Für nen 10er oder 15 Euro wärs ok gewesen. Das Spiel zum Vollpreis!? So viele Dr*gen kann man mir nicht geben, dass ich das tun würde.

Leider gibt es keinen neutralen Button. Denn es ist wirklich ein gutes Spiel. Leider gibt es zu viele Kleinigkeiten, die mir den Spaß daran versauen können. Deshalb kriegts den Daumen runter.

Visually the game is exceptionally good and the city has an amazing flair. The gameplay is decent. If this is what you are looking for, it is a great game.

But for me it is not the masterpiece that some people seem to see, because the story and the characters are mostly bland. I would go with a neutral rating, but as I personally think this is important for a Role Playing Game, [b]I focus my review soley on the story and characters[/b] and give it a negative rating. If this was a movie it would be one of those Marvel movies with amazing visuals, but you won't watch them for their plot.

Obviously, the following explanation contains mild spoilers.

[h3]The reason to hate Arasaka, the main story antagonist, is not communicated.[/h3]

You are doing jobs for other corpos, the government and violent gangs. Jackie, your best friend, is still associated with a local gang. There are enough reasons to hate the gangs or other corpos, because you see them do evil in side quests. But the game does not show you why you should hate Arasaka. From what you see, they seem to be the sheep amongst wolves. Meanwhile your character does not have a moral problem wearing cyberwear from Arasaka or other corps. This makes it hard to be hate Arasaka as a player and understand characters motivations.

[h3]There are too many characters without depth.[/h3]

98% of named characters you meet are nothing more than a one-line description from a tabletop RPG. 

Take Regina Jones for example. She is an ex media person with an eyepatch that made it her mission to help cyberpsychos. That's what you learn the first time you meet her and you won't learn anything else after doing 25 missions for her. 

Or Viktor Vektor, your local ripperdoc. The game wants to establish him as a caring father figure. He calls first after finishing the main story. But all I know of him is that he is a nice guy and a former boxer who lives in the neighborhood and calls me sometimes during main missions. 

It would have been better to have less characters with more depth instead. Notable exceptions are the 4 potential love interests and a car.

[h3]Suspending disbelief is hard at times.[/h3]

Johnny seems to know everything and explains the world to V eventhough he has been locked away for the last 50 years and can't see anything that V does not. Why is he so certain that NC is still the same as back in his time? Why should I trust him to give me an accurate view of the world? 50 years changed quite a lot in our timeline. 

Also 50 years after his death, Bartmoss' hacks are supposed to still be better than anything. Has technology not evolved? Has no corporation analysed his hacks and learned from them? 

I understand that most of this is fan service. But still it goes above credibility at times.

[h3]When taking certain decisions, the main story is hard to follow.[/h3]

Let me give two examples. 

First: When you do a job for the Voodoo Boys, you meet someone from Netwatch at the end. I had to search the internet what Netwatch and three other things were, because this was the first time it came up in the game and it seemed important. As in-character I had no reason to believe this guy I knocked him out early in our conversation. After that I went unconcious and woke up at a different spot. I had no clue why that happened, because the game did not give an explanation even later on. Had I heard the netwatch guy out, I would have understood what happened. But why does the game give an option to knock him out early, if this skips an important part of the main story? 

Second: I went for the secret ending first. When I had to make the final decision, I was lost. 50 hours in-game earlier someone explained what the plan there was, but I could not remember it. This felt unsatisfying, as the game ended and I had no clue what I just did. There are other endings, that give the same decision, but they give a wrap up before. But if you choose this path, you won't get it.

[h3]Decisions are irrelevant.[/h3]

Adding to the point above, the game gives options sometimes, that seem relevant, but have no relevance. It has been critisized often, but choosing your background changes the first hour of gameplay, but nothing beyond that. You can also directly decide if you trust Johnny or not in the last mission from the same savegame. How you acted towards him earlier in the game does not really matter. These design decisions by the developers have the consequences that many things have to be vague throughout the game. But this also makes it harder to relate for me as a player, because V and Johnny have to be everything and nothing at the same time.

I have the feeling it would have been better to be more railroaded in a way similar to RDR2, where you have less direct decisions, but your decisions throughout the game decide how your character develops and what ending you get. This might have led to a better story arc, where you feel your relation with Johnny improve over time if you trust him. But as it is, he feels like a pita the whole time and I never came to a point where I understood his intentions.

All in all, this game feels as if most of the story and character work was invested in Act 1, which is about 6 hours long. After that story telling and character design degrades.
This game will make you want to storm your country's Arasaka Tower equivalent :)

Cyberpunk 2077.
I remember the hype surrounding this game before it released. I remember the mess it was, the disappointment, the refunds.

But CDPR did not stop there. Over the years, the game improved. Content was added, features delivered, bugs fixed. In time, a DLC was released, expanding the game even further.

I bought the game during a sale, on a whim. It landed in my backlog, like so many other titles.
Friends and family members played the game and urged me to give it a try.

And so I did. In summer 2025, I arrived in Night City. And for the coming months, I played nothing else.

In short, this game is undoubtedly a masterpiece.
It oozes atmosphere, the world feels so very much alive and you, the player, so very much a part of it.
The storytelling - the story itself - is simply brilliant. I don't remember a game in which I felt so utterly invested, in which I just wanted to know what happens next. It pulls you in and never lets go.

The soundtrack is outstanding. I have added so many tracks to my personal playlist I lost count.

The DLC adds just so much. A new area, a gripping spy movie-like storyline, new endings, items, side missions. Do yourself a favor and always grab the Ultimate Edition, if you can. It is worth every cent you spend on it.

I played the game exclusively on my Steam Deck.
Graphically, it looks amazing and is terrifingly well optimized. Of course, if you seek to enjoy the horrors and beauty of Night City in all their glory, you should use a more capable system.
Technically, I still encountered some very minor bugs and experienced in total three crashes. Nothing game-breaking, nothing too annoying.

All in all, I loved every second I spent in Night City. I did almost everything there is to do.
For now, I need a break. But I have already planned my second playthrough, what my V should look like, what I will do differently next time. It is one of those games, you can play again and again and again, like a more modern Skyrim.

Everyone should experience this masterpiece.

Cyberpunk 2077 — несомненно лучшая игра, в которую я играл.

Она заставляет испытать целый спектр эмоций: от тревоги, безысходности, давления и постоянного чувства опасности — до искренней любви и сопереживания тем, кого ты ещё пару минут назад реально ненавидел. Игра очень чётко даёт понять, что никакого абсолютного добра и зла не существует, и любое твоё решение не будет правильным на 100%.

Одна из самых сильных сторон — атмосфера. Ей пропитан буквально каждый уголок Найт-Сити. Она везде: в музыке по радио в машине (одна из самых удачно подобранных вообще в истории игр), в окружении, в визуальном стиле, в общем ощущении города. Найт-Сити не просто декорация, он давит, живёт своей жизнью и вообще не подстраивается под игрока.

Отдельно удивляет вариативность боёвки. Это не просто «пистолет, винтовка и удушение». Можно катаной отбивать пули, стрелять во время рывка или подката, кидать ножи, драться киберимплантами в ближнем бою. Я уже молчу про нетранера — там вообще можно творить дичь и выносить врагов, даже не подходя к ним вплотную, например заставить чела убить себя или атаковать своих же. 

Больше всего мне нравится вайб киберпанка именно в плане NPC и сюжета. Ты постоянно находишься в напряжении, всегда ждёшь, что тебя могут кинуть, никому не доверяешь на 100% и взвешиваешь открыться ли этому NPC или нет. Это реально пробивает на эмоции, и в какой-то момент ты просто забываешь, что это игра.

Что касается NPC: идея засунуть Джонни Сильверхенда в голову Ви — гениальная. Это куда лучше, чем если бы он был просто очередным дружеским персонажем. Ты вынужден считаться с его мнением и выходками, влиять на него и при этом следить, чтобы он не навредил тебе. Прикольно, что он непредсказуем — никогда не знаешь, похвалит он тебя или наоборот осудит. Он как моральный компас, который не всегда совпадает с твоим мнением, но часто заставляет задуматься.

Круто и то, как игра со временем заставляет изменить отношение к Джонни. Да и в целом Cyberpunk постоянно показывает вещи с разных сторон, из-за чего ты начинаешь смотреть на происходящее более объёмно, без чёрно-белого восприятия.

Сюжет основной игры — это смесь боевика и личной трагедии. История, в которой нет хорошего финала. Как говорил Декстер Дешон: либо смерть в лучах славы, либо тихая жизнь. И очень сильно цепляет то, как игра показывает, что нет ничего вечного — сегодня ты в Высшей Лиге, а завтра ты уже никто.

Дополнение.

К Phantom Liberty я изначально относился как к очередному дорогому и пустому DLC, пока не купил его.

На деле дополнение спокойно может тягаться с основной игрой и оставляет не меньше эмоций. После финала ты ещё долго прокручиваешь всё в голове и думаешь: а мог ли я здесь поступить лучше, сделать что-то по-другому?

Сюжет — самая сильная сторона DLC, и дело даже не в шпионской истории в стиле Джеймса Бонда. Сойка в какой-то степени отражает самого Ви — она ищет помощь и не может её найти. К ней легко проникнуться симпатией, и даже понимая ближе к концу, что она тебя кинет, всё равно хочется ей доверять и помочь.

С другой стороны Рид. Чел, который страдает от моральных последствий собственных решений. Он хочет всем сделать лучше, но в итоге не может помочь даже себе. Вообще все персонажи во вселенной Cyberpunk неоднозначные, и именно это мне в них нравится. Здесь невозможно однозначно сказать, кто прав, а кто нет, поэтому каждый выбор приходится делать осторожно.

Итог.

Cyberpunk 2077 — это очень удачная смесь красоты окружения, стиля, вайба, гениальной музыки, звуков окружения, харизматичных NPC со своей историей и реально сильного сюжета.

Это не просто игра.
Это целый мир.

历经打磨优化，如今的《赛博朋克 2077》早已蜕变为一款名副其实的赛博朋克沉浸式神作。
夜之城是游戏的灵魂所在，六大区域从光鲜摩天楼到破败贫民窟，层次分明又充满烟火气。全息广告闪烁、义体行人穿梭，完美诠释 “高科技、低生活” 的核心调性，随机事件与 NPC 故事更让这座城市鲜活立体。
剧情上，雇佣兵 V 与强尼・银手的共生羁绊张力拉满，三种出身开局、多分支抉择、多结局设定，搭配朱迪、帕南等一众鲜活角色，让每一次冒险都充满专属感。无固定职业限制，枪械、黑客、义体改造自由搭配，可玩性直接拉满。

La primera run que hice de este juego fue con male V y fue buenísima. Sentí que lo jugué un poco apresurado, pero ahí lo dejé. Unos meses después estaba aburrido y empecé de nuevo otra run con female V y pensé que sería algo pasajero. Qué iluso. El juego me volvió a atrapar y me sumergí de lleno en Night City, al punto que me propuse desbloquear todos los logros. El juego es una maravilla narrativa: detalles pequeños, nombres de misiones con títulos de canciones y sutiles guiños a la cultura pop, a otros juegos o series de TV. Johnny Silverhand es uno de esos personajes agrios que siempre te tira la mierda por toda la cara y piensas que nunca cambiará, y sin darte cuenta él se está lamentando y asustado de que ya no estará ahí para ti. En pocas palabras, Ciberpunk es uno de esos juegos que te cambian por completo mientras avanzas con la historia; es una maravilla y chingue su madre Yorinonu Arasaka.

Cyberpunk 2077 is a highly controversial blockbuster that stumbled out of the gate but made a stunning comeback later. After multiple updates and the release of its DLC Phantom Liberty, it has evolved into a benchmark for cyberpunk-themed games, ideal for story-driven players and world-building enthusiasts.
 
Core Highlights
 
- Immersive Worldbuilding: The neon-lit streets, cybernetic enhancements, and holographic advertisements of Night City create a top-tier cyberpunk atmosphere, with exceptionally high-quality Chinese voice acting that takes immersion to the next level.

- Compelling Narrative & Characters: The symbiotic consciousness struggle between V and Johnny Silverhand is intensely gripping. Multiple endings are influenced by side quests, with key side stories featuring rich plots and movie-grade cutscenes.

- Revamped Gameplay & Updates: The 2.0 update overhauled skills, cyberware, and combat, enabling diverse playstyles (hacker, stealth, melee, etc.). The DLC Phantom Liberty boasts outstanding quality, with significantly improved optimization.

- Stunning Visuals & Music: Enhanced by ray tracing, the game delivers breathtaking graphics, especially shining in rainy nights and nightclub lighting effects. The electronic soundtrack perfectly fits the setting, amplifying the immersive experience.
 
Key Shortcomings
 
- Sense of Content Incompleteness: The main storyline is relatively short, with a large number of "cookie-cutter" gigs padding the open world, and some area designs failing to reach their full potential.

- Lack of Combat Depth: Once players master their preferred playstyle in the late game, combat becomes overly easy; AI and stealth mechanics are relatively simplistic, leading to a drop in challenge.

- Lingering Legacy Issues: Despite fixes for the disastrous bugs and poor optimization at launch, minor glitches still persist. Some systems (such as the police mechanism) remain poorly designed.

Cyberpunk 2077 – Geç Gelen Özür, Güçlü Bir Dönüş

Cyberpunk 2077, muhtemelen oyun tarihinin en olaylı çıkışlarından birine sahip. Çıkış günü yaşananlar malum: bug’lar, performans sorunları, yarım hissi veren mekanikler… Ancak aradan geçen zaman, gelen büyük güncellemeler ve ek paketlerle birlikte oyun bugünkü halinde bambaşka bir noktaya ulaşmış durumda. Artık “ne olabilirdi” değil, “ne oldu” üzerinden konuşmak gerekiyor.

Oyunun en güçlü tarafı kesinlikle atmosferi. Night City sadece büyük bir harita değil; gerçekten yaşayan, nefes alan bir şehir gibi hissettiriyor. Neon ışıklar, reklam panoları, dar arka sokaklar, yüksek binalar ve arka planda sürekli akan bir kaos hissi var. Bazı anlarda bir göreve gitmek yerine arabayı kenara çekip şehri izlediğim oldu. Oyun bunu başarabiliyorsa, doğru bir şey yapıyor demektir.
Night City, sadece görevden göreve koşulan bir alan değil; keşfetmeyi seven oyuncular için detaylarla dolu bir oyun alanı. Haritada işaretlenmeyen küçük hikayeler, sokak aralarında rastlanan yan karakterler ve çevresel anlatım oyunun dünyasını daha inandırıcı kılıyor. Bazı binaların içine girip sadece etrafa bakmak bile Cyberpunk evreninin karanlık tonunu hissettirmeye yetiyor. Özellikle ilk kez oynayanlar için keşif hissi oldukça güçlü.

Şehirdeki bölgeler birbirinden net şekilde ayrılıyor. Zengin semtlerle fakir mahalleler arasındaki fark sadece görsel değil, atmosfer olarak da hissediliyor. Bu detaylar, oyunun distopik temasını daha da güçlendiriyor. Night City bazen güzel, bazen rahatsız edici, bazen de doğrudan depresif hissettirebiliyor ve bunu bilinçli olarak yapıyor.

Hikaye ve karakterler tarafında Cyberpunk 2077 oldukça iddialı. Ana hikaye, klasik “dünya kurtarma” klisesinden ziyade daha kişisel bir anlatım sunuyor. V karakterinin yaşadığı iç çatışma, Johnny Silverhand ile olan ilişkisi ve bu ikilinin zamanla gelişen dinamikleri oyunu sürükleyen ana unsur. Keanu Reeves’in performansı genel olarak başarılı; bazı sahnelerde sahneyi resmen ele geçiriyor, bazı yerlerde ise biraz fazla konuşkan olduğu düşünülebilir. Yine de karaktere uyuyor.

Yan görevler de en az ana hikaye kadar özenli. Hatta bazı yan görev zincirleri, ana hikayeden bile daha etkileyici olabiliyor. Karakterlerin arka planları, seçimlerin verdiği küçük ama anlamlı sonuç farkları oyunun rol yapma tarafını güçlendiriyor. Her seçim dünyayı alt üst etmese de “boşuna seçmedim” hissini veriyor.

Oynanış tarafında oyun, oyuncuya ciddi bir özgürlük tanıyor. Silahlı ağırlıklı, yakın dövüş, gizlilik ya da tamamen hacker odaklı şekilde oynayabiliyorsunuz. Build çeşitliliği gayet başarılı. Bir oynanışta düşmanları uzaktan hack’leyip yere yığarken, diğerinde siber kolunla dalıp ortalığı dağıtmak mümkün. Silah çeşitliliği tatmin edici ve gunplay, şu anki haliyle gayet akıcı.

Grafikler ve teknik taraf, oyunun belki de en çok konuşulan kısmı. Özellikle ray tracing açıkken Night City gerçekten görsel bir şölen sunuyor. Işıklandırma, yansımalar ve gece sahneleri oldukça etkileyici. Tabii bunun bir bedeli var: güçlü bir sistem istiyor. Optimizasyon eskisine göre çok daha iyi ama düşük sistemlerde hala ayarlarla oynamak gerekebiliyor.

Ver müzüğüü:

Cyberpunk 2077’nin müzikleri oyunun atmosferine ciddi katkı sağlıyor. Araba sürerken radyodan gelen parçalar, çatışma anlarındaki tempo ve sakin sahnelerde kullanılan arka plan müzikleri oldukça başarılı. Müzikler çoğu zaman sahnenin duygusunu yükseltiyor, hatta bazı görevleri daha akılda kalıcı hale getiriyor.

Seslendirme tarafında da genel kalite yüksek. Ana karakterler ve önemli yan karakterler duyguyu iyi aktarıyor. Arka plandaki şehir sesleri, kalabalık hissi ve mekanlara göre değişen ambiyans sesleri Night City’nin canlı görünmesine yardımcı oluyor. 作为没有经历过首发暴死的玩家，在往日之影出了之后，赛博朋克2077已经算的上是一部非常优秀的3A大作了。没有了首发那么多的bug，没有了糟糕的优化，现在的2077带给我们的就是一个活生生的夜之城，以及夜之城中许多栩栩如生的角色。行走在这座不夜城中，社会百态尽显眼前，与角色们的故事也更加引人入胜。有关心咱们的老维，有好兄弟杰克，有朱迪，帕南，以及夜之城的传奇强尼银手，还有我们的活传奇V。  
       说是活传奇，其实夜之城就没有活着的传奇，V从和银手共生之时就已经是个死人了。但是V没有选择死的像个无名小卒，而是选择死得名扬天下。从一路杀出荒坂塔，好兄弟杰克牺牲，到被竹村救活，为了自己能活下去不惜历经千难万险，劫持华子小姐的花车，认识了很多朋友；从踏进狗镇救总统，为了让百灵鸟获得真正的自由而努力，到和强尼一起再次杀进荒坂塔，最后不得不在自己和强尼之间选择一个灵魂活下去。他的故事已经超越了强尼，已经成为了传遍全夜之城的传说。而我们非常幸运能够体验到这样一个传奇人物的一生，能够做一回V震天。
游戏目前优化很不错，我玩的时候没有出现什么bug(i9+4060)，画面非常惊艳，但是需要好一点的配置，剧情设计很有深度(特别是往日之影)，枪械手感还不错，就是载具驾驶非常飘，所有的支线主线任务都设计的很好，没有特别多重复的(除非你要清地图上的ncpd任务)，真正的次时代大作，值得入手体验，不过建议打折了再买完全版(往日之影必买)。

本体是真的烂，2020年的游戏大街上的路人连一个有效的互动都没有，画面好，内核糙得就像4399小游戏。20年前的博德之门2、暗黑2在21世纪之初开了个好头，过了20年不进反退我是真没想到。游戏一开始三条线的区别竟然只存在于序章，第一章找漩涡帮的任务线之后再也没有这么高完成度的任务，结尾所有的故事都没讲完。强尼银手到底想干什么？亚当重锤铺垫这么多竟然只是打一架完事？蓝眼睛是什么？V到底从哪儿来到哪儿去？搞不清楚CDPR想干嘛，DLC才是完整的游戏该有的样子，但是依然不能改变半成品的本质。

Cyberpunk 2077 se siente como una historia sobre vivir con el objetivo de dejar una huella y que, aún así, no estás seguro de estar viviendo como realmente quieres. No es solo el miedo a morir, sino a llegar al final y darte cuenta de que nunca fuiste del todo tú.

La historia de V gira alrededor del tiempo que se acaba, y el juego te recuerda constantemente que no tienes el control total de tu cuerpo ni de tu destino. Silverhand no es solo una voz en tu cabeza, también es una presencia incómoda que te obliga a pensar quién eres, qué queda de ti y si realmente vale la pena ser recordado. Y en un punto, la pregunta no es si V va a morir, sino qué hará con el tiempo que le queda.

La ciudad intenta compensar su falta de humanidad con luces y tecnología, pero más temprano que tarde te exprime. Todo gira alrededor del consumo, el estatus y la venta de una versión falsa de libertad. En Night City, hay gente que nace perdiendo, casi nadie tiene un final digno y el juego nunca intenta esconderlo. Muchas misiones secundarias reflejan esto mejor que la historia principal, mostrando personajes rotos, decisiones sin salida y finales que no se sienten bien, pero sí reales.

El juego no romantiza la idea de “dejar huella”. De hecho, considero q la pone en duda. Te muestra que ser recordado no siempre significa haber vivido bien, y que muchas personas que intentaron cambiarlo todo terminaron igual de vacías o rotas. Por eso el foco no está en salvar la ciudad ni en volverte una leyenda, sino en no traicionarte del todo en el proceso.

El juego me dejó pensando en lo fácil que es convertirse en uno más, y en lo desesperante que es intentar evitarlo cuando el tiempo no está de tu lado. Es una idea que me encanta, porque incluso en la actualidad, se me presentan diferentes golpes de ansiedad por dejar una marca en un mundo que no se detiene por nadie.
Golpes en los que me doy cuenta de que estoy viviendo en una cuenta regresiva constante, y nace la presión por hacer que mi vida valga algo antes de desaparecer.

Je vais aller droit au but : vous devez jouer à ce jeu une fois dans votre vie. 
Pour éviter d'avoir de faux espoirs : lancez le jeu sans avoir d'attentes particulières et profitez de ce qu'il a à offrir. 
ATTENTION ! J'estime que c'est un jeu qui s'apparente plus à un film interactif plutôt qu'un énième jeu de tir banal. Je pense que le temps de jeu se décompose de la façon suivante : 75% dans des dialogues et cinématiques avec prises de décisions. 25% dans les combats, infiltrations et explorations.
Le doublage français est sublime, donc aucune raison de ne pas en profiter !
Je vous conseille même de jouer sans les sous-titres pour s'immerger au maximum dans l'univers et admirer le travail fait sur l'environnement, les personnages, les voix et les animations.

Si vous voulez plus de détails, vous pouvez lire les points suivants.

Les points que j'ai aimé :
- Des sujets importants, concrets (et ignobles) de notre société sont mis en lumières (des sujets plus légers et drôles sont aussi de la partie)
- L'ambiance cyberpunk et de Night City sont au rendez-vous jusque dans les moindres détails
- Le scénario est génial
- Une VF exceptionnelle
- La prise de décisions et l'impact de celles-ci se ressentent dans le jeu
- Les relations que l'on créé avec les différents personnages sont super
- Le gameplay est très bon et offre différents styles de combats (discrétion / hacking / armes à feu / armes au corps à corps...)
- Le système d'implants pour s'améliorer renforce l'immersion dans l'univers

Les points négatifs :
- Quelques bugs mineurs mais ils n'ont pas impactés mon expérience au global
- Il faut une bonne machine pour le faire tourner avec suffisamment de FPS et une excellente qualité graphique (notamment dans la zone du DLC)
- Par moment, j'ai eu la sensation que les animations labiales étaient moins bien travaillés dans les missions du DLC.

J'ai hâte de découvrir le prochain opus.

Сексуальное наси́лие — любое принудительное сексуальное действие или использование сексуальности другого человека. Сексуальное насилие происходит во всём мире, хотя в большинстве стран по этой проблеме проводится недостаточно исследований[1]. Скрытый характер сексуального насилия затрудняет оценку масштаба явления[2].

По исследованиям, проведённым в ЮАР и Танзании, приблизительно каждая четвёртая женщина подвергается сексуальному насилию со стороны интимного партнёра и около трети девочек-подростков сообщают, что их первый сексуальный опыт был связан с принуждением[3][4][5].

Сексуальное насилие имеет серьёзные последствия для физического и психического здоровья. Оно не только вызывает физические травмы, но и увеличивает риск проблем с сексуальным и репродуктивным здоровьем, имеющих как немедленные, так и отдалённые последствия[6]. Его влияние на психическое здоровье может быть не менее серьёзным и продолжительным, чем физические последствия[7]. Сексуальное насилие может приводить к смерти в результате самоубийства, заражения ВИЧ-инфекцией или убийства, причём последнее может быть совершено во время сексуального нападения или позже, в форме убийства чести. Сексуальное насилие также может сильно влиять на социальное благополучие пострадавших, если они подвергаются стигматизации и остракизму, в частности, со стороны своих родственников и близких[8].

Насильственный сексуальный акт может приносить насильнику сексуальное удовлетворение, хотя его основная цель, как правило, состоит в утверждении власти и контроля над жертвой. Часто люди, принуждающие к сексу партнёров, с которыми они состоят в браке, считают свои действия допустимыми на этом основании. Изнасилование женщин и мужчин часто используется во время войны как форма атаки на противника, символизирующая покорение и унижение представляющих его женщин и мужчин[9]. Оно может также использоваться для наказания людей за нарушение социальных или моральных норм, например, за супружескую измену или нахождение в общественном месте в состоянии опьянения. Женщины и мужчины также подвергаются изнасилованиям, находясь под стражей или в тюремном заключении.

[h1] Love it or hate it, a 5/10 experience for me [/h1]

The problem with rating a game on Steam is that it is a Yes or No. Perhaps they should implement a "Meh" button too?

Overall, I felt that the game lacked anything beyond progressing through the story, occasionally taking a break from it to do side missions.

I did sometimes enjoy taking in the city views and the wonderful vistas I came across during my gameplay. I also appreciated the Easter eggs and cameo appearances like Nina Kraviz, Hideo Kojima, and others.

[h3] What people say about this game [/h3]

I read reviews before buying the game on sale a year ago and decided to give it a go. Most reviews were overwhelmingly positive, with players saying that this is THE GREATEST GAME and that THE DEVELOPERS REDEEMED THEMSELVES. I do not mind people loving this game and expressing their positive feelings about it. However, I feel like they are giving this game too much credit for what it actually is. The game is also still infested with bugs, even in side quests or fixer missions. For a game that has had massive updates, they still failed to keep it clean.

So I do not really get why people are calling this game truly great.

[h2] The Story and the Game [/h2]

No spoilers here, but story-wise I felt rather impartial about what the story was about, as it mostly revolves around tech talk, stealing the latest tech from big corporations, chips, implants, and similar themes. I did have fun playing fixer missions and side quests, and I appreciated the Easter eggs and encounters with famous faces.

The story itself is about V, the character you play. No matter which path you select at the beginning, it leads you to the same point. You are simply a mercenary doing jobs for fixers, trying to make it big in Night City. The only real difference lies in having some additional dialogue options.

I would not say there is much to this game beyond its side quests and stories. CDPR advertised a game centered around a massive city with overpromised world depth. While Night City looks impressive, it lacks reactive systems. This game is as wide as an ocean, but shallow as a puddle. Yes, that phrase is a reference to another infamous game with a horrible launch.

[h3] The illusion of choice and the shallow RPG system [/h3]

The game advertises itself as an RPG, but it is not. It only has a few RPG elements, such as limited dialogue choices when speaking to NPCs and leveling up to assign points to skills and attributes. The game is primarily about action. There are also no real consequences for the choices you make in the world, which makes everything feel indifferent. Your dialogue options and origin-specific dialogue have no meaningful impact on the world. At best, you get small advantages like increased rewards or the option to avoid combat, or engage in more combat, during certain encounters.

Your choices do not matter. NPC friends, contacts, fixers, and gang enemies do not react differently to you. For me, this is quite insulting when the game is marketed as an RPG.

Moment-to-moment gameplay feels serviceable, but rarely engaging. Gunplay works, but it lacks weight and tension, especially once you realize that most encounters can be handled in the same way regardless of your build. Enemies tend to behave predictably, and combat often turns into a straightforward shootout rather than something tactical or immersive.

No matter how you invest points into your skills, it does not truly support the type of build you are going for. You can usually break into any compound in any way you want, because there is almost always a missing fence, an open window, or a hatch that can be opened without needing high tech or brute-force skills. It is fine to offer multiple solutions, but when there is no real resistance, it raises the question of why builds matter at all.

Vehicle gameplay also feels inconsistent. Driving lacks weight, and vehicle combat feels clumsy and underutilized. For a game centered around a futuristic city, movement and traversal should feel exciting, but they often feel like a means to an end rather than an enjoyable part of the experience.

[h2] Final Thoughts [/h2]

I do not think Cyberpunk 2077 is a terrible game, nor do I think it deserves the extreme praise it often receives. It is a visually impressive action game with some well-written side content, but it falls short of being the deep RPG experience it was marketed as. For me, it sits firmly in the middle. Not bad, not great, just a 5/10 experience that I finished without ever feeling truly engaged.

Cá estamos, indo para os seis anos de lançamento de Cyberpunk 2077. E lembro muito bem a sensação e o hype pré-lançamento com todos os trailers, vazamentos e notícias do game, ainda mais de uma desenvolvedora extremamente famosa que também fez um dos jogos mais marcantes que eu joguei: The Witcher 3. E acho que é isso que a CD Projekt RED brilha; brilha em marcar as pessoas com seus jogos. Claro, o jogo saiu e foi uma grande decepção, principalmente com as altas expectativas, e confesso que também me decepcionei muito, não pelas mentiras ou bugs, mas pelo potencial deste mundo (ou melhor, desta cidade). Porém é inegável depois desses longos anos o jogo foi sendo consertado e atualizado e mostrou perfeitamente o brilho que Cyberpunk tem. Mostrou o brilho de uma cidade distópica, anarcocapitalista, com um neoliberalismo que mostra a primazia da desgraça capitalista, com grandes corporações governando Night City e o capital como forma de destruição e poder, sendo o dinheiro mais importante que todas as vidas dentro da cidade. De fato, uma cidade que não existe finais felizes, mas que vende muito bem a ilusão da cidade dos sonhos, do caminho mais rápido e certo para a série A. Uma cidade que engole e te mantém como uma vítima da própria fome, como um animal controlando sua presa. A cidade é um animal vivo, e ela se mostra à noite com seus shows de luzes pronto para atrair novas vítimas que serão devoradas lentamente sem que saibam o porquê. E bizarramente, a CD Projekt RED mostra isso de uma maneira de se encantar os olhos. Não só pela cidade, pela arquitetura que mescla do cyber pro retroprunk, dos personagens extremamente bem desenvolvidos e imersos em dilemas e dificuldades na cidade, assim como a história que é contada que mostra o quão profundo é esse mundo, e como essa história é contada através da ótica de V. E de fato, aqui o que me encanta é o quanto esse mundo pode te contar histórias, e o quanto isso pode te despertar sentimentos (em principal tristeza), melancolia, mas uma vibe e uma sensação indescritível. A soundtrack do game torna isso muito mais incrível, com músicas insanas e que inevitavelmente te afogam e te emergem nessa cidade e no mundo, como se você fizesse parte dele. Desde que joguei o game e zerei eu não paro de sentir saudades de Night City, dos personagens,  e zerar me deu uma certo vazio, uma solidão --- solidão essa que só os melhores jogos podem oferecer, oferecer esses mistos de sensações e uma marca severa na sua alma. Dito isso, Cyberpunk 2077 foi um jogo que me marcou e definitivamente um dos melhores jogos na história dos videogames e espero um dia poder estar voltando para Night City seja para uma segunda rodada ou um jogo completamente novo. Definitivamente um MUST PLAY GAME. Não morra antes de jogar Cyberpunk 2077 pelo menos uma vez. Te vejo em Night City, tchum!

游戏确实很上瘾，很久没有这么上瘾过了，之前令我这么上瘾的还是辐射3、上古卷轴5这种ARPG，地图非常大，任务非常多，我玩的最高难度开局，人物成长比较平滑，技能点还可以随便洗（如果属性点也能洗就更牛逼了）。特别是潜行这块（最高难度不得不玩潜行啊），它设计得就像细胞分裂、耻辱这类潜行游戏一样好，不仅有各种机关、暗道，还得利用黑客技能吸引敌人什么的，真的就得好好思考怎么去破解关卡。最高难度的经验和金钱收益也非常可观，基本上一个任务就可以升一级，快速升级获得技能点，钱又可以去买武器装备，就可以切换成你喜欢玩的别的流派了。

如果说让我不够满意的，就是义体词缀系统，升级才能换词缀，而且词缀搭配那么多，数值范围又那么大，要投入太多的资金和时间进去了。如果说是升级的时候选择要替换的某一个词条，而不是3个全部打乱重新选还差不多，这样升级3次就可以把3个词条全部换掉了。然后再加入一个提升词缀数值的功能，喂相应阶级的材料就能把例如原来的3的近战伤害提升到4，然后逐步提升到7.5满值。另外词缀根据不同的部位应该也有合理的选项，比如表皮和骨骼应该是偏防御的，手臂手掌应该是偏攻击的，腿部应该是偏移动的，不然一个劲地堆攻击，太无脑了。
其次就是那么多结局里就没有一个圆满的，虽然说每个结局都比较贴合实际，比如主角消失2年后物是人非了等等，而且万恶的资本主下的夜之城迎来的只能是一个又一个荒板，但是不让V活着就很让人不爽，难道是因为V太强大了，连暴恐机动队都秒杀，所以才不能活着吗？可能也正因如此，我和许多网友都不愿意通关，就想在夜之城里一直做义警，做一个超级英雄，哪怕不能剧情上推翻荒板，也要惩恶扬善。如果你想V活着，选择帕南并且让V留下来应该是最好的，毕竟它是开放式结局，并没有把V写死——但夜之城的传说也永远成为了传说

Quizás no llegue a ser la obra maestra que es The Witcher 3, pero está muy cerca. Los mejores gráficos de los últimos 10 años, sin dudas. Excelente jugabilidad y opciones de progresión, así como gran sensación de disparo y mecánicas de conducción. La expansión Phantom Liberty termina de redondear el paquete con una historia maravillosa y emocionante a partes iguales. Hace de todo, y todo lo hace muy bien. Recomendado sin dudas.

J'ai fait Cyberpunk sur le tard, en fin d'année 2025.

Je faisais partie des rares qui n'étaient pas fans de The Witcher 3, du fait de son gameplay (entre autres choses), et j'avais donc un apriori négatif, me disant que même si l'univers du jeu avait l'air cool, le gameplay m'aurait complètement sortie du délire, comme pour The Witcher…

Alors, soyons honnêtes, les premières minutes n'ont pas été très plaisantes. J'avais voulu jouer avec la manette et, clairement, c'est une erreur. Je ne sais pas comment c'est possible de faire aussi mauvais en terme de gameplay à la manette...
Malgré plusieurs tentatives de configuration pour améliorer cela en essayant d'enlever la latence, l'accélération de la caméra, ... je n'étais toujours pas satisfait et je me suis donc résolu à passer au clavier-souris. Évidemment, même comme ça, il a fallu remapper les touches ZQSD parce que malgré le budget mis dans ce jeu, le layout n'est pas détecté. M'enfin…

Passer ces difficultés, j'ai découvert un jeu plaisant de bout en bout.

La ville de Night City est agréable à parcourir (enfin, dans son genre hein) et la qualité d'écriture des quêtes secondaires est vraiment au-dessus de tout ce qui se fait dans les autres jeux, encore aujourd'hui.
De manière générale, l'univers est cohérent, riche, et les personnages sont réellement attachants, si bien qu’on a un pincement au cœur au moment de désinstaller le jeu et de passer à autre chose. L'histoire est prenante et la seule raison pour laquelle on ne la rush pas, c'est pour avoir le plaisir de faire les quêtes secondaires de qualité.

Le gameplay (clavier-souris donc), y compris le gunfight, est plaisant. C’est le jour et la nuit avec le gameplay manette…

Niveau stabilité, je n'ai eu aucun problème. Un unique écran noir lors d'un voyage rapide en 80h de jeu.
Je note cependant que la zone du DLC (Dogtown) semble plus demandante, sans raison apparente.
J'ai joué avec le Ray Tracing d'activé, sur Linux.

Verdict: Recommended – But Don’t Compare with The Witcher 3

Playtime: ~240 hours

Pros:

World-Building: Cyberpunk 2077 truly shines in its world-building. As someone who loves dystopian futures—think Blade Runner or Judge Dredd—I was hoping for that classic mix of grim, tech-heavy urban landscapes, with towering mega-corporations, a hazy, polluted atmosphere, and flying cars. Unfortunately, you can’t drive a flying car here ☹, but the world is still vast and fascinating. You’ll enjoy driving through dense cityscapes, poor suburbs, and even some sparse desert areas. While the world isn’t quite as alive or dynamic as The Witcher 3 (CD Projekt Red’s masterpiece), there’s still so much to explore—from rogue AIs to empathic machines and unpredictable weapons. It’s a rich experience, even if it’s a bit more focused on tech and hacking than the pure dystopian thrill I initially hoped for.

Customization: The character customization options are a major highlight. While Cyberpunk 2077 is primarily a first-person shooter, it goes far beyond that. Whether you want to play as a sneaky cyber-ninja, a gun-blazing Autobot, or a cyber-psycho samurai, the game offers huge freedom in how you approach combat and quests. There are countless ways to tailor your character to fit your preferred playstyle, which makes each playthrough feel unique and rewarding.

Quests: One of the game’s strongest points. Besides the main storyline, there are numerous side quests that involve deeply developed characters, each with their own backstory, motivations, and goals. It’s your choice which quests to follow, and honestly, I found myself invested in almost every character. These quests give the game emotional depth, and I found myself genuinely caring about the fate of the people I encountered.

Graphics: If your system can handle it, Cyberpunk 2077 is visually stunning. The ray-tracing effects are on par with games like Control, and the lighting, weather, and environmental effects are simply breathtaking. The world looks incredible, especially at night, when the neon lights and holographic advertisements really shine.

DLC – Phantom Liberty: The Phantom Liberty DLC refines the Cyberpunk experience in many ways. It tightens up the pacing, improves the overall structure, and offers some of the best quests in the game. The story is more compelling than the main game’s, and the new characters and settings blend seamlessly into the world. Honestly, it’s everything I was hoping the base game would be, but with more focus and polish.

Cons:

World Liveliness: While the world is detailed and expansive, it doesn’t quite feel as alive as I expected. NPCs can seem a bit static, and the dynamic interaction with the world isn’t as immersive as in The Witcher 3. It’s a great backdrop, but it doesn’t have the same level of immersion that makes a game truly feel "alive."

Performance Issues (Launch): My first experience with Cyberpunk 2077 was a bit of a letdown. The performance was poor, with low framerates and constant stuttering, especially while driving. There were also plenty of bugs—NPCs would pop in and out, and I’d occasionally lose characters entirely. After a series of patches, though, the game became much more stable. By 2025, when I decided to dive back in for Phantom Liberty, the performance had significantly improved, and I could finally experience the game as it was meant to be.

Audio: The music is decent but not remarkable. It serves its purpose in creating atmosphere but doesn’t have any standout tracks that I’d listen to outside the game. It’s functional but lacks the musical impact that The Witcher 3 had.

Final Verdict:

Cyberpunk 2077 is a game that has a lot to offer, but it’s important to go in with realistic expectations. If you’re expecting another Witcher 3, you may be disappointed, but if you’re a fan of dystopian settings and futuristic tech, you’ll find plenty to enjoy. The character customization, side quests, and vast world are major strengths, and the new Phantom Liberty DLC really polishes the experience, proving that CD Projekt Red can deliver when they focus on refining their formula.

In the end, it’s not perfect, but it’s a solid, engaging game with a ton of potential. With the improvements made over time and the excellent DLC, Cyberpunk 2077 proves that it’s definitely worth your time. So, don’t compare it to The Witcher 3, enjoy it for what it is, and embrace the chaos of being a cyber-enhanced badass in Night City.
